cues.title: 跟随一个像素
cues.caption: 纸上的一个点，要经过一整条成像链。
cues.captionEn: One printed dot travels through an entire imaging process.
cues.zh: 打印机一响，纸上就有了字。可激光究竟照在哪里？先跟住这个橙色像素。我们打开外壳，看看它怎样从一条指令，变成纸上摸得到的碳粉。
cues.en: A printer hums, and a page appears. But where does the laser actually shine? Follow the orange pixel as we open the machine and trace an instruction all the way to a mark on paper.

cues.title: 认识感光鼓
cues.caption: 激光照的是感光鼓，纸张走另一条路。
cues.captionEn: The laser reaches the drum; paper follows a separate path.
cues.zh: 中间这根圆筒叫感光鼓。上方是光路，下方才是纸张的通道。先分清这两条路：光负责安排图案，纸负责接走图案，它们并不直接碰面。
cues.en: The central cylinder is the imaging drum. Light approaches from above; paper passes below. Keep those paths separate in your mind: the light arranges a pattern, and the paper collects it later.

cues.title: 均匀充电
cues.caption: 先把鼓面充成均匀负电位。
cues.captionEn: First, give the drum an even negative potential.
cues.zh: 让鼓转起来。充电辊先把表面处理得一样，暂时没有任何图案。这里演示的是负电荷系统；橙色位置和旁边的空白位置，此刻还没有区别。
cues.en: As the drum turns, the charging roller prepares an even surface. There is no image yet. In this negative-charge teaching model, our orange position starts out electrically just like the surrounding blank area.

cues.title: 用光写入
cues.caption: 曝光改变电位，先写出看不见的图案。
cues.captionEn: Exposure changes potential, creating an invisible pattern.
cues.zh: 现在从上方看。激光扫过需要成像的位置，让那里的电位变得没那么负。图案已经写好了，只不过它还是电荷的差别。激光没有把纸烧黑。
cues.en: Look down along the optical path. The laser scans the intended image and makes those regions less negative. The pattern now exists as an electrical difference. Nothing has been burned into the paper.

cues.title: 碳粉显影
cues.caption: 带电碳粉把电位图案变成可见图案。
cues.captionEn: Charged toner makes the electrical pattern visible.
cues.zh: 显影辊带来细小的碳粉。注意橙色像素附近：碳粉在电场作用下留到曝光区域，旁边的空白区保持干净。刚才看不见的潜像，终于显出来了。
cues.en: The developer brings in tiny toner particles. Watch the orange pixel: the electric field guides toner onto the exposed region while the nearby background stays clear. The invisible image is becoming a visible one.

cues.title: 看清电场
cues.caption: 显影取决于各部件之间的电位差。
cues.captionEn: Development depends on potential differences between components.
cues.zh: 停近一点。别把这一幕简单理解成正负相吸。鼓面、碳粉和显影辊都有各自的电位；它们之间的电场，才决定碳粉往哪里走、在哪里留下。
cues.en: Let us stay close for a moment. This is more than a simple opposite-charges story. The drum, toner and developer have different electrical conditions; the resulting field determines where toner moves and where it stays.

cues.title: 把像交给纸
cues.caption: 转印电场让碳粉离开鼓面，来到纸面。
cues.captionEn: The transfer field moves toner from drum to paper.
cues.zh: 纸到了。鼓面与纸张以配合的速度经过接触区，转印电场把碳粉带到纸上。橙色像素换了位置，却还是同一个图案。现在用手一擦，它还可能掉。
cues.en: Here comes the paper. Drum and sheet move through the transfer region at matching surface speeds. An electric field brings the toner across. Our pixel is on paper now, but the image is still fragile.

cues.title: 热与压力
cues.caption: 加热软化树脂，压力帮助碳粉黏合纸纤维。
cues.captionEn: Heat softens toner resin; pressure helps it bond to paper.
cues.zh: 接下来经过这对辊子。碳粉里有树脂，受热会软化；再加上压力，就能与纸纤维牢固黏合。这才是定影。纸刚出来时温热，原因主要在这里。
cues.en: The sheet now passes between these rollers. Toner contains resin that softens with heat; pressure helps bond it to the paper fibers. This is fusing, and it explains much of the warmth of a freshly printed page.

cues.title: 清洁再出发
cues.caption: 清掉残粉与残余电荷，鼓面才可以重新使用。
cues.captionEn: Remove leftover toner and charge before reusing the drum.
cues.zh: 纸已经走远，感光鼓的任务却还没结束。刮片清掉残粉，残余电荷也被消除。否则上一张图案就可能影响下一张。清洁完成，鼓面重新回到起点。
cues.en: The paper leaves, but the drum has another job. A blade removes leftover toner, and residual charge is cleared. Without that reset, one image could affect the next. The surface is ready for another cycle.

cues.title: 连起来看
cues.caption: 充电 → 曝光 → 显影 → 转印 → 定影。
cues.captionEn: Charge, expose, develop, transfer, then fuse.
cues.zh: 把镜头拉远，再连起来看一遍。电荷准备表面，光安排位置，碳粉让图案现身，电场把它交给纸，热和压力把它固定。每一步都给下一步创造条件。
cues.en: Pull back and connect the sequence. Charge prepares the surface, light selects the positions, toner reveals the image, a field transfers it, and heat and pressure make it lasting. Each stage prepares the next.

cues.title: 机械同步
cues.caption: 共同节距和表面速度，让各部件配合。
cues.captionEn: Shared pitch and matched surface speeds coordinate the parts.
cues.zh: 再看齿轮和皮带。它们不是背景装饰：传动必须连续，鼓面与纸张不能各转各的。这里用教学剖面放慢过程，真实机器会把大量像素连续送过这些部件。
cues.en: Notice the gears and belt. They coordinate motion rather than merely decorate the machine. Drum and paper cannot move independently. This cutaway slows the process down; a real printer carries many pixels through it continuously.

cues.title: 带走一个判断
cues.caption: 激光写电荷，碳粉留图案，定影让它牢固。
cues.captionEn: Light writes charge; toner forms the image; fusing makes it last.
cues.zh: 回到最初的问题：一束光怎么变成字？它先改变电荷，再借碳粉、纸张、热和压力完成接力。下次拿到一张打印纸，想想这个像素刚刚走完的路。
cues.en: So how does light become a letter? It first changes charge, then hands the job to toner, paper, heat and pressure. The next time you collect a print, think of the journey hidden inside each dot.

cues.title: 从踏板出发
cues.caption: 跟住金色链节，看动力怎样绕一圈。
cues.captionEn: Follow the gold link around the drivetrain.
cues.zh: 为什么上坡要换挡？先不记齿比。跟着金色链节走一圈：脚转动前链盘，链条牵动后飞轮，后轴再带着轮子前进。动力沿着这条路传过去。
cues.en: Why do we shift before a climb? Forget the formula for a moment. Follow the gold link: your foot turns the chainring, the chain pulls the rear sprocket, and the rear axle drives the wheel.

cues.title: 链节怎样接住齿
cues.caption: 齿与链节共享同一个节距。
cues.captionEn: Teeth and links share the same pitch.
cues.zh: 靠近看。每颗齿都要接住对应的链节，间距不能随便画。链条绕过两个轮，再从另一侧回来，形成闭环。连续啮合，才有连续而可信的传动。
cues.en: Move closer. Each tooth must meet a matching link, so their spacing is not arbitrary. The chain wraps both sprockets and returns along the other side. A continuous loop makes continuous transmission possible.

cues.title: 数一圈
cues.caption: 前链盘转一圈，拉过与齿数相同数量的链节。
cues.captionEn: One chainring turn advances one link per tooth.
cues.zh: 现在数前链盘的一圈。三十四颗齿，就拉过三十四个节距的链条。后面只有二十四颗齿，接完这些链节，就必须转过一圈多。速度关系从这里出来。
cues.en: Count one turn of the chainring. Thirty-four teeth advance thirty-four chain pitches. The rear sprocket has twenty-four teeth, so receiving that chain takes more than one revolution. That is where the speed ratio comes from.

cues.title: 看见传动比
cues.caption: 后轴转速 = 踏频 × 前齿数 ÷ 后齿数。
cues.captionEn: Rear speed equals cadence times front teeth divided by rear teeth.
cues.zh: 看下面的传动比。三十四除以二十四，大约是一点四二。脚转一圈，后轴转一点四二圈。这里是两轴教学传动架，帮助我们把这个比例直接看出来。
cues.en: The ratio below is thirty-four divided by twenty-four, about one point four two. One pedal revolution produces that many rear revolutions. This two-axle teaching rig makes the relationship easy to see.

cues.title: 换小飞轮
cues.caption: 相同踏频，小飞轮让后轴转得更多。
cues.captionEn: At the same cadence, a smaller sprocket turns the axle faster.
cues.zh: 换成十二齿的小飞轮。脚还是按原来的节奏转，后轴却明显加快。链条每秒走过的长度没变，较小的轮子接完它，需要转更多圈。
cues.en: Switch to the twelve-tooth rear sprocket. The pedals keep their rhythm, but the rear axle speeds up. The chain advances at the same rate; the smaller sprocket must turn more times to receive it.

cues.title: 速度的代价
cues.caption: 同样的链条拉力，小飞轮提供的轴上扭矩更小。
cues.captionEn: For the same chain pull, a smaller sprocket gives less axle torque.
cues.zh: 快了，为什么会更费力？链条的拉力作用在更小的半径上，转动后轴的力矩就更小。想克服同样的阻力，你往往得在踏板上给出更大的力。
cues.en: Why can that faster gear feel harder? Chain pull acts at a smaller radius, producing less torque at the rear axle. To overcome the same resistance, you generally need to push harder on the pedals.

cues.title: 换大飞轮
cues.caption: 大飞轮以较低轮速换取更有利的力矩。
cues.captionEn: A larger rear sprocket trades wheel speed for torque.
cues.zh: 现在换成三十二齿。后轴慢下来，作用半径却变大了。用更低的前后齿比，你可以更轻松地转动负载，所以陡坡上往往会选更大的后飞轮。
cues.en: Now choose thirty-two teeth. The rear axle slows, but the chain acts at a larger radius. The lower ratio makes the load easier to turn, which is why a larger rear sprocket often helps on a steep climb.

cues.title: 把路抬起来
cues.caption: 坡度增加，维持相同速度需要更大的驱动力。
cues.captionEn: A steeper road requires more driving force at the same speed.
cues.zh: 把路抬高一点。除了滚动和空气阻力，你还得对抗沿坡向下的重力分量。看看所需踏板力怎么变。变速能调整你出力的方式，不能让坡度消失。
cues.en: Raise the road. Alongside rolling resistance and drag, you must now overcome a larger downhill component of gravity. Watch the required pedal force rise. Gearing changes how you supply effort; it cannot remove the hill.

cues.title: 换节奏
cues.caption: 踏频改变，链速与轮速一起改变。
cues.captionEn: Changing cadence changes both chain speed and wheel speed.
cues.zh: 保持齿轮不动，慢一点踩，再快一点踩。链速和后轴转速一起变化。齿比决定两者的比例，踏频决定运行的节奏；这两个调节不能混为一谈。
cues.en: Keep the gears fixed and vary the pedaling rhythm. Chain speed and rear speed change together. The gear ratio sets their relationship; cadence sets the pace. Those are two different controls over the ride.

cues.title: 能量没有免费午餐
cues.caption: 省力不等于少做相同路程所需的功。
cues.captionEn: Less pedal force does not erase the work of a climb.
cues.zh: 省下的力并没有凭空变成能量。爬同样的高度，仍要增加重力势能。低挡通常需要踩更多圈；在相同踏频下，也会走得更慢。速度和力在互相交换。
cues.en: An easier push does not create energy. Climbing the same height still requires a gain in gravitational potential energy. A lower gear usually takes more pedal turns and, at the same cadence, moves you more slowly.

cues.title: 实际骑行的边界
cues.caption: 读数表示维持所选踏频所需的力和功率。
cues.captionEn: The readouts show the effort needed to maintain the selected cadence.
cues.zh: 看一下功率。模型算的是维持所选踏频需要多少输出，不代表骑车人一定做得到。它包含坡度、滚阻和风阻；换挡瞬间与拨链器动作，则没有在这里模拟。
cues.en: Check the power readout. The model calculates what maintaining your chosen cadence would require, not what a rider can necessarily deliver. It includes slope, rolling resistance and drag, while leaving out the transient shifting mechanism.

cues.title: 回到上坡
cues.caption: 前小后大更轻，前大后小更快。
cues.captionEn: Smaller front and larger rear favor easier pedaling.
cues.zh: 再看这三次对比。上坡想轻一点，就降低前后齿比；平路想在相同踏频下快一点，就提高它。记住这条链路，比只背一句“大齿轮省力”更可靠。
cues.en: Compare the gears once more. Lower the front-to-rear ratio for an easier climb; raise it for more speed at a given cadence. Following the chain gives you a more reliable rule than simply calling one gear large or small.

cues.title: 拉起再松手
cues.caption: 高度先储存能量，松手后开始转化。
cues.captionEn: Height stores energy that motion can release.
cues.zh: 把摆球拉到一边，先停住。它还没有速度，但已经比最低点高。松手后，这一点高度开始变成运动。我们跟完整个来回，看看能量和时间各自怎么变化。
cues.en: Lift the bob and hold it still. It has no speed yet, but it sits above its lowest point. Release it, and that height begins turning into motion. Follow a full swing to separate energy from timing.

cues.title: 为什么往回摆
cues.caption: 重力沿圆弧方向的分量，把摆球拉向最低点。
cues.captionEn: The tangential part of gravity pulls the bob toward the bottom.
cues.zh: 线把摆球约束在圆弧上。重力一直向下，其中沿着圆弧的那一部分，让它朝最低点加速。线的拉力主要改变运动方向，在这个理想模型里并不做功。
cues.en: The string constrains the bob to a circular arc. Gravity points downward; its tangential component accelerates the bob toward the bottom. The string mainly redirects motion and does no work in this ideal model.

cues.title: 经过最低点
cues.caption: 最低处势能最小，速度最大。
cues.captionEn: At the bottom, potential energy is lowest and speed is highest.
cues.zh: 看它经过中间。位置最低的时候，势能条变短，动能条变长。它不会在这里停下，因为刚才加速积累的速度还在，惯性带着它继续向另一边走。
cues.en: Watch the crossing. At the lowest point, the potential-energy bar is short and the kinetic-energy bar is long. The bob does not stop there: its accumulated speed carries it onward toward the other side.

cues.title: 在另一端转身
cues.caption: 到达端点，速度降到零，方向反转。
cues.captionEn: At an endpoint, speed reaches zero before reversing.
cues.zh: 上升时，速度又变回高度。到最远处，摆球短暂静止，却没有失去全部能量；能量主要存回了势能。随后重力让它返回，交换过程再来一遍。
cues.en: On the way up, speed turns back into height. At the far end the bob pauses, but its energy has not vanished; most is potential again. Gravity then brings it back through the same exchange.

cues.title: 一整个周期
cues.caption: 从同一位置、同一运动方向回来，才算一周期。
cues.captionEn: A full period returns to the same position and direction.
cues.zh: 什么叫摆一次？要回到同一位置，而且运动方向也相同，才算完整周期。只从左边到右边，是半个周期。下方的角度曲线把这件事记录了下来。
cues.en: What counts as one oscillation? A complete period returns to the same position with the same direction of motion. Left endpoint to right endpoint is only half a period. The angle trace records that repeating pattern.

cues.title: 换一条长线
cues.caption: 摆长增加，周期按平方根关系增大。
cues.captionEn: Period grows with the square root of length.
cues.zh: 换长一点的线，用相同角度释放。它往返得更慢了。小角度下，周期与摆长的平方根成正比；所以长度翻倍，周期并不会直接翻倍。
cues.en: Use a longer string and release from the same angle. The motion takes longer. For small swings, period grows with the square root of length, so doubling the length does not double the period.

cues.title: 改变质量
cues.caption: 理想单摆里，质量改变能量，不改变周期。
cues.captionEn: In an ideal pendulum, mass changes energy, not period.
cues.zh: 把摆球加重，再用同样的摆长释放。能量变大了，往返节奏却几乎没变。重力随质量变大，惯性也同比变大，两者在运动方程里抵消了。
cues.en: Make the bob heavier while keeping the length and release angle fixed. Its energy rises, but the rhythm stays the same. Gravitational force and inertia both scale with mass, so mass cancels from the motion equation.

cues.title: 搬到月球
cues.caption: 重力减弱，相同摆长的钟摆走得更慢。
cues.captionEn: Weaker gravity makes the same pendulum slower.
cues.zh: 现在把它搬到月球。摆长和质量都不动，只降低重力。把摆球拉回来的作用弱了，来回就更慢。用地球重力校准的摆钟，不能直接拿到月球上计时。
cues.en: Now move the experiment to the Moon. Keep length and mass fixed, and reduce gravity. The restoring effect weakens, so each swing takes longer. A pendulum clock calibrated on Earth would not keep the same time there.

cues.title: 大角度的差别
cues.caption: 大摆幅会偏离小角度周期公式。
cues.captionEn: Large swings depart from the small-angle period formula.
cues.zh: 回到地球，拉得更高一点。你熟悉的周期公式有个前提：摆角要小。这里真正计算的是非线性方程，大幅摆动会更慢，不能拿小角公式当作所有情况的精确答案。
cues.en: Back on Earth, release from a much larger angle. The familiar period formula assumes a small swing. This simulation uses the nonlinear equation, so large swings take longer; the small-angle readout is only an approximation.

cues.title: 增加阻尼
cues.caption: 阻尼把机械能转移给环境。
cues.captionEn: Damping transfers mechanical energy to the surroundings.
cues.zh: 给它加一点阻尼。每次回来都低一点，动能和势能的总和也逐渐下降。能量没有被消灭，而是通过空气阻力、摩擦等过程转移到了环境中。
cues.en: Add damping. Each return reaches a little less height, and the total of kinetic and potential energy falls. Energy is not destroyed; resistance and friction transfer it into the surroundings, mostly as heat.

cues.title: 真实的摆钟
cues.caption: 真实摆钟需要补充损耗，并保持稳定的摆动。
cues.captionEn: A real clock must replace losses and maintain a steady swing.
cues.zh: 想让钟一直走，光靠第一次松手可不够。真实摆钟需要从重锤或发条获得能量，定期补回损耗。这个实验没有擒纵机构，所以有阻尼时，它最终会停下来。
cues.en: A clock cannot run forever on one release. Real pendulum clocks draw energy from a weight or spring to replace losses. There is no escapement in this experiment, so damping eventually brings the bob to rest.

cues.title: 分清三个问题
cues.caption: 摆长和重力定节奏，阻尼改振幅，质量改能量尺度。
cues.captionEn: Length and gravity set the rhythm; damping changes amplitude.
cues.zh: 最后把三个问题分开：摆长和重力主要决定节奏，阻尼决定振幅怎样衰减，质量改变能量的尺度。看懂这三条关系，再去调参数，每次变化就都有原因可循。
cues.en: Separate the three questions. Length and gravity mainly set the rhythm, damping controls the fading amplitude, and mass sets the energy scale. With those relationships in mind, every change in the experiment has a reason.

cues.title: 热去了哪里
cues.caption: 冰箱把箱内的热搬到房间里。
cues.captionEn: A refrigerator moves heat from its interior into the room.
cues.zh: 冰箱里面冷，背后却常常发热。它不是在制造一种叫“冷”的东西，而是在把热搬出去。跟住管路里的亮点，我们从一圈制冷循环，找到这笔能量的去向。
cues.en: The inside is cold, but the back can feel warm. A refrigerator does not manufacture a substance called cold; it moves heat. Follow the bright marker around the circuit to see where that energy goes.

cues.title: 一个闭合回路
cues.caption: 制冷剂在封闭管路中循环，正常运行不被消耗。
cues.captionEn: Refrigerant circulates in a sealed loop rather than being consumed.
cues.zh: 先看完整管路。制冷剂流过四个主要环节，再回到起点。正常工作时，它反复使用，不会像燃料一样每转一圈就消耗掉。改变的是压力、温度和液汽状态。
cues.en: Start with the entire pipe circuit. Refrigerant passes through four main stages and returns to the beginning. During normal operation it is reused rather than burned up. Its pressure, temperature and liquid-vapor state change along the way.

cues.title: 为什么需要压缩
cues.caption: 压缩机做功，把蒸气推向高压、高温状态。
cues.captionEn: Compressor work raises the vapor to higher pressure and temperature.
cues.zh: 回来的蒸气压力低。压缩机消耗电能，对蒸气做功，让它升压、升温。为什么要先变热？因为要向房间放热，制冷剂得比周围空气更热才行。
cues.en: Returning vapor is at low pressure. The compressor uses electrical energy to raise its pressure and temperature. Why make it hot first? To release heat into the room, the refrigerant must be hotter than the surrounding air.

cues.title: 背后的热管
cues.caption: 冷凝器向空气放热，让蒸气凝成液体。
cues.captionEn: The condenser releases heat while vapor becomes liquid.
cues.zh: 沿着热色管路走。制冷剂把热交给房间，自己逐渐冷凝成液体。这里不仅放出了从箱内搬来的热，还要放出压缩机输入的那份能量。
cues.en: Follow the warm-colored pipe. Refrigerant releases heat to the room and gradually condenses into liquid. That rejected heat includes both what was removed from the interior and the energy supplied by the compressor.

cues.title: 压力分成两侧
cues.caption: 高压侧与低压侧，让同一种制冷剂在不同温度下换热。
cues.captionEn: High and low pressures let one refrigerant exchange heat at different temperatures.
cues.zh: 注意管路不是到处都处于同一种压力。高压侧适合向室内放热，低压侧则能在更低温度下吸热。正是这种压力安排，让热可以从冷的箱内被搬到暖的房间。
cues.en: The loop does not have one pressure everywhere. The high-pressure side releases heat to the room; the low-pressure side can absorb heat at a much lower temperature. This pressure arrangement makes the heat-moving cycle possible.

cues.title: 经过节流装置
cues.caption: 节流降压，一部分液体闪蒸。
cues.captionEn: Throttling reduces pressure and flashes some liquid into vapor.
cues.zh: 液体接着经过狭窄的毛细管。压力下降，一部分液体迅速闪蒸，出口成为低温的液汽混合物。这里没有活塞在做有用的机械功，也不是把冷气从管子里挤出来。
cues.en: Liquid passes through a narrow capillary. The pressure drops, and some liquid flashes into vapor, leaving a cold mixture. This restriction does not produce useful shaft work, and it does not squeeze a supply of cold air into existence.

cues.title: 在箱内沸腾
cues.caption: 蒸发需要能量，热从食物和空气进入制冷剂。
cues.captionEn: Evaporation takes energy from the food and air.
cues.zh: 现在来到箱内的蒸发器。剩下的液体继续沸腾，需要吸收能量。这份能量来自食物和箱内空气，于是它们冷下来。低压蒸气随后回到压缩机，循环闭合。
cues.en: At the evaporator inside the cabinet, the remaining liquid boils. That change needs energy, supplied by the food and air inside, so they cool down. Low-pressure vapor then returns to the compressor, completing the loop.

cues.title: 算一笔能量账
cues.caption: 放到房间的热 = 箱内移出的热 + 输入电功。
cues.captionEn: Heat released equals heat removed plus electrical work.
cues.zh: 看这三个数。假设输入八十瓦电功，制冷系数是二点五，就能搬走两百瓦的热，而房间得到两百八十瓦。热流可以大于电功，因为机器还搬运了已有的热。
cues.en: Read the three numbers. With eighty watts of input and a coefficient of performance of two point five, two hundred watts are removed inside and two hundred eighty released outside. The machine moves existing heat as well as consuming electricity.

cues.title: 效率怎样理解
cues.caption: COP 描述每份电功搬运多少热，不是能量创造率。
cues.captionEn: COP measures heat moved per unit of work, not energy creation.
cues.zh: 把制冷系数调高，看看同样的输入能搬走多少热。超过一不违背能量守恒，因为分子是搬运的热量，分母是你额外付出的功。这和把电直接变热的效率不是一回事。
cues.en: Increase the coefficient and watch how much heat the same input can move. A value above one does not violate conservation: the numerator is transported heat, while the denominator is added work. It is not an energy-creation efficiency.

cues.title: 开门能降室温吗
cues.titleEn: Can an open fridge cool a room?
cues.caption: 门一直打开，房间最终多得到压缩机输入的能量。
cues.captionEn: With the door open, the room gains the compressor input overall.
cues.zh: 那么一直开着冰箱门，能给房间降温吗？箱内吸走的热也来自这个房间，背后又把它连同电功一起放回来。把整个房间作为系统，净增加的是压缩机输入的能量。
cues.en: Could leaving the door open cool the room? The absorbed heat would now come from that same room, then return at the back along with compressor work. For the room as a whole, the electrical input becomes a net heat gain.

cues.title: 再走完整一圈
cues.caption: 压缩、冷凝、节流、蒸发，四步缺一不可。
cues.captionEn: Compression, condensation, throttling and evaporation form one cycle.
cues.zh: 再跟亮点走一圈：先做功升压，再向外放热；接着降压，最后在箱内吸热。颜色表示教学状态，粒子的速度并不代表真实分子速度，实际管路也会因机型变化。
cues.en: Follow the marker once more: add work and pressure, reject heat, reduce pressure, then absorb heat inside. Colors illustrate the states, not literal molecular behavior. Real pipe layouts and operating conditions vary between refrigerators.

cues.title: 记住两面
cues.caption: 看见冷的一面，也要找到热被送去的地方。
cues.captionEn: Whenever you see cooling, look for where the heat is rejected.
cues.zh: 下次看到冰箱或空调，别只盯着冷的一面。找找它从哪里吸热，向哪里放热，又从哪里获得做功的能量。把这三条路径连起来，制冷的原理就清楚了。
cues.en: The next time you see a refrigerator or air conditioner, look beyond the cold side. Find where heat is absorbed, where it is rejected, and where work enters. Connect those three paths, and the mechanism becomes much clearer.

cues.title: 先看声压
cues.caption: 声音是空气压力随时间的起伏。
cues.captionEn: Sound is a variation in air pressure over time.
cues.zh: 耳机明明多放了一段声音，为什么反而安静？先看蓝色波形。它表示耳边空气压力的起伏，不是空气沿着这条曲线跑。声音抵达同一点时，压力变化会相加。
cues.en: How can a headphone add sound and make things quieter? Start with the blue waveform: it shows pressure varying at your ear, not air traveling along a drawn curve. At one point, pressure changes add together.

cues.title: 两个同向的波
cues.caption: 波峰对波峰，叠加后的起伏变大。
cues.captionEn: Peak meets peak, and the combined variation grows.
cues.zh: 让橙色波形加入，并且和蓝色保持同一个节奏。波峰遇到波峰，波谷遇到波谷，下方的结果就更大了。所以“多放一个声音”本身，并不会带来降噪。
cues.en: Add the orange wave in step with the blue one. Peak meets peak and trough meets trough, so the result below grows. Merely adding another sound does not produce noise cancellation; its timing matters.

cues.title: 慢慢错开
cues.caption: 相位描述两道波在周期中的相对位置。
cues.captionEn: Phase describes the waves’ relative positions in a cycle.
cues.zh: 把橙色波形慢慢移开。它们的频率没变，只是到达波峰的时刻不同了。这种相对错位叫相位差。留意下面的曲线，它会随着相位连续变化。
cues.en: Slide the orange waveform gradually. Its frequency stays the same, but its peaks arrive at different moments. That relative shift is phase difference. Watch the lower curve respond continuously as the timing changes.

cues.title: 正好反过来
cues.caption: 相同幅度、相反相位，在这个位置完全抵消。
cues.captionEn: Equal amplitudes and opposite phases cancel at this point.
cues.zh: 现在让蓝色的波峰正对橙色的波谷。一个增加压力，另一个同样多地降低压力，相加恰好为零。下面变平了：在这个理想位置，这个频率被抵消了。
cues.en: Align a blue peak with an orange trough. One raises pressure by exactly as much as the other lowers it. Their sum is zero. At this idealized listening point, this particular frequency is canceled.

cues.title: 幅度也要匹配
cues.caption: 相位对了，幅度不匹配仍会留下残余。
cues.captionEn: Correct phase still leaves a residual if amplitudes differ.
cues.zh: 保持反相，但把橙色波形缩小。蓝色的起伏没有被完全补上，残余又出现了。降噪需要的不只是“反着放”，还要把抵消声的幅度调到合适大小。
cues.en: Keep the opposite phase but reduce the orange amplitude. It no longer offsets the full blue wave, so a residual returns. Cancellation requires both suitable timing and a suitable amplitude, not just an inverted waveform.

cues.title: 恢复匹配
cues.caption: 把幅度调回来，残余再次降低。
cues.captionEn: Matching the amplitudes reduces the residual again.
cues.zh: 让橙色逐渐追上蓝色，看看残余怎样减小。耳机也需要估计耳边实际剩下多少声音，再调整输出。真实声场会变化，这不是设置一次就永远准确的关系。
cues.en: Bring the orange amplitude back toward the blue one and watch the residual shrink. Headphones must also estimate what remains near the ear and adjust their output. In a changing sound field, one fixed setting is not enough.

cues.title: 晚到两毫秒
cues.caption: 额外延迟会破坏原来的反相关系。
cues.captionEn: Extra delay breaks the original phase alignment.
cues.zh: 如果处理和传播让抵消声晚到了呢？这里增加两毫秒。原本对好的波峰与波谷重新错开，抵消开始变差。很短的延迟，也可能在波的周期里占据很大比例。
cues.en: What if processing and propagation make the cancellation sound arrive late? Add two milliseconds here. Peaks and troughs drift out of alignment, and cancellation worsens. A tiny delay can occupy a substantial fraction of a wave cycle.

cues.title: 频率改变后
cues.caption: 同样的延迟，在高频里对应更大的相位转动。
cues.captionEn: The same delay spans more of a cycle at higher frequencies.
cues.zh: 保持同样的延迟，再提高频率。波峰更密，相同的时间差就跨过更多周期比例。效果会随频率起伏，因此某个频率调好了，不等于所有声音都一起消失。
cues.en: Keep the delay and raise the frequency. The peaks are closer together, so the same time difference represents more phase rotation. The result varies with frequency; tuning one tone does not remove every sound at once.

cues.title: 不是全屋静音
cues.caption: 这个波形实验只描述一个位置的叠加。
cues.captionEn: This waveform experiment describes superposition at one point.
cues.zh: 我们一直在看同一个位置。如果换个位置，两种声音走过的距离就变了，相位关系也可能改变。所以耳机的主动降噪主要照顾耳边区域，并不会让整个房间同时静音。
cues.en: We have been observing one location. Move elsewhere and the two sounds travel different distances, changing their phase relationship. Headphone cancellation is designed around the ear; it does not silence an entire room at once.

cues.title: 耳机怎样跟上
cues.caption: 麦克风、控制器和扬声器持续配合。
cues.captionEn: Microphones, a controller and speakers work together continuously.
cues.zh: 真实耳机会用麦克风采集信息，让控制器估计合适的输出，再由扬声器播放。我们画出的两道正弦波只是最清楚的一小部分，完整控制还要面对佩戴变化和复杂噪声。
cues.en: A real headphone collects microphone signals, estimates an appropriate response and drives its speakers continuously. Our two sine waves isolate the clearest part of the idea. The full controller must also handle fit changes and complicated noise.

cues.title: 低频更容易理解
cues.caption: 稳定低频的周期较长，时间误差相对更容易控制。
cues.captionEn: Long, steady low-frequency cycles make timing easier to manage.
cues.zh: 把频率降回去，并消除额外延迟。稳定低频的周期比较长，更适合看清这种补偿；突发或复杂高频声音则更难处理。耳罩本身的被动隔音，也在贡献安静。
cues.en: Return to the lower frequency and remove the extra delay. Its longer, steadier cycle makes the compensation easier to understand. Sudden and complex high-frequency sounds are harder, while the earcups also provide passive isolation.

cues.title: 用三件事检查
cues.caption: 抵消要同时看幅度、相位与延迟。
cues.captionEn: Cancellation depends on amplitude, phase and delay together.
cues.zh: 最后再对齐一次。想判断为什么降噪变差，就依次看幅度、相位和延迟。波形相加没有魔法；真正困难的是，让正确的波在正确的时刻，到达正确的位置。
cues.en: Align the waves one last time. If cancellation deteriorates, consider amplitude, phase and delay together. Superposition is straightforward; the difficult part is delivering the right wave at the right place and the right moment.

cues.title: 位置从时间开始
cues.caption: 卫星发来时间信息，接收机据此估计距离。
cues.captionEn: Satellite timing signals let a receiver estimate distances.
cues.zh: 地图上的蓝点不是卫星拍到你的照片。卫星广播自己的位置和时间信息，手机估计信号走了多久，再把时间换成距离。问题于是变成：哪些位置符合这些距离？
cues.en: The blue dot is not a satellite photograph of you. Satellites broadcast position and timing information. Your receiver estimates travel time, converts it into distance, then asks which location is consistent with those measurements.

cues.title: 一个距离
cues.caption: 在二维里，与一个点等距的位置组成一个圆。
cues.captionEn: In two dimensions, equal distance from one point forms a circle.
cues.zh: 先把世界压成平面。知道离第一颗卫星多远，只能画出一个圆。圆上的每个点都满足这个距离，所以一个信号不能单独告诉你在圆的哪一边。
cues.en: Flatten the world to a plane first. One known distance gives us a circle. Every point on that circle satisfies the measurement, so one signal cannot tell us which side of the circle contains the receiver.

cues.title: 第二个距离
cues.caption: 两个圆通常相交于两个候选位置。
cues.captionEn: Two circles generally leave two candidate positions.
cues.zh: 加入第二个距离。两个圆通常会留下两个交点。我们已经排除了很多位置，但仍然有两个候选答案。只挑一个看起来顺眼的点，不算完成定位。
cues.en: Add a second distance. The circles generally intersect at two points. Most possible locations disappear, but two candidates remain. Choosing whichever looks convenient would not be a valid position fix; we need more information.

cues.title: 第三条约束
cues.caption: 第三个距离排除另一个交点。
cues.captionEn: A third distance removes the other intersection.
cues.zh: 第三个圆来了。只有一个候选点同时落在它上面，另一个被排除了。你看到的是距离约束共同确定位置，这种方法叫测距定位，不是靠测三个方向的角度。
cues.en: Here comes the third circle. Only one candidate also satisfies this distance, so the other disappears. Position is determined by combining range constraints. We are measuring distances here, not intersecting three measured angles.

cues.title: 把解代回去
cues.caption: 把求出的点代回每一条距离，检查残差。
cues.captionEn: Substitute the solution into every distance and check the residuals.
cues.zh: 怎么知道这个点算得对？把它到每个信号源的距离重新算一遍，再和观测值比较。差值叫残差。真实定位里测量有误差，通常需要寻找整体最符合观测的解。
cues.en: How do we check that dot? Recalculate its distance to every source and compare those values with the measurements. The differences are residuals. Real measurements contain errors, so receivers generally seek a solution that best fits them together.

cues.title: 从圆进入球面
cues.caption: 三维中，等距离的位置组成球面。
cues.captionEn: In three dimensions, a range defines a sphere.
cues.zh: 把平面打开，进入立体世界。一个距离现在对应一个球面，两个球面的交线通常是圆。定位多了高度这个未知量，二维图里的三圆结论不能原样照搬过来。
cues.en: Open the plane into three dimensions. One range now defines a sphere, and two spheres usually intersect in a circle. Height adds another unknown, so the three-circle conclusion from our flat diagram cannot simply be carried over unchanged.

cues.title: 手机时钟不够准
cues.caption: 接收机时钟误差会给多条测距带来共同偏移。
cues.captionEn: Receiver clock error adds a common bias to measured ranges.
cues.zh: 还有一个麻烦：手机的时钟不像卫星钟那样精确。如果它统一偏了一点，计算出来的多条距离都会一起偏。球面于是对不上，问题并不一定出在你的位置。
cues.en: There is another unknown: the receiver clock is not as precise as the satellite clocks. A shared timing offset biases several measured ranges together. The spheres then fail to meet properly, even if the receiver has not moved.

cues.title: 第四个未知量
cues.caption: 三个位置坐标，加一个时钟偏差。
cues.captionEn: Three position coordinates plus one receiver clock bias.
cues.zh: 现在数未知量：东西、南北、高度，再加接收机时钟偏差，一共四个。足够独立的卫星观测，才能把它们一起解出来。这也是常说至少需要四颗卫星的原因。
cues.en: Count the unknowns: three position coordinates and one receiver clock offset. We need enough independent satellite observations to estimate them together. That is the reason a basic three-dimensional fix is commonly described as requiring at least four satellites.

cues.title: 校正共同误差
cues.caption: 扣除共同偏差，球面重新对齐。
cues.captionEn: Removing the common bias brings the spheres into alignment.
cues.zh: 看这些球面一起收回来。模型正在从观测距离里扣除共同的时钟偏差，而不是随便移动某一颗卫星。调整到合适的位置和偏差后，多条约束就重新一致了。
cues.en: Watch the spheres adjust together. The model subtracts a shared clock bias from the observed ranges rather than arbitrarily moving one satellite. With a suitable position and offset, the separate constraints become consistent again.

cues.title: 卫星也讲站位
cues.caption: 卫星分布太集中，会让某些方向的位置更难确定。
cues.captionEn: Clustered satellites make some position directions harder to resolve.
cues.zh: 卫星并不是越多就一定越好，站位也很重要。如果都挤在相近方向，距离的一点误差就可能对应很大的位置变化。分布更展开，通常能提供更独立的几何约束。
cues.en: Satellite count is not the whole story; geometry matters too. When sources cluster in similar directions, small range errors can imply large position changes. A wider spread generally supplies more independent constraints on the solution.

cues.title: 实际天空更复杂
cues.titleEn: The real sky is more complicated
cues.caption: 大气、反射与轨道误差还会影响真实测距。
cues.captionEn: Atmosphere, reflections and orbit errors also affect real measurements.
cues.zh: 真实信号还会穿过大气、被建筑反射，卫星轨道信息也存在误差。这里的距离和时钟是缩放后的教学模型，没有把这些修正全部搬进来，所以不能当作真实定位器。
cues.en: Real signals travel through the atmosphere, may reflect from buildings, and rely on imperfect orbit information. Our scaled distance-and-clock model leaves out many of those corrections. It explains the geometry rather than serving as an actual navigation receiver.

cues.title: 重新认识蓝点
cues.caption: 蓝点是多条距离与时间信息共同约束出的解。
cues.captionEn: The blue dot is a solution constrained by distance and time.
cues.zh: 回到地图上的蓝点。它背后是一组不断更新的距离、时钟和几何约束。记住从一个圆，到多个球面，再到共同校正时钟的过程，你就看到了定位计算的骨架。
cues.en: Return to that blue dot. Behind it sits a continually updated set of ranges, timing estimates and geometric constraints. From one circle to several spheres and a shared clock correction, you have now seen the basic structure of the calculation.

cues.title: 一次回车
cues.caption: 一次加载包含寻找地址、连接、传输和绘制。
cues.captionEn: A page load includes lookup, connection, transfer and rendering.
cues.zh: 按下回车，页面似乎一下就出现了。我们把这段旅程放慢：请求得先找到地址，建立通道，拿回内容，浏览器才有东西可画。每一段等待，都有自己的原因。
cues.en: Press Enter and a page seems to appear at once. Slow that journey down: the request needs an address, a connection and content before the browser can draw anything. Each stretch of waiting has a different cause.

cues.title: 先找地址
cues.caption: DNS 把域名查询成可连接的地址。
cues.captionEn: DNS resolves a domain name into an address to contact.
cues.zh: 浏览器知道域名，却还需要服务器地址。第一次访问时，它向解析器询问。这个过程可能经过缓存和多级查询；图里把它概括成一段查找，不代表每次都走完整链路。
cues.en: The browser knows the domain name but needs an address to contact. It asks a resolver. Caches and several lookup stages may be involved; the diagram summarizes that work rather than claiming every visit follows a complete lookup chain.

cues.title: 建立可靠通道
cues.caption: 这里用 TCP 握手说明连接建立。
cues.captionEn: This model uses a TCP handshake to establish a connection.
cues.zh: 找到地址后，两端先建立连接。我们选的是基于传输控制协议的教学路径：双方交换消息，确认连接状态。来回一趟需要时间，距离远、网络慢时，这种等待会更明显。
cues.en: After finding the address, the endpoints establish a connection. This teaching path uses a transmission-control handshake to agree on connection state. A round trip takes time, especially when endpoints are far apart or the network is slow.

cues.title: 协商加密
cues.caption: TLS 验证服务端身份，并建立加密会话。
cues.captionEn: TLS verifies server identity and establishes an encrypted session.
cues.zh: 接着协商加密。浏览器要检查服务端身份，并建立保护后续通信的会话密钥。这一步解决的是通信安全，不是把网页画得更快；已经建立的安全连接，可以在条件允许时复用。
cues.en: Next comes encryption negotiation. The browser checks the server identity and establishes session keys to protect later communication. This step secures the exchange; it does not render the page. An existing secure connection can sometimes be reused.

cues.title: 请求到服务器
cues.caption: 发出请求后，还要等待服务器处理。
cues.captionEn: Sending the request is followed by server processing time.
cues.zh: 通道准备好，请求才真正到达服务端。服务器可能读取文件，也可能运行应用、访问数据库。图里的处理时间只是教学设定；即使网络很快，服务端忙也会让首个响应晚到。
cues.en: Once the channel is ready, the request reaches the server. The server may read files, run application code or consult a database. Its processing time here is illustrative: a busy server can delay the response even on a fast network.

cues.title: 内容分段回来
cues.caption: 响应逐步抵达，页面还会需要样式、脚本和图片。
cues.captionEn: Responses arrive progressively, with styles, scripts and images also needed.
cues.zh: 内容开始回来。网页通常不只有一份文本，还会引用样式、脚本、图片和字体。真实浏览器可以并发请求、边接收边处理；这里用串行阶段，帮助你分清每种工作的职责。
cues.en: Content starts arriving. A page usually references styles, scripts, images and fonts in addition to its initial document. Real browsers overlap requests and processing; our staged view separates responsibilities so the different kinds of work are visible.

cues.title: 代码变成像素
cues.caption: 解析、布局、绘制与合成，把内容变成画面。
cues.captionEn: Parsing, layout, painting and compositing produce the image.
cues.zh: 数据到了，还不是你看到的画面。浏览器要解析结构和样式，算出每个元素的位置，再绘制并合成屏幕。网络完成只是交接点，页面是否流畅还取决于这些后续工作。
cues.en: Received data is not yet the picture on your screen. The browser parses structure and styles, computes positions, paints and composites the result. Finishing the network transfer is a handoff; rendering still determines much of the visible experience.

cues.title: 第二次访问
cues.caption: 地址缓存与连接复用，能省去部分往返。
cues.captionEn: Address caching and connection reuse remove some round trips.
cues.zh: 现在原样访问第二次。地址还在缓存里，连接也还没断开，于是有些准备工作可以省掉。看时间线里被跳过的段落：同一网页，未必每次都重复第一次的等待。
cues.en: Visit the same page again while the address is cached and the connection remains open. Some setup work disappears. Watch the skipped sections: the same page does not necessarily repeat all the waiting from its first visit.

cues.title: 直接读本地资源
cues.caption: 新鲜资源命中缓存时，可以省去该资源的网络请求。
cues.captionEn: A fresh cached resource can avoid its network request.
cues.zh: 再进一步，资源本身还在新鲜的本地缓存里。这时连重新请求它都可能不需要，但浏览器仍然要把内容画出来。缓存省下了传输，并没有取消所有计算。
cues.en: Go one step further: the resource itself is still fresh in the local cache. Its network request can be avoided entirely, but the browser must still produce the page. Caching removes transfer work, not every computation.

cues.title: 如果丢了一段
cues.titleEn: What if a segment is lost?
cues.caption: 丢包和重传，会延长内容到达的等待。
cues.captionEn: Loss and retransmission can delay content delivery.
cues.zh: 把缓存关掉，再让一个分段丢失。等待变长了，因为可靠传输需要把缺失内容补回来。图里的额外时间只是示意；实际恢复方式和耗时，取决于拥塞、往返时延与协议细节。
cues.en: Disable the cache and lose a segment. Delivery takes longer because reliable transfer must recover the missing content. The extra delay shown is illustrative; actual recovery depends on congestion, round-trip time and protocol behavior.

cues.title: 换一条更远的路
cues.caption: 时延会影响多个阶段，不只影响下载。
cues.captionEn: Latency affects several stages, not just downloading.
cues.zh: 把往返时延调大。看看查地址、建连接和等响应怎样一起变长。带宽大，不代表第一屏一定快；需要多次往返时，时延也会成为明显的瓶颈。
cues.en: Increase the round-trip delay. Lookup, connection setup and response waiting all grow. High bandwidth does not guarantee a quick first screen: when several round trips are required, latency can become a major part of the delay.

cues.title: 按阶段找瓶颈
cues.caption: 先分清网络、服务端和渲染，再决定优化什么。
cues.captionEn: Separate network, server and rendering work before optimizing.
cues.zh: 最后把全程连起来。慢在查找、连接、服务端、传输，还是画页面？先定位阶段，再谈优化。这里演示 HTTP 二、TCP 和 TLS 一点三，其他协议的细节会不同。
cues.en: Connect the journey again. Is the delay in lookup, connection, server work, transfer or rendering? Identify the stage before choosing an optimization. This teaching path represents HTTP version two over TCP with a TLS version one-point-three handshake.

cues.title: 从一小块开始
cues.caption: 把图像放大成 8 × 8 像素块。
cues.captionEn: Zoom in to an eight-by-eight pixel block.
cues.zh: 一张照片变小以后，究竟丢了什么？先只看这六十四个像素。我们不拿整张图片做黑箱压缩，而是把一小块拆开，再亲眼看它怎样重建回来。
cues.en: When a photograph gets smaller, what is actually lost? Start with these sixty-four pixels. Instead of treating a whole image as a compression black box, we will take one small block apart and rebuild it in front of you.

cues.title: 换一种表达
cues.caption: 像素值可以改写成不同频率图案的组合。
cues.captionEn: Pixel values can be represented as a mixture of frequency patterns.
cues.zh: 同一块图像，不一定只能用六十四个亮度值表示。也可以问：它包含多少整体亮度、多少横向变化、多少纵向变化？这些明暗图案组合起来，仍能描述原来的像素。
cues.en: A block need not be described only as sixty-four brightness values. We can instead measure its overall brightness and its horizontal and vertical variations. A mixture of those patterns can still represent the original pixels.

cues.title: 认识基底图案
cues.caption: 每一种基底，都表示一种方向与速度的明暗变化。
cues.captionEn: Each basis pattern represents a direction and rate of brightness variation.
cues.zh: 看中间轮流出现的条纹。粗条纹变化慢，细条纹变化快；方向不同，描述的结构也不同。离散余弦变换，就是计算原图需要每种图案多少份。
cues.en: Watch the patterns in the middle. Broad stripes vary slowly; narrow stripes vary quickly, and different directions describe different structure. The discrete cosine transform calculates how much of each pattern the original block needs.

cues.title: 先只留平均亮度
cues.caption: 只留下直流系数，重建结果是一片均匀亮度。
cues.captionEn: Keeping only the DC coefficient reconstructs a uniform block.
cues.zh: 先只留第一项。右边变成一片均匀的灰，因为这一项描述整块的平均亮度。它能告诉你总体偏亮还是偏暗，却不能告诉你边缘在哪里。
cues.en: Keep only the first coefficient. The reconstruction becomes a uniform gray because this term describes average brightness across the block. It tells us whether the block is broadly light or dark, but cannot locate an edge.

cues.title: 加回低频
cues.caption: 低频先恢复大范围轮廓。
cues.captionEn: Low frequencies restore broad structure first.
cues.zh: 把变化比较慢的图案加回来。大范围的明暗分布开始出现，轮廓也逐渐可辨。低频不是“重要像素的位置”，而是跨越整块图像的一种变化方式。
cues.en: Add the slowly varying patterns. Broad light and dark regions return, and the outline becomes recognizable. A low-frequency coefficient is not the location of an important pixel; it describes a pattern extending across the whole block.

cues.title: 加回高频
cues.caption: 高频让边缘和细小变化逐步恢复。
cues.captionEn: High frequencies restore edges and finer variations.
cues.zh: 再加入变化更快的图案。边缘变清楚，细小起伏也回来了。如果所有系数都精确保留，再做逆变换，就能恢复原来的数值，除了有限计算精度带来的误差。
cues.en: Now add faster variations. Edges sharpen and finer details return. If every coefficient is preserved precisely, the inverse transform can recover the original values, apart from limited numerical precision. The transform itself is not the main source of loss.

cues.title: 变换不是压缩魔法
cues.titleEn: The transform is not the loss
cues.caption: DCT 改变表示方式；量化才开始丢失精度。
cues.captionEn: DCT changes representation; quantization discards precision.
cues.zh: 到这里，我们主要换了一种记法，并没有凭空减少六十四个数。真正的取舍从量化开始：不再精确保存每个系数，而是按规定步长取整，让一些细微差别合并。
cues.en: So far we have mainly changed the notation, not magically removed sixty-four numbers. The tradeoff begins with quantization: coefficients are rounded to specified steps, merging small differences that would otherwise require more precise values.

cues.title: 把量化变粗
cues.caption: 量化步长变大，更多系数变成零。
cues.captionEn: Larger quantization steps turn more coefficients into zero.
cues.zh: 把质量向下调，看看系数和重建图。量化更粗，一些小系数被舍成零。需要描述的信息更简单了，但原来不同的细节也被合并，逆变换不能把它们猜回来。
cues.en: Lower the quality setting and compare the coefficients with the reconstruction. Coarser rounding turns small coefficients into zeros. The description becomes simpler, but distinct details merge. The inverse transform cannot know which lost values were originally present.

cues.title: 看误差而非口号
cues.caption: 重建误差直接比较原始像素与恢复像素。
cues.captionEn: Reconstruction error compares original and recovered pixels.
cues.zh: 看误差读数，再看边缘。它衡量这块图重建后偏离原像素多少，并不等于人眼对整张照片的评分。某些图案容易压，尖锐边缘和细纹理往往更敏感。
cues.en: Read the error value, then inspect the edge. It measures how far this reconstructed block differs from its original pixels; it is not a complete perceptual score for a photograph. Sharp edges and fine textures can be especially sensitive.

cues.title: 颜色还有另一条路
cues.caption: 色度降采样减少颜色细节，和亮度块量化不同。
cues.captionEn: Chroma subsampling reduces color detail separately from luminance quantization.
cues.zh: 彩色照片还有颜色通道。常见编码会保留较多亮度细节，降低部分颜色分辨率，叫色度降采样。我们眼前实算的是亮度块，所以不能把它当成已经演示了所有彩色编码步骤。
cues.en: Color photographs introduce additional channels. Common encoders retain more brightness detail while reducing some color resolution through chroma subsampling. Our live calculation is a luminance block, so it does not claim to perform every stage of color encoding.

cues.title: 零怎样节省空间
cues.caption: 系数顺序与熵编码，进一步利用零和重复模式。
cues.captionEn: Coefficient ordering and entropy coding exploit zeros and repetition.
cues.zh: 系数产生很多零以后，还可以按规定顺序组织，再用游程和熵编码描述重复模式。这一步把统计规律变成更短的比特序列。但这里没有输出完整文件，非零系数数目也不是实际文件大小。
cues.en: Once many coefficients are zero, ordering and entropy coding can describe runs and recurring patterns compactly. That turns statistical regularity into fewer bits. We do not output a complete image file here, so a nonzero-coefficient count is not a file size.

cues.title: 把取舍看完整
cues.caption: 变换、量化、重建，让细节与表示成本形成取舍。
cues.captionEn: Transform, quantize and reconstruct to see the tradeoff.
cues.zh: 最后把质量拉回来。细节恢复，系数也更丰富了。记住这三步：变换找到结构，量化决定舍弃多少精度，重建把取舍重新变成像素。你现在能看见压缩到底在牺牲什么。
cues.en: Bring quality back up. Detail returns and the coefficients become richer. Remember the three steps: transform reveals structure, quantization chooses how much precision to discard, and reconstruction turns that choice back into pixels you can inspect.

cues.title: 独立的方向
cues.caption: 维度表示定位所需的独立坐标数量。
cues.captionEn: Dimension counts the independent coordinates needed to locate a point.
cues.zh: 四维究竟多了什么？先别急着想一个奇怪的立体。维度最基本的意思，是确定位置需要几个独立坐标。我们从一条线开始，让每一个新增方向都实际出现。
cues.en: What does a fourth dimension add? Start without imagining an exotic solid. Dimension counts the independent coordinates needed to locate a point. Begin with a line, and let each new direction appear one step at a time.

cues.title: 从线到面
cues.titleEn: From a line to a plane
cues.caption: 线段沿新方向移动，扫出正方形。
cues.captionEn: Move a segment in a new direction to sweep out a square.
cues.zh: 线上的位置用一个数就能描述。现在把整条线沿另一个独立方向移动，它扫出了正方形。位置需要两个数：沿原方向走多少，再沿新方向走多少。
cues.en: One number locates a point on a line. Move that whole segment in an independent direction and it sweeps out a square. A point now needs two numbers: one along the original direction and one along the new one.

cues.title: 从面到体
cues.titleEn: From a plane to a volume
cues.caption: 正方形沿第三个方向移动，扫出立方体。
cues.captionEn: Move the square in a third direction to sweep out a cube.
cues.zh: 再把正方形抬出原来的平面。你熟悉的立方体出现了。它不是把正方形画得更大，而是增加了一个原来两个方向都无法替代的方向：高度。
cues.en: Lift the square out of its plane and a familiar cube appears. This is not merely a larger square. It introduces a direction that neither of the original two can replace: height, requiring a third coordinate.

cues.title: 认出投影
cues.caption: 屏幕上的立方体，本来就只是二维投影。
cues.captionEn: The cube on your screen is already a two-dimensional projection.
cues.zh: 其实你现在也没直接看到一个三维物体。屏幕只有二维，深度通过投影、遮挡和运动表达出来。我们早就习惯用低维图像理解高维结构，只是平时没有特别注意。
cues.en: You are not directly viewing a three-dimensional object even now. The screen is flat; projection, occlusion and motion communicate depth. We already use lower-dimensional images to understand higher-dimensional structures, often without noticing the translation.

cues.title: 再做一次同样的事
cues.caption: 沿第四个独立方向复制并连接立方体。
cues.captionEn: Copy and connect the cube along a fourth independent direction.
cues.zh: 照着刚才的构造再来一次：沿第四个独立方向移动立方体，对应顶点连接起来，得到超立方体。这个方向不能简单画成屏幕上的另一根普通空间轴，所以我们看它的投影。
cues.en: Repeat the construction: move a cube along a fourth independent direction and connect corresponding vertices. The result is a tesseract. That direction cannot be drawn as another ordinary spatial axis on the screen, so we study a projection.

cues.title: 数结构，不猜外壳
cues.caption: 超立方体有 16 个顶点和 32 条边。
cues.captionEn: A tesseract has sixteen vertices and thirty-two edges.
cues.zh: 看对应的连接关系。四维超立方体有十六个顶点、三十二条边。图里像是一个盒子套另一个盒子，这只是投影的外观，并不说明四维里真的有一个小盒子藏在大盒子中间。
cues.en: Look at corresponding connections: a tesseract has sixteen vertices and thirty-two edges. The picture resembles one box inside another, but that is a projection effect. It does not mean a physically smaller box sits inside a larger one in four dimensions.

cues.title: 旋转之后
cues.caption: 投影形状改变，原结构的连接关系保持不变。
cues.captionEn: Projection changes shape while the original connectivity stays fixed.
cues.zh: 让它在涉及第四维的平面里旋转。边的投影长度和前后关系都在变，但哪些顶点相连并没有变。盯住同一条边，你会更容易区分结构本身和我们观看它的方式。
cues.en: Rotate in a plane involving the fourth coordinate. Projected edge lengths and apparent depth change, but the connections remain the same. Follow one edge to distinguish the underlying structure from the particular view used to display it.

cues.title: 换成切片
cues.caption: 切片只保留物体与某个平面的交集。
cues.captionEn: A slice keeps only the intersection with a chosen plane.
cues.zh: 投影和切片又有什么区别？现在用一个球来说明。平面穿过球，只留下它们相交的圆。切片没有把整个球都压到纸上，它只显示这个高度上真正切到的部分。
cues.en: How is a slice different from a projection? Use a sphere to see it. A plane cuts through the sphere and reveals their circular intersection. It does not flatten the whole sphere; it keeps only the part actually touched by that plane.

cues.title: 一串切片
cues.caption: 圆从小到大再变小，记录球体不同高度的截面。
cues.captionEn: Circles grow and shrink across the sphere’s different heights.
cues.zh: 把平面慢慢扫过去。圆先出现、变大，经过中心后再缩小，最后消失。低维观察者只看到这些变化的圆，也可以由一连串切片，推断背后有一个更高维的物体。
cues.en: Sweep the plane through. A circle appears, grows, reaches its largest size at the center, then shrinks and disappears. An observer seeing only these circles could use their sequence to infer a higher-dimensional object behind them.

cues.title: 特征也是维度
cues.caption: 质量、甜度和含水量，可以成为不同的特征坐标。
cues.captionEn: Mass, sweetness and water content can be feature coordinates.
cues.zh: 换个意思看维度。这些水果可以用质量、甜度、含水量描述，每个独立特征都能占一个坐标。这里的第四维不一定是空间方向；它也可以只是第四种用于比较对象的属性。
cues.en: Now consider another meaning of dimension. Fruit can be described by mass, sweetness and water content, each supplying a feature coordinate. A fourth dimension need not be a direction in physical space; it may simply be another attribute used for comparison.

cues.title: 换轴不换水果
cues.caption: 更换展示的特征，只改变这张图的视角。
cues.captionEn: Changing displayed features changes the view, not the objects.
cues.zh: 把纵轴从甜度换成含水量。点的位置变了，水果本身却没变。我们只是挑选了不同的两个特征来展示。高维数据可视化的许多方法，都在处理这种展示与信息保留之间的取舍。
cues.en: Switch the vertical axis from sweetness to water content. The points move, but the fruit has not changed; we selected a different pair of attributes. Many high-dimensional visualizations make related tradeoffs about which information a view preserves.

cues.title: 三种表示，分开理解
cues.caption: 坐标、投影和切片，是理解高维的不同工具。
cues.captionEn: Coordinates, projections and slices offer different tools for higher dimensions.
cues.zh: 最后回看超立方体。维度说的是独立坐标，投影给我们一个低维视图，切片则取出某个截面。分清这三个概念，就不必把四维想成一个神秘、无法接近的形状。
cues.en: Return to the tesseract. Dimension concerns independent coordinates; projection provides a lower-dimensional view; slicing selects an intersection. Keeping those ideas distinct lets you reason about four dimensions without treating them as a mysterious, inaccessible shape.

cues.title: 预测从哪里开始
cues.caption: 同一句输入，训练前也会产生一组概率。
cues.captionEn: Even an untrained model produces probabilities for the same input.
cues.zh: 输入“猫爱吃”，模型下一步会选什么？先看还没训练过的版本。它也能输出概率，但这些数主要来自初始权重，还没有从例子中学会猫和鱼之间的关系。
cues.en: Give the model the phrase “cat likes eating.” What comes next? Even this untrained version produces probabilities, but they mostly reflect its initial weights. It has not yet learned the relationship between cats and fish from examples.

cues.title: 从字到词元
cues.caption: 教学模型把九个字符作为词表。
cues.captionEn: This teaching model uses a vocabulary of nine characters.
cues.zh: 这台小模型先把文字变成编号。为了让每一步都能看清，我们只用了九个字符；真实模型通常会把文本切成更复杂的词元。编号不是含义，它只是进入计算的入口。
cues.en: Our tiny model first turns text into identifiers. We use only nine characters so every step stays visible; production systems generally tokenize text differently. An identifier is not meaning itself, but an entry point into the calculation.

cues.title: 嵌入到向量
cues.caption: 嵌入表把每个词元映射成一组可学习的数。
cues.captionEn: An embedding table maps each token to learnable numbers.
cues.zh: 看这张嵌入矩阵。每个词元对应一组数，也就是向量。训练会改变这些数，让它们在后续计算中变得有用。它不是我们预先给“猫”写好的一份百科解释。
cues.en: Look at the embedding matrix. Each token maps to a vector, a set of numbers that training can change. Those numbers become useful in later computation; they are not a prewritten encyclopedia definition of the word cat.

cues.title: 顺序也要进入计算
cues.caption: 位置与词元一起进入模型，顺序不能丢。
cues.captionEn: Position accompanies token information so order is represented.
cues.zh: “猫吃鱼”和“鱼吃猫”用到的字相近，意思却不同。模型不能只收一袋没有顺序的字。这个教学网络把位置信息也加入表示，再把它们送入注意力计算。
cues.en: “Cat eats fish” and “fish eats cat” contain similar tokens but mean different things. The model cannot treat text as an unordered bag. This teaching network includes position information before sending the representations into attention.

cues.title: 看注意力
cues.caption: 每个位置按计算得到的权重汇集上下文。
cues.captionEn: Each position gathers context using calculated attention weights.
cues.zh: 看注意力图里的一行。它显示当前这个位置怎样分配对上下文的权重，再把信息加权汇集起来。亮一点表示权重较大；它并不等同于人类在认真思考某个词。
cues.en: Read one row of the attention map. It shows how a position weights available context and combines that information. Brighter cells mean larger weights. That numerical weighting should not be confused with a person consciously thinking about a word.

cues.title: 不能偷看答案
cues.caption: 因果遮罩阻止当前位置读取未来词元。
cues.captionEn: A causal mask prevents a position from reading future tokens.
cues.zh: 注意图里被挡住的未来位置。练习预测下一个字时，模型不能提前看到答案。因果遮罩就是这道限制：每个位置只能利用允许的历史上下文，否则训练题就被泄题了。
cues.en: Notice the blocked future positions. A model learning next-token prediction must not see the answer ahead of time. The causal mask enforces that restriction, limiting each position to permitted earlier context rather than leaking future tokens into the exercise.

cues.title: 概率与正确答案
cues.caption: 正确词元的概率越低，这次预测的损失越大。
cues.captionEn: Lower probability for the target produces a larger prediction loss.
cues.zh: 现在拿预测对照训练答案。目标是“鱼”，如果模型给它的概率很低，这次损失就比较大。损失是一个可计算的评价值，让“这次猜得不好”变成可以优化的数学问题。
cues.en: Compare the prediction with the training target, fish. A low probability for that target produces a larger loss. This calculable score turns “that prediction was poor” into a mathematical objective that the learning process can try to reduce.

cues.title: 梯度指向哪里
cues.caption: 反向传播计算损失对各权重的局部变化率。
cues.captionEn: Backpropagation calculates how loss changes locally with each weight.
cues.zh: 误差怎样变成学习？从损失往回算，得到各个权重的梯度。它回答的是：在当前附近，这个数稍微变一点，损失倾向于怎样变？它不是直接把正确答案塞进某一个格子。
cues.en: How does an error become learning? Work backward from the loss to obtain gradients. Each asks how the loss would change with a small nearby change to a weight. This does not simply place the correct answer into one particular cell.

cues.title: 更新并重复
cues.caption: 优化器利用梯度更新权重，再处理新的训练样本。
cues.captionEn: The optimizer updates weights from gradients, then processes more examples.
cues.zh: 优化器根据梯度调整权重，再继续看训练样本。留意损失曲线和概率一起变化。这些数来自真正运行的小网络，不是预先画好的下降曲线；个别步骤也不保证每次都下降。
cues.en: The optimizer adjusts the weights, then processes more training examples. Watch loss and probabilities change together. These values come from the working small network, not a prerecorded falling curve, and individual updates are not guaranteed to improve every prediction.

cues.title: 学会一小组规律
cues.titleEn: Learn a small set of patterns
cues.caption: 更多训练让小语料中的关联逐渐进入权重。
cues.captionEn: Repeated training puts patterns from this tiny dataset into the weights.
cues.zh: 多练习几轮，再看“鱼”的概率。模型开始反映这份小语料里的规律。但它只有很小的词表和结构，这个结果只证明教学任务上的变化，不能拿来宣称已经拥有通用语言能力。
cues.en: After more training, inspect the probability of fish. The model begins reflecting patterns in this tiny dataset. Its vocabulary and structure are deliberately small; success here demonstrates the mechanism, not general language understanding or the capabilities of a production model.

cues.title: 进入生成阶段
cues.caption: 生成读取已经学到的权重，不再反向传播更新。
cues.captionEn: Generation uses the learned weights without updating them.
cues.zh: 现在切到生成。把训练停下来，锁住权重，再给它“猫爱吃”。这次只向前计算下一字的分布，不对照训练答案，也不做刚才那种反向更新。
cues.en: Now stop training and switch to generation. Hold the weights fixed and supply the same context. We only run forward to obtain a next-token distribution; we do not compare against a training target or perform a backward update.

cues.title: 选出一个词元
cues.caption: 从分布选出的词元，被追加到上下文。
cues.captionEn: A token selected from the distribution is appended to the context.
cues.zh: 从概率分布里选一个词元，接到输入后面。这里为了演示可复现，先选择概率最高的一项。真实系统也可以采样；选法影响结果，但不是在这一步重新训练权重。
cues.en: Select a token from the distribution and append it to the context. For a reproducible demonstration, we choose the highest-probability option. Real systems may sample instead. That choice changes the output without retraining the weights at this step.

cues.title: 再预测一次
cues.caption: 新的上下文再进入同一个网络，生成逐步展开。
cues.captionEn: The new context reenters the same network for another prediction.
cues.zh: 把刚生成的字放回去，再预测下一字。句子就是这样逐步长出来的。每一步的上下文会变，概率也可能变，但权重仍然不动。这和训练阶段最关键的区别，就在这里。
cues.en: Feed the newly extended context through the same network and predict again. The sequence grows one token at a time. Context and probabilities change from step to step, while the weights stay fixed—the crucial distinction from training.

cues.title: 把两条过程分开
cues.caption: 训练改变参数；生成在固定参数下反复预测。
cues.captionEn: Training changes parameters; generation repeatedly predicts with fixed parameters.
cues.zh: 回头看完整链路：词元进入向量，注意力汇集上下文，输出概率；训练再算损失、求梯度、更新权重。生成则选择词元、追加上下文、继续预测。把这两条过程分清，很多困惑就解开了。
cues.en: Trace the whole chain: tokens become vectors, attention combines context, and the network produces probabilities. Training adds loss, gradients and weight updates. Generation instead selects a token, extends context and predicts again. Keeping those two processes separate resolves many common confusions.

cues.title: 同一批乘客
cues.caption: 公平比较策略，先固定乘客与到达时间。
cues.captionEn: Fix passengers and arrival times before comparing strategies.
cues.zh: 明明有两部电梯，为什么还得等？先看这一批乘客：从哪层来、去哪层、什么时候到，都固定下来。接下来我们换调度规则，客流原样重播，才知道差别来自哪里。
cues.en: Two elevators are available, so why the wait? Fix this passenger group first: origin, destination and arrival time. We will replay the same demand under different dispatch rules, so any difference can be traced to the scheduling strategy.

cues.title: 先来先服务
cues.caption: 按照任务到达顺序安排，不提前照顾后来的近任务。
cues.captionEn: Serve tasks in arrival order without favoring later nearby requests.
cues.zh: 第一轮先来先服务。任务按到达顺序排队，规则容易理解，也容易解释。但电梯不只是在队列上移动：它还得真的上楼、下楼、开门、让乘客进出。
cues.en: Start with first come, first served. Tasks are ordered by arrival, a simple rule to explain. But an elevator is not just a queue marker: it must physically travel, open its doors and let people enter or leave.

cues.title: 距离也是时间
cues.caption: 先来的任务可能很远，近处乘客仍要等。
cues.captionEn: An earlier distant task can keep nearby passengers waiting.
cues.zh: 跟住一部轿厢。排在前面的任务如果很远，附近后来的人即使看见电梯，也不一定马上被接走。规则尊重了顺序，却可能增加空跑和等待，这正是我们要观察的代价。
cues.en: Follow one car. An earlier task may be far away, while a nearby later passenger keeps waiting despite seeing an elevator. Respecting arrival order can add empty travel and delay; those physical costs are what we want to observe.

cues.title: 记录整批结果
cues.caption: 只看某一位乘客，不能代表整个策略。
cues.captionEn: One passenger’s experience cannot represent the whole strategy.
cues.zh: 先记住这一轮的情况。有人早上车，有人晚一些；平均等待把整批人汇总起来。不能只挑一个被快速接走的人就宣布策略优秀，也不能只看其中一次不走运的等待。
cues.en: Take stock of the first run. Some people board earlier than others; average waiting summarizes the whole group. One lucky passenger does not establish that a strategy is excellent, and one unlucky wait does not describe every passenger.

cues.title: 改为最近优先
cues.caption: 同一份客流重放，这次优先响应较近任务。
cues.captionEn: Replay the same demand, prioritizing nearby tasks.
cues.zh: 把乘客全部放回原来的到达时刻，第二轮开始。这次优先响应较近任务。注意初始位置和客流没有换；变的是分配规则，所以这一轮才可以和刚才公平比较。
cues.en: Reset every passenger to the original arrival schedule. This time, prioritize nearby tasks. Starting conditions and passenger demand stay the same; only the dispatch rule changes. That makes the new run comparable with the first one.

cues.title: 局部好处
cues.caption: 就近响应通常能减少某些接客路程。
cues.captionEn: Nearby assignment can shorten some pickup trips.
cues.zh: 看电梯先接谁。距离近的任务，可能更快被响应，减少一些接客路程。但“离得最近”只是当前这一刻的判断，它不一定把后面所有人的路线都安排得最好。
cues.en: Watch which requests the cars take first. Nearby tasks can be reached sooner and may reduce pickup travel. But nearest is a judgment about the current situation; it does not necessarily produce the best complete route for everyone who will arrive.

cues.title: 方向不能忽略
cues.caption: 位置接近，不代表行驶方向和目的地合适。
cues.captionEn: A nearby car may still be traveling in an unhelpful direction.
cues.zh: 再看方向。某部电梯离你很近，却可能正往相反方向走，或带着一批已有乘客。单独比较楼层距离，会漏掉这些信息。更完整的调度必须考虑轿厢接下来要做什么。
cues.en: Now consider direction. A car can be nearby while moving away from you or carrying people elsewhere. Floor distance alone misses that context. A fuller dispatch decision must account for what the car is already committed to doing.

cues.title: 顺路停靠
cues.caption: 保持方向，把顺路的接送任务合在一起。
cues.captionEn: Maintain direction and combine compatible pickup and drop-off stops.
cues.zh: 第三轮还是同一批人，这次采用顺路停靠。电梯沿着当前方向，把适合顺路处理的任务一起完成，再考虑反向。看看它的停靠顺序，和刚才逐个追任务有什么不同。
cues.en: Replay the same passengers a third time using collective stops. A car continues in its current direction, serving compatible tasks before considering reversal. Compare its stop order with the earlier behavior of chasing tasks more individually.

cues.title: 少折返不等于最优
cues.titleEn: Fewer reversals are not a proof of optimality
cues.caption: 顺路合并任务可能更高效，也会影响个别人的等待。
cues.captionEn: Combining stops can improve efficiency while changing individual waits.
cues.zh: 顺路处理能减少一些折返，但也可能让反方向的乘客多等一会儿。调度没有一句对所有客流都成立的口号：早高峰、午间往来、楼层分布不同，结果都可能改变。
cues.en: Combining stops can reduce reversals, but passengers wanting the opposite direction may wait longer. There is no single slogan that wins for every demand pattern. Morning peaks, mixed traffic and different floor distributions can all change the outcome.

cues.title: 把结果放一起
cues.titleEn: Put the results side by side
cues.caption: 使用完整模拟结果比较平均等待与行程。
cues.captionEn: Compare waiting and travel using complete simulation results.
cues.zh: 现在把三种规则的结果放在一起。表格来自同一输入跑到完成的计算，不只截取动画播到某一刻的样子。先看平均值，再想想它可能掩盖了哪些个体差异。
cues.en: Put all three results side by side. The table comes from complete simulations of the same input, rather than snapshots taken halfway through the animation. Compare the averages, then consider what differences between individuals those averages may hide.

cues.title: 真实楼宇还有约束
cues.caption: 容量、开关门与安全约束，让真实调度更复杂。
cues.captionEn: Capacity, door operations and safety constraints make real dispatch more complex.
cues.zh: 真实电梯还要考虑容量、开关门时间、拥挤和安全规则。我们保留了有身份的乘客和固定步长模拟，用来理解调度逻辑；这不是可以直接控制楼宇的工业控制器。
cues.en: Real systems also account for capacity, door timing, crowding and safety rules. Our identified passengers and fixed-step simulation help explain dispatch logic. This teaching model is not an industrial controller ready to operate a building.

cues.title: 学会公平比较
cues.caption: 固定输入、完整统计，再讨论策略的取舍。
cues.captionEn: Fix the input, complete the accounting, then compare tradeoffs.
cues.zh: 所以，下次觉得电梯“明明很近却不来”，别只看它在哪层。想想方向、已有乘客和其他任务。要比较规则，先固定输入，再完整统计；看到取舍，才是真的理解调度。
cues.en: Next time a nearby elevator does not arrive immediately, consider its direction, current passengers and other requests. To compare rules fairly, hold the demand fixed and complete the accounting. Understanding the tradeoffs is more useful than declaring one rule universally best.

cues.title: 没有事故的环路
cues.caption: 没有路口和事故，车流仍可能形成拥堵波。
cues.captionEn: Traffic can form a jam wave without an intersection or incident.
cues.zh: 前面没出事故，也没有红绿灯，为什么突然堵起来？这里是一条闭合环路，车辆最初均匀分布。先观察它们正常前进，再给其中一辆车一个很小的扰动。
cues.en: There is no crash and no traffic light, so why can a queue suddenly form? This is a closed ring with evenly spaced cars. Watch the steady flow first, then introduce a small disturbance to one vehicle.

cues.title: 每辆车只看前方
cues.caption: 跟车行为取决于车距、相对速度与期望速度。
cues.captionEn: Following behavior depends on gap, relative speed and desired speed.
cues.zh: 每辆车不会提前知道整条环路的未来。它根据前车距离、速度差和自己的期望速度，加速或减速。我们用跟车模型计算这些反应，拥堵形状不是预先画好的动画。
cues.en: Each driver reacts without knowing the ring’s future. Gap, relative speed and desired speed determine acceleration or braking. A car-following model calculates those responses; the shape of the queue is not drawn as a prerecorded animation.

cues.title: 轻踩一次刹车
cues.caption: 金色车辆短暂减速，扰动开始。
cues.captionEn: The gold car briefly slows, starting a disturbance.
cues.zh: 注意金色这辆。它只短暂踩了一下刹车，没有停在路上制造障碍。后车的距离开始缩短，于是也要减速。一个局部动作，就这样交给了下一位驾驶者。
cues.en: Watch the gold car. It brakes briefly rather than parking as an obstacle. The following gap begins to shrink, so the next driver slows too. A local action is passed along to the next vehicle in line.

cues.title: 反应传给后车
cues.caption: 后车相继调整，减速影响向车队后方传递。
cues.captionEn: Successive reactions carry the slowdown toward the back of the queue.
cues.zh: 再盯住金色车后面的几辆。每一辆都在应对前车已经发生的变化，减速的位置逐步向后移。单个驾驶者没有故意制造堵车，整体却开始出现一团慢行区域。
cues.en: Follow the next few cars behind the gold one. Each responds to changes already made by the car ahead, shifting the slowdown farther backward. Nobody needs to intend a traffic jam for a slow-moving region to emerge.

cues.title: 车和波方向不同
cues.caption: 车辆向前，拥堵波可以向后传播。
cues.captionEn: Cars move forward while a congestion wave can travel backward.
cues.zh: 分开看两个对象：车仍然向前开，慢行区域却可能往后退。一辆车进入慢区、减速，再离开加速；构成这团拥堵的，并不始终是同一批车。
cues.en: Track two different things. Individual cars still move forward, while the slow region can travel backward. A car enters, slows and later accelerates out. The vehicles making up the jam are therefore not always the same group.

cues.title: 原来的车已经走了
cues.titleEn: The original car has moved on
cues.caption: 最初扰动结束，车流反应仍可能继续。
cues.captionEn: The initial disturbance can end while the traffic response continues.
cues.zh: 最初踩刹车的车已经恢复前进，后面的影响却不一定立刻消失。交通系统有自己的恢复过程。在某些密度和跟车参数下，小扰动会放大并持续一段时间。
cues.en: The original braking car has resumed moving, but the effect behind it need not disappear immediately. Traffic has its own recovery dynamics. At some densities and following parameters, a small disturbance can amplify and persist.

cues.title: 把时间画出来
cues.titleEn: Draw time as well as position
cues.caption: 时空图记录每个时刻、每个位置的速度。
cues.captionEn: The space-time view records speed across position and time.
cues.zh: 看下方的时空图。横向是一圈道路的位置，纵向依次记录时间，颜色表示速度。每一行都是路面的一次快照，叠起来之后，拥堵传播的方向就留在图里了。
cues.en: Look at the space-time chart below. The horizontal direction represents position around the ring; successive rows represent time, and color shows speed. Stacking road snapshots preserves the direction of the jam’s movement as a visible pattern.

cues.title: 读懂斜纹
cues.caption: 斜纹表示慢行区域随时间移动。
cues.captionEn: Diagonal bands show a slow region moving over time.
cues.zh: 慢色区域如果在后面的时间行里出现在更靠后的位置，就形成斜纹。它记录的是波的移动，不是某一辆车的行车路线。看图时把这两件事分开，就不容易误读方向。
cues.en: A slow-colored region appearing farther backward in later time rows creates a diagonal band. That band tracks the wave rather than a single car’s route. Separating those two interpretations prevents a common mistake when reading the diagram.

cues.title: 换一组密度
cues.caption: 车辆更少时，同样的扰动可能更容易被吸收。
cues.captionEn: With fewer cars, the same disturbance may be easier to absorb.
cues.zh: 把环路上的车辆减少，再做同样一次刹车。车距更宽，后车有更多余地调整，波的表现也会变化。这里比较的是同一个模型里的不同密度，不是某条真实道路的精确预测。
cues.en: Reduce the number of cars and repeat the same braking event. Larger gaps give following vehicles more room to adjust, changing the wave’s behavior. This compares densities within one model rather than predicting a specific real road exactly.

cues.title: 留出反应空间
cues.caption: 更平缓的速度调整，有助于减少扰动的放大。
cues.captionEn: Smoother speed adjustments can reduce disturbance amplification.
cues.zh: 现在恢复三十六辆车，只把期望跟车时距从一点二秒调到一点八秒，再轻踩一次刹车。驾驶规则会更早为前车留出余量。看波怎样变化，同时记住：这是期望时距，实际车距仍受车流密度限制。
cues.en: Restore thirty-six cars. This time, change only the desired following headway, from one point two to one point eight seconds, then repeat the brake. The rule leaves more margin when responding to the car ahead. Watch the wave change. Desired headway is a model setting; density still constrains the actual gaps.

cues.title: 模型的边界
cues.caption: 单车道环路忽略换道、路口与驾驶者差异。
cues.captionEn: The single-lane ring omits lane changes, junctions and driver variation.
cues.zh: 这条路没有换道、路口，也没有每位驾驶者不同的习惯。我们刻意移开这些复杂因素，留下最基本的跟车反应。它说明没有事故也能形成拥堵，不代表现实中每次堵车都只有这个原因。
cues.en: Our road leaves out lane changes, junctions and differences between drivers. Removing those complications isolates basic following behavior. It shows that an incident is not required for a jam, without claiming this is the sole explanation for every real queue.

cues.title: 看系统，不只看前车
cues.caption: 局部反应连接起来，产生整体的拥堵波。
cues.captionEn: Connected local reactions produce a system-wide congestion wave.
cues.zh: 最后再看一圈。没有谁按下“制造拥堵”的按钮，很多局部反应却连成了整体的波。理解车流时，既看每辆车怎样动，也看影响怎样在人与人之间传播。
cues.en: Watch the ring once more. Nobody presses a button labeled “create a jam,” yet many local reactions combine into a traveling wave. Understanding traffic means following both the vehicles and the way their influence passes from driver to driver.

cues.title: 一个点发出的光
cues.caption: 先跟住一个物点，它的光会走许多条路。
cues.captionEn: Follow one object point: its light takes many paths.
cues.zh: 拍照的时候，镜头并不是把一张小照片搬进相机。看看左边这个亮点：它朝不同方向发光，其中一些穿过透镜，落到右边的屏上。我们把过程放慢，只跟住这个点，看看这些光什么时候才能重新聚到一起。
cues.en: A lens does not carry a tiny finished photograph into your camera. Look at the bright point on the left. Some of its light reaches the lens along different paths. Follow those paths toward the screen, and watch what it takes to bring them together.

cues.title: 把光线拐回来
cues.caption: 来自同一点的光，在透镜后改变方向。
cues.captionEn: The lens redirects rays from the same point.
cues.zh: 换到侧视图，看看光线怎么转弯。光线到达透镜时的位置不同，转弯的程度也不同。上方的光向下拐，下方的光向上拐。它们不是在寻找屏幕，而是在透镜作用下，沿新的直线继续前进。
cues.en: The side view makes the bend easier to see. Rays arrive at different heights and leave in different directions. They are not searching for the screen. The lens redirects each one, and the light then continues along its new straight path.

cues.title: 屏幕来到交点
cues.caption: 移动成像屏，让分散的光重新落在同一点。
cues.captionEn: Move the screen until the rays meet at one point.
cues.zh: 先别动透镜。我们只把右边的屏慢慢推近。刚才光落在不同位置，现在这些小点靠拢了。就在这个位置，一个物点能对应一个像点。这就是合焦；继续移动屏幕，它们又会分开。
cues.en: Keep the lens still and move only the screen. The separate marks draw together. At this particular distance, light from our one object point lands at one image point. That is focus. Move the screen away from this plane, and the marks separate again.

cues.title: 为什么是倒像
cues.caption: 物点向下，像点向上；整个图像因此倒立。
cues.captionEn: The object point moves down while its image moves up.
cues.zh: 让亮点从箭头上端走到下端。注意右边，它恰好往相反方向走。透镜没有识别上下，也没有故意翻转画面；这是这些光路相交后的几何结果。照片显示时，相机会把这个倒立的光学图像按正常方向呈现。
cues.en: Slide the bright point down the object. On the screen, its image travels upward. No part of the lens recognizes which way is up. The inversion follows from the crossing geometry. A camera presents the resulting photograph in the familiar upright orientation.

cues.title: 物体移近以后
cues.caption: 物体靠近透镜，清晰像面移得更远。
cues.captionEn: A closer object needs a more distant image plane.
cues.zh: 现在把物体往透镜移近，屏的位置先不动。刚才清楚的点又散开了。看绿色标记，新的像面跑到了屏幕后面。对焦并不是只在第一次拍照时完成；物体换了距离，成像条件也跟着变了。
cues.en: Bring the object closer, but leave the screen where it was. The point spreads out again. The green marker shows the new image plane farther behind the lens. Changing subject distance changes where the rays would meet, even though the lens itself has not changed.

cues.title: 重新对焦
cues.caption: 让成像屏追上新的像面，光点再次收拢。
cues.captionEn: The screen reaches the new image plane and the spot contracts.
cues.zh: 这次把屏往后移，追上新的像面。小点又收拢了，而且倒像变大了。真实相机通常让镜片组移动来适配固定传感器；这张光学台反过来移动屏幕，只是为了把需要改变的距离展示得更清楚。
cues.en: Move the screen back to the new image plane. The spot contracts, and the inverted image is larger. Real cameras usually move lens elements relative to a fixed sensor. Moving our screen instead lets you see the changing distance directly, without hiding it inside a lens barrel.

cues.title: 焦距改变什么
cues.caption: 同样的物距，更长焦距带来更远、更大的像。
cues.captionEn: At the same object distance, longer focal length gives a farther, larger image.
cues.zh: 保持物体不动，再换一种透镜强度。焦距变长时，光会聚得没那么急，清晰像面往后走，图像也变大。我们让屏同步跟上它。这里展示的是理想薄透镜；真实变焦镜头会让多组镜片配合完成这件事。
cues.en: Keep the object in place and change the lens power. A longer focal length bends the bundle less strongly. The image plane moves back and the image grows. Our screen follows it. A real zoom lens coordinates several elements; this ideal lens isolates the essential relationship.

cues.title: 越过焦点的边界
cues.caption: 物体进入焦距以内，光线不再在屏上会聚。
cues.captionEn: Inside the focal distance, the rays no longer meet on a screen.
cues.zh: 最后让物体靠得更近，进入焦距以内。出来的光还在散开，怎么移屏也接不到清晰的像。虚线是我们向后延长的方向，看起来像从左边一个放大的正立物体发出。这就是虚像，也解释了放大镜的工作方式。
cues.en: Now bring the object inside the focal distance. The outgoing rays diverge, so a screen cannot collect a sharp image. Extend their directions backward, along the dashed lines. They appear to come from a larger upright object on the left: the virtual image seen through a magnifier.

cues.title: 一张照片里的距离
cues.caption: 花朵、前景和灯光，在不同距离上。
cues.captionEn: The flower, foreground and lights sit at different distances.
cues.zh: 先看这朵花。花心清楚，前面的叶子和后面的灯却有些柔软。它们不是被随手涂糊了，而是在不同距离上。这次固定五十毫米焦距，先对焦两米远的花，再看看光圈怎样改变同一幅画面。
cues.en: Look at the flower. Its center is crisp, while the nearer leaves and distant lights are softer. They occupy different depths. We will keep a fifty-millimeter focal length, focus at two meters, and change the aperture while watching exactly the same scene.

cues.title: 数字大，开口小
cues.titleEn: A bigger number, a smaller opening
cues.caption: 光圈值是焦距除以入瞳直径。
cues.captionEn: The f-number is focal length divided by entrance-pupil diameter.
cues.zh: 这个圆，表示从镜头前面看进去的有效开口，叫入瞳。它正在缩小，可光圈数字却变大了。因为光圈值是焦距除以这个直径。五十毫米镜头的二点零，对应二十五毫米开口；八点零的开口只有它的四分之一。
cues.en: The circle represents the effective opening seen from the front, called the entrance pupil. As it shrinks, the f-number rises: focal length divided by opening diameter. At fifty millimeters, f-two means a twenty-five-millimeter opening. At f-eight, that diameter is only a quarter as large.

cues.title: 少进来的光
cues.caption: 同样快门，光圈每收一挡，进光量约减半。
cues.captionEn: At equal shutter time, each full stop roughly halves the light.
cues.zh: 暂时关掉亮度补偿。注意二点零到二点八，再到四点零，画面一挡一挡变暗。光是穿过一个面积，不是一条直径，所以直径减半，进光量约剩四分之一。平时相机自动调整快门或增益，可能把这种变暗藏起来了。
cues.en: Turn off brightness compensation for a moment. From f-two to f-two-point-eight, then f-four, the image darkens in steps. Light passes through an area. Halving the diameter leaves a quarter of that area. Automatic exposure can conceal this change by adjusting shutter time or gain.

cues.title: 散景从哪里来
cues.caption: 离焦光束被屏截开，一个点成为一小片。
cues.captionEn: A defocused light bundle reaches the sensor as a patch.
cues.zh: 重新补偿亮度，只看清晰程度。背景灯的光本该在另一个位置会聚，传感器却在花朵的像面上，把这束光截成一个小圆。放大图里，开口缩小，光锥变窄，落在传感器上的弥散圆也跟着变小。
cues.en: Restore brightness compensation and watch one background light. Its rays would meet at a different image plane. The sensor intercepts that bundle as a small disc. In the enlarged view near focus, closing the aperture narrows the cone and reduces the disc on the sensor.

cues.title: 清楚不是一道墙
cues.caption: 小光圈扩大可接受的清晰范围，不会让所有距离完全合焦。
cues.captionEn: A smaller opening widens acceptable sharpness; it does not focus every distance perfectly.
cues.zh: 看这条绿色带，是我们允许的清晰范围。光圈收小时，它向前后展开，叶片和远处花瓶更容易看清。不过，真正精确合焦的距离仍然只有一个。景深取决于你容许多大的模糊；这里把传感器上的直径阈值设为零点零三毫米。
cues.en: Watch the green depth band widen as the aperture closes. More of the foreground and background becomes acceptably sharp, but only one object plane is exactly in focus. Depth of field needs a blur tolerance. Our band uses a three-hundredths-of-a-millimeter diameter on the sensor.

cues.title: 把焦点交给背景
cues.caption: 对焦距离改变，清晰范围跟着移动。
cues.captionEn: Changing focus moves the region of acceptable sharpness.
cues.zh: 现在重新开大光圈，把焦点慢慢交给后面的灯。花心的细节退下去，背景的窗和灯逐渐站出来。我们没有改变物体的位置，只改变了透镜与像面的配合。拍摄时，焦点放在哪里，本身就在决定你希望别人先注意哪里。
cues.en: Open the aperture again and pass focus toward the distant lights. The flower softens as background detail becomes clearer. None of the objects moved. Only the focus setting changed. Choosing focus is also a way to guide attention: the same scene can tell a different visual story.

cues.title: 不能无限缩小
cues.titleEn: Why smaller is not always better
cues.caption: 小光圈减少离焦模糊，却增加衍射光斑。
cues.captionEn: Stopping down reduces defocus but enlarges the diffraction spot.
cues.zh: 那把开口缩得越小越好呢？放大看这个点。光也有波动性，通过很小的开口后会展开，形成衍射光斑。光圈越小，这个斑越大。清晰度因此需要折中：不能只想着把所有离焦圆压小，还要考虑衍射和镜头本身的像差。
cues.en: Could we simply make the opening smaller forever? The enlarged spot shows the limit. Light behaves as a wave, and a small opening produces diffraction. Stopping down enlarges that spot. Useful sharpness is a compromise among defocus, diffraction and the imperfections of a real lens.

cues.title: 为这张照片做选择
cues.caption: 先决定想让谁清楚，再平衡光圈和曝光。
cues.captionEn: Choose what should be sharp, then balance aperture and exposure.
cues.zh: 回到这朵花。大光圈让它从背景里突出；小一些的光圈，能交代更多环境。两种都可以成立。想清楚要让谁成为主角，再决定清晰范围，最后照顾快门和亮度。你现在可以自己试试，让这张照片按你的意图变化。
cues.en: Return to the flower. A wide aperture separates it from the background. A smaller one reveals more of the setting. Either can be useful. Choose your subject, choose the depth you want to show, then balance aperture with exposure. Try the controls and make that choice yourself.

cues.title: 四次行程，一次燃烧
cues.caption: 活塞走过四个行程，曲轴转过两圈。
cues.captionEn: Four piston strokes take two crankshaft revolutions.
cues.zh: 看这只活塞，下来，上去，再下来，再上去。动作很像，里面发生的事却不同。进气、压缩、做功、排气，合起来才是一个完整循环。先跟着它走两圈，再把每一步拆开，看一次燃烧怎样变成轴上的转动。
cues.en: Watch the piston travel up and down. The motion repeats, but the job changes each time: intake, compression, power and exhaust. Together they make one cycle, spanning two crankshaft turns. Follow a complete cycle first, then we will open up each step.

cues.title: 气门先打开
cues.caption: 进气门打开，下降的活塞让气体进入。
cues.captionEn: The open intake valve admits gas as the piston descends.
cues.zh: 先看左侧气门，它向气缸里打开了一点。活塞下行，缸内空间扩大，新鲜气体沿着左边的通道进入。右边的排气门关着，所以它没有从另一边直接跑掉。记住这次向下，任务是吸入，不是燃烧做功。
cues.en: Look at the valve on the left. It opens into the cylinder as the piston descends, increasing the available space. Fresh gas enters along the intake passage. The exhaust valve stays shut. This downward stroke is about filling the cylinder, not delivering combustion power.

cues.title: 把同一份气体压紧
cues.caption: 两扇气门关闭，容积缩小，压力上升。
cues.captionEn: Both valves close; falling volume raises pressure.
cues.zh: 到了下面，进气门也关上了。这次活塞往上走，困在里面的气体被压进越来越小的空间。看看压力读数，它一路升高。此时曲轴要花力气推活塞，气体转矩是负的。不是每个行程都在向外输出能量。
cues.en: At the bottom, the intake valve closes too. The piston now rises against trapped gas. Watch the volume shrink and the pressure climb. The crankshaft must supply work during compression, so net gas torque is negative. An engine does not deliver energy through every part of its cycle.

cues.title: 火花改变压力
cues.caption: 接近上止点时点火，高压气体开始推动活塞。
cues.captionEn: Ignition near the top creates pressure that pushes the piston.
cues.zh: 注意上面的小火花。这里把燃烧简化成瞬间加热，所以压力一下子跳高了。气体向活塞施力，但恰好在最高点时，曲柄还没有转动力臂。再转过去一点，压力才开始真正推动曲轴。真实燃烧会持续一小段时间。
cues.en: Watch the small spark near the top. Our ideal cycle adds heat instantly, so the pressure jumps. The gas pushes on the piston, but at dead center the mechanism has no turning leverage. Move just beyond that point and pressure can drive the crank. Real combustion takes a finite time.

cues.title: 压力换成转动
cues.caption: 气体膨胀，连杆把活塞的推动传给曲柄。
cues.captionEn: Expanding gas drives the piston, rod and offset crank.
cues.zh: 现在跟着金色连杆走。上端连着活塞销，下端连着偏离主轴的曲柄销。活塞向下，连杆摆动，曲轴继续转。随着气体膨胀，压力逐渐降低；转矩也不会保持一样大。这一段，才是四个行程中的做功行程。
cues.en: Follow the gold connecting rod. Its upper end meets the wrist pin; its lower end meets the offset crankpin. As the piston descends, the rod swings and the shaft turns. Expansion reduces the pressure, and torque changes along the way. This is the powered stroke of the four.

cues.title: 给下一次进气腾地方
cues.titleEn: Make room for the next charge
cues.caption: 排气门打开，上行活塞把废气推出。
cues.captionEn: The open exhaust valve lets the rising piston expel spent gas.
cues.zh: 右侧气门打开了。活塞再次上行，把废气沿右边通道推出去，为下一次进气腾出空间。你可能发现，它又回到了最高点，可这一回不会点火。还要先吸入，再压缩。只看活塞位置，分不清它正在循环里的哪一步。
cues.en: Now the valve on the right opens. The rising piston pushes spent gas through the exhaust passage, making room for another charge. At the top again, it is not ready to fire. Intake and compression must come first. Piston position alone cannot tell you which stroke is happening.

cues.title: 同样压力，不同力臂
cues.caption: 转矩同时取决于压力和曲柄—连杆的几何。
cues.captionEn: Torque depends on pressure and the crank–rod geometry together.
cues.zh: 再慢看一次做功。高亮的是曲柄销，它绕着主轴走圆圈，连杆的两个接点始终不分开。开头压力很大，转动力臂却小；中间力臂展开，后面压力又下降。所以压力最高的时刻，不一定就是转矩最大的时刻。
cues.en: Slow down the power stroke once more. The highlighted crankpin circles the main shaft while both rod joints stay connected. Near the top, pressure is high but turning leverage is small. Farther down, leverage improves as pressure falls. Peak pressure therefore need not coincide with peak torque.

cues.title: 把一个循环画出来
cues.titleEn: Draw the work of one cycle
cues.caption: 压力—容积曲线包围的面积，是理想循环净功。
cues.captionEn: The area inside the pressure–volume loop is net ideal-cycle work.
cues.zh: 把这四步放在一张图上。横向是气缸容积，向上是压力。光点走过压缩和膨胀，围出一块面积：膨胀做的功，减去压缩花掉的功，就是净输出。真实机器还会损失热量、克服摩擦。这张图先让你看清，热怎样经过每一步变成机械功。
cues.en: Trace the cycle on this diagram: volume runs horizontally and pressure vertically. The compression and expansion paths enclose an area. Expansion work minus compression work gives net output. Real engines lose additional heat and overcome friction. This ideal loop makes the conversion from heat to mechanical work visible.

cues.title: 四种部件，一套轮系
cues.caption: 先把齿轮与行星架装到位，再开始转动。
cues.captionEn: Assemble the gears and carrier before starting rotation.
cues.zh: 中间金色的是太阳轮，周围三颗叫行星轮。外面这圈齿朝里，叫内齿圈。后面的三臂支架，托住行星轮的轴心。先沿轴向把部件装好，再慢慢转动输入。每一颗行星轮，都必须同时咬住两边。
cues.en: Gold in the middle: the sun gear. Three planets surround it, inside a ring with inward-facing teeth. The carrier holds their axles. Slide the parts together before turning the input. Each planet must mesh with both neighbors at once.

cues.title: 一颗齿轮，两种转动
cues.caption: 行星轮在自转，它的轴心也在公转。
cues.captionEn: The planet spins while its axle travels around the sun.
cues.zh: 跟住有金色标记的那颗行星轮。它的轴心绕着太阳轮走，自身也在转。外面的齿圈不动，行星轮沿着它的内侧滚过去。青绿色行星架跟随的是轴心的公转。先把这两种转动分开，就不会把自转速度误当成输出。
cues.en: Follow the planet with the gold mark. Its axle travels around the sun, while the gear itself spins. The stationary ring gives it an inner track to roll along. The teal carrier follows the orbiting axle, not the planet’s own spin. Those are two different motions.

cues.title: 数一圈输出
cues.caption: 内齿圈固定，太阳轮转 3.5 圈，行星架转一圈。
cues.captionEn: With the ring fixed, 3.5 sun turns produce one carrier turn.
cues.zh: 现在从标记开始数。固定内齿圈，太阳轮要转三圈半，行星架才走完一圈。看两边的计数，它们一直按这个比例增加。这里太阳轮二十四齿，内齿圈六十齿，算出的减速比是三点五。转动没有丢掉，而是换成了更慢的输出。
cues.en: Start counting from the marks. With the ring fixed, the sun makes three and a half turns while the carrier completes just one. The two counters keep that proportion throughout. Our twenty-four-tooth sun and sixty-tooth ring give a three-point-five reduction, with the output turning in the same direction.

cues.title: 慢一些，更有力
cues.caption: 理想情况下，降速 3.5 倍对应输出转矩增大 3.5 倍。
cues.captionEn: Ideally, a 3.5-fold reduction gives 3.5 times the output torque.
