cues.zh: 慢一点，就可以拧得更有劲。先忽略摩擦，输入一份转矩，行星架能给出三点五份。不过，它转过的角度也只有输入的三点五分之一。转矩乘上转角，仍是同样的功。真实齿轮还会损失一部分能量，所以不能把理想倍数当成实测效率。
cues.en: A slower output can push harder. Ignore friction for this ideal comparison: one unit of input torque becomes three and a half at the carrier. But output angle is only one part in three and a half. Torque times angle still gives the same work. Real gears also lose some energy.

cues.title: 换一个固定部件
cues.caption: 固定太阳轮，从内齿圈输入，行星架以另一比例跟随。
cues.captionEn: Hold the sun and drive the ring for a different carrier speed.
cues.zh: 停下来，换一种固定方式。这次太阳轮不动，让外面的内齿圈转起来。行星轮仍然同时贴着两边，只是约束换了。行星架跟着同向转动，速度却和刚才不同：内齿圈转一点四圈，行星架就能走完一圈。
cues.en: Stop and choose another fixed member. This time the sun stays still and the ring supplies the input. Both gear contacts remain engaged, but the constraint has changed. The carrier follows in the same direction at a different reduction: one point four ring turns now give one carrier turn.

cues.title: 让输出倒过来
cues.caption: 固定行星架，行星轮原地自转，内齿圈反向输出。
cues.captionEn: Hold the carrier: the planets spin in place and the ring reverses.
cues.zh: 再固定行星架。三颗行星轮的轴心不绕圈了，只在原地自转。太阳轮与行星轮从外侧啮合，先反一次方向；行星轮和内齿圈从内侧啮合，保持同向。于是内齿圈相对太阳轮反转。输入两圈半，输出反向一圈。
cues.en: Hold the carrier. The axles stay put, and the planets spin in place. The outside mesh reverses rotation once; the inside mesh keeps that direction. The ring therefore turns opposite to the sun. With these teeth, two and a half input turns give one reverse output turn.

cues.title: 一起转，就不再相对转
cues.caption: 把太阳轮与内齿圈连接，整个轮系一起转动。
cues.captionEn: Couple the sun and ring, and the whole gearset turns together.
cues.zh: 如果把太阳轮和内齿圈连接在一起呢？现在两者同速，行星架也只能同速。看那颗有标记的行星轮：它还跟着整组移动，但相对于行星架，已经不再自转。输入一圈，输出也是一圈，就像整套齿轮暂时成了一个整体。
cues.en: Now couple the sun and ring so that they turn together. The carrier must match their speed. Our marked planet still moves with the assembly, but it no longer spins relative to the carrier. One input turn gives one output turn: the gearset behaves as a single rotating unit.

cues.title: 约束，决定结果
cues.caption: 比较相同的一圈输入，观察不同角色与约束下的输出。
cues.captionEn: Compare one input turn across different member roles and constraints.
cues.zh: 最后都用一圈输入，再看一次。固定齿圈、固定太阳轮、固定行星架，输入和输出的角色随之调整，结果各不相同。关键不只是齿数，还有哪个部件被固定，哪个负责输入，哪个负责输出。现在你可以自己换一种约束，慢慢转一圈。
cues.en: Compare one input turn in each arrangement. Fix the ring, the sun or the carrier, and the input and output roles change with it. Tooth counts matter, but so do those roles and constraints. Choose a fixed member yourself, then turn the input slowly and follow the marked planet.

cues.title: 让光住进玻璃里
cues.caption: 保护层淡出，留下纤芯、包层和一束正在前进的光。
cues.captionEn: Fade the protective layer to reveal the core, cladding and moving light.
cues.zh: 一根细细的玻璃，怎么把信号送到很远的地方？先把外面的保护层淡去。中间是纤芯，旁边是包层。跟住这个光点：它碰到边界，又回到纤芯里。这里没有镀银的镜子，留住光的秘密，藏在两种玻璃的交界处。
cues.en: How can a thin strand of glass carry a signal over a long distance? Fade away the protective coating. A core sits inside a surrounding cladding. Follow the light as it meets the boundary and returns to the core. There is no silvered mirror here. The important part is the boundary between two materials.

cues.title: 先看一次相遇
cues.caption: 光从玻璃射向空气，一部分反射，另一部分折射。
cues.captionEn: Light meeting air from glass splits into reflected and refracted parts.
cues.zh: 先把一个边界放大，用玻璃和空气看得更清楚。光从玻璃里过来，碰到交界，一部分回去了，另一部分穿出去，而且方向变了。注意虚线：角度要从这条法线量起，不是从表面量起。两条出射光的亮度，也会随着角度改变。
cues.en: Zoom into one boundary, using glass and air to make the effect easy to see. Some light returns to the glass; some crosses into the air and changes direction. Measure angles from the dashed normal, not from the surface. As we change the angle, the two outgoing beams also change in relative brightness.

cues.title: 跨过临界角
cues.caption: 超过临界角后，空气中不再有传播的折射光线。
cues.captionEn: Above the critical angle, no refracted ray propagates into the air.
cues.zh: 现在让光越来越斜。穿出去的那一束，渐渐贴近表面。到了临界角，再增加一点，它就不再向空气中传播了，光全部反射回玻璃。这叫全反射。这个例子大约是四十一点八度；换一种材料，临界角也会跟着变。
cues.en: Tilt the incoming ray farther. The transmitted beam approaches the surface. At the critical angle, then just beyond it, no refracted ray propagates out into the air. The light is totally internally reflected. Here the threshold is about forty-two degrees. Different material pairs have different thresholds.

cues.title: 回到纤芯与包层
cues.caption: 纤芯折射率略高于包层；合适的角度使光连续全反射。
cues.captionEn: A slightly higher core index supports repeated total internal reflection.
cues.zh: 回到光纤，外面不需要是空气。纤芯的折射率稍高，包层稍低，也可以形成全反射。这里两者很接近，光要以更贴近边界的方向前进。看每一次碰壁：入射角满足条件，光就继续留在纤芯里。画面把这个过程大大放慢了。
cues.en: Back in the fiber, the surrounding material does not have to be air. A core index slightly above the cladding index can also support total internal reflection. Because these indices are close, guided rays meet the boundary at grazing angles. Every encounter must meet the condition. We have slowed the light dramatically so you can follow it.

cues.title: 不是任何方向都能进入
cues.caption: 入射方向超出接收范围，纤芯里的光量逐次减少。
cues.captionEn: Outside the acceptance cone, power remaining in the core decreases at each encounter.
cues.zh: 从入口改变方向。开始时，光能沿着纤芯走下去。再偏一些，壁面上的入射角反而变小，全反射条件失效。看那些进入包层的分支，纤芯里剩下的光越来越少。所以接入光纤时，对准位置还不够，方向也很重要。
cues.en: Change the direction at the entrance. At first the ray remains confined. Tilt it farther and its angle to the wall normal becomes smaller. Total internal reflection fails. Watch the branches entering the cladding, leaving less power in the core after each encounter. Coupling light into a fiber depends on direction as well as position.

cues.title: 把折射率差拿走
cues.caption: 包层折射率接近纤芯，导光边界逐渐消失。
cues.captionEn: As the cladding index reaches the core index, the guiding boundary disappears.
cues.zh: 再做一个对照：保持入口方向不变，把包层的折射率慢慢提高。两者越接近，能被留住的角度范围越窄。等到折射率完全一样，光看不到这条光学边界了，直接穿过去。真正起作用的是材料的差别，保护层主要负责保护，不是镜面。
cues.en: Keep the entrance direction fixed and raise the cladding index. As the two indices approach each other, the acceptance range narrows. When they match, the optical boundary disappears and the ray passes through it. The index contrast provides guidance; the outer coating mainly provides mechanical protection.

cues.title: 同一时刻出发，不一定同时到达
cues.titleEn: Together at launch, apart at arrival
cues.caption: 不同路程带来不同延迟，叠加后的脉冲变宽。
cues.captionEn: Different path lengths produce different delays and broaden the combined pulse.
cues.zh: 光被留住了，信号就一定完美吗？比较同一时刻发出的窄脉冲。走直线的先到，走斜线的绕得更远，晚一点到。把这些到达时间叠起来，原本集中的脉冲就散开了。这是阶跃型多模光纤的一种色散直觉，不是所有光纤都以同样方式展宽。
cues.en: Guidance alone does not guarantee an undistorted signal. Launch one narrow pulse along several paths. The axial path arrives first; inclined paths travel farther and arrive later. Add those arrivals and the pulse spreads out. This is a ray picture of modal dispersion in a step-index multimode fiber. Other fiber designs behave differently.

cues.title: 让明暗携带信息
cues.caption: 按同一序列发出光脉冲，接收端延迟读出对应的比特。
cues.captionEn: The receiver reads the same pulse sequence after a propagation delay.
cues.zh: 最后，把光的明暗排成一个短序列。有光代表一，没有光代表零。看接收端，过了一段时间，同样的顺序出现了。实际通信还要处理噪声、损耗和色散，但基本想法很直接：让光沿着受控的路径前进，再从到达的变化里读出信息。
cues.en: Finally, send a short sequence of light and dark intervals. Light represents one; darkness represents zero. After a delay, the receiver sees the same sequence. Real links must also manage noise, loss and dispersion. The basic idea is direct: guide the light, then read information from changes in what arrives.

cues.title: 一位装不下二
cues.titleEn: When one place is not enough
cues.caption: 一位只表示零或一；一加一，把一进到左边。
cues.captionEn: One bit holds zero or one; adding two ones carries into the next place.
cues.zh: 一加一当然是二。可如果每一位只能放零或者一，二要写在哪里？看右边这一列：本位留下零，向左进一个一，就成了二进制的一零。它仍然表示二，只是换了一套位权。计算机的加法，就从这两个小输出开始。
cues.en: One plus one is two. But where does two go if each place can hold only zero or one? The current place keeps zero and sends a carry to the left. Binary one-zero still means two. It uses different place values. Those two little outputs are the beginning of a computer adder.

cues.title: 把加法拆成两个问题
cues.caption: 异或门决定本位和，与门决定是否进位。
cues.captionEn: XOR gives the sum bit; AND decides whether a carry is needed.
cues.zh: 换到线路里面看。第一条路问：两个输入是不是不同？不同就输出一，这个门叫异或门。另一条路问：是不是两个输入都是一？都为一，才需要进位，这个门叫与门。四种输入轮流走一遍，两个输出合起来，正好完成一位相加。
cues.en: Look inside the circuit. One path asks whether the inputs differ: that is XOR. The other asks whether both inputs are one: that is AND. When both are one, a carry is needed. Watch the four input combinations. Together, these two outputs perform a one-bit addition.

cues.title: 还要接住上一级的进位
cues.titleEn: Make room for the incoming carry
cues.caption: 全加器同时处理两个输入位和上一级进位。
cues.captionEn: A full adder combines two operand bits with an incoming carry.
cues.zh: 但一串数字不能只顾自己。低一位还可能送来一个进位，所以这里多了第三个输入。先看一加零，再把进位的一送进来，结果就变了。如果三个输入都是一，本位是一，还要再进一个一。这套线路叫全加器，可以接住来自旁边的一步。
cues.en: A longer number needs one more input: a carry from the lower place. Start with one plus zero, then add that incoming carry. The result changes. If all three inputs are one, the sum bit is one and another carry leaves. A full adder handles all three inputs, so one stage can connect to the next.

cues.title: 让相同的小电路排成一行
cues.titleEn: Put the stages in a row
cues.caption: 每一级的进位输出，接到更高一位的进位输入。
cues.captionEn: Each carry output connects to the carry input of the next higher bit.
cues.zh: 把这样的电路按位排起来，就能算更长的数。现在是五加七。两行数字按位权对齐，从右边的一开始。每一列都算自己的本位和，再把进位交给左边。最后留下的这一行是一一零零，换回我们平时的数法，就是十二。
cues.en: Arrange those circuits by place value. Here we add five and seven. Corresponding bits line up, with the ones place on the right. Each stage produces its sum bit and passes any carry toward the higher place. The final binary row represents twelve. A larger calculation is built from repeated small operations.

cues.title: 一个进位，走过整串数字
cues.titleEn: A carry across the whole word
cues.caption: 255 加 1 让进位穿过所有八位，结果逐级确定。
cues.captionEn: Adding 1 to 255 makes the carry pass through all eight stages.
cues.zh: 来一个特别容易看清进位的例子：二百五十五加一。八个一，每一位都要把进位继续送过去。跟住进位 C，它逐级传向更高位权，一步步确定结果。还没确定的位置先留着小点，不要把它当成零。真实电路也需要传播时间，画面把这种依赖放大了。
cues.en: Now add one to two hundred fifty-five: eight ones followed by a long carry chain. Follow the carry toward higher place values. Outputs become known step by step. A dot means unresolved, not zero. Real gates take time to respond; this teaching clock makes their logical dependencies visible.

cues.title: 第九位去了哪里
cues.titleEn: Keep track of the ninth bit
cues.caption: 八位结果之外的进位，保留了数值 256 的信息。
cues.captionEn: The carry beyond the eight-bit result preserves the value 256.
cues.zh: 结果出来了：原来的八位都变成零，进位 C8 则变成一。完整答案是二百五十六。如果只保留八位，这个一就放不进去，所以必须另外记录最高位进位，或者使用更多位数。零不是完整答案；它只是八位范围里留下来的部分。
cues.en: The eight stored bits are now zero, with one extra bit beyond them. The complete answer is two hundred fifty-six. An eight-bit result cannot hold that ninth bit. Keep the carry separately or use a wider result. Zero is only the portion left inside the eight-bit word, not the complete mathematical answer.

cues.title: 同样的位串，可以有不同读法
cues.titleEn: The same bits, a different interpretation
cues.caption: 最高位进位与有符号溢出，描述不同的范围限制。
cues.captionEn: Carry-out and signed overflow describe different range limits.
cues.zh: 最后再看一百二十七加一。按无符号数读，结果是一百二十八，没有最高位进位。现在换成八位有符号读法，最高位的权重变成负的一百二十八，同样的位串就被读成负数。线路没有变，是表示范围不够了：这叫有符号溢出，和进位不是一回事。
cues.en: Add one to one hundred twenty-seven. With no sign bit, the result is one hundred twenty-eight and there is no carry-out. Now interpret the highest bit with a negative weight. Those same stored bits read as negative one hundred twenty-eight. That is signed overflow. It is different from carry-out.

cues.title: 每一步，都可以追踪
cues.caption: 同一套逻辑门与进位连接，也能完成其他输入的加法。
cues.captionEn: The same gates and carry connections add different input values.
cues.zh: 换成四十二加十九，再走一遍。这次有些位置可以早一点确定，有些要等前面的进位。结果是六十一。计算机没有背下每一道加法题，而是用简单的逻辑关系，把每一位连起来。你可以换两个数，也可以停在某个信号还没确定的时刻。
cues.en: Try forty-two plus nineteen. Some outputs can become known early; others depend on a carry. The result is sixty-one. The circuit does not memorize every addition problem. It connects small logical operations by place value. Change the inputs yourself, or pause while an intermediate signal is still unresolved.

cues.title: 捏下去，远处发生了什么
cues.caption: 主缸、油管和两侧活塞，把手指与碟片连起来。
cues.captionEn: A master cylinder, a hose and two pistons connect your hand to the rotor.
cues.zh: 捏下刹车，手边只动了一小段，远处的刹车片却把碟片夹住了。中间没有一根拉紧的钢索，而是一条装着液体的油路。我们打开这套装置，沿着主缸、软管和卡钳，看看这一捏究竟传递了什么。
cues.en: Squeeze the lever. A small movement at your hand makes two pads grip a distant rotor. There is no tensioned cable between them. Instead, the connection is filled with liquid. Let us open the master cylinder, follow the hose and look inside the caliper. What does that squeeze actually transmit?

cues.title: 先关上通往储液腔的门
cues.caption: 活塞越过补偿孔后，排液才进入封闭油路。
cues.captionEn: Once the piston passes the compensation port, displacement enters the closed circuit.
cues.zh: 先看手边。松开时，主缸通过一个小孔连着储液腔。活塞起步先越过这个孔，随后才向封闭的制动油路排液。放大图把这段很小的行程展开了。注意，手柄已经动了，并不意味着刹车片已经开始夹紧。
cues.en: Start at the lever. While released, the master cylinder communicates with a reservoir through a small port. The piston first passes that opening, then displaces liquid into the closed brake circuit. The enlarged section makes this tiny movement visible. A moving lever does not yet mean the pads are gripping.

cues.title: 先走完间隙，再建立压力
cues.titleEn: Take up the gap, then build pressure
cues.caption: 两片刹车片接触碟片后，继续排液才明显增加压力。
cues.captionEn: After both pads meet the rotor, further displacement raises pressure strongly.
cues.zh: 再看两侧的刹车片。主缸推出的液体先把两个活塞向内移动，填掉与碟片之间的间隙。接触以后，油路和刹车片只能再压缩一点点，压力就明显升高。剖面中的间隙是放大示意；真实装置的这段移动非常小。
cues.en: Watch both pads approach. The displaced liquid first moves the two pistons inward, taking up the clearance around the rotor. After contact, only a little further compression of the liquid, hose and pads is possible, so pressure rises sharply. The caliper section enlarges the clearance; the actual travel is tiny.

cues.title: 同样压力，不同面积
cues.titleEn: The same pressure acts on different areas
cues.caption: 相同表压作用在更大的活塞面积上，产生更大的推力。
cues.captionEn: The same gauge pressure produces more force on a larger piston area.
cues.zh: 现在慢慢加压。主缸和卡钳承受相同的压力变化，但卡钳活塞的面积更大，所以每片刹车片得到的推力也更大。留意单侧刹车片力，它表示每一片受到的力。液体传递压力，活塞面积把压力换成力；这里忽略了高度差和密封摩擦。
cues.en: Now increase the pressure. The master cylinder and caliper experience the same pressure change, but the caliper pistons have larger areas. Each pad therefore receives a larger force. The pad-force reading is the force on each pad. Liquid transmits pressure; piston area converts it into force. Height differences and seal friction are omitted here.

cues.title: 大主缸，短行程，也更费力
cues.titleEn: A larger master trades travel for effort
cues.caption: 保持同样压力，主缸变大时行程缩短、所需手力增加。
cues.captionEn: At the same pressure, a larger master needs less travel and more hand force.
cues.zh: 把压力保持住，换一个更大的主缸。看，刹车片推力没变，但主缸不用走那么远了；与此同时，手需要更大的力。省下的距离要用力来交换。这是我们设定的理想手柄和油路，不能把一种尺寸的效果直接套到真实车辆上。
cues.en: Hold the pressure steady and widen the master cylinder. The pad force stays the same, but the piston no longer needs to travel as far. The hand must push harder instead. Less distance comes with more force. These dimensions describe our ideal teaching assembly, rather than a recommendation for changing a real brake.

cues.title: 同样捏动，气泡分走了行程
cues.caption: 气泡可被明显压缩，同样行程下留下更低的油压。
cues.captionEn: Compressible air absorbs displacement, leaving less pressure at the same stroke.
cues.zh: 再捏到同样的三毫米主缸行程，这次油路里带着一小团空气。气泡明显缩小，吃掉了一部分排液体积，压力和夹紧力就降下来了。液体也不是绝对不能压缩，只是这里的气体软得多。放大图里的气泡大小跟着计算变化。
cues.en: Squeeze back to the same three-millimeter master-cylinder stroke, this time with a small pocket of air in the circuit. The bubble shrinks substantially, absorbing some of the displaced volume. Pressure and clamping force fall. Liquid is not perfectly incompressible either; the gas is simply much more compressible here. The enlarged bubble follows the calculated volume.

cues.title: 手控制夹紧，动能变成热
cues.titleEn: The hand controls the grip; motion becomes heat
cues.caption: 摩擦制动力做功，把车辆动能转成热。
cues.captionEn: Frictional braking work converts the vehicle’s kinetic energy into heat.
cues.zh: 真正刹住时，热量主要来自哪里？看这段放慢的制动：速度下降，动能减少，转成的热量增加。手的作用是控制夹紧，不是提供全部热量。这里设定人车总质量一百公斤、初速十八公里每小时，并假定轮胎始终纯滚动。
cues.en: Where does the braking heat come from? Watch this slowed-down stop. Speed falls, kinetic energy decreases and the heat tally grows. Your hand controls the grip; it does not supply all that heat. This calculation uses a combined mass of one hundred kilograms and an initial speed of eighteen kilometers per hour, with ideal rolling.

cues.title: 释放，让油路回到起点
cues.titleEn: Release and return to the starting state
cues.caption: 松手后压力下降，刹车片退开，补偿孔重新打开。
cues.captionEn: Releasing pressure retracts the pads and reopens the compensation port.
cues.zh: 现在松开。压力退下去，弹性的恢复让刹车片离开碟片，主缸也回到原位，补偿孔重新打开。实际回位还涉及密封圈的变形和弹簧。你可以再捏一次：先关孔，再走间隙，最后建立夹紧力，每一步都有自己的位置和作用。
cues.en: Let go. Pressure falls, elastic recovery retracts the pads, and the master piston returns until the compensation port opens again. Real return behavior also involves deforming seals and springs. Try the squeeze once more: close the port, take up the gap, then build clamping force. Each small movement has a different job.

cues.title: 同一颗月亮
cues.caption: 改变的是视角，不是月球形状。
cues.captionEn: The shape stays round; our view of the light changes.
cues.zh: 先看这道弯弯的亮边。它慢慢展开，变成半圆，再接近满月。月球没有被切掉一块，也没有自己变大。变化的是：太阳照亮的那半边，我们究竟看到了多少。跟着同一颗月亮走一圈，就能把这件事看清。
cues.en: Watch the slender bright edge open out into a half Moon, then almost a full circle. Nothing is being cut away, and the Moon itself is not growing. What changes is how much of its sunlit half we can see. Let us follow that same Moon around its orbit.

cues.title: 谁照亮月球
cues.caption: 太阳始终照亮朝向它的半个球面。
cues.captionEn: Sunlight illuminates the hemisphere facing the Sun.
cues.zh: 把视线拉远。右侧的光线指向月球，朝向太阳的半个球面亮着，背向太阳的半边是夜晚。再看地球上的视角：我们能看到的半球，和太阳照亮的半球，并不总是同一个。亮区的弯边，就是这两个条件共同留下的轮廓。
cues.en: Pull back to the orbital view. Sunlight reaches the hemisphere facing the Sun; the other hemisphere is in night. Now compare the view from Earth. The half we can see and the half receiving sunlight are not always the same half. Their overlap creates that curved bright shape.

cues.title: 把视角接起来
cues.caption: 月球位置、日照与观察画面一起变化。
cues.captionEn: Position, sunlight and the observed face change together.
cues.zh: 沿着虚线看过去：地球始终在看同一颗月球。它走到太阳这一侧时，亮面大多背对我们；走到另一侧，亮面便转向我们。轨道图把距离压缩了，但旁边月面上的每一道明暗变化，都用的是同一个太阳方向。
cues.en: Follow the dotted sight line from Earth. When the Moon is on the Sunward side, most of its illuminated face points away from us. On the opposite side, that face turns toward us. The diagram compresses distance, but both views use exactly the same sunlight direction.

cues.title: 走完一轮盈亏
cues.caption: 八个观察点，连接同一轮盈亏。
cues.captionEn: Eight observations trace one continuous cycle.
cues.zh: 再慢慢走完一轮。细月牙变宽，经过上弦、盈凸，来到满月附近；随后亮区缩小，经过下弦，回到新月。下面的小月亮只是沿途的观察点，变化本身是连续的。明暗交界弯曲，是因为我们在看一个球面。
cues.en: Now watch a whole cycle unfold. A crescent widens through first quarter and a gibbous shape toward full Moon. The light then retreats through last quarter toward new Moon. The small portraits are checkpoints along one continuous motion. The curved boundary belongs to a sphere viewed at changing angles.

cues.title: 满月不等于月食
cues.caption: 轨道稍微倾斜，多数满月便错开地球的影子。
cues.captionEn: A tilted orbit lets most full Moons miss Earth’s shadow.
cues.zh: 那月食又是什么？先看满月从地球影子上方经过，虽然很圆，却没有进入影子。现在只改变轨道的对齐方向，让它穿过本影，月面才暗下来。这里是一组受控对照。普通盈亏来自视角；月食还需要太阳、地球和月球特别对齐。
cues.en: What about an eclipse? This nearly full Moon initially passes above Earth’s shadow. Now change the orbit’s alignment so the Moon enters the umbra, and the portrait darkens. This is a controlled comparison. Ordinary phases come from viewing geometry; an eclipse additionally requires a close alignment with Earth’s shadow.

cues.title: 同一面朝向地球
cues.caption: 公转一圈，自转一圈，同一面持续朝向地球。
cues.captionEn: One spin per orbit keeps one face toward Earth.
cues.zh: 盯住金色标记。月球绕地球走，标记也跟着转，却始终指向地球。这就是同步自转：相对远处恒星，一圈公转配一圈自转。所以我们总看到大致相同的一面。另一面叫远侧，绝不是永远黑暗；它也会轮流迎来白天。
cues.en: Keep your eye on the gold marker. As the Moon goes around Earth, the marker turns with it and keeps pointing inward. That is synchronous rotation: one spin for each orbit, measured against distant stars. We therefore see roughly the same face. The far side still has its own days and nights.

cues.title: 两种月长
cues.caption: 绕恒星一圈后，还要追上改变的太阳方向。
cues.captionEn: After one stellar circuit, the Sun’s direction has moved on.
cues.zh: 为什么绕一圈大约二十七天，月相却要接近三十天才重复？看那条太阳方向线：地球绕太阳前进，它也慢慢偏转。月球相对恒星回到原处时，还没追上这个新方向。所以一轮月相要多走一点，平均约二十九点五天。
cues.en: Why does an orbit take about twenty-seven days, while the phases repeat in nearly thirty? Watch the Sun-direction line shift as Earth advances around the Sun. After one circuit relative to the stars, the Moon still has farther to go. Repeating the solar alignment takes about twenty-nine and a half days.

cues.title: 重新看一眼月亮
cues.caption: 同一束阳光，同一个球面，一轮不断改变的观察。
cues.captionEn: One light source, one sphere, a changing observation.
cues.zh: 最后再看一次，不必记住一串名字。月球始终是圆的，太阳始终照向它的一侧，我们沿途看见不同大小的亮区。地球的影子只在特殊对齐时加入。下次看到月牙，试着顺着亮面想一想：太阳大概在哪个方向？
cues.en: Watch once more without trying to memorize the names. The Moon remains round, sunlight reaches one side, and our changing view reveals different amounts of that light. Earth’s shadow joins in only under a special alignment. Next time you see a crescent, use its bright side to imagine where the Sun must be.

cues.title: 两条铜线，一个磁路
cues.caption: 两条电路没有相接；变化的磁通同时穿过两个绕组。
cues.captionEn: The circuits are separate; changing flux links both windings.
cues.zh: 先沿着铜线走一遍。左边连着交流电源，右边的开关还是断开的，两根铜线并没有接在一起。现在看绿色箭头：磁场沿着铁芯闭合，并且不断反向。左边的励磁电流让磁场变化，这个变化也穿过了右边的绕组。于是，没有负载电流，右边仍然能出现电压。
cues.en: Follow the copper first. The left winding connects to the AC source; the right circuit is open. The wires never meet. Now watch the green arrows reverse around the closed core. Primary excitation establishes a changing field that also links the secondary. Even with no load current, a voltage can appear at its terminals.

cues.title: 电压跟着斜率走
cues.caption: 磁通到峰顶，电压过零；磁通过零，电压的绝对值最大。
cues.captionEn: At a flux crest, voltage is zero; at zero flux, voltage magnitude is greatest.
cues.zh: 把目光移到两条曲线。绿色是磁通，铜色是次级电压，它们共用一条时间轴。先停在绿色的峰顶：磁通很大，却暂时不再增加，下面的电压恰好为零。再走到绿色过零的位置，这里变化最快，电压反而最大。法拉第定律关心的是变化速度，不是磁场有多强。
cues.en: These two traces share the same time axis. Green is magnetic flux; copper is secondary voltage. Pause at the green crest. There is plenty of flux, but its slope is zero, so the voltage is zero too. Move to the flux zero crossing: change is fastest there. Faraday’s law follows the slope, not simply the field strength.

cues.title: 每一匝都算数
cues.caption: 链接同一磁通的匝数翻倍，开路感应电压也翻倍。
cues.captionEn: Double the turns linking the same flux and the open-circuit voltage doubles.
cues.zh: 保持左边二十四匝和四伏交流不变。右边先是十二匝，每匝链接同一个磁通，电压加起来是两伏。换成二十四匝，就得到四伏；再换成四十八匝，就是八伏。绿色曲线没有随之变高。多出来的电压来自更多匝的叠加，并不是铁芯突然产生了更强的磁场。
cues.en: Keep the primary at twenty-four turns and four volts RMS. With twelve secondary turns, the output is two volts. Replace that winding with twenty-four turns: four volts. Forty-eight turns gives eight. Notice that the green trace has not grown. The higher voltage comes from adding more turns around the same changing flux, rather than strengthening the field.

cues.title: 闭合之后，电流出现
cues.caption: 负载电流反抗原来的磁通变化，电源补充初级电流。
cues.captionEn: Load current opposes the original flux change; the source supplies more primary current.
cues.zh: 现在把右边的开关闭合，给电压一条经过电阻的回路。次级有了电流，左边的电流也随之增加。次级电流产生的磁动势会反抗原来的变化，电源便补充初级电流来维持磁通。这里输入电压和频率不变，绿色曲线几乎不动；变化的是电源开始向负载持续供给能量。
cues.en: Close the switch and give the secondary voltage a path through the resistor. Load current appears, and primary current increases as well. The secondary’s magnetic effect opposes the original change; extra primary current balances it. With source voltage and frequency fixed, the flux stays the same in this lossless model. The source is now delivering power to a load.

cues.title: 升压，不凭空增加功率
cues.caption: 相同理想输出功率下，电压提高，输出电流减小。
cues.captionEn: At equal ideal output power, higher voltage comes with lower output current.
cues.zh: 这一段暂时忽略励磁电流和所有损耗。先看两伏输出，再换成八伏，同时把负载电阻调大，让功率保持相同。电压变成四倍，输出电流就降到四分之一，下方的功率条一样长。变压器改变电压与电流的配比，没有凭空增加能量。若不调整负载电阻，就不是相同功率的比较了。
cues.en: For this comparison, omit excitation current and all losses. Start with two volts at the output. Now use eight volts and increase the load resistance so the power stays equal. Four times the voltage needs one quarter of the output current. The power ribbon remains unchanged. This is an equal-power comparison; leaving resistance fixed would give a different result.

cues.title: 直流只留下接通的变化
cues.titleEn: DC: a transient, then a static field
cues.caption: 限流直流使磁通逐渐稳定，次级电压随之衰减。
cues.captionEn: Current-limited DC lets flux settle while the secondary voltage decays.
cues.zh: 换一个实验：右边保持开路，左边接入带限流电阻的直流。接通的一刻，电流开始增加，磁通也跟着建立，所以右边短暂出现电压。继续往后看，绿色曲线逐渐变平，铜色电压落向零。稳定磁场还在，却没有持续感应电压。真实铁芯还会饱和，这里只研究限流后的线性暂态。
cues.en: Try a different experiment. Leave the secondary open and switch on DC through a current-limiting resistor. At first, current and flux build, creating a brief secondary voltage. As the green curve flattens, that voltage fades towards zero. A static field remains, but it cannot sustain induction. This linear, current-limited example does not model saturation in a real transformer.

cues.title: 热量去了哪里
cues.caption: 叠片减少涡流损耗；铁损与绕组铜损分开计算。
cues.captionEn: Laminations reduce eddy currents; core and copper losses are accounted for separately.
cues.zh: 回到交流，看看铁芯细密的叠片。变化磁场也能在铁里感应涡流，片间绝缘把这些导电回路限制住，减少损耗。它不能消除磁滞，也不能消除铜线电阻产生的热。先看开路，再接上负载：铁芯损耗一直存在，铜损随着电流变化。下方把负载得到的功率与两处损耗分别列出。
cues.en: Back on AC, look at the thin core laminations. A changing field can drive eddy currents in conducting iron; insulation between sheets restricts those loops. Hysteresis and copper resistance still cause loss. Watch the open circuit, then the loaded circuit. Core loss remains even without output power, while copper loss changes with current. The ribbon accounts for each destination separately.

cues.title: 维持变化，才能持续传递
cues.caption: 相同交流电压下，提高频率所需的磁通摆幅更小。
cues.captionEn: At the same AC voltage, higher frequency needs a smaller flux swing.
cues.zh: 最后保持匝数和输入电压不变，把频率从五十赫兹提高到一百赫兹。每次变化用的时间缩短一半，绿色磁通的摆幅也减半，次级电压却保持不变。回头看整条因果链：电源维持变化的磁通，每一匝产生感应电压，接上负载才有输出电流。暂停或拖动时间轴，可以把这些关系逐一对上。
cues.en: Finally, hold the turns and input voltage fixed, and raise frequency from fifty to one hundred hertz. Each cycle takes half as long, so half the flux swing produces the same secondary voltage. Follow the chain once more: the source maintains changing flux, each turn contributes induced voltage, and a connected load draws current. Pause and scrub to line up each relationship.

cues.title: 一条指令，五个工位
cues.caption: I1 从取指走到写回，仍要经过五拍。
cues.captionEn: I1 takes five cycles from fetch through writeback.
cues.zh: 先跟住编号一。它先被取来，译码时确定要做什么；执行级算出零加四，经过访存这个位置，最后把四写进寄存器。加法不需要读内存，但仍经过这个工位。这是一个教学用的五级顺序处理器，每一级占一拍。
cues.en: Follow instruction one. Fetch brings it in; decode identifies the operation. Execute adds zero and four. It passes the memory stage, then writes four into a register. This addition needs no memory access, but still passes that station. Our teaching processor has five stages, each taking one cycle.

cues.title: 把空着的工位用起来
cues.caption: I1 还没完成，I2 已经开始自己的第一步。
cues.captionEn: I2 starts its first step before I1 has finished.
cues.zh: 现在换一种安排。编号一往前走，空出的取指工位马上迎来编号二。再过一拍，第三条也进来了。跟住这些编号：同一拍里，几条指令占着不同工位。编号会标出每条指令正走到哪一步。它们同时工作，只是各做不同的一步。
cues.en: Now change the schedule. As instruction one moves on, instruction two uses the fetch station it has left behind. A cycle later, the third arrives. Follow the instruction IDs. In one cycle, several instructions occupy different stations. Each ID shows which step its instruction has reached. They work at the same time, on different steps.

cues.title: 更快的是完成的节奏
cues.caption: 同一份程序，完成间隔缩短，单条延迟没有缩成一拍。
cues.captionEn: The same program finishes sooner; one instruction does not shrink to one cycle.
cues.zh: 让同一份程序同时跑两次：上面允许重叠，下面做完一条才开始下一条。留意完成的编号，上面出现得更密。可第一条从开始到结束，两边都用了五拍。流水线提高的是吞吐量。完整程序里的空位从哪里来？接下来把它们放慢看。
cues.en: Run the same program both ways. The upper schedule overlaps instructions; the lower finishes one before starting another. Completed IDs arrive closer together above. Yet instruction one still takes five cycles in both schedules. The improvement is throughput. Those gaps in the overlapping schedule have causes too. Let us slow down and inspect them.

cues.title: 遇到还没写回的值
cues.titleEn: A value that has not been written
cues.caption: I3 需要 r1 和 r2；关闭前递时，必须等待正确的值。
cues.captionEn: I3 needs r1 and r2; without forwarding, it must wait for their values.
cues.zh: 先关掉数据前递。编号三要把前两条得到的四和七相加，可寄存器里的值还没更新。它不能拿旧值凑答案，只能留在译码级等待。后面的取指也停住，前面的指令继续写回。这个空位是为了保证正确，不是丢失了一条指令。
cues.en: Turn forwarding off. Instruction three needs the four and seven produced by the first two instructions, but the register values are not ready. It must wait in decode instead of using stale inputs. Fetch waits too, while older instructions continue toward writeback. The empty slot protects correctness; no instruction has been lost.

cues.title: 把结果直接交过去
cues.caption: I3 从两处锁存值取得 4 和 7，在执行级算出 11。
cues.captionEn: I3 takes 4 and 7 from two pipeline latches and computes 11 in EX.
cues.zh: 回到同一段程序，这次打开前递。看指向编号三的两条路：四来自写回这一端，七来自访存之前已经锁存的运算结果。执行级直接收到它们，算出十一。这时结果寄存器还没有变成十一。结果已算出，和结果已写回，是两个时刻。
cues.en: Replay that same passage with forwarding enabled. Two routes reach instruction three: four from the writeback side, and seven from an arithmetic result already latched before memory. Execute can add them immediately. The destination register still has not become eleven. Computing a result and writing it back happen at different times.

cues.title: 有一拍，不能省
cues.caption: 加载在访存结束才有数据，I5 保持一拍，再接着计算。
cues.captionEn: The load returns at the end of MEM; I5 waits one cycle, then continues.
cues.zh: 再看编号四，它从内存读取数据。执行级只算出了地址，还没有拿到地址里的十一。紧跟着的编号五马上就要用它，前递也不能传来尚未读出的数。因此等一拍，让访存完成。下一拍，十一沿前递路径送到执行级，计算才接上。
cues.en: Instruction four loads a value from memory. Execute has calculated its address, but has not yet obtained the eleven stored there. Instruction five needs that value immediately. Forwarding cannot supply data that has not arrived. Hold for one cycle while memory finishes; then forward eleven into execute and let the addition continue.

cues.title: 走错的路，要撤回
cues.caption: 分支成立时，清除 I7、I8，从 I9 重新取指。
cues.captionEn: Taking the branch flushes I7 and I8; fetch resumes at I9.
cues.zh: 编号六比较两个十一，决定跳到编号九。可是决定出来以前，取指已经沿着原来的顺序往前走了。把编号七和八划掉：它们虽然被取来，却不能写寄存器，更不能把错误结果写进内存。重新从目标取指，空出的两个位置，就是这次分支的代价。
cues.en: Instruction six compares two elevens and branches to instruction nine. Before that decision, fetch has continued down the original path. Cross out seven and eight. They were fetched, but must never write a register or memory. Fetch restarts at the target. The two empty positions are the cost of this taken branch.

cues.title: 最后把结果对上
cues.caption: 八条有效指令：流水线 15 拍，逐条参考 40 拍，结果相同。
cues.captionEn: Eight useful instructions: 15 pipelined cycles, 40 sequential cycles, identical results.
cues.zh: 最后重新跑完整份程序，把结果核对上。两边完成的都是八条有效指令，寄存器和内存也完全一致。流水线用了十五拍：八条指令，加上四拍填充排空、一拍数据等待和两个分支空位。逐条执行用了四十拍。得到同一个答案，安排工作的方式改变了完成时间。
cues.en: Run the whole program again and check the results. Both schedules finish the same eight useful instructions, with identical registers and memory. The pipeline takes fifteen cycles: eight instructions, four for filling and draining, one data stall, and two branch bubbles. Sequential execution takes forty. Scheduling changes the finish time while preserving the answer.

cues.title: 光去哪里，场朝哪里
cues.caption: 光沿轴向前，电场在横向振动。
cues.captionEn: Light travels along the axis; its electric field oscillates across it.
cues.zh: 先分清两种方向。光沿着中间的轴向前传播，金色电场却在横向来回振动。下面迎着光看，就能看清这根振动的轴。偏振描述的是电场的方向，波线并不是光绕着弯走的路线。这里把振动大幅放慢了。
cues.en: Start with two directions. Light travels forward along the central axis, while the gold electric field oscillates across it. The end-on view shows that oscillation axis clearly. Polarization describes the field direction. The wave is not a winding path taken by light; its motion is greatly slowed.

cues.title: 没有优先的方向
cues.caption: 非偏振光的电场方向随时间变化，没有固定优先轴。
cues.captionEn: Unpolarized light has no persistent preferred electric-field axis.
cues.zh: 现在换成非偏振光。注意横截面里的电场，它不再守着同一根轴。淡色线条汇集不同时间的方向，不表示它在匀速转圈。把时间拉长，两个相互垂直的方向平均一样强；这就是下一片滤光片要面对的入射光。
cues.en: Now the source is unpolarized. Watch the field in the circular view: it no longer stays on one axis. The faint lines summarize directions over time, rather than regular circular rotation. Averaged over time, perpendicular transverse directions have equal intensity. This is the light entering our first filter.

cues.title: 第一片，留下半束
cues.caption: 理想第一片转到任何方向，都透过非偏振入射的一半。
cues.captionEn: The first ideal polarizer passes half of unpolarized input at any angle.
cues.zh: 放入第一片，只留下沿透光轴的电场分量。透过的光有了固定振动方向，平均光强剩下一半。慢慢转动这片滤光片：后面的振动轴跟着转，百分之五十却没有变。这不是每种入射光都适用的规则，而是非偏振光的时间平均。
cues.en: The first filter keeps the field component along its transmission axis. The transmitted light now has a fixed polarization and half the original intensity. Turn the filter: the outgoing axis turns too, but fifty percent remains. That half-intensity rule comes from unpolarized input; it is not a rule for every source.

cues.title: 投影，要取平方
cues.caption: 第二片的透过率，取决于两轴夹角的余弦平方。
cues.captionEn: The second filter transmits the squared cosine of the angle between the axes.
cues.zh: 再加一片，先把两根轴对齐。已有的线偏振光可以继续通过。现在转动末片，能留下的电场投影越来越短。光强看的是振幅的平方，所以曲线按余弦平方下降。角度到六十度时，这一片只透过到达它的四分之一。
cues.en: Add a second filter with its axis aligned. The already polarized light passes through. As the final axis turns, the surviving field projection gets shorter. Intensity follows the square of that amplitude, giving the cosine-squared curve. At sixty degrees, this filter transmits one quarter of the light arriving at it.

cues.title: 交叉，投影归零
cues.caption: 两轴相差 90°，末片没有可透过的电场分量。
cues.captionEn: At 90°, no component of the arriving field passes the final filter.
cues.zh: 让末片继续转，到两根轴恰好垂直。现在沿末片方向的投影为零，接收屏完全暗下来。第一片后面仍有光，消失的是最后一片之后的输出。这是理想交叉滤片的结果；真实滤片通常还会漏过一点光。
cues.en: Keep turning until the axes are perpendicular. The projection onto the final axis reaches zero, and the screen goes dark. Light still exists between the filters; it is the output after the last one that vanishes. These are ideal crossed polarizers. Real filters generally let a little light leak through.

cues.title: 在中间，改变方向
cues.caption: 中间轴转向 45°，交叉外片后重新透出 12.5%。
cues.captionEn: Turning the middle axis to 45° restores 12.5% transmission through crossed outer filters.
cues.zh: 外面两片先别动。在中间加一片，让它从平行第一片开始，慢慢转向四十五度。光回来了。中间片留下了一个斜向投影，末片面对的电场方向因此改变。两次四十五度的投影之后，原来入射光的八分之一继续向前传播。
cues.en: Leave the outer filters crossed. Add a middle filter, initially parallel to the first, and turn it toward forty-five degrees. Light returns. The middle filter leaves a diagonal projection, changing the field that reaches the final filter. Two forty-five-degree projections let one eighth of the original intensity continue forward.

cues.title: 光变亮，能量没有增加
cues.caption: 沿三片依次看：100% → 50% → 25% → 12.5%。
cues.captionEn: Along the three-filter path: 100% → 50% → 25% → 12.5%.
cues.zh: 把同一份入射能量记下来。第一片吸收一半，中间片再吸收原来总量的四分之一，末片吸收八分之一，最后八分之一透过。每经过一片，光都在变弱。增加中间片改变了送往末片的方向，并没有凭空补进能量。
cues.en: Account for the same input energy. The first filter absorbs half, the middle absorbs a quarter of the original total, and the final filter absorbs an eighth. Another eighth passes through. Intensity decreases at every filter. Adding the middle filter changes what reaches the last one; it supplies no energy.

cues.title: 找到透光的角度
cues.caption: 外片保持交叉，中间轴在 45° 时给出最大输出。
cues.captionEn: With crossed outer filters, the middle axis gives maximum output at 45°.
cues.zh: 最后只转中间这一片。与第一片平行时，末片把光挡住；与末片平行时，光先被中间片挡住。两端之间，四十五度让两次投影取得最大的乘积。可以停在这里，再自己转一转圆环，把每一次明暗变化和电场方向对应起来。
cues.en: Turn only the middle filter. Parallel to the first, it leaves light that the last filter blocks. Parallel to the last, it blocks the light earlier. Between those endpoints, forty-five degrees maximizes the product of both projections. Pause here, then try the dial and connect each brightness change to the field direction.

cues.title: 同一轨道，两种季节
cues.caption: 同一纬度的南北两地，白昼长短在半年后交换。
cues.captionEn: At opposite latitudes, long and short days swap after half an orbit.
cues.zh: 先看金色纬圈，再看下面两条白昼带。现在北边白天长，南边白天短。沿轨道走过半年，它们交换了。两地离太阳几乎一样远，这里还特意把轨道设成圆形。季节的线索，藏在地球接受阳光的方向里。
cues.en: Follow the gold latitude circle, then compare the two daylight ribbons. The northern day is long while the southern day is short. Half an orbit later, they trade places. Both locations are almost equally far from the Sun. We even keep this orbit circular. Look instead at the direction of the incoming light.

cues.title: 地轴留在空间里
cues.caption: 地球沿圆轨道前进，地轴在空间中的方向保持不变。
cues.captionEn: Earth follows its orbit while the axis keeps the same direction in space.
cues.zh: 看这四根小小的地轴，它们始终平行。地球向前走，地轴却不会追着太阳转。于是有时北极偏向太阳，有时南极偏向太阳。地轴和轨道面法线之间的夹角仍然相同，改变的是它与阳光的关系。
cues.en: Look at the four small axes. They remain parallel as Earth travels around the Sun. The axis does not turn to keep pointing toward the light. That leaves the northern end leaning sunward during one part of the orbit, and the southern end during another. The tilt itself has not changed.

cues.title: 同一束光铺开
cues.caption: 太阳越低，同一束光铺得越开，单位水平面积入射越少。
cues.captionEn: A lower Sun spreads the same beam across more horizontal area.
cues.zh: 现在只看这束金色的光。与光线垂直量过去，宽度始终是一。太阳慢慢降低，落在地上的金线却变长了。同样一束光分给更多地面，每平方米得到的入射就减少。这就是太阳高度改变能量分布的几何原因。
cues.en: Watch the gold beam. Measured across the rays, its width stays at one. As the Sun lowers, the bright footprint on the ground stretches. The same incoming beam is shared by more horizontal area, so each square metre intercepts less power. This is a change in geometry before we consider air or weather.

cues.title: 一天能照多久
cues.caption: 白昼越长，水平面接收阳光的时间就越长。
cues.captionEn: A longer day gives the horizontal surface more time to receive sunlight.
cues.zh: 角度之外，还要看时间。让立杆分别经历冬天和夏天的一日：太阳走过天空，影子绕着底座转动。看曲线的宽度，白昼长时，入射从更早延续到更晚。曲线下面积，把太阳的高度和照射时间一起累加起来。
cues.en: Angle is only part of the story. Let the post experience a winter day and then a summer day. The Sun crosses the sky and the shadow turns around the base. Notice the width of the input curve. Longer daylight extends the receiving time. The area underneath combines Sun height with time.

cues.title: 分点的平衡
cues.caption: 分点时太阳赤纬为零；非极点地区的几何昼夜各占一半。
cues.captionEn: At an equinox, zero declination divides geometric day and night equally away from the poles.
cues.zh: 来到分点，看看地球的明暗边界，它经过两极。太阳的直射位置回到赤道，南北两条白昼带一样长。这里用太阳中心越过几何地平线作为日出日落，所以各是十二小时。真实观测还会受到大气折射和太阳圆面大小的影响。
cues.en: Now approach an equinox. The day–night boundary passes through both poles, and the Sun’s direct overhead point returns to the equator. The two daylight ribbons match. We define sunrise and sunset using the Sun’s centre on a geometric horizon. That gives twelve hours here; real observations also include refraction and the Sun’s disk.

cues.title: 午夜还看见太阳
cues.caption: 越过极圈，太阳可以全天不落，也可以全天不升。
cues.captionEn: Beyond the polar circle, the Sun can stay above or below the horizon all day.
cues.zh: 把观测场搬到北纬七十五度。接近六月至点，太阳已经走到午夜，仍然没有落下。金色纬圈整圈都在白昼这一侧。再走过半年，太阳整天藏在地平线下面。极昼和极夜，是同一套倾角几何在高纬度的延续。
cues.en: Move the observing field to seventy-five degrees north. Near the June solstice, follow the Sun right through midnight: it still stays above the horizon. The entire latitude circle receives daylight. Half a year later, the Sun remains below the horizon all day. Polar day and night extend the same geometry to high latitudes.

cues.title: 把地轴扶正
cues.caption: 零倾角的圆轨道中，同一纬度的日照几何全年不变。
cues.captionEn: With zero tilt and a circular orbit, the daily geometry at a fixed latitude stays the same all year.
cues.zh: 回到北纬五十度，做一次受控对照：把地轴扶正，再让地球继续公转。正午的影子不再随季节改变，白昼带保持十二小时，全年入射曲线也变平了。现在地点和光束都没换，消失的是地轴倾斜带来的年度变化。
cues.en: Return to fifty degrees north for a controlled comparison. Set the axis upright and continue around the orbit. The noon shadow stops changing, daylight remains twelve hours, and the annual input curves become flat. The place and the incoming beam are unchanged. Removing tilt removes this yearly variation in our circular-orbit model.

cues.title: 几何走到哪里
cues.caption: 太阳高度与白昼时长决定几何入射；气温还需要热量收支。
cues.captionEn: Sun height and daylight determine geometric input; temperature also needs an energy balance.
cues.zh: 恢复地球的倾角，让一年再走一遍。南北两条曲线错开半年，影子也随之伸长、缩短。我们量到的是一天累计接到多少几何入射，不是气温。云、大气、海洋和地面的蓄热还会继续改变结果，最热的一天不必就在夏至。
cues.en: Restore Earth’s tilt and watch a full year return. The two latitude curves run half an orbit apart while the shadow lengthens and shortens. We have measured accumulated geometric input, not temperature. Clouds, the atmosphere, oceans and heat stored in the ground still affect the result. The hottest day need not be the solstice.

cues.title: 先把支撑接起来
cues.caption: 轴、内圈、滚珠、外圈、支座，组成连续的承载路径。
cues.captionEn: Shaft, inner ring, balls, outer ring and housing form a connected load path.
cues.zh: 先看中间这根轴。轴带动内圈，外圈则固定在支座里。我们移去一小块前侧材料，让你看到夹在两条滚道之间的球。跟住金色的这一颗：它既要让轴能转，又要把载荷传向外圈。后面的滚道并没有断开。
cues.en: Watch the shaft at the center. Its inner ring turns, while the outer ring stays in the housing. A small inspection window reveals the balls between the two races. Follow the gold one: it helps support the shaft while allowing rotation. The raceway behind our cut stays connected.

cues.title: 同时满足两处接触
cues.caption: 球心前进与球的自转相加或抵消，分别跟上两条滚道。
cues.captionEn: Translation and spin add at one contact and cancel at the other.
cues.zh: 看这个接触局部。外圈不动，所以接触它的那个球面点，此刻也要不动。球心却还在前进，怎么办？让球反向自转，就能抵消外侧的速度。到了内侧，这两份速度相加，恰好跟上正在移动的内圈表面。
cues.en: Look at the contact detail. The outer ring is stationary, so the ball surface touching it must be stationary at that instant. Yet the center is moving. Opposing spin cancels the motion outside. At the inner contact, the two contributions add, matching the moving race.

cues.title: 公转和自转不是一回事
cues.caption: 保持架跟随球心；球相对固定支座反向自转。
cues.captionEn: The cage follows the centers; each ball spins oppositely in the fixed frame.
cues.zh: 现在把保持架看清楚。它的凹槽分开每颗球，并跟着球心绕轴走。再看金色球上的小黑点：球身还在反向自转。这两个角速度都由刚才的接触条件确定，不是随手设的动画速度。这里的读数，以不动的支座为参考。
cues.en: Now inspect the cage. Its concave fingers separate the balls and travel around with their centers. The dark mark on the gold ball reveals another motion: backward spin. Both speeds follow from the contact constraints. These readouts use the stationary housing as their reference frame.

cues.title: 把自转拿掉会怎样
cues.caption: 人为禁止自转后，相同的球心速度会在两处接触产生滑动。
cues.captionEn: Preventing spin creates slip at both contacts, even with the same center speed.
cues.zh: 做一个有意不真实的对照。两颗球的中心前进得一样快，但对照组的球被强行禁止自转。它靠近外圈的表面还在动，靠近内圈的表面又跟不上。两处都出现滑动。滚动的关键，是让接触双方在相遇时对上速度。
cues.en: Try a deliberately constrained comparison. Both centers travel at the same speed, but one ball is deliberately prevented from spinning. Its outer surface keeps moving against the fixed race, while its inner surface cannot keep up. Both contacts slide. Rolling coordinates the surface speeds where the bodies meet.

cues.title: 同一颗球，轮流承载
cues.titleEn: One ball enters the load zone
cues.caption: 载荷方向固定；金色球进入亮区承载，离开后卸载。
cues.captionEn: The load direction stays fixed while the gold ball enters and leaves the loaded region.
cues.zh: 让载荷朝下。注意，亮区留在下面，并没有跟着保持架走。金色球转进这个区域，承载权重上升；再转出去，权重下降。其他球接着经过。亮度只是一个教学假设，帮助看清轮流承载的过程，不是算出的真实接触力。
cues.en: Apply an illustrative downward load. The bright zone stays underneath the shaft as the cage turns. Our gold ball enters, its load weight rises, and then it leaves. Other balls take their turn. The glow is an assumed teaching distribution, not a computed force in newtons.

cues.title: 点接触放大以后
cues.caption: 真实承载会形成有限接触斑；放大图不表示真实尺寸。
cues.captionEn: Real loading produces a finite contact patch; this enlargement is not to scale.
cues.zh: 刚才用一个点标出了接触位置。再放大，就不能把真实材料当成绝对刚硬了。承载时，球和滚道会发生微小形变，接触成为一片区域。画面把它大幅夸张，便于观察。它没有把滑块换算成接触压力，也没有给出真实膜厚。
cues.en: We marked each contact as a point. Magnify it, and perfectly rigid geometry is no longer enough. Under load, the ball and race deform slightly, producing a finite contact area. This view exaggerates that area for inspection. It does not predict contact pressure or actual lubricant-film thickness.

cues.title: 滚动为什么仍有损耗
cues.caption: 真实接触、局部滑动、润滑和可选的接触密封，都可能贡献损耗。
cues.captionEn: Real contact, local slip, lubricant and optional contact seals can contribute losses.
cues.zh: 沿着这几个细节看。真实材料经历加载和卸载；有限接触斑里可能有微滑；润滑剂帮助分开表面，同时也要被剪切和搅动。如果再装上接触式密封，还会多一处滑动。注意，纯弹性形变本身不等于损耗，我们也没有给这些来源编造百分比。
cues.en: Inspect the loss sources in turn: real material loading and unloading, local slip within the contact, and lubricant shear and churning. A contact seal, if fitted, adds another sliding interface. Perfectly elastic deformation alone is not an energy loss. No percentage or efficiency estimate is assigned here.

cues.title: 把整体重新接起来
cues.caption: 滚珠协调两处接触，在支撑转轴的同时减少持续的宏观滑动。
cues.captionEn: Coordinated rolling supports the shaft while reducing sustained macroscopic sliding.
cues.zh: 最后回到整只轴承。外圈固定，内圈随轴转动，球心和保持架缓慢公转，球身同时反转。载荷通过球与两条滚道传出去。它不是没有摩擦的魔法，而是一组配合得很好的接触。现在你可以自己转动内圈，把金色球停在任何想细看的位置。
cues.en: Return to the complete bearing. The outer ring stays fixed, the inner ring follows the shaft, and the cage carries the ball centers around while each ball spins backward. Loads pass through the races and balls. Explore by turning the inner ring and stopping our marked ball wherever you want to look closer.

cues.title: 空管不会自己启动
cues.titleEn: An empty tube does not start
cues.caption: 顶部有空气，低出口也还不能形成虹吸。
cues.captionEn: A low outlet is not enough while air interrupts the crest.
cues.zh: 先看左边的水。它进了管口，却停在接近水面的位置。管子另一头已经很低，顶部仍然空着。落差只是条件之一；空气把这条水路截断了。先记住这个空白，接下来我们要把它变成一条连续的水柱。
cues.en: Look at the water on the left. It enters the tube but only rises close to the reservoir surface. The far end is already low, yet air still occupies the crest. A height difference is only one condition. Remember that empty stretch: next we will replace it with a continuous water column.

cues.title: 先排气，再流动
cues.caption: 预充器先做功；水柱连通后，落差接手。
cues.captionEn: The primer supplies work first; the head difference then sustains flow.
cues.zh: 现在接上手动预充器。绿色水段向前推进，原先占着管子的空气被排出去。这一步需要外部做功。等水路完全连通，再拿走预充器，流动仍然继续。虹吸能够维持已经连通的水柱，却没有在这里凭空完成最初的爬升。
cues.en: Now connect the hand primer. The green water front advances and displaces the air that occupied the tube. This preparation requires external work. Once the entire path is filled, remove the primer. Flow continues. The siphon sustains a connected column; this apparatus did not create that initial climb without help.

cues.title: 跟住一小份水
cues.caption: 上升段爬高，整条水路却向更低处输水。
cues.captionEn: One leg climbs, but the complete journey ends lower.
cues.zh: 跟着金色标记，先上行，越过顶部，再下行。单看上升段，水确实在增加重力势能；看完整条路，终点却低于起点。水源的液面在下降，右边接到的水在增加。三处水量相加不变，流动消耗的是整体的高度差。
cues.en: Follow the gold tracer upward, across the crest, and down again. The ascending parcel gains gravitational potential energy, but its complete journey ends lower than it began. Watch the source level fall as the receiving vessel gains water. The total inventory stays fixed. The net elevation drop supplies the moving water with energy.

cues.title: 顶部为什么低压
cues.titleEn: Why pressure falls at the crest
cues.caption: 压力与高度一起变化；自由出口回到环境压力。
cues.captionEn: Pressure changes with elevation and returns to ambient at the free outlet.
cues.zh: 先看弯顶的压力标记。抬高水、维持速度、克服沿程损失，都要占用这份能量。最低压会稍稍落在弯顶下游，因为损失还在累计。再往下走，压力逐渐恢复，管口回到环境压力。两栏读数和这条曲线，都来自同一份水流计算。
cues.en: Focus on the crest pressure marker. Raising water, keeping it moving, and overcoming losses reduce pressure here. The minimum lies a little farther downstream because losses keep accumulating. Pressure then recovers to ambient at the free outlet. Both readings and the curve use the same flow calculation.

cues.title: 把出口抬到水面
cues.titleEn: Raise the outlet to the surface
cues.caption: 管长没有改变；落差减小，持续流量归零。
cues.captionEn: Tube length is unchanged. Less head brings the sustained flow to zero.
cues.zh: 保持同一根刚性弯管，围绕浸没的入口慢慢转动。出口被抬高，金色的高度差越来越短，水流也慢下来。当出口来到水源液面附近，持续流动停止。决定这个自由出口水头的，是液面与管口的高度差，不是管子顶部有多高。
cues.en: Rotate the same rigid tube around its submerged inlet. The outlet rises without changing tube length. The gold head marker shortens, and flow slows. At the source-surface height, sustained flow stops. For this free outlet, the relevant head is the drop from the source surface to the mouth, not the height of the crest.

cues.title: 让空气进来
cues.caption: 低出口仍在，进气却切断了连续液柱。
cues.captionEn: The outlet is still low, but admitted air breaks the column.
cues.zh: 先把出口放低，水重新流动。现在只打开顶部的小进气口。看两侧水段退开：一部分回到水源，另一部分落入接水容器。出口仍然很低，却没有持续虹吸。空气破坏了连续液柱；只把进气口重新关上，并不会自动排掉已经进入的空气。
cues.en: Lower the outlet and flow returns. Now open only the small vent at the crest. Water retreats down both sides: some returns to the source, and some enters the receiver. The outlet remains low, yet sustained siphoning has stopped. Closing the vent alone would not remove the air already inside; the tube needs priming again.

cues.title: 顶部不能无限升高
cues.titleEn: The crest has a pressure limit
cues.caption: 沿管最低压触及蒸气压时，单相水柱模型失效。
cues.captionEn: The single-phase column fails when its lowest pressure reaches vapor pressure.
cues.zh: 换成一组更高、分别预充好的管子。这里不是把同一根软管拉长。随着顶部升高，注意沿管最低压这一栏。它触及水的饱和蒸气压时，金色标记出现，连续水柱的计算停止。弯顶压力仍单独显示；实际水中的溶解气体和漏气，还可能更早切断水柱。
cues.en: Compare taller tubes, each prepared and primed separately. We are not stretching one hose. As the crest rises, watch the minimum-pressure reading. When it reaches vapor pressure, gold markers flag the failure of our continuous-column model. Crest pressure remains a separate reading. In real water, dissolved gas and leaks can interrupt the column earlier.

cues.title: 大气压扮演什么角色
cues.caption: 相同大气压不增加驱动水头，却改变水柱能保持的高度。
cues.captionEn: Equal ambient pressures add no driving head, but change the column’s feasible height.
cues.zh: 最后固定这根高管，只降低周围的气压。先看流量：只要水柱还能连通，高度差没变，流量就基本不变。再看最低压与汽化边界的间隔，它持续缩小，直到模型失效。大气压没有额外增加驱动水头，却与水的状态一起，限定这条连续水路能否存在。
cues.en: Keep this tall tube fixed and lower the surrounding air pressure. While the column remains feasible, its height difference stays unchanged, so the flow rate stays the same. Now watch the gap between minimum pressure and the vapor boundary shrink until the model fails. Atmospheric pressure adds no extra driving head, but helps determine whether the continuous column can exist.

cues.title: 从停着到转起来
cues.caption: 磁场存在还不够；转动线圈，才让磁通随时间改变。
cues.captionEn: A field alone is not enough; rotation makes the linked flux change.
cues.zh: 先别转，看看这圈铜线。磁铁已经在两边，线圈里也有磁通，但电压仍然是零。现在转动连接在线圈上的轴。线圈朝向不断改变，穿过它的磁通也跟着改变，下面才留下起伏的电压。先记住这件事：这里需要的不是把磁铁消耗掉，而是让机械转动持续改变磁通。
cues.en: Leave the shaft still for a moment. The magnets are already there, and flux threads the copper loop, yet the voltage is zero. Now turn the connected shaft. As the loop changes orientation, its linked flux changes too, and a voltage appears below. The process needs continued mechanical motion, not a magnet being used up.

cues.title: 把线圈转过四分之一圈
cues.caption: 磁通到极值时电压为零；转到磁通过零，电压的绝对值最大。
cues.captionEn: At a flux extremum voltage is zero; at zero flux its magnitude is greatest.
cues.zh: 把线圈围住的面积暂时显出来。它的法线正对磁场时，磁通最大，但这一刻变化率是零，所以没有瞬时感应电压。接着转过四分之一圈，磁通降到零，电压却达到峰值。影片在这里停一下，是让我们观察同一个瞬间，并没有把计算中的转速改成零。
cues.en: Let the enclosed area become visible. When its normal points along the field, flux is greatest, but its instantaneous rate of change is zero. So is the induced voltage. A quarter turn later, flux is zero and voltage reaches its peak. The film holds that instant for inspection; it has not changed the modeled shaft speed to zero.

cues.title: 旋转与固定之间
cues.caption: 两只完整滑环各接一个端头，固定电刷持续接触各自的环。
cues.captionEn: Two complete rings keep separate endpoints connected to stationary brushes.
cues.zh: 沿着铜线走到轴前方，找到这两只完整的金属环。线圈的两个端头，各自连着一只环；固定电刷压在环的外缘。下面沿轴看，彩色接点跟着转，电刷却始终留在原地。这样，外面的电线不必越拧越紧，而且两端的身份一直保留，没有每半圈互相交换。
cues.en: Follow the copper towards the front of the shaft. Each end reaches its own complete metal ring, touched by a stationary brush. In the end-on view below, the colored wire joints rotate while the brushes stay put. External wires therefore need not twist. Each terminal keeps its identity throughout the turn; the rings never swap the connections.

cues.title: 一圈里的正与负
cues.titleEn: Positive and negative within one turn
cues.caption: 转过半圈以后，感应电压反号；完整滑环不会把它自动变成直流。
cues.captionEn: After half a turn the induced voltage reverses; continuous rings do not rectify it.
cues.zh: 跟着光标看完一整圈。前半圈电压向上，经过零点以后，后半圈转到下方。线圈并没有换一根铜线，改变的是磁通的变化方向，所以电压极性反过来了。完整滑环只是保持接通，不会把负的半圈翻到上面。这里得到的是交流；机械换向还需要另一种分裂环结构。
cues.en: Follow the cursor through a full revolution. Voltage rises during one half, returns through zero, then becomes negative during the other. It is still the same conductor. The direction of flux change has reversed, so the polarity reverses. Continuous slip rings only preserve contact; they do not flip the negative half upward. This machine produces AC, without a split-ring commutator.

cues.title: 转快以后，什么一起改变？
cues.titleEn: What changes when the shaft turns faster?
cues.caption: 转速翻倍，电压幅值翻倍，物理周期减半。
cues.captionEn: Double the speed: voltage amplitude doubles and physical period halves.
cues.zh: 把原来三百六十转每分钟的电压留成虚线，再把轴转速提高一倍。铜线圈、磁场和面积都没变，但同样的磁通变化在一半时间里完成，电压幅值就翻倍了。横轴依然是一圈的转角。再看轴转速：它翻倍时，每圈所需时间减半。转快影响了幅值，也影响了频率。
cues.en: Keep the original three-hundred-sixty-rpm trace as a dashed reference, then double the shaft speed. The loop, area and field are unchanged, but the same flux change happens in half the time. Voltage amplitude doubles. The axis still shows one turn. Doubling shaft speed halves the time for each turn. Speed changes both voltage amplitude and frequency.

cues.title: 接上负载，轴为什么更难转？
cues.titleEn: Why does a connected load resist turning?
cues.caption: 负载电流产生反向力矩；维持转速需要驱动轴持续做功。
cues.captionEn: Load current creates opposing torque; maintaining speed requires shaft work.
cues.zh: 刚才负载开路，虽然有电压，却没有负载电流。现在把开关闭合。电流穿过线圈，两边的导线受到磁力，合起来产生反抗转动的力矩。轴没有自动减速，是因为外部驱动在维持这个转速，并补上所需的机械功。接得更重，电流更大，驱动就要付出更多。
cues.en: With the output open, voltage existed without load current. Now close the switch. Current flows through the loop, and magnetic forces on its sides produce an opposing torque. The shaft does not slow here because an external drive maintains its speed and supplies the required work. A heavier electrical load draws more current and demands more mechanical input.

cues.title: 倒转，阻力也跟着反向
cues.titleEn: Reverse the drive, reverse the braking torque
cues.caption: 同一转角下反转轴，电压和电流反号，力矩仍反抗实际转动。
cues.captionEn: Reverse the shaft at the same angle: voltage and current reverse, while torque still opposes motion.
cues.zh: 接着让轴慢下来，停过零点，再朝反方向转。转速为零的一刻，没有感应电压；倒转以后，同一个转角对应的电压和电流都反号了。再看力矩，它也换了方向，仍然阻碍现在的转动。电阻并没有因为电流反向而开始供电，能量依旧从驱动轴流向电路。
cues.en: Let the shaft slow through zero and then turn the other way. At zero speed, induced voltage vanishes. Reversing speed reverses voltage and current at a given angle. The torque reverses as well, continuing to oppose the actual motion. The resistor has not become an energy source just because current changed direction. Energy still comes from the driving shaft.

cues.title: 把一整圈的能量对上
cues.caption: 本圈机械功，等于负载电能加内部损耗；磁场参与转换而不提供持续能量。
cues.captionEn: Shaft work for this turn equals load energy plus internal loss; the field enables the conversion.
cues.zh: 最后回到正转，累计这一整圈的能量。金色曲线是驱动轴输入的机械功，蓝色是负载得到的电能，剩下的一小部分消耗在内部等效电阻中。每一个停帧，这三笔账都能对上。现在把因果关系连起来：转动改变磁通，电压推动电流，电流带来反向力矩，驱动所做的功最终进入电路。
cues.en: Return to forward rotation and add up the energy over one turn. Gold tracks shaft work, blue tracks energy reaching the load, and the small remaining share is internal resistive loss. The amounts balance at every frame. Rotation changes flux, induced voltage drives current, and current creates an opposing torque. The work supplied by the drive ultimately enters the circuit.

cues.title: 读一个字节，带回一行
cues.titleEn: Read one byte, fetch one line
cues.caption: 缓存为空时，读取地址 1 会复制地址 0–3 的整行。
cues.captionEn: Reading address 1 into an empty cache fetches the whole line at addresses 0–3.
cues.zh: 从地址一开始。缓存还是空的，所以这次没有找到数据。注意搬过来的不是一个字节，而是零到三这一整行。需要的字节从行内取出，邻居则一起留下。主内存中的原件并没有消失；缓存保存的是一份容量很小的副本。
cues.en: Start at address one. The cache is empty, so this read misses. Watch what comes across: not just one byte, but the entire line from zero through three. Return the requested byte and keep its neighbours nearby. The original data remains in main memory; the cache holds a small collection of copies.

cues.title: 标签、组号与偏移
cues.caption: 地址 18 拆成标签 1、组号 0、偏移 2；有效且标签匹配才命中。
cues.captionEn: Address 18 has tag 1, set 0 and offset 2. A hit needs a valid, matching tag.
cues.zh: 换成地址十八，把它写成六位二进制。右边两位选行内的字节，中间两位选组，左边两位是标签，用来辨认这一行来自哪里。先到零号组，再查有效位和标签。空位置虽然也写着零，却不能当成有效数据；填入之后才可以读取。
cues.en: Write address eighteen in six binary bits. The right pair selects a byte within its line. The middle pair selects the set. The left pair is the tag, identifying which line belongs there. Check both valid and tag. An empty entry with a zero tag is not usable data; it must first be filled.

cues.title: 空间局部性
cues.caption: 邻近地址同属一行，后面的读取可以直接命中。
cues.captionEn: Nearby addresses share a line, so later reads can hit.
cues.zh: 现在从零开始，连续读取八个地址。第一次带回零到三，所以接着读取的一、二、三都能直接命中。走到地址四，才需要另一行。八次读取，只搬来两行。空间局部性说的就是这种关系：访问一个位置以后，很快又要访问它附近的位置。
cues.en: Read eight consecutive addresses, starting at zero. The first read brings in zero through three, so the next three neighbours hit. Address four needs another line. Eight reads require just two fills. This is spatial locality: after accessing one location, the program soon wants other locations nearby in the address space.

cues.title: 时间局部性
cues.caption: 再次读取同一地址时，只要副本仍在，就不必重新搬运。
cues.captionEn: Reusing an address needs no new fetch while its copy remains cached.
cues.zh: 这次不继续往远处走，而是在刚才那一小片里反复读取。看地址零又出现了，后来还会再出现。数据没有重新跨过内存与缓存之间的边界，因为那份副本一直留着。时间局部性关注的是重复使用同一个位置，和前一章的邻近地址是两种关系。
cues.en: Stay within one small region and revisit it. Address zero appears again, and later once more. No new line crosses from memory, because its copy is still present. Temporal locality means using the same location again soon. That is different from spatial locality, which concerns neighbouring addresses rather than repeated ones.

cues.title: 空位之外，还有映射限制
cues.caption: 地址 0 与 16 都只能去组 0，轮流替换；其余三组仍空着。
cues.captionEn: Addresses 0 and 16 compete for set 0, evicting each other while three sets stay empty.
cues.zh: 在零和十六之间来回读，会发生什么？它们的标签不同，组号却都是零。直接映射只允许这一行使用零号组唯一的位置，所以两份副本轮流把对方换出去。再看一、二、三号组，它们明明还是空的。问题不在总共放不下，而在允许放置的位置发生了冲突。
cues.en: Alternate between zero and sixteen. Their tags differ, but both map to set zero. Direct mapping gives each of them only that one place, so they repeatedly evict each other. Check sets one, two and three: they remain empty. These two lines would fit in the total capacity. Their allowed placement is what causes the conflict.

cues.title: 容量相同，位置更灵活
cues.caption: 同样六次读取、同样 16 B：直接映射零次命中，二路相联四次命中。
cues.captionEn: Same six reads, same 16 B: zero direct-mapped hits, four two-way hits.
cues.zh: 把同样四条缓存行，重新分成两组，每组两个位置。注意总容量没有增加，访问序列也没换。现在零和十六可以住在同一组的不同路。前两次仍要从内存带回，后面四次都命中。更灵活的放置减少了这次冲突，但硬件也需要检查更多标签。
cues.en: Regroup the same four cache lines into two sets, with two ways in each. Capacity has not increased, and the address sequence is unchanged. Zero and sixteen can now occupy different ways of one set. The first two reads miss; the next four hit. More placement choices help here, but hardware must check more tags.

cues.title: 真正的最近最少使用
cues.caption: 再次读取 0 后，16 成为组内最久未用的行；32 到来时替换它。
cues.captionEn: Reusing 0 makes line 16 the least recently used in its set; 32 replaces it.
cues.zh: 两个位置也会住满。先读零，再读十六，然后回头读零。看最近使用的编号，零刚刚被访问过，所以三十二到来时，要换走更久没有使用的十六。这就是本模型的最近最少使用规则。如果下一次又需要十六，就得重新搬回；规则并不知道未来。
cues.en: Two ways can fill up too. Read zero, then sixteen, then zero again. The last-use numbers show that zero was just touched. When thirty-two arrives, replace sixteen, which has gone unused longer. That is least recently used replacement. If sixteen is requested next, it must be fetched again. The policy cannot see the future.

cues.title: 更大缓存行，公平比较
cues.caption: 都保持 16 B：一字节行需要八次填充，四字节行只需两次。
cues.captionEn: At 16 B capacity, one-byte lines need eight fills; four-byte lines need two.
cues.zh: 最后改变行大小，但把数据容量都固定在十六字节。再次读取同样八个连续地址：每行一个字节，要填充八次；每行四个字节，只需两次。两边实际都搬了八字节。大行利用了这次的邻近访问，跳着读取却可能带回用不上的邻居；命中次数也不能直接等同于整台处理器的速度。
cues.en: Change line size while keeping both data capacities at sixteen bytes. Read the same eight consecutive addresses. One-byte lines need eight fills; four-byte lines need two. Both fetch eight bytes overall. Larger lines exploit these nearby accesses, but a strided pattern may fetch unused neighbours. Hit counts alone do not determine whole-processor performance.

cues.title: 一条缝，宽亮带
cues.titleEn: A narrow slit, a wide band
cues.caption: 单缝之后，远处屏幕出现宽中央峰与较弱侧峰。
cues.captionEn: A single slit makes a broad central maximum and weaker side peaks on a distant screen.
cues.zh: 先看狭缝，再看远处的接收屏。亮光没有只留下开口的窄窄投影，而是铺成一条中央亮带，两侧还有更弱的峰。这里的光是同一波长的平面波。要解释这幅图样，我们要追踪整个开口的电场贡献，而不是只盯着两条边。
cues.en: Look at the slit, then at the distant screen. The light forms a broad central band with weaker peaks on either side. It is not simply a narrow shadow of the opening. With one wavelength illuminating the slit uniformly, we can explain the pattern by adding contributions across the whole opening.

cues.title: 正前方，同向相加
cues.caption: 正前方，各段电场同相相加，形成中央峰。
cues.captionEn: Straight ahead, all aperture strips add in phase to make the central maximum.
cues.zh: 把狭缝分成八段，只是为了看清计算。正前方，各段到达时没有一阶程差。看这些箭头依次首尾相接，它们方向相同，合成电场越加越长。箭头代表一段开口的场积分，不是八个光子。全部加完，就得到中央峰的参考振幅。
cues.en: Divide the aperture into eight strips to make the calculation visible. Straight ahead, there is no first-order path difference. The arrows line up head to tail, building the resultant field. Each arrow is a strip’s field integral, not a photon. Their completed sum gives the central reference amplitude.

cues.title: 第一暗纹，两两抵消
cues.titleEn: The first minimum cancels in pairs
cues.caption: 相距半个缝宽的对应段，在第一暗纹处相差半个波长。
cues.captionEn: At the first minimum, matching strips half a slit-width apart differ by half a wavelength.
cues.zh: 把观察点慢慢移向第一条暗纹。各段相位开始错开，箭头链弯成一圈。现在配对来看：相距半个缝宽的两段，程差恰好是半个波长，贡献方向相反。每一段都能找到这样的搭档。箭头链回到起点，合成电场归零。
cues.en: Move the observation point toward the first dark minimum. The phases separate and the arrow chain curls into a loop. Pair strips half a slit-width apart: their path difference is half a wavelength, so their contributions oppose each other. Every strip has a partner. The closed sum gives zero field.

cues.title: 电场反相，光强仍为正
cues.caption: 电场可以反相；光强取合成场的模平方。
cues.captionEn: The field can reverse phase; intensity is the squared magnitude of the resultant.
cues.zh: 再向外一点，来到第一侧峰。箭头的合成结果越过零，指向另一边，说明电场相对中央参考反相了。橙色虚线可以为负，绿色光强却仍为正，因为光强取场的平方。这个侧峰只有中央峰大约百分之四点七的强度。
cues.en: Move a little farther to the first side peak. The resultant points the other way, indicating a phase reversal relative to the center. The dashed field curve can be negative; the green intensity curve cannot, because intensity squares the field magnitude. This side peak is about 4.7 percent of the center.

cues.title: 开口越窄，亮带越宽
cues.titleEn: A narrower slit spreads the pattern
cues.caption: 缝宽减半，中央亮带的宽度约增加一倍。
cues.captionEn: Halving the slit width approximately doubles the width of the central band.
cues.zh: 保持波长和屏距不变，只把狭缝从八十微米缩到四十微米。看两条暗纹向外分开，毫米尺没有换。开口变窄，要转向更大的观察角，才能积累到相消所需的程差。中央亮带因此变宽；这里每幅图按自己的中央峰归一化。
cues.en: Keep wavelength and screen distance fixed. Narrow the slit from eighty to forty micrometers. The first minima move apart on the same millimeter scale. A narrower opening needs a larger viewing angle to build the path difference for cancellation. The central band widens. Each pattern is normalized to its own center.

cues.title: 波长也决定张开角
cues.caption: 同一狭缝中，长波长的第一暗纹离中心更远。
cues.captionEn: Through the same slit, a longer wavelength moves the first minimum farther from the center.
cues.zh: 现在固定狭缝，先换成短一些的蓝光，再换成长一些的红光。第一暗纹的位置跟着改变。相消仍需要整条缝积累一个波长的程差；波长越长，就需要更大的角度。这次变的是波长，不是开口，距离标尺也保持一致。
cues.en: Fix the slit and change the wavelength, first toward blue, then toward red. Watch the first minimum move. Cancellation still requires one wavelength of path difference across the opening. A longer wavelength needs a larger angle. This time the aperture stays fixed, and the screen keeps the same distance scale.

cues.title: 远场，不只看距离
cues.caption: 屏幕靠近后，被忽略的孔径相位曲率不能再忽略。
cues.captionEn: Bringing the screen closer makes the neglected aperture phase curvature matter.
cues.zh: 把屏幕拉近，注意这个用缝宽、波长和距离组成的数。它变大时，开口上的二次相位不能再忽略。画面因此暂停远场预测，并不是实际的光突然消失。这里用了保守的教学阈值。把屏幕移远，条件恢复，远场图样才重新显示。
cues.en: Bring the screen closer and watch the number combining slit width, wavelength, and distance. As it grows, quadratic phase across the aperture matters. The far-field prediction is withheld; real light has not vanished. This display uses a conservative guard. Move the screen away again and the far-field pattern returns.

cues.title: 波长尺度的边界
cues.caption: 零点方程有边界；没有有限零点，不等于没有衍射。
cues.captionEn: The zero equation has limits; no finite zero does not mean no diffraction.
cues.zh: 最后单独检查零点方程。当波长与缝宽之比趋向一，算出的角度趋向九十度，平面屏幕上的位置跑到无穷远。超过一，这个方程没有实数角度解。衍射没有因此消失；接近波长的开口还需要真实材料和电磁边界模型，不能只外推这条公式。
cues.en: Finally, inspect the zero equation on its own. As wavelength divided by slit width reaches one, the angle reaches ninety degrees, infinitely far out on a plane screen. Above one, no real angle solves it. Diffraction has not disappeared: wavelength-sized openings also need material and electromagnetic boundary conditions beyond this aperture formula.

cues.title: 先经过车轮，再到车身
cues.caption: 轮胎、轮组、弹簧与减振器，把路面的变化传给车身。
cues.captionEn: Tire, wheel, spring and damper connect road motion to the body.
cues.zh: 路上的凸起，为什么不会原样传到座椅？先看这台只保留一角车身的试验架。下面的路面平台抬起，轮胎先压缩，车轮再上移。上面较重的车身反应不同。把两个质量分开，才能看清颠簸怎样穿过轮胎和悬架。
cues.en: Why does a road bump not reach the seat unchanged? Watch this rig representing one corner of a car. The road platen rises, the tire compresses, and the wheel moves. The heavier body responds differently. Keeping those two masses separate reveals the path through the tire and suspension.

cues.title: 弹簧会把能量还回来
cues.caption: 理想弹簧储能与放能；没有阻尼，振荡不会自行消失。
cues.captionEn: An ideal spring stores and returns energy; without damping, oscillation persists.
cues.zh: 现在把阻尼设为零，保留弹簧和轮胎。凸起已经过去了，车身却还在上下运动。弹簧压缩时储存能量，回弹时又把能量交回来。它允许车身和车轮有不同的位移，但仅靠理想弹簧，并没有一个把振荡能量持续带走的过程。
cues.en: Set the damper coefficient to zero, keeping the spring and tire. The bump has passed, yet the body keeps moving. A spring stores energy as it deflects and gives that energy back. It permits relative motion, but an ideal spring alone provides no continuing route for the oscillation energy to leave.

cues.title: 更软，仍然会振荡
cues.caption: 较软弹簧改变静态下沉和振动节奏，却不能代替阻尼。
cues.captionEn: A softer spring changes static sag and oscillation timing; it cannot replace damping.
cues.zh: 给这两个悬架完全相同的凸起。铜色这组弹簧更软，静态压缩也更大。看两条车身曲线，它们的节奏不一样，但都还在振荡。更软会改变力与位移的关系，并不自动把能量变成热。这一章两边都没有阻尼，先把问题分开看。
cues.en: Give both suspensions exactly the same bump. The softer spring has more static compression. Watch the body traces: their timing differs, but both keep oscillating. Softness changes the relationship between force and displacement; it does not automatically turn motion energy into heat. Both dampers are disabled for this comparison.

cues.title: 同一个凸起，两种衰减
cues.caption: 保持弹簧不变，加入阻尼后，振荡能量逐渐离开系统。
cues.captionEn: With the spring unchanged, damping lets oscillation energy leave the system.
cues.zh: 这次两边用相同的弹簧，只给蓝色这组加入阻尼。路面输入和观察时间仍然完全一致。没有阻尼的一组继续来回运动，另一组逐渐安定下来。减振器抵抗的是两个端点之间的相对速度，不是把车身硬钉在一个固定高度。
cues.en: Now keep the spring identical and add damping only to the second rig. The road input and inspection time still match. One body continues to bounce; the other settles. The damper opposes relative velocity between its attachments. It does not pin the body to a fixed height.

cues.title: 能量去了哪里
cues.caption: 路面固定时，机械能减少的部分由减振器耗散；瞬时功率始终非负。
cues.captionEn: With the road fixed, lost mechanical energy becomes damper dissipation; its power is nonnegative.
cues.zh: 固定路面，把车身从四十毫米的位移释放。透过轮胎和减振器剖面，看活塞随两个端点运动。下面的蓝色能量逐渐减少，铜色的累计耗散增加。这里算的是阻尼乘相对速度的平方，再对时间积分。它是能量记录，不是油温计。
cues.en: Hold the road still and release the body from a forty-millimeter displacement. Through the transparent tire and damper section, watch the piston follow the attachments. Mechanical energy falls as accumulated dissipation grows. We integrate the damping coefficient times relative velocity squared. This records energy, not oil temperature.

cues.title: 阻尼不是越大越好
cues.caption: 较大阻尼限制相对运动，也会更强地传递快速输入；比较同一凸起的加速度。
cues.captionEn: Higher damping limits relative motion but can transmit rapid input more strongly; compare acceleration on the same bump.
cues.zh: 把阻尼继续加大，会不会更好？看这一次相同凸起的车身加速度。更大的阻尼使两个端点更难相对运动，也能把快速变化更强地传给车身。这里看到的是这组参数和这条路面的结果。评价悬架，需要同时考虑车身响应、可用行程和轮胎接触。
cues.en: Would still more damping be better? Compare body acceleration over the same bump. Stronger damping resists relative motion more, but can also transmit a rapid input more strongly to the body. This result belongs to these parameters and this road. Suspension design must consider motion, available travel and tire contact together.

cues.title: 轮胎接触的边界
cues.caption: 法向载荷降到零，线性轮胎模型停止；这里不推演离地后的运动。
cues.captionEn: At zero normal load the linear tire model stops; airborne motion is not predicted.
cues.zh: 换成连续的小起伏。轮组有自己的惯性，不会完美贴着路面走。看法向载荷曲线，它现在接近零。轮胎可以压住地面，却不能拉住地面。到了这个边界，演示就停下来。若继续计算离地和重新落地，需要另一套接触模型，不能沿用这条线性弹簧。
cues.en: Switch to repeated small ripples. The wheel assembly has inertia; it cannot follow the road perfectly. Watch the normal-load trace approach zero. A tire can push against the road, but it cannot pull on it. We stop at that boundary. Flight and renewed contact would require a different contact model.

cues.title: 把三个目标接在一起
cues.caption: 弹簧储能，减振器耗能，轮胎连接路面；一组参数不能替代完整的工况判断。
cues.captionEn: The spring stores energy, the damper dissipates it, and the tire connects to the road.
cues.zh: 回到完整的悬架。弹簧容许相对位移并储存能量，减振器控制振荡，轮胎把轮组连接到路面。软硬只是其中一个问题。现在可以用同一条路面改变刚度和阻尼，再把时间停在想看的位置。比较时，也别忘了观察车身、行程和接触这三个不同的结果。
cues.en: Return to the complete suspension. The spring permits relative displacement and stores energy, the damper controls oscillation, and the tire connects the wheel to the road. Stiffness is only one part of the story. Explore the same input with different settings, checking body response, suspension travel and contact separately.

cues.title: 阀门先停下
cues.caption: 靠近阀口的水先减速，远处仍在流动。
cues.captionEn: Water near the valve slows before water farther upstream.
cues.zh: 先看管内的箭头，整根管的水原本都在向前流。现在让末端阀门快速关闭。靠近阀口的箭头先变短，压力颜色变暖；远处却还保持原来的流动。关阀不是一道命令瞬间传遍整管，水需要时间把这个变化传出去。
cues.en: Watch the arrows inside the pipe. Initially the whole column moves forward. Now close the terminal valve quickly. Arrows near the valve shorten as the pressure color warms, while distant water keeps moving. Closure does not issue an instantaneous command to the whole pipe. The change must travel through it.

cues.title: 跟着波前走
cues.caption: 波前到达哪里，哪里的流动才开始改变。
cues.captionEn: Local flow changes only when the wavefront arrives.
cues.zh: 跟住暖色与冷色之间的过渡。压力变化正在向水库传播，经过测点时，那里的流速才明显改变。沿管的距离尺是同一根一百二十米管道。波速远大于水本身的流速，所以传播的是扰动，不是一团水从阀门高速跑回水库。
cues.en: Follow the transition between the warm and cool regions. The pressure change moves toward the reservoir, changing the flow as it passes each location. This is the same one-hundred-and-twenty-meter pipe. The wave travels far faster than the water. A disturbance is moving upstream, not a lump of water racing back from the valve.

cues.title: 水与管壁都让了一点
cues.caption: 微小压缩与扩张，把动能暂时存成弹性能。
cues.captionEn: Tiny compression and expansion store some kinetic energy elastically.
cues.zh: 在测点重放一次，把形变放大八百倍。看这同一份水，压力到来后体积微微缩小；同一测点的管截面却变大。两种变化共同提供顺应性，也储存弹性能。真实变化远小于画面，数字保留原来的应变，没有把水当成完全刚硬的活塞。
cues.en: Replay the event at the probe with strains enlarged eight hundred times. The same water sample occupies slightly less volume as pressure arrives. The bore at this probe becomes slightly larger. Both changes provide compliance and store elastic energy. Real deformations are much smaller than these pictures; the numbers retain the actual modeled strains.

cues.title: 水库把扰动反号送回
cues.titleEn: The reservoir reverses the pressure disturbance
cues.caption: 上游压力固定，返回的压力扰动必须反号。
cues.captionEn: Fixed upstream pressure requires a reflected disturbance of opposite pressure sign.
cues.zh: 现在让波前到达水库。这里的条件很特别：上游压力始终固定。原来的升压扰动不能在边界留下来，因此反射出降压扰动，向阀门返回。注意箭头可以反向，压力固定并不等于水不许动。反射的样子，由边界限制的量决定。
cues.en: Let the wave reach the reservoir. This boundary holds pressure fixed, so the arriving pressure rise cannot remain there. A pressure-reducing disturbance returns toward the valve. Notice that the water can reverse direction: fixed pressure does not mean fixed velocity. What a boundary constrains determines how it reflects the disturbance.

cues.title: 关阀处再反射
cues.titleEn: A second reflection at the closed valve
cues.caption: 关闭的阀门约束零流速，返回波再次改变压力。
cues.captionEn: The closed valve enforces zero velocity as the returning wave changes pressure again.
cues.zh: 返回的降压波终于抵达关闭的阀门，一次往返已经过去。这里要守住的是零流速，于是压力扰动再次反射。阀前压力可以低于最初的压力，不是永远只会上升。这个理想模型没有管摩阻，所以往返的振荡不会自己慢慢消失。
cues.en: The returning pressure drop now reaches the closed valve, completing a round trip. This boundary must keep velocity at zero, so the disturbance reflects again. Valve pressure can fall below its initial value; it does not only rise. Our ideal pipe has no wall friction, so these reflections do not gradually fade away.

cues.title: 给反射留出时间
cues.caption: 慢关过程中返回波已经到达，首个强峰被削弱。
cues.captionEn: During slow closure, returning waves modify the flow before the valve finishes closing.
cues.zh: 把两次试验放在同一时钟上。灰线快速关闭，金线缓慢关闭；管道、初速和初始压力都相同。看关闭时间与往返时间的比较：慢关时，反射已经回来，阀门却还没关完。这套规定的平滑开度规律给出更低的压力峰值，不是所有阀门都能套用的一条保证。
cues.en: Put both trials on the same clock. Gray closes quickly; gold closes slowly. Pipe dimensions, initial speed and initial pressure are identical. During slow closure, reflections return while the valve is still moving, modifying the pressure buildup. This specified smooth opening law gives a lower peak. It is a controlled comparison, not a guarantee for every valve.

cues.title: 改变弹性，不改变初速
cues.titleEn: Change elasticity, keep the initial speed
cues.caption: 管壁更软，波速降低，快速停止的首波幅度也降低。
cues.captionEn: A softer wall lowers wave speed and the first rapid-stop pressure rise.
cues.zh: 再做另一组对照，这次只改变管壁的弹性模量。较软的管壁更容易扩张，压力变化传播得更慢，往返时间更长。相同初速被快速停止时，首波幅度随波速降低。这里比较的是线弹性参数，并没有把塑料的黏弹性、管接头或支架运动一并解决。
cues.en: Now change only the wall’s Young’s modulus. A more compliant wall expands more easily, giving a slower pressure wave and a longer travel time. Stopping the same initial flow quickly also produces a smaller first-wave rise. This compares linear elastic parameters; it does not solve polymer viscoelasticity, joints or moving supports.

cues.title: 在模型边界停下
cues.caption: 到达蒸气压后，需要另一套物理才能继续。
cues.captionEn: Beyond vapor pressure, further motion needs additional physics.
cues.zh: 最后降低初始绝对压力，再做同样的快速关闭。升压波之后，回来的降压波不断消耗压力余量。触及水的蒸气压时，画面停在第一次到达边界的位置。接下来可能出现汽腔、液柱分离与重新撞合；这个单相模型不能预测那些过程，所以我们在这里停下。
cues.en: Lower the initial absolute pressure and repeat the same rapid closure. After the first pressure rise, the returning drop uses up the available margin. The display stops at the first point to reach water’s vapor pressure. Cavities, column separation and rejoining require additional physics. This single-phase model stops here instead of inventing the subsequent motion.

cues.title: 在水面转一个弯
cues.caption: 光线从空气进入水滴，向入口法线偏折。
cues.captionEn: Entering water, the ray bends toward the local normal.
cues.zh: 先别急着看整条彩虹，我们跟住这一束光。它碰到水滴，在入口处转了一个弯。虚线是这里的法线，也就是球面的径向方向。进入水中，光线向这条线靠近。接下来，它会碰到水滴的另一侧。
cues.en: Leave the whole rainbow for a moment. Follow this one ray. At the water surface, it changes direction. The dashed line is the local normal, pointing along the radius. Inside water, the ray bends toward that line. Now watch it approach the far side.

cues.title: 光没有全部折回
cues.caption: 背面同时反射和透射；主虹追踪其中反射的部分。
cues.captionEn: The far surface both reflects and transmits; the primary follows the reflected part.
cues.zh: 看第二个接触点。大部分光从这里透过去，浅色支路标出了它的去向。我们继续跟随的是折回水滴内部的那一部分。所以，这里并不是全反射。只留下这一条路径，是为了看清主虹怎样形成，并不是说其他光消失了。
cues.en: At the second contact, most of the light passes through the surface. The pale branch shows where it goes. Our highlighted ray follows the smaller reflected part. This is partial reflection. We are isolating one path to understand it, while keeping the other branch visible.

cues.title: 回到空气中
cues.caption: 再次折射后，主虹支路朝阳光来向附近返回。
cues.captionEn: After the second refraction, the primary branch travels back toward the incoming side.
cues.zh: 这束光又碰到水面，终于回到空气里。出口处，它偏离法线，方向再转一次。入水、一次内反射、出水，这三个接触点连成了主虹的路径。下面的比例也提醒我们：走完这条路的，只占最初阳光的一小部分。
cues.en: One more surface, and the ray is back in air. This time it bends away from the normal. Entry, one internal reflection, then exit: three contacts make the primary path. The power readout tells another part of the story. Only a small fraction of the original light follows it.

cues.title: 相邻入口，接近的出口方向
cues.caption: 入射位置继续移动时，出射角在驻值附近变化很小。
cues.captionEn: Near the stationary entry, moving the incoming ray barely changes its outgoing angle.
cues.zh: 现在让入口慢慢移动。出射角先增大，到了一个位置，却几乎不再变化，然后又减小。看看光束扇：许多相邻入口，挤到了接近的方向。角度分箱也在那里鼓起来。这个方向上的集中，解释了彩虹为什么出现在特定的位置。
cues.en: Move the incoming ray across the droplet. Its outgoing angle grows, almost stops changing, then turns back. Notice the fan of rays near that turning point. Neighboring entries leave in nearly the same direction. The angular bins gather there too. That is the preferred direction we are looking for.

cues.title: 颜色分开，是方向略有不同
cues.caption: 水的折射率随波长变化；红光的主虹角略大于紫光。
cues.captionEn: Water’s index changes with wavelength; red has a slightly larger primary angle than violet.
cues.zh: 把不同颜色放到一起。水对它们的折射率略有不同，所以出口方向也错开了一点。这里先保持同一个入口，下面再比较每种波长各自最集中的方向。红光的角度略大，紫光略小。真实的差别并不大，却足以把颜色分成一条带。
cues.en: Bring the colors together. Water bends different wavelengths by slightly different amounts. In the droplet we keep the entry fixed; below, we compare each wavelength’s own preferred direction. Red sits at a slightly larger angle than violet. A small angular difference is enough to separate the colors.

cues.title: 先固定一滴水
cues.caption: 同一滴水中，红光朝向眼睛，同一入口的紫光偏离眼睛。
cues.captionEn: At one droplet, red reaches the eye while violet at the same entry misses it.
cues.zh: 现在站到观察者的位置，太阳在身后。先只看水滴 A。我们把它放在这样一个位置：接近集中方向的红光，正好进入眼睛。同一入口的紫光呢？沿虚线追过去，它错开了。一个水滴不会把整条彩色弧线同时投进这只眼睛。
cues.en: Stand at the eye now, with the Sun behind you. Keep droplet A fixed. Its red ray, close to the preferred direction, reaches the eye. Follow violet through the same entry. The dashed ray misses. This droplet is not projecting an entire rainbow into one eye.

cues.title: 另一种颜色，来自另一条视线
cues.titleEn: Another color, another line of sight
cues.caption: 另一位置的水滴送来紫光；两种颜色从不同视线进入同一只眼睛。
cues.captionEn: A second droplet sends violet to the same eye along a different line of sight.
cues.zh: 再加一滴水 B，位置稍微变一变。现在，它的紫光也能到达同一只眼睛。注意两条视线，它们指向不同的水滴。天空里有许多这样的水滴，观察者从不同方向接到不同颜色的集中光，于是看见有顺序的色带。
cues.en: Add droplet B in a slightly different position. Its violet ray can now reach the same eye. Compare the two lines of sight: they point toward different droplets. With many droplets in the air, the observer receives the strongest colors from different directions, producing the ordered band.

cues.title: 圆锥被地平线切开
cues.caption: 虹围绕反太阳方向成圆；太阳升高时，地平线以上的弧段变少。
cues.captionEn: The bow circles the antisolar direction; a higher Sun leaves less of it above the horizon.
cues.zh: 把这些视线围绕反太阳方向转一圈，就得到一个圆锥。横线是地平线，我们通常只看到它上面的弧段。太阳升高，反太阳方向就往下走，彩虹也跟着下降。再让太阳低下来，弧线重新出现。彩虹的位置，始终连着太阳、水滴和你的眼睛。
cues.en: Sweep those viewing directions around the point opposite the Sun. They form a cone. The horizontal line marks the horizon, leaving only the upper arc visible. Raise the Sun and the bow drops. Lower it and the arc returns. Its position connects sunlight, droplets and your eye.

cues.title: 追踪绳上的点
cues.caption: 波峰在前进，物质点只在原位振动。
cues.captionEn: Crests travel; material points oscillate in place.
cues.zh: 先认准绳上的金点。两边的脉冲正在靠近，但这个点不会搭着波峰走。浅金色实线是绳子真正的形状，蓝色和陶红色虚线分别表示两列波的贡献。下面的轨迹记下金点的上下运动。横坐标始终没变，传过去的是扰动。
cues.en: Keep your eye on the gold point as the two pulses approach. It belongs to the string, so it does not ride along with a crest. The pale line is the actual string; the dashed lines separate the two contributions. Below, the trace records motion at that one fixed position.

cues.title: 相消的瞬间
cues.caption: 同一点的正、负位移相加，可以恰好为零。
cues.captionEn: Opposite displacements can sum to zero at the same point.
