cues.zh: 现在看两列脉冲重叠的地方。不要把两个波峰直接比较，要在同一个横坐标上取两项位移，再相加。三根刻度列出两项位移与总和。一个向上，一个向下；当两个形状完全对齐，绳子恰好平直。波真的消失了吗？
cues.en: Watch the overlap. We add displacements at the same horizontal position, not the heights of two unrelated crests. The three columns show the two contributions and their sum at P. As the matching pulses align, every displacement cancels. The string becomes straight. But a straight string need not be motionless.

cues.title: 平直仍有能量
cues.caption: 位移抵消时，速度可以不为零，能量仍在。
cues.captionEn: Displacement can cancel while velocity and energy remain.
cues.zh: 先停在这根平直的绳上，注意物质点旁的竖直箭头。它们表示速度，说明不少位置仍在运动。蓝色曲线显示动能，形变能此刻为零。继续一点点时间，绳形重新出现。没有能量凭空消失；只看位移，会漏掉正在发生的运动。
cues.en: Pause on the straight string and notice the vertical velocity arrows. Many material points are still moving. The blue energy curve shows kinetic energy; the string has no slope energy at this instant. Advance a little and its shape reappears. Cancellation removed displacement, not the motion or its energy.

cues.title: 穿过而不交换
cues.caption: 在线性理想绳中，两个脉冲保持形状穿过彼此。
cues.captionEn: On an ideal linear string, both pulses pass through unchanged.
cues.zh: 让时间继续。向右的脉冲出现在右边，向左的脉冲出现在左边，形状没有互相交换。金点完成了自己的运动，又回到平衡位置。整段过程来自同一个叠加公式。这种互不改变的穿越，依赖这里的小幅度、无阻尼和无色散假设。
cues.en: Now let the pulses separate. The rightward pulse emerges on the right, and the leftward pulse on the left, each keeping its original shape. P completes its own motion and returns to equilibrium. This passage follows the same sum throughout, under the small-slope, lossless, nondispersive assumptions of our ideal string.

cues.title: 改变相位差
cues.caption: 同频同向波：从同相增强，转到反相抵消。
cues.captionEn: Co-propagating waves go from reinforcement to cancellation as phase changes.
cues.zh: 接下来换成同频、同向的简谐波，专看同一点。先让两列波同相，合振幅是单列的两倍。保持振幅不动，逐渐把相位差转到半个周期，合振幅就降到零。这里比较的是不同输入，不是说调相位的过程没有外界作用。
cues.en: Switch to sinusoidal waves traveling together and compare one point. Equal waves in phase give twice the individual amplitude. Keep their amplitudes fixed and move their phase difference toward half a cycle: the resultant falls to zero. These are comparisons between different inputs, not an isolated system changing phase by itself.

cues.title: 反相还不够
cues.caption: 完全抵消需要反相，也需要等振幅。
cues.captionEn: Full cancellation requires equal amplitudes as well as opposite phase.
cues.zh: 把相位差留在半个周期，只减小第二列波的振幅。现在一项位移已经不足以抵消另一项，金色的合位移重新出现。第二列减到一半时，还剩两毫米的合振幅。反相描述的是节奏；两边还必须一样强，才能处处相消。
cues.en: Leave the phase difference at half a cycle and reduce only the second amplitude. Its contribution can no longer cancel the first, and the gold resultant returns. With the second wave at half strength, two millimeters remain. Opposite phase specifies timing; complete cancellation also needs the two amplitudes to match.

cues.title: 波列进入，波节形成
cues.caption: 反向波列真正进入并重叠，固定的波节逐渐显现。
cues.captionEn: Incoming counterpropagating trains overlap and establish stationary nodes.
cues.zh: 现在让两列同频波从相反方向进入。注意蓝色和陶红色的前沿，它们确实沿绳传播，不是把驻波图案慢慢显出来。重叠区扩大以后，有些位置一直相消，有些位置振动很大。前沿通过整个观察窗后，这些固定的波节就连成了驻波。
cues.en: Now waves arrive from opposite directions. Follow the blue and coral fronts: the envelopes really travel along the string. As overlap grows, some positions repeatedly cancel while others move strongly. Once both fronts have passed through the window, the stationary pattern is established. No clamps were added to make those nodes.

cues.title: 不动的点，流动的能量
cues.caption: 波节相隔半个波长；驻波仍有局部能量交换。
cues.captionEn: Nodes are half a wavelength apart; local energy still exchanges.
cues.zh: 看圆环标出的波节，旁边的波腹正在起伏，波节却始终不动。相邻波节相隔半个波长。再看下面：动能和形变能交替增减，窗口内的总量保持不变。驻波的平均净能流为零，并不等于每一瞬间都没有局部能量流动。
cues.en: The rings mark nodes. Neighboring antinodes move, but those positions remain still, half a wavelength apart. Below, kinetic and potential energy trade places while the total in this window stays constant. A standing wave has zero average net energy flow; that does not rule out local flow at individual instants.

cues.title: 三相，合成一个转向
cues.caption: 三相电流错开三分之一个周期，合成磁场持续转向。
cues.captionEn: Three currents are a third of a cycle apart; their combined field keeps turning.
cues.zh: 先看三种颜色的绕组。它们固定不动，电流却轮流增强、减弱和反向。轴端的小箭头把三个方向的作用加在一起，得到这根绿色箭头。转起来的是磁场，不是外面的铁壳。这里也计入了转子电流对磁场的反作用。
cues.en: Watch the three colored windings. They stay still while their currents rise, fall, and reverse. The small arrows resolve their magnetic contributions into one green arrow. That field turns even though the stator does not. The circuit also accounts for the opposing magnetic effect of the rotor currents.

cues.title: 磁场有自己的速度
cues.caption: 这里是两极电机：50 Hz 的电源，对应每分钟 3000 转的磁场。
cues.captionEn: This two-pole motor has a 50 Hz supply and a field that turns at 3000 rpm.
cues.zh: 现在沿轴看进去。绿色磁场不断转过一圈，铜色的转子标记却留在原地，因为这一幕把轴固定住了。这台模型只有一对磁极，电源每完成一个周期，磁场就转一圈。五十赫兹对应每分钟三千转，不是每分钟五十转。
cues.en: Look straight down the shaft. The green field keeps making complete turns, while the copper rotor mark stays put: we are holding the shaft in this shot. With one pole pair, each electrical cycle makes one field revolution. Fifty cycles per second therefore means three thousand revolutions per minute.

cues.title: 没有接线，也能有电流
cues.caption: 磁场掠过静止铜条；电流沿导条与两端铜环闭合。
cues.captionEn: A moving field induces current in stationary bars; the two end rings close the paths.
cues.zh: 靠近前面的铜环。转子没有接到电源的电线，但每根铜条都和前后两只端环连在一起，形成闭合通路。圆点表示电流朝向你，叉号表示流向背面。端环里的电流把这些方向连接起来。颜色表示电流方向和强弱，不是在追踪电子。
cues.en: Come closer to the front copper ring. There are no supply wires on the rotor, but every bar joins both end rings. Those connections close the current paths. A dot means current toward you; a cross means current away. The ring currents join those paths. Their colors show direction and relative strength.

cues.title: 松开轴，转子开始追赶
cues.caption: 电磁转矩先加速转子；转子接近磁场速度后，感应电流减小。
cues.captionEn: Torque accelerates the rotor; induced current falls as it approaches the field speed.
cues.zh: 松开轴以后，电磁转矩先把转子加速起来。看启动曲线怎样上升，再慢慢变平。这里用转矩和转动惯量计算速度，负载始终是一牛米。转子越接近磁场，看到的磁通变化越慢，电流和转矩就越小，最后与负载达到平衡。
cues.en: Release the shaft and electromagnetic torque accelerates the rotor. Follow the startup curve as it rises and then levels off. The calculation includes inertia and a constant one newton-meter load. As the rotor approaches the field speed, induction weakens. Torque falls until it balances the load.

cues.title: 追上了，反而没有转矩
cues.titleEn: Catch the field, lose the torque
cues.caption: 把转子带到同步速度，转差为零，感应电流和电磁转矩也为零。
cues.captionEn: At synchronous speed, slip is zero, so induced rotor current and torque are zero.
cues.zh: 这一幕用外力设定转速，让转子慢慢追上磁场。留意转差、转子电流和转矩：这三个数一起趋向零。完全同步时，转子不再看到变化的主磁通，所以没有持续的感应电流。定子仍然需要磁化电流，但那不等于转子还有驱动转矩。
cues.en: Here an external drive sets the rotor speed, bringing it up to the field speed. Watch slip, rotor current, and torque all approach zero. At synchronism, the main flux no longer changes in the rotor frame. Stator magnetizing current remains, but the model produces no rotor current or driving torque.

cues.title: 多一点负载，多一点落后
cues.caption: 比较稳定运行点：负载加大，转子稍慢，转差带来更大的转矩。
cues.captionEn: At stable operating points, added load makes the rotor slightly slower and torque larger.
cues.zh: 把负载从一牛米增加到四牛米，比较曲线上的稳定运行点。交点向低一点的转速移动，转差却增加了。转子因此感应出更大的电流，提供更大的转矩。这里选的是接近同步速度的稳定支，不能把负载无限加大，还期待电机总能追上。
cues.en: Increase the load from one to four newton-meters and compare the settled operating points. The intersection shifts to a slightly lower speed. More slip induces more current and produces more torque. These points lie on the stable branch near synchronism. A motor cannot support an arbitrarily large load.

cues.title: 换相序，重新启动
cues.caption: 停机后交换两相再启动，磁场和转子的方向一起反转。
cues.captionEn: After stopping, swapping two phases reverses the field and the restarted rotor.
cues.zh: 现在从已经停稳的状态重新开始，把相序由 A、B、C 换成 A、C、B。绿色磁场先改变方向，转子再沿着新的方向加速。绕组位置和鼠笼连接都没有变化。这是在比较两种启动方向，没有模拟高速运转中直接换相产生的制动暂态。
cues.en: Start again from rest, this time changing the sequence from A, B, C to A, C, B. The field turns the other way, and the rotor accelerates in that direction. Neither the windings nor the cage connections move. This compares two starts; it does not simulate switching phases on a running motor.

cues.title: 落后的那一部分，变成热
cues.caption: 穿过气隙的功率，一部分变成机械功，一部分在转子里发热。
cues.captionEn: Air-gap power splits into mechanical power and heat in the rotor.
cues.zh: 最后跟着功率走。电气输入先扣掉定子铜耗，剩下的功率穿过气隙。它再分成机械功和转子铜耗。转差越大，气隙功率里变成转子热量的比例越大。这里没有计算铁耗、风阻和轴承摩擦，所以这组数是教学模型的收支，不是实物效率承诺。
cues.en: Follow the power at the end. Subtract stator copper loss from the electrical input to find air-gap power. That splits into mechanical power and rotor copper loss. Slip is exactly the fraction lost as rotor heat in this model. Core loss, windage, and bearing friction would add further losses in a real machine.

cues.title: 不变的发射节拍
cues.caption: 双方静止时，传播只推迟到达，不改变间隔。
cues.captionEn: With both bodies still, propagation delays arrivals without changing their spacing.
cues.zh: 先盯住上排的短线。声源每隔同样长的时间发出一个波峰，接收者稍晚才收到。现在双方都静止，下面的短线虽然整体推后，间隔却完全相同。传播花了时间，但还没有改变频率。
cues.en: Watch the evenly spaced marks on the upper row. Each one is a new crest leaving the source. The receiver gets it later, after sound has crossed the gap. With both objects still, that delay shifts the whole pattern along. It does not change the spacing between arrivals.

cues.title: 圆心留在过去
cues.caption: 声源移走后，每一圈仍以发射时的位置为圆心。
cues.captionEn: After the source moves on, each circle stays centered at its emission position.
cues.zh: 现在让声源向右移动。沿着它身后的几个小圆点，看一圈波怎样长大：圆心留在出发的位置，没有被声源拖走。下一圈从更靠右的地方发出。每圈都以同样的声速扩张，前后的间距却开始不同。
cues.en: Now move the source to the right. Look at the little dots left behind it. Each dot is where a particular circle began, and that center stays put as the circle grows. The next crest starts farther right. Every front expands at the same sound speed, but their spacing becomes uneven.

cues.title: 前方更快到达
cues.caption: 前方波长缩短；源频率不变，接收频率升高。
cues.captionEn: The forward wavelength shrinks. Emission frequency stays fixed; reception frequency rises.
cues.zh: 把接收者放在正前方。看金色标尺量出的两峰间距，比静止时短了。声源每走近一步，下一峰就少走一段路，所以相邻波峰更快抵达。上排发射节拍照旧，下面却挤出了更多到达。这就是靠近时升高的音调。
cues.en: Put the receiver directly ahead. The gold bracket measures a shorter gap between crests. Each new crest starts closer to the receiver, so it has less distance to travel than the one before. Emissions keep their original rhythm above, while arrival marks crowd together below. A higher arrival rate means higher pitch.

cues.title: 后方需要多等一会
cues.caption: 声源远离时，后方波长变长，到达节拍变慢。
cues.captionEn: As the source recedes, rearward wavelengths lengthen and arrivals slow down.
cues.zh: 再从后面接收同一个声源。它发下一峰时已经走得更远，声音要补上多出来的路程。看后方两圈之间的距离，再看下面两次到达之间的空隙，两处都拉长了。声源并没有放慢振动，是接收者等得更久。
cues.en: Now receive the same source from behind. By the next emission, the source is farther away, and that crest has extra distance to cover. Compare the wider space between circles with the wider space between arrival marks. The source has not slowed its vibration. The receiver simply waits longer between crests.

cues.title: 迎着波峰走
cues.caption: 声源静止、波长不变，移动接收者仍能改变到达频率。
cues.captionEn: With a stationary source and unchanged wavelength, receiver motion still changes arrival frequency.
cues.zh: 这次把声源停住，只让接收者迎着波峰走。波圈重新变成等间距，可下面的到达依然加快了。区别在这里：移动声源改变波峰在空气中的间距，移动接收者则改变自己穿过波峰的速度。两种情况不能直接互换。
cues.en: This time, hold the source still and let the receiver walk into the waves. The circles return to equal spacing, yet arrivals still speed up. A moving source changes crest spacing in the air. A moving receiver changes how quickly it crosses those crests. Swapping their roles does not give the same equation.

cues.title: 一起移动，节拍回归
cues.caption: 两者同速前进：波长缩短与接收者远离的作用恰好抵消。
cues.captionEn: At equal velocities, shorter forward crests and receiver recession exactly balance.
cues.zh: 现在让两者以同样的速度向右走。前方的波圈仍然压缩，接收者却也在离开那些发射位置。这两个作用恰好抵消：下排刻度重新与上排一样均匀。判断频移时，要同时看源、接收者和作为传播参照的空气。
cues.en: Let both objects travel rightward at the same speed. Crests ahead are still compressed, but the receiver is also moving away from the places where those crests began. The effects balance exactly: both rows have the same spacing again. Keep track of the source, the receiver, and the air that carries the sound.

cues.title: 声音来自较早的位置
cues.titleEn: Sound comes from an earlier position
cues.caption: 离轴经过时，沿真正的传播方向回看过去的发射点。
cues.captionEn: During an off-axis pass, follow the actual propagation direction back to emission.
cues.zh: 把接收者移到路旁。声源经过时，金线指向的是过去的发射点，而虚线才指向现在的声源。声音需要时间才能抵达，不能只看眼前两点的连线。随着真正的传播方向转动，下面接连几段到达间隔逐渐改变，音调也随之过渡。
cues.en: Move the receiver beside the path. The gold line points back to where arriving sound was emitted; the dashed line points to the source now. Those are different directions because travel takes time. As the actual sound path turns during the pass, successive arrival intervals change. Pitch does not switch simply at the visible nearest point.

cues.title: 接近声速的边界
cues.caption: 声源仍低于声速；拥挤的波峰不能直接外推成激波模型。
cues.captionEn: The source remains subsonic. Crowded crests are not a shock-wave model.
cues.zh: 最后提高声源速度，但仍留在声速以下。和低速实验相比，前方波峰挤得更紧，到达刻度也更密，发射节拍始终没变。恰好达到声速时，前面这套条件就到了边界。本篇停在这里；超声速的激波，以及光的频移，需要另外的模型。
cues.en: Finally, use a faster source that still stays below the speed of sound. Crests crowd tightly ahead, and arrival marks become much denser, while the emission beat remains unchanged. Exactly at the sound speed, these assumptions reach their boundary. We stop short of it: shock waves, and Doppler shifts of light, need different models.

cues.title: 一条水路，三个测压口
cues.caption: 喉部更窄，水更快，开口水柱反而更低。
cues.captionEn: The throat is narrower and faster, yet its pressure column is lower.
cues.zh: 先看这三个相连的测压口。水从左侧进入，穿过喉部，再从右侧离开。中间的截面最小，那里的水体标记走得更快，开口水柱却更低。这是一根已经稳定流动的管道；入口流量由外部装置规定，接下来我们跟着同一份水解释这个差别。
cues.en: Look at the three pressure taps connected to one tube. Water enters from the left, passes through the throat and leaves on the right. The narrowest section carries the fastest moving markers, yet its water column is lower. This flow is already steady, with discharge prescribed upstream. Follow one water volume to see why the readings differ.

cues.title: 同一份水，在窄处拉长
cues.titleEn: One volume stretches through the throat
cues.caption: 体积守恒把截面积与流速连在一起。
cues.captionEn: Conserved volume connects cross-sectional area to velocity.
cues.zh: 现在只留下这一份金色的水。看它的前后边界：进入喉部时，两端的距离变长了，但这份水的体积没有变。上方两个圆显示真实的截面积比例。每秒通过各处的水量必须相同，所以面积越小，平均流速越大。标记离开出口后不会瞬移回去。
cues.en: Keep your eye on the single gold volume. Its front and rear boundaries spread apart in the throat, but its volume stays fixed. The two circles show the actual area ratio. Equal volume must pass every section each second, so the smaller section needs greater mean speed. This material identity eventually leaves the tube; it never jumps back to the inlet.

cues.title: 把速度和压力放进同一本账
cues.titleEn: Put pressure and speed in one account
cues.caption: 水平无损时，总水头不变，压力与速度水头互相转换。
cues.captionEn: In the horizontal lossless case, pressure and velocity head share a constant total.
cues.zh: 把同一条管路换成水头账本。测点从入口走向喉部，蓝色的压力部分变短，金色的速度部分变长，两者的顶端仍对着同一条总水头线。这是沿同一流线的无损能量平衡。它需要稳态和不可压缩等条件，不能只凭一个速度数字判断任何地方的压强。
cues.en: Now read the same tube as an energy account. As the probe approaches the throat, the blue pressure contribution shrinks and the gold velocity contribution grows. Their top stays on the same total-head line. This is a lossless balance along one streamline, with steady incompressible flow. A speed reading alone cannot determine pressure in every possible flow.

cues.title: 宽回来，压力也恢复
cues.caption: 扩张段流速降低，理想无损出口恢复入口压力。
cues.captionEn: The diffuser slows the flow and recovers inlet pressure in the ideal model.
cues.zh: 继续往出口追踪测点。管道逐渐变宽，局部流速开始下降，压力读数回升。出口和入口的面积、高度相同；在这次没有损失的计算里，压力也恢复到入口值。这不是说真实装置一定能完全恢复，而是先把理想的能量转换看清楚。
cues.en: Continue following the probe toward the outlet. The tube gradually widens, local speed falls and the pressure reading rises. Outlet and inlet have the same area and elevation, so this lossless calculation recovers the inlet pressure. Real apparatus need not recover it completely. First, we are isolating the ideal conversion between pressure and kinetic energy.

cues.title: 速度一样，压力还能不同
cues.titleEn: Equal speed can still mean different pressure
cues.caption: 等截面管抬高出口，速度不变，压力降低。
cues.captionEn: Raising a uniform tube’s outlet lowers pressure without changing speed.
cues.zh: 换成一根等截面的管，流量保持不变。现在逐步抬高出口，看两端的速度读数：它们仍然相同，出口压力却下降了。能量账本多了高程这一项。画面是在比较一系列独立稳态，不是模拟搬动水管的过程；快流必然低压的口号，在这里显然不够用。
cues.en: Switch to a uniform tube while keeping the same discharge. Raise the outlet and watch the two speed readings: they remain equal, but outlet pressure falls. Elevation now matters in the energy account. These are separate steady solutions, not a simulation of lifting a flowing pipe. The slogan that faster flow always means lower pressure is not enough.

cues.title: 水不动，仍有压力差
cues.titleEn: Still water can have a pressure difference
cues.caption: 零流量时，液面等高不代表各处压力相等。
cues.captionEn: At zero flow, level column surfaces do not mean equal local pressure.
cues.zh: 保留这根倾斜管，把流量设为零。水体标记停住，三个开口水柱的自由液面仍在同一高度。再沿管移动测点：越高的位置，压力越低，即使各处速度都是零。液面高度表示的是压力水头加高程；这一步把伯努利关系接回了静水压。
cues.en: Keep the inclined tube and set its discharge to zero. The water markers stop, and all three open-column surfaces still line up. Move the probe uphill: local pressure decreases even though velocity is zero everywhere. Surface elevation represents pressure head plus elevation. This connects the energy relation to ordinary hydrostatics and distinguishes a level surface from uniform pressure.

cues.title: 把沿程损失算进去
cues.caption: 同样的流量与几何，有损总水头沿管下降。
cues.captionEn: With the same flow and geometry, loss makes total head decrease downstream.
cues.zh: 回到文丘里管，这次加入指定的沿程摩阻。灰虚线保留无损对照，两次流量、入口压力和几何都一样。测点向下游移动，累计损失增加，总水头随之降低。摩阻系数是作者给定的教学参数，没有自动算出真实湍流；这里只比较这一项明确计算的机械能损失。
cues.en: Return to the Venturi and add a specified distributed friction loss. Gray dashed lines retain the lossless reference; flow, inlet pressure and geometry are identical. Moving downstream increases accumulated loss and lowers total head. The friction factor is an authored teaching parameter, not a turbulence prediction. We are comparing one explicitly calculated mechanical-energy loss.

cues.title: 到蒸气压，模型停下
cues.caption: 绝对压力触及蒸气压后，不再外推单相液流。
cues.captionEn: A liquid-only solution is not continued past vapor pressure.
cues.zh: 最后降低入口的绝对压力，测压口改用密闭仪表。喉部还有多大的压力余量，现在直接看得见。最低压力触及蒸气压时，画面停在液态模型的边界，同时列出原先请求的入口压力。气泡、汽化和流量改变需要额外物理；我们不把公式继续外推成不存在的液态画面。
cues.en: Finally, lower inlet absolute pressure and read the sealed instruments. The remaining pressure margin at the throat is now explicit. When the minimum reaches vapor pressure, the display stops at the liquid model’s boundary and separately shows the requested inlet pressure. Bubbles, vapor formation and changes in discharge need additional physics. We do not extrapolate an unsupported liquid state.

cues.title: 四位数据，七个位置
cues.caption: 四个数据位保留原值，三个校验位补足偶校验。
cues.captionEn: Four data bits stay intact; three check bits make each group even.
cues.zh: 先跟住这四位数据，一零一一。它们放在第三、第五、第六和第七位，数值没有改变。剩下三个位置不是备份，而是校验位。看彩线依次亮起，每条线只管自己的四个位。补上零或一，让这一组里面，一的总数成为偶数。四位消息就织成了七位码字。
cues.en: Follow the four data bits: one, zero, one, one. They keep their values at positions three, five, six and seven. The three empty places hold check bits. Watch each colored loop in turn. We fill its check position so that the loop contains an even number of ones. Four data bits now travel as seven.

cues.title: 重叠形成位置指纹
cues.titleEn: Overlap gives each position a signature
cues.caption: 每个位参加不同的校验组合；位置 6 属于 C2、C4，不属于 C1。
cues.captionEn: Each position has a different check signature; position 6 belongs to C2 and C4, but not C1.
cues.zh: 为什么让彩线重叠？现在沿着三条线再看一遍。一个位置可能被一条、两条，或者三条线检查。注意第六位，它在第二组和第四组里，却不在第一组里。七个位的参与组合都不同。以后如果只有一位翻转，哪些组变成奇数，就能反过来认出它的位置。
cues.en: Why do the loops overlap? Follow them again. A position can belong to one, two or all three checks. Look at position six: it belongs to C two and C four, but stays outside C one. Every position has a different membership pattern. One flipped bit will disturb exactly the checks that include it.

cues.title: 码字穿过信道
cues.caption: 先对齐相同位编号，再让信道只翻转第 6 位。
cues.captionEn: Align the same positions, then let the channel flip only position 6.
cues.zh: 把完整码字送出去。先比较发送和接收，它们逐位相同。现在让信道只翻转第六位，一变成了零。数字上方的编号没有变，所以我们始终跟着同一个位置。校验位也和数据一起经过信道，并不是放在接收端的一份秘密答案。接收端必须只凭收到的七个位来判断。
cues.en: Send the complete word. At first, sent and received bits match position by position. Now the channel flips position six from one to zero. Its number stays fixed, so we can follow its identity. The check bits travel through the channel too. The receiver has no secret copy of the original message to compare against.

cues.title: 把校验结果读成位置
cues.titleEn: Read the syndrome as a position
cues.caption: C4、C2、C1 的结果是 110₂ = 6；单错假设下定位第 6 位。
cues.captionEn: C4, C2, C1 read 110₂ = 6, locating position 6 under the single-error assumption.
cues.zh: 接收端重新数每条线里的那些位。偶数个一，校验结果是零；奇数个一，结果是一。第一组通过，第二组和第四组失败。按第四、第二、第一组的顺序排起来，得到一一零。这个二进制数就是六。我们称它为综合征；在只有单错的前提下，它给出了错误位置。
cues.en: Recheck the received word. An even number of ones gives zero; an odd number gives one. C one passes, while C two and C four fail. Read the results in the order C four, C two, C one: one, one, zero. That binary number is six. Under the single-error assumption, this syndrome locates the flipped bit.

cues.title: 翻回，再提取
cues.caption: 只翻回第 6 位，校验归零，四位数据恢复为 1011。
cues.captionEn: Flip only position 6 back; checks return to zero and the data returns to 1011.
cues.zh: 先停在还没有修正的码字上。综合征指向六，所以解码器只翻回第六位。再看三项校验，结果又全部为零。现在从第三、第五、第六、第七位取出数据，一零一一回来了。这里不需要猜原始消息。只要整字最多错一位，即使翻错的是校验位，也能用同样的规则恢复。
cues.en: Pause on the received word before repair. The syndrome points to six, so the decoder flips just that position back. All three checks now return zero. Extract positions three, five, six and seven: one, zero, one, one is restored. This works for any single flipped position, including a check bit, provided there is at most one error.

cues.title: 双错也能伪装
cues.caption: 翻转 3、5 位也产生综合征 6；再翻 6 会通过校验，却交付错误数据。
cues.captionEn: Flips at 3 and 5 also produce syndrome 6; flipping 6 then passes the checks but delivers wrong data.
cues.zh: 接下来换一个信道：同时翻转第三位和第五位。综合征居然还是六。普通解码器不知道我们动了两处，仍然翻转第六位。看结果，三项校验全通过，可提取的数据已经不是原来的消息。双错伪装成了另一个位置的单错。校验通过，并不等于这次纠正真的正确。
cues.en: Now change the channel: flip positions three and five together. The syndrome is still six. The ordinary decoder cannot tell that we changed two places, so it flips position six again. All checks pass afterward, but the extracted data is wrong. Two errors have impersonated a single error elsewhere. Passing the checks does not prove the repair was correct.

cues.title: 加上全字的奇偶检查
cues.titleEn: Add a check across the whole word
cues.caption: 相同双错下，s 非零而 q 为零；扩展码检出双错，拒绝误纠。
cues.captionEn: For the same double error, s is nonzero and q is zero; the extended code detects it and refuses to correct.
cues.zh: 再加第八位，让整个八位码字里，一的总数也成为偶数。这是扩展汉明码。现在仍然翻转第三位和第五位。两次翻转不会改变全字的奇偶性，但原来的综合征仍然非零。两条线索合起来，接收端认出双错，停止纠正，也不交付数据。多这一位，换来了识别这种歧义的能力。
cues.en: Add an eighth bit so the entire eight-bit word has even parity. This is extended Hamming. Repeat the same flips at three and five. Two flips leave overall parity even, yet the original syndrome remains nonzero. Together, those clues identify a double error. The receiver stops instead of guessing a repair, and withholds the data.

cues.title: 一位可纠，两位可检
cues.caption: 在最多两位翻转的前提下区分四种情况；更多错误没有同样保证。
cues.captionEn: Distinguish four cases under an at-most-two-flip assumption; larger errors carry no such guarantee.
cues.zh: 最后把四种情况放在一起看。没有错误，两个检查都为零。只错第六位，总奇偶为奇，按综合征修正。只错新增的第八位，综合征为零，总奇偶仍为奇，单独修正第八位。双错则报警。这个保证到两位为止：更多翻转可能被误纠，甚至完全漏检。纠错能力始终有边界。
cues.en: Watch the four cases. With no errors, both results are zero. One error at six gives odd overall parity and a location to repair. An error in the added eighth bit leaves the syndrome zero but makes overall parity odd. Two errors trigger detection. These guarantees stop at two: larger error patterns may be miscorrected or go unnoticed.

cues.title: 同一根车轴，走两条不同的弧
cues.caption: 外侧车轮路程更长，需要转得更快。
cues.captionEn: The outside wheel follows a longer path and must turn faster.
cues.zh: 汽车转弯时，两只驱动轮能一直转得一样快吗？看这两条轮迹。它们属于同一根车轴，经过的时间相同，外侧却走了更长的圆弧。如果轮胎都在滚动，外侧就必须转得更快。差速器要容许这个差别，同时保持发动机与两侧车轮的机械联系。
cues.en: Can both driven wheels keep the same speed through a turn? Follow these two tracks from one axle. The time is identical, but the outside wheel travels a longer arc. Rolling without slip requires different wheel speeds. The differential permits that difference while keeping both wheels mechanically connected to the drive.

cues.title: 直行时，行星齿轮只随壳体公转
cues.caption: 两只半轴齿轮同速，行星齿轮相对壳体不自转。
cues.captionEn: With equal side speeds, the pinions do not spin relative to the carrier.
cues.zh: 先回到直行。输入带动这个开窗的壳体，壳体中的十字轴也一起转。铜色的小齿轮绕车轴公转，却没有相对十字轴自转。两只半轴齿轮和车轮保持同速。不要把壳体带着小齿轮转，与小齿轮绕自己的轴转，混成同一种运动。
cues.en: Start with straight travel. The input rotates the carrier and its cross pin. The bronze pinions orbit the axle, but do not spin relative to that pin. Both side gears and wheels turn at the same speed. Watch the distinction between being carried around and spinning about a gear’s own shaft.

cues.title: 转弯时，行星齿轮还会自转
cues.caption: 同一个锥顶、相交的轴线，保持齿面接触。
cues.captionEn: A common cone apex and intersecting axes keep the tooth flanks in contact.
cues.zh: 现在给两侧不同的转速。铜色行星齿轮开始绕自己的轴转，补上左右半轴的差。凑近看，它们不是普通圆柱齿轮：齿面沿锥体收窄，两组轴线相交，节锥有共同的顶点。亮点跟着真实计算的齿面接触移动，不是贴在一个固定交叉点上。
cues.en: Now give the sides different speeds. The bronze pinions begin spinning on their own shafts to accommodate the difference. Look closely: these are conical gears, with tapered teeth and intersecting axes. Their pitch cones share an apex. The highlights follow calculated tooth-flank contacts rather than a fixed decorative crossing point.

cues.title: 平均转速由壳体决定
cues.titleEn: The carrier sets the mean speed
cues.caption: 一侧减少的转速，恰好由另一侧增加。
cues.captionEn: A decrease on one side is matched by an increase on the other.
cues.zh: 保持壳体转速不变，逐渐增大、再减小两侧的转速差。看中间这个标记，它始终留在两个车轮转速的正中间。一侧比壳体慢多少，另一侧就快多少。两侧相加等于壳体转速的两倍。这个关系规定平均值，并没有要求两只车轮每时每刻一样快。
cues.en: Keep the carrier speed fixed while increasing and then reducing the difference between the sides. The central mark stays halfway between the wheel speeds. One side loses exactly what the other gains relative to the carrier. Their sum is twice carrier speed. The constraint fixes an average, not identical wheel speeds.

cues.title: 固定一侧，另一侧转得更快
cues.titleEn: Hold one side, speed up the other
cues.caption: 这是固定一只车轮的试验，不是锁止差速器。
cues.captionEn: This test holds one wheel; it does not lock the differential.
cues.zh: 在试验台上固定左轮，再让壳体转动。左轮的转速现在为零，右轮就达到壳体转速的两倍。行星齿轮的自转更加明显。这里固定的是一只输出轮，不是把差速器锁住。我们先规定运动约束，尚未用这幅动画推断轮胎打滑或汽车能否前进。
cues.en: Hold the left wheel on the test stand and rotate the carrier. With the left speed at zero, the right speed becomes twice carrier speed. Pinion spin is now more obvious. Holding one output wheel is different from locking the differential. This is a prescribed-motion test, not a prediction of tire slip.

cues.title: 分开看：转速与扭矩
cues.caption: 理想、无损且忽略齿轮惯性时，两侧扭矩相等。
cues.captionEn: The ideal, lossless model with negligible gear inertia gives equal side torques.
cues.zh: 转速可以不同，扭矩又怎样分配？换到理想载荷模型：忽略齿轮惯性、摩擦和损耗，两侧得到相等的扭矩。下面的功率却可以不同，因为功率还要乘上各自的转速。把两侧功率加起来，正好等于壳体输入。不要把相同扭矩误读成相同功率。
cues.en: Different speeds do not automatically mean different torques. In this ideal load model, gear inertia, friction and losses are neglected, and side torques are equal. The powers below can still differ because power also includes shaft speed. Adding the two output powers gives carrier input power. Equal torque need not mean equal power.

cues.title: 弱侧的上限，会限制两侧
cues.titleEn: The weaker limit constrains both sides
cues.caption: 这里只计算可维持的扭矩上限，不预测打滑后的车速。
cues.captionEn: This calculates sustainable torque limits, not vehicle speed after wheel slip.
cues.zh: 让左侧轮胎能提供的反作用扭矩逐渐减少。两侧扭矩仍然相等，所以右侧也被较低的上限限制。请求的输入扭矩不能全被接受，图中把请求与实际传递分开。这个模型说明开放式差速器的牵引限制；它没有计算轮胎打滑之后的加速、转速或车辆运动。
cues.en: Gradually reduce the reaction torque available at the left tire. Equal side torques mean the right side is limited too. The full input request can no longer be accepted, so the diagram separates the request from transmitted torque. This explains a traction limitation; it does not calculate the later acceleration or wheel-slip speed.

cues.title: 允许差速，保留机械联系
cues.caption: 道路要求不同转速，齿轮约束它们的平均值。
cues.captionEn: The road requires different speeds; the gears constrain their average.
cues.zh: 回到这些彼此连接的齿轮。壳体带来平均转速，行星齿轮允许左右出现差别。转弯半径决定无侧滑时需要多大的差，而可用反作用扭矩属于另一个问题。现在可以固定一侧、改变输入，或比较两条轮迹，再把时间停在想检查的接触位置。
cues.en: Return to the connected gears. The carrier provides the average speed; pinion spin permits a difference between the sides. Turn radius determines the difference needed for rolling, while available reaction torque is a separate question. Explore a held output, change the input, compare wheel paths, or pause at a particular tooth contact.

cues.title: 先发出一小段声音
cues.caption: 有限脉冲离开探头，随后沿原声线返回。
cues.captionEn: A finite pulse leaves the probe and later returns along the same ray.
cues.zh: 先看探头下面那一小段振动。它有开始，也有结束，不是一股持续不断的声音。探头发完就转为接收，等界面把一部分声音送回来。发射曲线给出这段脉冲的形状，体模里的窄带标出它正在经过的位置。
cues.en: Watch the small packet leaving the probe. It begins and ends; this is not a continuous stream of sound. After transmission, the same probe receives sound returning from a boundary. The transmit trace shows the finite pulse shape, while the narrow band in the phantom follows its actual position.

cues.title: 用往返时间定位
cues.titleEn: Locate a boundary by its delay
cues.caption: 先走到界面，再返回探头；往返时间除以二才给出深度。
cues.captionEn: Travel to the boundary and back: divide the round-trip time by two to recover depth.
cues.zh: 同一次发射，会收到几个先后到来的回波。浅界面先到，深界面后到。把选中的回波时刻乘以声速，还要除以二，因为声音已经走了一个来回。看体模的深度刻度，再对照曲线上的到达位置，两边由同一段传播时间连接。
cues.en: One transmission produces several arrivals. Shallow boundaries return first; deeper ones return later. Multiply an echo’s delay by sound speed, then divide by two, because sound has traveled there and back. Compare the phantom’s depth ruler with the arrival marks. The same travel-time calculation connects the two views.

cues.title: 反射一部分，继续走一部分
cues.caption: 能量在界面分流；深部回波还要通过上方界面两次。
cues.captionEn: Energy divides at a boundary; deeper echoes cross overlying interfaces on both legs.
cues.zh: 放慢看第一处界面。声波到这里并没有全部折返：一部分成为回波，其余继续向深处走。旁边两条能量标尺加起来正好是一。要算更深处的回波，还得记住，它出去和回来都要穿过上方界面，不能只乘一次透射。
cues.en: Slow down at the first boundary. Sound does not all turn back here. Some reflects, and the rest continues deeper. The two energy fractions add to one. A deeper echo also has to cross every overlying interface twice, once on the outward journey and once on its return to the probe.

cues.title: 负回波也能成为亮线
cues.titleEn: A negative echo can still be bright
cues.caption: 先保留 RF 的符号与相位，再从相干信号求非负包络。
cues.captionEn: Keep RF sign and phase, then obtain a nonnegative envelope from the coherent signal.
cues.zh: 把两次回波的中心对齐。上面在中心向上，下面却向下，这是声阻抗降低时发生的相位翻转。再看金色包络：两条都在零线上方。扫描图把包络大小变成亮度，不能把负压简单画成黑色，也不能在相加之前丢掉回波的符号。
cues.en: Align the centers of two echoes. The first points upward at its center; the second points downward because reflection into lower impedance reverses pressure phase. Both gold envelopes remain positive. Image brightness comes from the envelope, so negative pressure is not simply black. Keep the signs until the echoes have been added coherently.

cues.title: 一条 A 线，成为一列像素
cues.titleEn: One A-line becomes one image column
cues.caption: 每个停驻位置收齐回波，再按时间和亮度组成扫描列。
cues.captionEn: At each stationary position, complete an echo record and map its timing and strength into a column.
cues.zh: 现在让探头沿体模移动。每停一个位置，先收齐一条回波记录，再把它放成图像的一列。亮线对应阻抗界面，均匀层的内部保持暗。注意薄片的两面和右边的嵌块：它们不是预先画上去的形状，而是各列回波共同重建出的边界。
cues.en: Move the probe across the phantom. At each position it completes one echo record, which becomes one image column. Bright lines mark impedance boundaries; uniform interiors stay dark. Watch the foil faces and the insert appear. Their image boundaries are reconstructed from the individual records, rather than painted into the scan.

cues.title: 缩短脉冲，分开近邻
cues.titleEn: Shorten the pulse to separate neighbors
cues.caption: 同一片 0.64 mm 薄片：长脉冲合并，短脉冲分出两峰。
cues.captionEn: The same 0.64 mm foil: a long pulse merges the returns; a short pulse separates two peaks.
cues.zh: 这片薄片的两面只相隔零点六四毫米。上图保留八周期脉冲，两次回波叠成一个宽峰。现在逐渐缩短下面的发射脉冲，两峰终于分开。物体没有变，变的是每次回声拖延的时间。这组比较保持峰值压强相同，不代表发射能量相同。
cues.en: The foil faces are only 0.64 millimeters apart. Keep the eight-cycle reference above and shorten the transmitted pulse below. A broad merged return separates into two peaks. The object has not changed; each echo now occupies less time. Peak transmitted pressure is held fixed here, not the total energy in the pulse.

cues.title: 亮表面，暗后方
cues.titleEn: A bright face with a darker region behind
cues.caption: 增加嵌块衰减，前表面不变，深部回波变弱。
cues.captionEn: Increase insert attenuation: its near face stays fixed while deeper echoes weaken.
cues.zh: 保持界面不动，只增加嵌块内部的衰减。前表面的亮线仍然在那里，后方的深部回波却变暗了。因为这些声音经过嵌块两次，去程和回程都要损失。暗处并不一定没有界面；在这个已知体模里，界面还在，只是返回的信号更弱。
cues.en: Keep every boundary fixed and increase attenuation inside the insert. Its front echo stays the same, while deeper returns become darker. Those paths cross the insert twice, losing signal on the way down and again on the way back. Darkness does not necessarily mean no boundary: here the known boundaries are still present.

cues.title: 声速假设会移动图像
cues.titleEn: An assumed speed moves the image
cues.caption: 同一回波记录，用错误声速重建会定位过深；校准后恢复。
cues.captionEn: The same record is placed too deep with an excessive assumed speed; calibration restores its position.
cues.zh: 最后故意用偏大的声速，把同一份回波记录换算成深度。看五十六毫米的界面，被放到了更深的位置。现在把假定值改回体模已知的声速，亮线回到真实标记。声音到达的时刻从未改变，变化的是我们用什么假设解释这段时间。
cues.en: Finally, reconstruct the same echo record using an intentionally excessive sound speed. The 56-millimeter boundary appears too deep. Correct the setting to the phantom’s known speed and the bright line returns to its true marker. Echo arrival times never changed. What changed was the assumption used to interpret those times.

cues.title: 先看挡住转动的那一组
cues.titleEn: Start with a stack that blocks rotation
cues.caption: 上弹子跨在固定外壳与锁芯之间。
cues.captionEn: A driver pin bridges the fixed shell and the plug.
cues.zh: 先看这一组弹子。上面的银色弹子，一部分留在固定外壳里，另一部分伸进可以转动的锁芯。它像一座跨过边界的小桥，所以现在请求转动，锁芯仍然不动。下面那段弹子的长度是固定的。接下来，我们只用完整的匹配钥匙，看它怎样让这座桥让开。
cues.en: Look at one pin stack before inserting the key. The silver driver sits partly in the fixed shell and partly in the rotating plug. It bridges their boundary, so a rotation request does not move the plug. The lower pin has a fixed length. We will follow a complete matching key as it clears that bridge.

cues.title: 钥匙沿着同一条通道推进
cues.titleEn: The key advances through one keyway
cues.caption: 钥匙先接触圆头，再把整组弹子推高。
cues.captionEn: The key contacts the rounded tip and raises the entire stack.
cues.zh: 钥匙从左侧沿钥匙槽推进。注意第一个圆头：并不是钥匙一出现，弹子就跳到正确高度。前端先接近圆头，再沿着斜面把它顶起来。下面的弹子推动上面的弹子，弹簧随之缩短。这里每一处抬升，都来自同一条真实参与计算的钥匙轮廓。
cues.en: The key advances from the left through its keyway. Watch the first rounded tip. It does not jump to a chosen height when the key appears. The leading ramp reaches it and gradually lifts the whole stack. The upper pin compresses its spring. Every lift here comes from the same continuous key profile shown in the cutaway.

cues.title: 圆头沿齿形连续抬升
cues.titleEn: Rounded tips follow the continuous profile
cues.caption: 抬升来自实际接触；弹簧的两端始终有支承。
cues.captionEn: Contact determines lift; both spring ends stay seated.
cues.zh: 现在靠近第四组。圆头碰到斜坡时，接触点不一定在弹子的正下方。它沿着圆头移动，决定这一组需要抬多高。再看弹簧：下端始终贴着上弹子，顶端始终抵住固定座。钥匙继续进入，六组弹子各自跟随经过身下的齿形，不会一起做相同的起伏。
cues.en: Move closer to stack four. On a slope, contact need not lie directly below the center of the rounded tip. That moving contact determines the lift. Above it, both ends of the spring stay seated. As insertion continues, each stack follows the profile passing beneath its own position, giving six different motions rather than one shared bounce.

cues.title: 不同长度，抵达同一边界
cues.caption: 匹配的齿高与下弹子长度互相补足。
cues.captionEn: Each matching cut complements its key-pin length.
cues.zh: 钥匙肩部已经到位。依次看六个接缝，它们现在都来到绿色边界。钥匙上的高度并不相同，下弹子也不是同样长。较低的齿面配较长的下弹子，较高的齿面配较短的一段。真正需要相同的，是每一对上下弹子的接缝位置，而不是钥匙表面本身。
cues.en: The shoulder is now seated. Scan the six interfaces along the green boundary. The key surface is not level, and the lower pins are not equal in length. A lower cut pairs with a longer pin; a higher cut pairs with a shorter one. What must agree is the position of every pin-to-pin interface, not the key surface.

cues.title: 只差一处，仍然转不动
cues.titleEn: One mismatch still blocks the plug
cues.caption: 比较同一时刻：一个错误高度仍会阻挡锁芯。
cues.captionEn: At the same instant, one incorrect height still blocks rotation.
cues.zh: 把同一插入深度的两把钥匙放在一起比较。右边只在第三处高了一点，其余五处都保持相同。看第三个接缝，它越过了绿色边界，下面的弹子仍伸入固定外壳这一侧。即使另外五组都对齐，整个锁芯也没有获得转动许可。这里检查的是完整钥匙的正常匹配。
cues.en: Compare two complete keys at the same insertion depth. Only the third cut on the right is higher; the other five remain unchanged. Its interface now lies above the green boundary, leaving the lower pin across the plug and shell. Five aligned stacks cannot cancel that one obstruction. This is a comparison of ordinary matching-key geometry.

cues.title: 边界清空，锁芯才能转动
cues.titleEn: Clear the boundary, then turn the plug
cues.caption: 钥匙和下弹子随锁芯转，上弹子留在外壳里。
cues.captionEn: The key and lower pins turn with the plug; drivers stay in the shell.
cues.zh: 回到匹配钥匙，所有接缝都已对齐。现在才让锁芯缓慢转动。钥匙和下弹子一起离开原来的方向，上弹子与弹簧仍留在固定外壳里。上弹子的底部改由锁芯表面支承。前面的钥匙动作和后面的拨片转动，属于同一个机械连接，不是彼此独立的动画。
cues.en: Return to the matching key. All six interfaces are aligned, so the plug can now turn. Follow the key and lower pins as they rotate together. The drivers and springs remain in the fixed shell, with the plug surface supporting the drivers. The key at the front and the actuator at the rear belong to one connected mechanism.

cues.title: 先回正，再退出
cues.caption: 转动时钥匙保持就位；回到入口位置后才能退出。
cues.captionEn: The key stays seated while turned; withdrawal requires the home position.
cues.zh: 先别把钥匙抽走。锁芯还转着的时候，钥匙必须保持就位；画面中的退出请求不会改变它的位置。接着让锁芯回正。下弹子的孔重新回到上弹子下面，钥匙也回到原来的入口方向。这个演示把回正作为退出条件，让一个完整的操作顺序闭合起来。
cues.en: Keep the key seated while the plug is turned. A withdrawal request at this point leaves its position unchanged. Now bring the plug home. Its lower pin bores return beneath the drivers, and the key returns to the entry orientation. This demonstration makes that return a condition of withdrawal, closing the sequence of intended operation.

cues.title: 钥匙退出，弹子重新跨界
cues.titleEn: Withdraw the key, restore the barrier
cues.caption: 齿面离开后，弹簧使上弹子重新进入锁芯。
cues.captionEn: As the profile leaves, springs return the drivers into the plug.
cues.zh: 现在可以退出了。随着齿面离开，每个圆头沿着经过的轮廓下降；弹簧把上弹子送回锁芯孔内。最后，再看最初的那一组：上下两部分又跨住了边界。钥匙的作用不是把所有弹子抬得一样高，而是用相配的高度，让所有接缝在同一时刻让开。
cues.en: Now withdraw the key. As each part of the profile passes, the rounded tips descend and the springs return the drivers into the plug bores. The original barrier appears again. The key was never trying to lift every pin to one height. Its matching cuts brought all six interfaces to the same boundary at the same time.

cues.title: 先让电流交替
cues.caption: 发送端先建立交流电流；没有电线跨过线圈之间的间隙。
cues.captionEn: The transmitter establishes alternating current; no wire crosses the gap between the coils.
cues.zh: 先看下方的线圈。接收回路还没有闭合，发送电路开始建立交流电流。铜线是一条连续的八匝螺旋，内端通过绝缘跨线引出来，没有偷偷接到上面的线圈。波形在正负之间往返，说明这里需要的是不断变化的电流。
cues.en: Look at the lower coil first. The receiver circuit is open while the transmitter establishes alternating current. Follow its eight continuous turns: an insulated crossover brings out the inner end. There is no hidden wire to the upper coil. The waveform keeps reversing, creating the changing magnetic excitation.

cues.title: 变化的磁链，感应的电压
cues.caption: 共享磁链的变化感应出电压；磁链最大时，瞬时感应电压恰好为零。
cues.captionEn: Changing shared flux linkage induces voltage; at peak linkage the instantaneous induced voltage is zero.
cues.zh: 现在跟着蓝色磁链曲线，再看感应电压曲线。磁链到达最高点时，变化速度暂时为零，电压也经过零点。再过四分之一个周期，磁链变化最快，电压达到峰值。接收端虽然有感应电压，开路时仍没有负载电流。
cues.en: Follow the blue flux-linkage curve, then the induced-voltage curve. At a linkage maximum, its rate of change is zero, so voltage passes through zero. A quarter-cycle later, linkage changes fastest and voltage reaches its peak. An open receiver can have induced voltage without delivering load current.

cues.title: 闭合接收回路
cues.caption: 接收回路闭合以后，电流才流过交流负载，发送端也感受到这个负载。
cues.captionEn: Closing the receiver circuit lets current reach the AC load and reflects that load back to the transmitter.
cues.zh: 看接收电容旁边的小开关。它合上以后，接收电流才穿过电阻负载，输出功率从零抬起来。发送电流也变了，因为接收端的负载会通过互感反映到发送端。这里计算到交流电阻为止，还没有把整流器和电池加入模型。
cues.en: Watch the little switch beside the receiver capacitor. When it closes, current can flow through the resistive load and delivered power rises from zero. The transmitter current changes too: mutual inductance reflects the receiver load back into its circuit. Our numerical model ends at this AC resistor, before rectification or a battery.

cues.title: 让两只线圈靠近
cues.caption: 线圈靠近，共享耦合增强；在当前运行范围里，负载得到更多功率。
cues.captionEn: Closer coils share stronger coupling; in this operating range, the load receives more power.
cues.zh: 让上方线圈慢慢靠近，先保持两边中心对齐。间距缩小，互感读数上升，负载获得更多功率。这里使用明确给定的耦合近似，帮助观察距离的影响，并不是某款手机的实测曲线。共振电路的功率还受负载和频率影响，不能只靠距离判断所有情况。
cues.en: Bring the upper coil closer while keeping the centers aligned. Mutual inductance rises and the load receives more power in this operating range. The coupling relation is a declared teaching approximation, not a measured phone-charger curve. Frequency and load still matter, so distance alone cannot predict every resonant link.

cues.title: 高度没变，耦合却减弱
cues.caption: 侧向错开，即使距离不变，也会减少两个线圈共享的耦合。
cues.captionEn: Lateral misalignment reduces shared coupling even when the vertical gap stays fixed.
cues.zh: 现在只向侧面移动，线圈高度保持不变。俯视图里，两组绕组的重叠逐渐减少，耦合和接收功率一起下降。注意发送端仍可能流过明显的电流。电流大，不代表负载一定收到很多电能；有一部分功率只是消耗在发送侧电阻里。
cues.en: Now move sideways without changing the vertical gap. In the top view, the two winding patterns move out of alignment. Coupling and received power fall. Notice that transmitter current can remain substantial. A large current does not guarantee useful delivery; power can instead be dissipated in resistance on the sending side.

cues.title: 电容改变电路的节奏
cues.caption: 电容抵消线圈的感抗；接近调谐频率，电流与接收功率明显改变。
cues.captionEn: Capacitors cancel coil reactance; near the tuning frequency, current and received power change substantially.
cues.zh: 保持线圈位置不动，把驱动频率从偏低的位置向调谐频率移动。电容的容抗和线圈的感抗逐渐抵消，电流和接收功率明显上升。曲线来自同一个电路解。标出的自谐振频率是单个线圈和电容的匹配条件，不保证就是任意耦合负载下的功率最大点。
cues.en: Keep the coils still and raise the drive frequency toward their tuning point. Capacitive and inductive reactance increasingly cancel, changing current and received power. The curve comes from the same circuit solution. The marked self-resonance is a coil-and-capacitor condition; it is not automatically the maximum-power frequency for every coupled load.

cues.title: 磁通也需要返回路径
cues.caption: 移除铁氧体磁片，电感和互感一起改变，原来的调谐条件也随之改变。
cues.captionEn: Removing ferrite changes inductance and mutual coupling, so the original tuning condition changes too.
cues.zh: 深灰色磁片是铁氧体，它帮助磁通沿磁路返回。现在比较有磁片和没有磁片的两个稳定状态。磁片移除后，磁通仍然闭合，只是更多经过空气；本模型的电感和互感都减小了。电容没有更换，原先的调谐点因此移动，固定频率下的接收功率也随之改变。
cues.en: The dark sheets are ferrite, helping provide a magnetic return path. Compare steady operation with and without them. Flux still forms closed paths without ferrite, but more of the path lies in air. The model assigns lower inductance and mutual coupling. With unchanged capacitors, the tuning point shifts and delivered power changes.

cues.title: 每一瓦都要有去处
cues.caption: 线圈电阻增加，铜耗占比上升；负载、线圈和源电阻的功率始终对得上。
cues.captionEn: Increasing winding resistance raises the copper-loss share; load and losses always sum to source power.
cues.zh: 最后增加两只线圈的等效电阻，其他条件保持不变。功率条重新分配：负载得到的部分变少，铜耗占比变大。所有部分加起来，始终等于源输入功率。谐振可以放大电压或循环电流，却不能制造能量。这也不是电池端效率，真实充电系统还有这里没有计算的损耗。
cues.en: Finally, increase both winding resistances while keeping the other conditions fixed. The power ribbon redistributes: less reaches the load and copper losses take a larger share. Every portion still sums to source input. Resonance can magnify voltage or circulating current, but it cannot create energy. A real battery charger adds further losses.

cues.title: 线圈带动整个组件
cues.caption: 磁路固定，音圈与锥盆连成同一个移动组件。
cues.captionEn: The magnetic circuit stays fixed; coil and cone form one moving assembly.
cues.zh: 先看这道剖面。后面的磁体和导磁零件固定在盆架上，中间的铜线绕在线圈骨架上，又连着前面的锥盆。加一个很小的电压，线圈先受力，带动整组零件起步。画面把行程放大了，但每个连接点都跟随同一个实际位移。
cues.en: Look into the cutaway. The magnet and steel circuit stay fixed, while the copper winding sits on a bobbin joined to the cone. A small applied voltage starts the moving assembly. Travel is enlarged so you can follow it, but all its connected parts use the same physical displacement.

cues.title: 磁隙里的换向
cues.caption: 同一磁场中，电流的正负决定电磁力方向。
cues.captionEn: In a fixed field, reversing current reverses electromagnetic force.
cues.zh: 靠近这个窄磁隙。蓝色箭头表示永久磁体建立的磁场方向；它不会跟着电信号反转。现在看电流读数从正变负，音圈受到的轴向力也换了方向。电流乘以力因数就是推力。音圈需要在磁隙里自由移动，而不是摩擦着铁芯滑行。
cues.en: Move closer to the narrow gap. The blue arrow marks the permanent field, which does not reverse with the signal. Now the current changes sign, and the axial force reverses with it. Force equals current times the force factor. The coil moves with clearance; it does not slide against the pole.

cues.title: 柔性的连续连接
cues.caption: 折环与弹波允许轴向运动，并提供弹性回复。
cues.captionEn: The surround and spider allow axial travel and provide restoring force.
cues.zh: 接着追踪音圈和锥盆之间的连接。它们一起运动，外圈的折环和里面的弹波则不断弯曲，固定端始终留在盆架。下面的位移与回复力方向相反：偏得越远，弹性支承拉回得越强。柔性引线也留着弯曲余量，让电路持续接通。
cues.en: Follow the joint between the coil and cone. They move together while the surround and spider flex between moving and fixed endpoints. Below, spring force points opposite displacement: move farther from equilibrium and the restoring force grows. The flexible leads bend too, keeping the electrical connection intact throughout the motion.

cues.title: 运动也能发电
cues.caption: 回路保持闭合；线圈回弹产生反电动势。
cues.captionEn: With the circuit closed, the returning coil generates back EMF.
cues.zh: 现在把外加电压设为零，但不把电路断开。锥盆还存着弹性能，会继续回弹。盯住速度和反电动势：线圈在磁场里动，就会产生电压，并在这个闭合回路中影响电流。电流推动运动，运动又反过来影响电流，这是同一个电机的两个方向。
cues.en: Set the applied voltage to zero but leave the circuit closed. Stored spring energy keeps the cone moving. Watch velocity and back EMF together: a moving coil generates voltage and affects current in the closed circuit. Current can drive motion, and motion can drive current. Both directions share the same force factor.

cues.title: 功率的去向
cues.caption: 输入功率等于电阻损耗、机械耗散与储能变化率之和。
cues.captionEn: Input power equals copper loss, mechanical loss and the change in stored energy.
cues.zh: 回到正弦驱动，看一个周期里的功率。电阻发热，机械阻尼也耗散能量；剩下的部分改变磁场、质量运动和弹簧的储能。储能变化率可以为负，表示先前存下的能量正在释放。两端口的转换功率完全相同，所以不会在电与机械之间凭空多出能量。
cues.en: Return to sinusoidal drive and follow power through a cycle. Resistance and mechanical damping dissipate energy; the remainder changes magnetic, kinetic and spring energy. A negative storage rate means earlier energy is being released. Electrical and mechanical conversion powers are equal, so coupling the two domains cannot create extra energy.

cues.title: 每个频率都不同
cues.caption: 相同峰值电压下，各频率的稳态最大行程并不相同。
cues.captionEn: At the same peak voltage, different frequencies produce different steady excursions.
cues.zh: 把电压峰值固定住，再逐个比较频率。每个点都等到稳态，并取最大行程，因此这不是把频率突然扫过去的瞬态。质量、弹性、阻尼和电感共同改变响应，曲线先起伏，再下降。这里测的是锥盆走多远，不能把它直接当成听到的声压级。
cues.en: Keep peak voltage fixed and compare frequencies one by one. Each point is a settled sinusoidal response, measured at maximum excursion, rather than a rapid sweep. Mass, stiffness, damping and inductance all shape the curve. It describes how far the cone moves; it is not the sound-pressure level at a listener.

cues.title: 阻尼改变响应
cues.caption: 增加阻尼会改变行程峰，也会通过反电动势改变电气响应。
cues.captionEn: Damping changes excursion and feeds back into the electrical response.
cues.zh: 这一次频率不变，只比较不同的机械阻尼。阻尼增大，行程峰降低，下面的电气阻抗也跟着改变，因为运动产生的反电动势变了。不能只把音圈看成一个固定电阻。我们仍在比较各设置的稳态，没有把参数变化冒充成无外界作用的自由运动。
cues.en: Now keep frequency fixed and compare different mechanical damping values. More damping lowers excursion, and electrical impedance changes too because motion changes the back EMF. The coil is more than a fixed resistor. These are settled comparisons between settings, not a freely moving system whose damping changes without outside intervention.

cues.title: 空气没有一路飞走
cues.titleEn: Air does not travel with the wave
cues.caption: 空气质点在附近往复，压缩图样向外传播。
cues.captionEn: Air points oscillate nearby while the compression pattern travels outward.
cues.zh: 最后跟住金色的空气质点。它只在原位附近往复，向外走的是压缩图样，不是这颗质点。边界跟随锥盆的运动，相邻位置按传播延迟作出响应。这是一维平面波的运动学示意，位移和颜色都作了教学处理，不能用来读取真实扬声器的声压级。
cues.en: Follow the gold air point. It oscillates near its own rest position while the compression pattern travels outward. The boundary follows the cone, and neighboring positions respond after a propagation delay. This is a one-dimensional plane-wave illustration with enlarged motion, not a prediction of the real speaker’s spatial sound-pressure field.

cues.title: 从网址，追踪一个 v
cues.titleEn: Follow one v from the URL
cues.caption: 同一个 v：118 → 01110110，始终追踪位 b6。
cues.captionEn: The same v: 118 → 01110110. Keep following bit b6.
cues.zh: 先看这段熟悉的网址。它一共有十七个字节，正好装进我们选的第一版、L 级二维码。今天只跟住里面的 v。它对应十进制的一百一十八，写成八个位，就是画面中的零和一。留意左起第二位，标作 b 六，原始值是一。接下来，不管整幅图怎样变化，我们都会找回同一位。
cues.en: We’ll turn this real URL into a QR Code. Its seventeen ASCII bytes fit Version One, level L. Keep your eye on the letter v. Its byte value is one hundred eighteen, shown here as eight bits. We’ll follow the second bit from the left, called b six. Its original value is one.

cues.title: 先告诉读者怎样读
cues.titleEn: Tell the reader how to read
cues.caption: 模式、字节数、消息和终止位组成 19 个数据码字。
cues.captionEn: Mode, byte count, message, and terminator form 19 data codewords.
cues.zh: 读码器需要先知道该怎么读。开头的零一零零声明字节模式，下一段写明十七个字节。接上网址的一百三十六个位，再加四个终止零，正好是一百五十二位。每八位分成一个码字。看下面较短的消息：空出的容量要交替补入十六进制的 EC 和一一，这些填充不是网址内容。
cues.en: A reader needs instructions before the message. Zero one zero zero declares byte mode; the next field counts seventeen bytes. Add the URL’s one hundred thirty-six bits and four terminating zeros: nineteen codewords of eight bits. Compare the shorter message below. Alternating hexadecimal E C and one one fill unused capacity; they aren’t part of the text.

cues.title: 再算七个校验码字
cues.caption: 19 个数据码字 → GF(256) → 7 个 RS 校验码字。
cues.captionEn: 19 data codewords → GF(256) → 7 RS check codewords.
cues.zh: 十九个数据码字依次进入计算，下面七个余数跟着变化。这里使用的是二百五十六元有限域，运算规则不同于普通整数。最后得到七个里德所罗门校验码字。它们记录整块数据之间的关系，并不是把某个字节再抄一份。十九加七，一共二十六码字，下一步要把它们放到格子里。
cues.en: Feed the nineteen codewords through the calculation and watch the seven remainders change. This is arithmetic in a finite field with two hundred fifty-six elements, not ordinary integer arithmetic. The final seven bytes are Reed–Solomon checks: relationships across the block, rather than backup copies. Nineteen plus seven gives twenty-six codewords ready for the grid.

cues.title: 先留出方向与尺度
cues.caption: 先放功能图形，留下 208 个数据与校验位置。
cues.captionEn: Function patterns leave 208 positions for data and checks.
cues.zh: 这张方阵有二十一行、二十一列，但不能把每格都塞进消息。先看三个角上的定位图形，它们帮助读码器辨认方向。周围的白色隔离带要留空。接着，交替黑白的时序格标出网格尺度。格式信息也要预留位置。第一版没有校正图形。除去功能区域，正好还剩二百零八格。
cues.en: This grid is twenty-one modules wide, but the message cannot occupy every square. Three finder patterns establish orientation, with white separators around them. Alternating timing modules establish the grid spacing. We also reserve space for format information. Version One has no alignment pattern. After these function modules, exactly two hundred eight positions remain.

cues.title: 两列一组，把位放进去
cues.titleEn: Place bits in pairs of columns
cues.caption: 从右下折返放置；v 的位 b6 到达坐标 (13, 11)。
cues.captionEn: Weave from the bottom right; v’s bit b6 reaches (13, 11).
cues.zh: 从右下角出发，每次走相邻的两列，向上，再向下。遇到已经预留的功能格就跳过。金色的小框标出当前位置。还记得 v 的那一位吗？它落在横坐标十三、纵坐标十一；这里从左上角的零开始数。走完整条路径，消息和校验共二百零八个位都有了唯一的位置。
cues.en: Start at the bottom right, weaving through two columns at a time. Move upward, then downward, skipping reserved function modules. The gold outline marks the current position. Here comes our bit from v, at column thirteen, row eleven, counting from zero at the top left. Every data and check bit now has its own position.

cues.title: 八种掩码，逐一比较
cues.caption: 比较八种可逆掩码；此网址选择编号 3。
cues.captionEn: Compare eight reversible masks; this URL selects mask 3.
cues.zh: 直接印出这些位，可能出现太长的连串、大方块，或像定位图形的条纹。于是编码器试遍八种掩码，只对数据与校验区域做可逆的异或。每张候选图都要评分，也包括明暗比例。这段网址选中编号三。看我们的那一位：原始一遇到掩码一，印出来反而是白格。
cues.en: Printing the raw bits can create long runs, solid squares, or patterns that resemble finders. Try all eight masks: reversible exclusive-or operations on the data and check region. Score each complete candidate, including its dark–light balance. Mask three wins for this URL. Our original one meets a mask bit of one and prints white.

cues.title: 把解码说明写在两处
cues.caption: L 等级 + 掩码 3 + BCH 校验 → 两份格式信息。
cues.captionEn: Level L + mask 3 + BCH checks → two format copies.
cues.zh: 读码器怎么知道刚才选了哪种掩码？看定位图形旁边这两条细带。L 等级和掩码编号先合成五个位，再用 BCH 算出十个校验位，与固定值异或后，写成两份相同的格式信息。画面依次描出它们的位置。这里保护的是解码说明，与刚才保护数据的里德所罗门校验不是同一层。
cues.en: How does a reader know which mask was selected? Follow these narrow strips beside the finders. Level L and the mask number make five bits. BCH arithmetic adds ten check bits, followed by a fixed exclusive-or. The resulting fifteen-bit word is written twice. These checks protect reading instructions, separately from the Reed–Solomon checks protecting data.

cues.title: 现在，它可以被扫描
cues.caption: 退出教学高亮，保留四格静区，扫码读取真实网址。
cues.captionEn: Remove teaching highlights, keep four quiet modules, and scan the real URL.
cues.zh: 知道掩码，白格的零再和一异或，就找回 v 原来的那一位。现在撤掉教学标记，只留下真正的黑白二维码，以及四边各四格的白色静区。你可以扫描它，读出的文字就是这段网址；是否打开由读码软件决定。纠错能力不等于随意遮挡的保证，本篇也没有模拟受损图像的解码。
cues.en: Knowing the mask turns that printed zero back into our original one. Now remove the teaching highlights. Keep the black and white modules and four clear modules around every edge. Scan this finished code to read the URL; reader software decides whether to offer opening it. Error correction does not guarantee recovery from arbitrary covering.

cues.title: 对称的起点
cues.caption: 对称翼型、零攻角：上下面压力相抵，升力为零。
cues.captionEn: A symmetric section at zero incidence: the pressure loads balance, giving zero lift.
cues.zh: 先让机翼平着迎风。它的上下形状完全对称，空气仍会沿表面加快，但两侧压力相互抵消。看右边，升力是零。我们要找的是整个流场和整圈压力的结果，不能只看某一处空气跑得快。
cues.en: Begin with the wing level in the wind. Its upper and lower shapes are identical. Air still speeds up near both surfaces, but the pressure loads balance. The lift reading is zero. What matters is the complete flow and the pressure around the whole section, not speed at one isolated point.

cues.title: 改变迎风角度
cues.caption: 只改变攻角，边界条件选出的速度场与压力一起改变。
cues.captionEn: Change incidence: the boundary conditions select a new velocity field and pressure pattern.
cues.zh: 现在只抬高前缘，来流速度保持不变。看表面颜色和周围的速度箭头，一起失去了上下对称。计算先满足来流、表面不穿透和尾缘条件，得到速度场，再换算成压力。这里比较一系列稳态，不计算机翼转动的瞬间。
cues.en: Raise the leading edge while keeping the wind speed fixed. Watch the surface colors and velocity arrows lose their symmetry. The calculation first satisfies the distant wind, the solid boundary and the trailing-edge condition. It then converts velocity into pressure. These frames compare steady solutions; they do not simulate a rotating wing.

cues.title: 尖尾缘的约束
cues.caption: 两侧趋近同一有限尾缘速度；环量必须满足这个条件。
cues.captionEn: Both sides approach one finite trailing-edge velocity. Circulation must satisfy this condition.
cues.zh: 靠近尖尖的尾缘。青色和赭色探针分别从两侧接近，读出的速度逐渐靠拢，而不是变成无穷大。这个有限、相容的出口条件叫作库塔条件，它选定了环量。精确尖点不直接代入除法，下方给出单独算出的速度极限。
cues.en: Move close to the sharp trailing edge. The cyan and ochre probes approach from opposite sides. Their speeds converge instead of diverging to infinity. This finite, compatible exit is the Kutta condition, and it selects circulation. We exclude the exact cusp from direct division and show its separately calculated limiting speed below.

cues.title: 把一圈压力加起来
cues.caption: 沿整圈表面积分压力载荷，上下面都参与合力。
cues.captionEn: Add pressure loads around the entire surface. Both sides contribute to the resultant.
cues.zh: 沿翼型走一圈，把每一小段压力载荷加进来。蓝色箭头表示相对环境，向内的推力减少了，并不是空气在拉机翼。留意水平和竖直分量：一圈结束后，水平分量抵消，竖直分量留下升力。上下两面都参与这笔计算。
cues.en: Walk around the section, adding the pressure load from each small surface element. Blue arrows show a reduction in inward pressure relative to ambient, not air pulling on the wing. Follow both force components. Only after the complete circuit does horizontal pressure force cancel while vertical force remains as lift. Both surfaces contribute.

cues.title: 不必同时抵达
cues.caption: 同一时刻释放的相邻空气示踪点，不必同时经过翼尾。
cues.captionEn: Nearby air tracers released together need not pass the trailing edge together.
cues.zh: 从同一个上游截面，同时放出两个相邻示踪点。它们只服从各自位置的速度，不知道对方在哪里。青色先越过翼尾测量线，赭色随后才到。画面放慢了运动，毫秒读数保留真实模型时间。空气没有约定在翼尾重逢，速度也不是靠这个约定算出来的。
cues.en: Release two nearby tracers together at the same upstream plane. Each follows its local velocity, with no knowledge of the other. Cyan crosses the trailing-edge measurement plane first; ochre follows later. Motion is slowed, but milliseconds retain model time. There is no appointment at the trailing edge, and no equal-arrival assumption in the calculation.

cues.title: 用另一条路径核对
cues.caption: 闭合路径上的速度积分给出环量，不是空气在绕圈。
cues.captionEn: Integrating velocity around a closed contour gives circulation, not an orbit of air.
cues.zh: 现在画一条包围机翼的闭合路径，沿着它测量切向速度。金色点是积分位置，不是一团绕圈的空气。这样得到的环量，和来流、密度一起算出的升力，与整圈压力积分一致。真实流动如何建立环量涉及黏性和起动，这个理想模型没有计算。
cues.en: Now measure tangential velocity along a closed contour around the wing. The gold dot marks the integration position, not an air parcel traveling in a loop. Circulation, density and wind speed give a lift that agrees with the surface-pressure integral. How real flow establishes circulation involves viscosity and startup, which this ideal model does not calculate.

cues.title: 让升力反向
cues.caption: 同一对称翼型，攻角变负，压力分布与升力翻转。
cues.captionEn: With the same symmetric section, negative incidence reverses the pressure pattern and lift.
cues.zh: 把前缘慢慢放低，经过零攻角，再转到负角度。压力图案镜像翻转，升力箭头也向下了。机翼的上下长度从来没有改变，改变的是迎风条件选出的流场。这里的正负小攻角只用于比较理想解，不代表模型能预测分离或失速。
cues.en: Lower the leading edge, pass through zero incidence, and continue to a negative angle. The pressure pattern mirrors and the lift arrow points down. The upper and lower surface lengths have never changed. The flow selected by the wind and boundary conditions has. These small-angle ideal solutions do not predict separation or stall.

cues.title: 风速与升力的平方
cues.caption: 攻角不变：风速翻倍，理想压力载荷与升力变成四倍。
cues.captionEn: Keep incidence fixed: double the wind speed and the ideal loads and lift become four times larger.
cues.zh: 最后固定攻角，只把风速从十五提高到三十米每秒。速度箭头变长，压力系数的颜色图案不变，但升力变成四倍。这个平方关系来自动压，也和环量计算相符。真实机翼还会有黏性、分离和有限翼展的影响；这间理想观察窗没有把它们算进去。
cues.en: Keep incidence fixed and increase wind speed from fifteen to thirty meters per second. Velocity arrows lengthen and the pressure-coefficient colors stay the same, while lift becomes four times larger. That square law follows from dynamic pressure and agrees with circulation. Viscosity, separation and finite-span effects on real wings remain outside this ideal observation window.

cues.title: 物镜让光重新相遇
cues.caption: 追踪一个标本点发出的光，直到它在中间像面重新会合。
cues.captionEn: Follow light from one specimen point to its reunion at the intermediate plane.
cues.zh: 先跟着这个亮点发出的几条光线走。它们从同一个位置散开，经过物镜后，又在另一处会合。那里可以放一块屏接到像，所以它是真实的中间像。物镜的任务已经完成了第一步：把标本上的位置，变成管内可以找到的位置。
cues.en: Follow a few rays leaving this bright specimen point. They spread out, cross the objective and meet again elsewhere. A screen placed there could receive the image, so this intermediate image is real. The objective has completed the first step: mapping a specimen location to a location inside the microscope.

cues.title: 先得到一幅倒立实像
cues.caption: 同一个点的位移在像面反向放大；这里物镜放大率为负十九。
cues.captionEn: The point’s displacement is enlarged and reversed; this objective has magnification minus nineteen.
cues.zh: 让标本点慢慢越过光轴。看中间像往哪边走：方向相反，走过的距离也大得多。这里的物镜把横向位移放大十九倍，负号记录倒立。这个放大关系属于物镜与两侧距离，后面的目镜还没有参与决定这幅真实图像。
cues.en: Move the specimen point across the axis and watch its image. The image travels in the opposite direction, covering nineteen times the distance. The minus sign records inversion. This first magnification comes from the objective and its object and image distances. The eyepiece has not yet set the size of this real image.

cues.title: 目镜改变观察角度
cues.caption: 中间像位于目镜前焦面，同一点对应一束平行出射光。
cues.captionEn: With the image at the eyepiece front focus, each point produces a parallel outgoing bundle.
cues.zh: 现在加入目镜。把中间像放在它的前焦面，同一点出去的光就彼此平行，适合放松的眼睛观察。换成焦距更短的目镜，并移动到匹配的位置，光束的角度变大了。真实中间像没有变大，变化的是眼睛看它时所占的角度。
cues.en: Now include the eyepiece. With the intermediate image at its front focal plane, rays from one point emerge parallel, suitable for a relaxed eye. Shorten the eyepiece focal length and move it to the matching position. The outgoing angle increases. The intermediate image is unchanged; its apparent angular size has grown.

cues.title: 用载物台把像调清楚
cues.titleEn: Focus by moving the specimen stage
cues.caption: 同一对荧光点经过离焦到清晰；变化来自标本与物镜的距离。
cues.captionEn: The same fluorescent pair comes into focus as the specimen-to-objective distance changes.
cues.zh: 换成一对荧光点，先故意把载物台放偏。画面里的光散成一团，不是标本真的变大了。现在一点点把台面移回去，两个点逐渐集中。粗调与细调都移动同一个台面，只是每次移动的量不同；最后那一点位置差，也会影响清晰度。
cues.en: Switch to two fluorescent points and start with the stage out of position. Their light spreads out; the specimen itself has not grown. Move the stage back and the point images concentrate. Coarse and fine focus move the same stage with different step sizes. Even the final small displacement can affect sharpness.

cues.title: 不同深度，轮流清晰
cues.titleEn: Different depths come into focus in turn
cues.caption: 两排点相隔二十微米；焦点沿深度移动，清晰的一排随之交换。
cues.captionEn: The rows lie twenty micrometers apart in depth; moving focus swaps which row is sharp.
cues.zh: 这次保留两排点，但它们不在同一深度。上排先清楚，下排的光摊得很开。沿深度移动二十微米，清楚的位置交换了。显微镜的标本并不总是一张平纸；调到某一层时，前后其他层仍然可能存在，只是它们的点像已经散开。
cues.en: These two rows do not lie at the same depth. The upper row begins sharp while the lower row spreads out. Move focus by twenty micrometers and they exchange roles. A specimen need not be flat. When one layer is focused, other layers may still be present, but their point images are spread out.

cues.title: 孔径决定能分开多近
cues.caption: 保持两点间距不变，打开物镜孔径，使衍射点像收窄。
cues.captionEn: Keep point separation fixed and open the objective pupil to narrow its diffraction pattern.
cues.zh: 保持焦点和两点间距不动，只打开物镜孔径。单个点形成的光斑越来越窄，两点之间终于出现低谷。剖面画的是实际计算的强度相加。这里限制细节的是衍射和数值孔径，不是屏幕上画了多大的光点；几何光线相交，也不等于光斑无限小。
cues.en: Keep focus and point separation fixed, then open the objective pupil. Each diffraction pattern narrows until a dip appears between the two points. The profile is their calculated summed intensity. Resolution depends on diffraction and numerical aperture. Geometric rays meeting at a point do not mean that the physical image has zero width.

cues.title: 孔径也改变景深
cues.titleEn: Aperture also changes depth of field
cues.caption: 收小孔径让轴向响应变宽，同时牺牲相邻点的横向分离。
cues.captionEn: A smaller pupil broadens the axial response while sacrificing lateral separation.
cues.zh: 把焦点放在两层中间，再慢慢收小孔径。离焦曲线变宽了，两层都更能容忍位置偏差。但回头看每一排，相邻的两点也更难分开。更大的景深有代价。这里的景深数字只是声明的衍射尺度，并不是所有观察条件下都通用的清晰边界。
cues.en: Place focus between the layers and close the pupil. The axial response broadens, so both layers tolerate more displacement. But within each row, neighboring points become harder to separate. Greater depth of field has a cost. The displayed depth is a declared diffraction scale, not a universal boundary between sharp and blurred.

cues.title: 放大模糊，不会增加细节
cues.caption: 固定低孔径，只增加目镜放大；模糊变大，物方分辨尺度不变。
cues.captionEn: Keep the low aperture fixed and increase eyepiece power: blur grows, but object-space resolution stays fixed.
cues.zh: 最后固定这个较小的物镜孔径，只换更强的目镜。光斑在眼前变大，标尺也随之变化，可是那两个点仍然没有分开。这就是空放大：已有的模糊也被一起放大了。先让物镜取得细节，再把细节放到容易观察的大小，两件事不能混为一谈。
cues.en: Finally, keep the smaller objective pupil and increase eyepiece power. The patch grows and the scale bar changes, yet the two points remain unresolved. This is empty magnification: existing blur is enlarged too. First the objective must capture detail; then magnification makes that detail comfortable to inspect. Those are separate tasks.

cues.title: 脉冲怎样变成直流
cues.titleEn: From pulses to a steady output
cues.caption: 开关节点在高低电压间切换；电感和电容把脉冲变成较平稳的输出。
cues.captionEn: The switch node jumps between voltages; the inductor and capacitor smooth the output.
cues.zh: 先看左边的开关。它并没有把十二伏直接变成一个较低的恒定电压，而是在接通和断开之间切换。沿着回路往右看，电感电流没有跟着跳断，电容两端的电压也只在小范围里起伏。画面把真实的高速开关大幅放慢，让这两个变化可以同时看清。
cues.en: Watch the switch on the left. It does not directly turn twelve volts into a smaller constant voltage. It connects and disconnects the source. Follow the circuit to the right: inductor current keeps flowing, while the output varies only slightly. We have slowed the switching enormously so you can follow both changes.

cues.title: 第一条路径：接通
cues.caption: 开关闭合，电源接入电感。电感两端电压为正，电流连续上升。
cues.captionEn: With the switch closed, positive inductor voltage makes current rise continuously.
cues.zh: 现在只看接通这一段。高亮回路从电源出发，经过开关和电感，再穿过负载回到电源。电感左端的电压比右端高，所以电流逐渐上升。电源送来的能量，一部分进入负载，一部分增加储能。那个光点只是帮助追踪能量，并不是一颗正在跑的电子。
cues.en: Now stay with the on interval. The highlighted loop goes from the source through the switch and inductor, through the load, and back. The left end of the inductor is at a higher voltage, so current rises. Incoming energy supplies the load and increases stored energy. The dot is an energy guide, not an electron.

cues.title: 第二条路径：续流
cues.caption: 开关断开，电感电流不会突然消失；二极管接上另一条闭合路径。
cues.captionEn: Opening the switch does not erase inductor current. The diode completes another loop.
cues.zh: 开关断开了，但请盯住电感电流：它从刚才的数值继续往下走，没有突然归零。现在回路经过下方的二极管，输入电源暂时退出。电感两端电压变成负值，储存的磁场能量逐渐释放。电流仍然沿原来的方向流过负载，只是大小正在下降。
cues.en: The switch opens. Keep your eye on inductor current: it starts from the value it already had, then falls. It does not suddenly vanish. The lower diode now closes the loop, with the input source disconnected. Negative inductor voltage releases stored magnetic energy. Current still passes through the load in the same direction.

cues.title: 电感的伏秒平衡
cues.caption: 周期稳态中，电感正负伏秒相抵；改变占空比，会改变新的平衡电压。
cues.captionEn: In periodic operation, positive and negative inductor volt-seconds cancel. Duty changes the balance.
cues.zh: 把接通和断开放回同一个周期。绿色和棕色面积，表示电感电压乘上时间；稳定重复时，它们刚好相抵，电流才不会一圈比一圈高。接着把占空比从百分之三十换成六十，比较两个已经稳定的状态。输出电压升高了，正负面积仍然保持平衡。
cues.en: Put the two intervals back together. The green and brown areas measure inductor voltage times time. In a repeating cycle, they cancel; otherwise current would drift from cycle to cycle. Now compare settled operation at thirty and sixty percent duty. Output voltage rises, but the positive and negative areas still balance.

cues.title: 电容接住电流差
cues.caption: 电感电流超过负载需求时，电容充电；不足时补上差额。更大电容减小纹波。
cues.captionEn: The capacitor absorbs surplus inductor current and supplies any shortfall. More capacitance reduces ripple.
cues.zh: 电容不是凭空把波形抹平。看它旁边的小箭头：电感送来的电流超过负载需求时，多余部分给电容充电；电流不够时，电容再把缺口补上。现在保持其他条件，换上更大的电容。输出曲线的峰峰纹波变小了。两次都是真正求解的电路，注意下面的电压范围。
cues.en: The capacitor does not smooth the waveform by magic. Its small arrow shows the difference between inductor current and what the load needs. Surplus current charges it; a shortfall discharges it. Now increase capacitance while keeping the other settings. Output ripple becomes smaller. Both curves are solved waveforms; check their numerical ranges as you compare.

cues.title: 负载突然加重
cues.caption: 负载突然加重，电容先补电流缺口；电感电流随后改变。这里没有稳压反馈。
cues.captionEn: A heavier load draws first on the capacitor; inductor current responds afterward. There is no feedback regulator here.
cues.zh: 这次不是切换两个稳态，而是真正把负载电阻从八欧突然降到三欧。负载马上需要更多电流，电感电流却不能跳变，于是电容先放电，输出出现下陷。电感随后响应，电压也逐渐调整。这里的占空比固定，没有反馈控制器保证它回到原来的电压。
cues.en: This time we make a real load step, from eight ohms to three. The load immediately demands more current, but inductor current cannot jump. The capacitor supplies the difference, and output voltage dips. The inductor then responds. Duty stays fixed throughout: no feedback controller is trying to restore the old output voltage.

cues.title: 第三段：电流归零
cues.titleEn: A third interval at zero current
cues.caption: 负载变轻，电流降到零后，二极管阻止反向流动，出现第三段空闲时间。
cues.captionEn: At light load, current reaches zero. The diode blocks reversal, leaving a third, idle interval.
cues.zh: 再把负载逐步变轻。电流下降的那一段，终于碰到了零线。二极管只允许一个方向导通，所以电流不会继续变成负值，而是停在零，直到下一次接通。在这段空闲时间里，电容独自供给负载。输出也不再简单等于输入电压乘占空比。
cues.en: Now compare progressively lighter loads. The falling current finally reaches zero. Because the diode blocks reverse current, it stays at zero until the next on interval. During that idle time, the capacitor alone supplies the load. This is discontinuous conduction, and output voltage no longer follows the simple input-times-duty rule.

cues.title: 每一份能量都有去向
cues.titleEn: Accounting for every part of the energy
cues.caption: 加入导通损耗，同一占空比的输出降低；输入能量分给负载、储能变化和热。
cues.captionEn: Conduction losses lower the output at the same duty. Input energy accounts for load, storage change, and heat.
cues.zh: 最后，比较理想器件和有导通损耗的器件。占空比没有变，但开关、电感绕组、电容内阻和二极管都会发热，输出电压因此降低。条带把一个稳定周期的能量分开记账；储能回到起点，输入正好等于负载所得加上热耗。真实电源还有这里没有计算的开关和控制损耗。
cues.en: Finally compare ideal components with conduction losses included. Duty is unchanged, but the switch, winding, capacitor resistance, and diode dissipate heat, lowering the output. The strip accounts for one settled cycle: stored energy returns to its starting value, so input equals load energy plus heat. Real supplies also have switching and control losses omitted here.

cues.title: 先把文字交给字节
cues.caption: 跟住 a 的 b0：字节 0x61 → 消息字 W[0]。
cues.captionEn: Follow a’s b0: byte 0x61 → message word W[0].
cues.zh: 从 abc 开始。UTF-8 把它编成三个字节，每个字节八个位。跟住 a 最右边的 b 零，它原来是一。按大端顺序装进三十二位消息字后，它到了第二十四位。此刻只是换了表示方式，信息还没有丢。
cues.en: Begin with a b c. UTF-eight encoding turns these letters into three bytes, each containing eight bits. Follow the rightmost bit of a, called b zero. Its value is one. Packing bytes into a thirty-two-bit word moves it to bit twenty-four. So far, we have only represented the same information.

cues.title: 给消息一个准确的结尾
cues.titleEn: Give the message an exact ending
cues.caption: 原消息 + 一位 1 + 零 + 64 位长度字段 → 512 位块。
cues.captionEn: Message + one 1 bit + zeros + 64-bit length → 512-bit blocks.
cues.zh: 先给消息一个明确的结尾。接上一位一，再补零，最后写入原消息的位数。这里原来有二十四位，长度字段就记二十四，不包括填充。现在恰好装满一个五百一十二位的块；更长的消息按同一规则分块。
cues.en: Hashing processes complete blocks, so the ending needs a precise rule. Append one set bit, then zeros, then the original message length. Here that length is twenty-four bits; padding does not count toward it. The result fills one five-hundred-twelve-bit block. Longer messages follow the same rule and may need additional blocks.

cues.title: 十六个字，展开成六十四个
cues.caption: 从已有的 16 个 32 位字，算出 64 个轮用消息字。
cues.captionEn: Expand 16 original 32-bit words into 64 round words.
cues.zh: 一个块先拆成十六个字，却要供给六十四轮计算。看 W 十六：四个较早的字，经过旋转、右移和相加，得到它的真实数值。后面的字继续按同一规则生成。我们的输入位进入了依赖链，影响会沿后续计算传播。
cues.en: One block supplies sixteen words, but compression needs sixty-four rounds. Watch W sixteen being made from four earlier words. Rotations, shifts, and addition produce its exact value. Later words use the same recurrence. Our input bit has entered this dependency chain; subsequent operations can spread its influence beyond its original position.

cues.title: 放慢看一轮
cues.caption: 消息与状态形成 T1、T2，再更新 a 与 e。
cues.captionEn: Message and state form T1 and T2, then update a and e.
cues.zh: 放慢第一轮。消息字和常量，与当前状态一起形成 T 一；另一条支路算出 T 二。两者相加，得到新的 a。原来的 d 加上 T 一，得到新的 e，其余六个字向下传递。所有加法只保留低三十二位。
cues.en: Slow down the first round. The message word and a fixed constant combine with the current state to form T one. Another path computes T two. Add them to get the new a; add T one to the old d to get the new e. The other words shift along. Additions retain only thirty-two bits.

cues.title: 八个状态字，接力六十四轮
cues.caption: 每轮把八个状态字交给下一轮；W 和 K 随轮次改变。
cues.captionEn: Each round passes eight state words onward; W and K change with the round.
cues.zh: 把六十四轮接起来。每轮都将八个工作字交给下一轮，并取用各自的消息字和常量。短线显示真实位值，下面标出当前的 W 和 K。你可以暂停在任意一轮，向前或向后复核；同一份输入始终得到同一条计算轨迹。
cues.en: Now connect all sixty-four rounds. Each passes eight working words into the next, using that round’s message word and constant. The small strokes show actual bit values; W and K appear below. You can pause at any round and inspect its exact state. Seeking backward reconstructs the same deterministic computation.

cues.title: 别忘了加回起点
cues.caption: 八个工作字逐项加回块输入，拼成最终 256 位摘要。
cues.captionEn: Add each working word to its incoming state word to form the 256-bit digest.
cues.zh: 六十四轮结束，还差一步。把八个工作字，分别加回进入这一块时的八个状态字，超出三十二位的进位仍然舍去。画面逐项算给你看。对这条单块消息，八个结果顺序拼接，就是二百五十六位摘要，写成六十四个十六进制字符。
cues.en: After sixty-four rounds, one essential step remains. Add each working word back to its corresponding incoming state word. Watch the additions in turn, still discarding overflow beyond thirty-two bits. For this one-block message, concatenating those eight results gives the final two-hundred-fifty-six-bit digest, commonly written as sixty-four hexadecimal characters.

cues.title: 消息可以长，摘要长度不变
cues.titleEn: Longer messages, the same digest length
cues.caption: 双块示例：前块链值进入后块，最终仍输出 256 位。
cues.captionEn: Two-block example: pass the chaining value onward; the final output stays 256 bits.
cues.zh: 换成这条五十六字节的标准示例。加上填充，它需要两个块。第一块输出的八个字，完整成为第二块的输入状态。看前两个字怎样交接。直到最后一块结束，才得到整条消息的摘要；消息变长，摘要仍是二百五十六位。
cues.en: Switch to this fifty-six-byte standard example. Padding makes it two blocks long. The first block’s eight results become the second block’s incoming state, rather than restarting from the initial constants. Follow the first two words across that handoff. Only the final block produces the complete message’s digest, still two hundred fifty-six bits long.

cues.title: 只改一位，再算一次
cues.titleEn: Change one bit and calculate again
cues.caption: 同一输入只翻转一位：实测差异，不是安全性证明。
cues.captionEn: Flip one bit of the same input: measured differences, not a security proof.
cues.zh: 回到 abc，只翻转刚才那一位，再按同样的轮次比较。金色标出不同的位。差异会扩大，也会回落；这次最终有一百一十二位不同，不保证每次恰好一半。哈希不是加密或可逆编码，碰撞也必然存在。这不是安全性证明。
cues.en: Return to a b c. Flip only our tracked bit and compare matching rounds. Gold marks differences. The count rises and falls, ending at one hundred twelve. Exactly half need not change. Hashing is neither reversible encoding nor encryption; collisions must exist. This animation is not a security proof.

cues.title: 两个互不接触的回路
cues.caption: 线圈回路接回电源，锅底中的等效电流自行闭合。
cues.captionEn: The coil returns to its source; induced current closes within the pan.
cues.zh: 先沿着铜线走一圈。它从电源出来，盘成平面线圈，再从下方接回电源。玻璃把它和锅隔开，电流没有穿过玻璃。锅底的蓝色环代表另一条闭合电流路径。前半边只是透明剖开，真实锅底仍完整；接下来看看它怎样获得能量。
cues.en: Follow the copper conductor. It leaves the source, winds into a flat spiral, then returns underneath. Glass separates it from the pan; current does not cross the glass. The blue ring represents a second closed current path inside the pan. Its transparent front is a cutaway, not a physical break.

cues.title: 盯住磁通的变化率
cues.caption: 感应电动势由外加磁通的变化率决定，电流还受回路阻抗影响。
cues.captionEn: Induced voltage follows changing applied flux; loop impedance also shapes current.
cues.zh: 现在把交流周期放慢。先看穿过蓝色回路的外加磁通，再看下面的感应电动势。磁通到达峰值时，它的变化率暂时为零；变化最快时，感应电动势最大。锅底电流还受到自身电阻和电感影响，所以不能把电流直接画成磁通的复制品。
cues.en: Slow the electrical cycle and track the applied flux through the blue loop. At a flux peak, its rate of change is momentarily zero. When flux changes fastest, induced voltage is largest. The pan current also depends on its resistance and inductance, so it is not simply a copy of flux.

cues.title: 热从多深的地方产生
cues.titleEn: How deep is the electrical heating?
cues.caption: 频率升高，集肤深度变小，周期平均电损耗更靠近锅底入射面。
cues.captionEn: Higher frequency reduces skin depth and concentrates electrical loss near the driven face.
cues.zh: 把目光移到锅底表面，再沿曲线向金属内部看。现在只提高频率，虚线标出的集肤深度逐渐变小，电损耗更集中在靠近线圈的一面。颜色表示周期平均的电阻发热，不是金属发光。这里省略了磁滞损耗，也没有把颜色当成真实温度分布。
cues.en: Look inward from the pan surface nearest the coil. Increase frequency and the marked skin depth becomes smaller: more of the electrical loss lies near that face. Color shows cycle-average resistive heating, not glowing metal. Hysteresis loss is omitted here, and this depth profile is not a predicted temperature map.

cues.title: 抬高同一口锅
cues.caption: 固定线圈电流和频率，增加间距会减弱互感与锅底功率。
cues.captionEn: At fixed coil current and frequency, more spacing weakens coupling and pan power.
cues.zh: 保持线圈电流和频率不变，只把同一口锅抬高一点。线圈和锅底之间的互感减小，蓝色回路获得的感应电动势随之减弱，电损耗也下降。这个比较没有偷偷增大电流来补偿距离。玻璃不需要先烧热，电磁耦合本身就能把能量送到锅底。
cues.en: Keep coil current and frequency fixed, then lift the same pan. Mutual coupling falls, so the induced voltage and pan heating fall too. The source is not increasing current to compensate for distance. Energy reaches the pan through electromagnetic coupling; the glass does not have to heat up first.

cues.title: 导体不只有一种
cues.caption: 同样的驱动下，材料会改变电阻、相位和发热；非磁性导体也可被感应加热。
cues.captionEn: With the same drive, material changes resistance and heating; nonmagnetic conductors can also heat.
cues.zh: 依次换成磁性钢、非磁性不锈钢和铝，几何与驱动条件都保持不变。留意电损耗并不只由导电性决定，集肤和回路电感也参与其中。铝的结果不是零。专门设计的设备可以加热非磁性金属；某口锅是否适配某台电磁炉，仍要看具体设备的设计。
cues.en: Compare magnetic steel, nonmagnetic stainless steel and aluminum without changing geometry or drive. Conductivity alone does not decide the heating; skin effect and loop inductance matter too. Aluminum still gives a nonzero result. Specially designed cooktops can heat nonmagnetic metals, while actual pan compatibility depends on the particular appliance.

cues.title: 开启一段，停顿一段
cues.caption: 缩短通电时间比例降低时间平均功率；停顿不代表锅已经冷却。
cues.captionEn: Less on-time lowers average power; an off interval does not mean a cold pan.
cues.zh: 这里用放慢的四秒包络说明功率调节。棕色区间内保持原来的交流驱动，空白区间暂停输入。看当前功率在开启和停止之间切换，而时间平均值更低。锅没有跟着每一次停顿立刻冷下来，因为热量已经存进了金属。真实炉具也可能采用别的调节方式。
cues.en: The four-second teaching envelope turns the same AC drive on for each brown interval, then pauses it. Current heating switches between its on value and zero, while average power is lower. The pan does not become cold at every pause because metal stores heat. Real appliances may regulate power differently.

cues.title: 锅先热，玻璃后热
cues.titleEn: The pan warms before the glass
cues.caption: 电损耗先进入锅体，随后通过接触传热使玻璃升温。
cues.captionEn: Electrical loss heats the pan first; contact then warms the glass.
cues.zh: 回到持续输入，把热过程加速。棕色曲线代表锅体，蓝色代表玻璃。起初只有锅体直接得到电损耗产生的热；有了温差，热量才通过接触流向玻璃。同时，两者都在向室温环境散热。下面储存的热量来自同一个能量收支，并不是另加的一段装饰动画。
cues.en: Return to continuous input and accelerate thermal time. Brown follows the pan; blue follows the glass. Initially, electrical loss heats only the pan. A temperature difference then drives contact heat into the glass, while both lose heat to the room. Their stored heat comes from that same energy balance.

cues.title: 断电以后，热还在走
cues.caption: 断电后总储热持续减少，玻璃仍可能短暂升温。
cues.captionEn: After power-off, total stored heat falls even while glass may briefly warm.
cues.zh: 现在停止电输入。锅体开始降温，但玻璃曲线还可能继续向上走一小段：较热的锅仍在把余热传给它。这并不违反能量守恒，两个物体的总储热一直在减少。把电功率关掉和把温度降到室温，是两件不同的事；最后留下的是逐渐散去的热。
cues.en: Stop electrical input. The pan cools, yet the glass may keep warming briefly because the hotter pan still transfers stored heat into it. That does not create energy: their total stored heat keeps falling. Switching electrical power off and returning everything to room temperature happen on very different time scales.

cues.title: 一根针，怎样留下两根线？
cues.caption: 铜红色上线穿过针眼；青绿色底线来自下方梭心。
cues.captionEn: The copper upper thread passes through the eye; the teal lower thread comes from the bobbin.
cues.zh: 先别跟着针尖跑，看看两种颜色。铜红色的上线从线轴出发，经过挑线杆，再穿过靠近针尖的针眼。青绿色的底线藏在布下面，由梭心供给。现在针向下走，把上线带进织物。针本身不会打结，真正让两根线相扣的动作，还在下面。
cues.en: Follow the two colours before following the needle. The copper thread comes from the spool, passes through the take-up lever, and enters the eye near the needle tip. The teal thread has a separate supply below the cloth. As the needle descends, it carries the upper thread down. The interlocking action is still to come.

cues.title: 针回升，线环才出现
cues.titleEn: A small rise makes a loop
cues.caption: 针先到底，再稍稍抬起：针后留出可供梭尖进入的线环。
cues.captionEn: After bottom dead centre, a small rise leaves a loop behind the needle.
cues.zh: 把目光停在针眼后面。针先降到最低处，随后开始回升。真实缝纫中，线与布料之间的作用让这段上线暂时留下，形成一个小环。针背上的凹槽给梭尖留出接近的位置。这里把柔软线的形状放慢展示；线环的大小并不是只由针的位置决定。
cues.en: Watch just behind the eye. The needle reaches its lowest position and begins to rise. In real sewing, interaction between thread and fabric leaves a small loop available for pickup.
