The scarf provides room for the hook point. Our slow view prescribes the flexible loop shape; needle position alone does not determine every detail of that shape.

cues.title: 梭尖进入针后的线环
cues.titleEn: The hook meets the rising needle
cues.caption: 旋梭连续转动，梭尖在针回升时接住上线。
cues.captionEn: The rotating hook picks up the upper loop as the needle rises.
cues.zh: 金色梭尖过来了。它接近的是针后的线环，不是针尖正下方。针已经回升，梭尖从针眼上方掠过，接住铜红色上线。看两者的相对位置：既要赶上这个线环，也必须给金属机针留出间隙。整个过程都由同一个周期位置决定，并非两个各自转动的动画。
cues.en: Here comes the gold hook point. It approaches the loop behind the needle, passing above the eye after the needle has begun rising. The captured copper strand follows the hook throat. Timing matters because the loop must be available while the metal parts remain separated. Needle and hook positions here come from the same cycle coordinate.

cues.title: 上线绕过整只梭心套
cues.titleEn: The loop travels around the case
cues.caption: 两条线腿分到梭心套前后，底线被包含在线环之内。
cues.captionEn: The two loop legs pass behind and in front of the case, enclosing the lower thread.
cues.zh: 现在沿着铜红色线环转过去。梭尖携带线环向下走，两条线腿分别经过梭心套的前面和后面。中间这只套没有跟着旋梭转；里面的梭心负责提供底线。关键不是让上线穿过梭心，而是把整个上线环带到它的周围，使底线进入这个环的包围之中。
cues.en: Follow the copper loop around the case. Its two legs take different routes, one behind the case and one in front. The case stays in place while the outer hook rotates. The bobbin supplies the teal thread inside it. The upper thread never needs to pass through the bobbin: its loop travels around the whole assembly.

cues.title: 线环脱离旋梭，走向前侧
cues.titleEn: The loop comes off the hook
cues.caption: 上线从梭心套外缘绕到前面；旋梭继续空转。
cues.captionEn: The loop clears the case rim toward the front while the hook continues rotating.
cues.zh: 线环已经绕过梭心套，现在轮到脱环。后侧的线腿沿外缘移到前侧，留出接下来收紧的通路。注意上线没有突然从套里面穿出来，也没有换成另一条线。旋梭仍然继续转动，但这一针的线环已不再跟随梭尖；在这个机构中，一次针周期对应旋梭两圈。
cues.en: The loop now leaves the hook. Its rear leg moves around the outside rim toward the front, opening a route for tightening. Keep following the same copper strand: it does not jump through the case or get replaced. The hook continues rotating without carrying this loop. This illustrated mechanism uses two hook revolutions for each needle cycle.

cues.title: 挑线杆把大环收成一针
cues.titleEn: Take-up turns the loop into a stitch
cues.caption: 挑线杆上升，外侧线环缩小，在布内与底线交锁。
cues.captionEn: The take-up lever rises, shrinking the loop into an interlock within the fabric.
cues.zh: 回到上方，看挑线杆抬起来。它把上线往回收，刚才包住梭心套的大环便越来越小。下面留下的不是一个独立绳结，而是上线绕住底线的交锁。这里把布料剖开，好看清两种颜色如何相扣。实际交锁落在什么深度，还取决于上下线张力与织物。
cues.en: Look up at the take-up lever as it rises. Drawing the upper thread back reduces the large loop below. What remains is an interlock with the lower thread, rather than a separate knot tied by the needle. The fabric section exposes the two colours. In a real seam, thread tensions and material affect where that interlock settles.

cues.title: 针已经离布，送布牙再推进
cues.titleEn: Clear the needle, then move the cloth
cues.caption: 本模型先收紧，再送布；针仍在布内时，织物保持不动。
cues.captionEn: This model tightens before feeding; the cloth stays still while the needle is in it.
cues.zh: 这一针收好了，织物才能送往下一针的位置。看送布牙：它从针板下面升起，贴住布底，再把布向后推进。此时机针已经完全离开织物。送布牙随后下降，在板下返回。本模型把送布放在收紧之后，便于分别看清；真实机构中的动作区间可能有部分重叠。
cues.en: The stitch is tightened, and the cloth can move to its next position. The feed dogs rise from below the plate, contact the underside, and advance the fabric while the needle is clear. They then drop and return underneath. We separate tightening and feeding for this explanation; actual mechanisms can overlap parts of those actions.

cues.title: 针距改变，交锁关系不变
cues.titleEn: A longer feed changes the spacing
cues.caption: 改变送布距离，两针之间的跨度改变，两根线仍在布内相扣。
cues.captionEn: A longer feed increases stitch spacing while preserving the two-thread interlock.
cues.zh: 最后比较两块分别计算的样布。两边始终处在相同的周期位置，机针与旋梭的关系完全相同；只有每针送布的距离不同。下方样布的线迹跨度更大，但上线与底线仍然在布内相扣。想复查刚才的一针，可以进入探索，慢慢移动周期滑块，把接环、脱环和收紧分别停下来。
cues.en: Compare these two separately reconstructed samples. Both follow the same cycle position and the same needle-to-hook timing. Only the feed distance differs. The lower sample has wider stitch spacing, but each interlock still joins the same two threads. In exploration, move through a single cycle to stop at pickup, release, or tightening and trace the route again.

cues.title: 正半周的两只二极管
cues.titleEn: Two diodes in the positive half-cycle
cues.caption: A 端电压较高时，D1 和 D4 接通；电流从负载上端流入，下端流出。
cues.captionEn: With A higher, D1 and D4 conduct. Current enters the top of the load and leaves the bottom.
cues.zh: 先沿着亮起的线路走一遍。这个半周，交流端 A 的电压较高，电流经过左上的 D 一，走到负载上端，再从负载下端经过右下的 D 四返回。只有这两只二极管导通。请记住负载里的方向：从上往下。下一段交流会反转，看看它会不会跟着改变。
cues.en: Follow the illuminated path. In this half-cycle, terminal A is higher. Current goes through the upper-left diode, D one, into the top of the load. It returns through the lower-right diode, D four. Only that pair conducts. Remember the downward direction through the load; we will check it again after the AC reverses.

cues.title: 换一条路，方向不变
cues.titleEn: A different route, the same direction
cues.caption: 交流极性反转，换成 D2 和 D3 导通；流过负载的方向保持不变。
cues.captionEn: Reversed AC selects D2 and D3. Current still passes through the load in the same direction.
cues.zh: 现在 B 端变成较高的一端。刚才那两只二极管截止，电流改走右上的 D 二，仍然先到负载上端，再经过左下的 D 三返回。桥里的路径换了，但负载里的方向没有换。四只二极管的连接方式，正是让两个相反的半周都得到同一种输出极性的原因。
cues.en: Now terminal B is higher. The previous pair blocks, and current takes the upper-right diode, D two, to the top of the load. It returns through the lower-left diode, D three. The bridge route has changed, but load current still points downward. That arrangement gives both opposite half-cycles the same output polarity.

cues.title: 每周期得到两个脉冲
cues.titleEn: Two output pulses per AC cycle
cues.caption: 两个半周都变成正向输出，但每次过零仍会下落：整流还不等于平滑。
cues.captionEn: Both half-cycles give positive output, but it still falls near every zero crossing. Rectification leaves ripple.
cues.zh: 把两个半周放回一张波形图。橙色交流电压一上一下，绿色输出却始终留在零线以上。交流每完成一个周期，输出就出现两个脉冲，所以五十赫兹输入对应一百赫兹脉动。不过，绿色曲线仍然反复下落。方向统一了，并不意味着输出电压已经足够平稳。
cues.en: Put both halves on one time axis. The orange source voltage swings above and below zero, while the green output stays nonnegative. One AC cycle produces two output pulses: fifty hertz in, one hundred hertz of pulsation. But the green trace still falls between peaks. Rectifying the direction has not yet smoothed the voltage.

cues.title: 第一次给电容充电
cues.titleEn: Charging the capacitor for the first time
cues.caption: 接入空电容后，只有源电压足够高时才充电；电容电压从零连续升起。
cues.captionEn: An empty capacitor charges only once the source is high enough. Its voltage rises continuously from zero.
cues.zh: 现在在负载两端接入一只空电容，从零电荷开始。源电压升高到足够推动二极管电流时，桥才给电容充电。请看紫色支路和电压曲线，储存的电荷一点点增加，没有瞬间跳到峰值。接下来，即使交流源开始回落，电容也已经有能量可以继续供给负载。
cues.en: Connect an initially empty capacitor across the load. Once the source is high enough to drive the diodes, current charges it. Watch the violet branch and the voltage trace: stored charge builds continuously, rather than jumping straight to the peak. When the source falls again, the capacitor already has energy to supply the load.

cues.title: 不是整个半周都在充电
cues.caption: 源电压幅值超过电容电压与两只二极管压降之和，桥才导通；其余时间由电容供电。
cues.captionEn: The bridge conducts above vC plus two diode drops. Between those windows, the capacitor supplies the load.
cues.zh: 留意虚线表示的门槛：电容电压，再加上两只二极管的压降。源电压的幅值超过它，桥电流才出现。离开这段窗口，四只二极管都截止，电容通过负载缓慢放电，直到下一次补充。整流桥不是整个半周都在给电容送电，电容也没有把电流倒灌回交流源。
cues.en: The dashed line marks the capacitor voltage plus two diode drops. Bridge current appears only when the source magnitude exceeds it. Outside that window, all four diodes block and the capacitor discharges through the load until the next recharge. It neither receives current throughout the whole half-cycle nor sends stored charge backward into the source.

cues.title: 电容改变纹波
cues.caption: 增大电容，同一负载下的电压下落变小；补充电荷仍集中在导通窗口里。
cues.captionEn: A larger capacitor loses less voltage between recharges. Bridge current still arrives in charging windows.
cues.zh: 保持电源和负载不变，把电容从二百二十微法换成两千二百微法。两张曲线使用相同的电压刻度，所以现在看到的起伏缩小，是真正的纹波下降。较大的电容每失去同样一小份电荷，电压下降得更少；而补充电荷的工作，仍要通过桥里的导通窗口完成。
cues.en: Keep the source and load settings, and increase capacitance from two hundred twenty to twenty-two hundred microfarads. Both traces use the same voltage scale, so the smaller variation is a real reduction in ripple. A larger capacitor loses less voltage for a given amount of charge removed. Recharging still happens through the bridge conduction windows.

cues.title: 负载与频率的拉锯
cues.caption: 负载加重会加快放电；把交流频率加倍，补充电荷的间隔变短，纹波又减小。
cues.captionEn: A heavier load discharges C faster. Doubling AC frequency shortens recharge intervals and reduces ripple.
cues.zh: 先把负载电阻从二百欧降到五十欧。负载索取更多电流，两次补充之间，电容电压下落得更明显。然后保持这个较重的负载，把交流频率从五十赫兹改成一百赫兹。同一个二十毫秒窗口里，充电机会变多了，电容来不及下降那么多，纹波因此又变小。
cues.en: First reduce the load from two hundred ohms to fifty. It draws more current, so capacitor voltage falls farther between recharges. Keep that heavier load and double AC frequency from fifty to one hundred hertz. In the same twenty-millisecond window, recharge opportunities arrive more often. The capacitor has less time to discharge, and ripple decreases.

cues.title: 浪涌与源电阻
cues.caption: 在电压峰值接入空电容，会出现浪涌；增大源电阻能限制峰值，也会减慢充电。
cues.captionEn: Connecting an empty capacitor at the voltage crest causes inrush. More source resistance limits it and slows charging.
cues.zh: 最后，把空电容接入的时刻移到交流峰值。电容起初没有电压，源和它之间的差值很大，于是出现很高的充电电流。现在增大图中的源电阻，峰值明显受限，电容充电也更慢。这里展示的是低压桥式整流模型；实际电源还需要考虑器件额定值、保护和更多寄生效应。
cues.en: Finally connect the empty capacitor at the AC crest. Its initial voltage is zero, leaving a large voltage difference that drives an inrush pulse. Increase the modeled source resistance: the peak falls, and charging becomes slower. This is a low-voltage teaching model; real supplies also require device ratings, protection, and parasitic effects beyond this calculation.

cues.title: 先有传导
cues.caption: 没有流动，热也会扩散；完全对称的初态不会凭空长出涡旋。
cues.captionEn: Heat diffuses without flow. An exactly symmetric initial state does not invent a vortex.
cues.zh: 先看一格完全静止、温度均匀的流体。下板保持暖，上板保持冷，颜色开始从两端向里面展开。亮点还没有移动，但热已经在传递，这叫传导。现在没有任何横向扰动，计算不会偷偷加一条循环路线。
cues.en: Begin with motionless fluid at one uniform temperature. Hold the lower plate warm and the upper plate cool. Color spreads inward from both ends. The tracers have not moved, yet heat is already traveling by conduction. There is no sideways disturbance in this setup, and no circulation path hidden in the animation.

cues.title: 给温度一点扰动
cues.caption: 重置为导热温度层，加入相同的小扰动，看它能否长大。
cues.captionEn: Start from a conductive temperature layer with a small prescribed disturbance. Can it grow?
cues.zh: 重新开始，这次先放好一个导热温度层，再加入很小的横向温度差。它是明确写入初态的扰动，不是随机晃动。留意中间和两侧，细小的速度箭头逐渐出现。温度影响浮力，流动又改变温度，两个计算从这里相互接上。
cues.en: Restart from a conductive temperature layer, this time with a small sideways temperature disturbance. It is prescribed in the initial state, not random movement. Watch the center and the sides as small velocity arrows appear. Temperature changes buoyancy, and the resulting flow carries temperature. The two parts of the calculation are now coupled.

cues.title: 暖流开始上升
cues.caption: 下热上冷时，温度扰动与浮力耦合，逐渐形成上升暖流。
cues.captionEn: With warmth below, temperature disturbances couple to buoyancy and grow into rising currents.
cues.zh: 让同一组计算继续。下方的暖色伸向上方，冷色流体也找到了向下的通道。并不是所有暖色点都只能往上走，局部速度由整个不可压缩流场决定。这里看到的暖流，是温度输运和浮力持续相互作用的结果。
cues.en: Continue the same calculation. Warm colors extend upward while cooler fluid finds a downward route. A warm-colored point is not required to move upward at every instant: its local velocity belongs to the whole incompressible flow. The developing current comes from temperature transport and buoyancy continually affecting one another.

cues.title: 追踪一团流体
cues.caption: 上升必须有回流；亮点和染料由同一个封闭速度场搬运。
cues.captionEn: Rising flow needs a return path. Tracers and dye follow the same closed-cell velocity field.
cues.zh: 跟住这个亮点，再看紫色染料怎样被拉开。格子没有出口，哪里向上，就必须有别处回流。亮点的身份一直保留，但它经过的局部温度会改变。圆圈不是预先画好的；位置和染料都从实际算出的速度场一步步推进。
cues.en: Follow the bright tracer and watch the purple dye stretch through the cell. There is no outlet, so rising fluid needs a return path elsewhere. The tracer keeps its identity, but the temperature at its position can change. Neither its route nor the dye pattern is drawn in advance; both follow the computed velocity.

cues.title: 拿掉浮力再比较
cues.caption: 保留相同温差，去掉浮力耦合：传导仍在，携热流动消失。
cues.captionEn: Keep the temperature difference and remove buoyancy: conduction remains, but circulating heat transport disappears.
cues.zh: 用相同初态和温差再做一次，只把浮力耦合关掉。没有驱动循环，热仍然能够传导。对照中间截面的携热读数：有流动时，流体搬走了热；没有流动时，这一项为零。温度颜色变化，并不自动意味着发生了对流。
cues.en: Repeat with the same initial temperature and plate difference, but disable buoyancy coupling. Nothing drives circulation, yet conduction still transfers heat. Compare the advective heat readings across the middle of the cell. Moving fluid carries heat; the motionless case has zero advective transport. A changing temperature image alone does not prove that convection is happening.

cues.title: 把暖板放在上面
cues.caption: 只交换冷热板，扰动不再长大；热从上方主要靠传导向下走。
cues.captionEn: Swap the warm and cool plates. The disturbance decays, and heat travels mainly downward by conduction.
cues.zh: 现在保留浮力，只交换冷热板的位置。同一个小扰动，从下面加热时能长大，从上面加热时却逐渐衰减。上方暖、下方冷的分层比较稳定。热没有被封住，仍主要靠传导向下走，只是不再发展出刚才那样的循环。
cues.en: Keep buoyancy active and exchange the warm and cool plates. The same small disturbance grows when heated from below but decays when heated from above. Warm fluid above cool fluid makes a stable arrangement here. Heat is not trapped: it still travels mainly downward by conduction, without developing the earlier circulation.

cues.title: 撤去温差以后
cues.caption: 把两板调到同温，余热与惯性不会瞬间消失，流动逐步衰减。
cues.captionEn: Set both plates to one temperature. Stored heat and motion remain briefly, then the flow decays.
cues.zh: 回到已经建立循环的格子，把两块板都调到中间温度。注意，亮点没有立刻停住，原来的温度差也没有瞬间消失。随着热扩散和动量耗散继续，颜色逐渐均匀，动能读数降低。撤去外加温差，与抹掉已有流动，是两件不同的事。
cues.en: Return to an established circulation and set both plates to the middle temperature. The tracers do not stop immediately, and stored temperature differences remain for a while. As diffusion and momentum dissipation continue, the colors even out and kinetic energy falls. Removing the imposed temperature contrast does not instantly erase the existing flow.

cues.title: 看清计算的边界
cues.titleEn: What the grid can tell us
cues.caption: 加密网格仍得到对流，但数值会变化；本演示不测量临界阈值。
cues.captionEn: A finer grid still gives convection, with different numbers. We do not measure an onset threshold.
cues.zh: 最后把计算单元显露出来，再用更细的网格比较同一时刻。两组都出现对流，携热数值却不完全相同。迎风格式还带有额外的数值耗散，所以这里不报一个所谓精确的临界阈值。画面解释这组理想边界里的温度与流动，不替代真实三维实验。
cues.en: Reveal the computational cells and compare a finer grid at the same elapsed time. Both produce convection, but their heat-transport readings differ. The upwind scheme also adds numerical dissipation, so we do not report a supposedly precise onset threshold. This window explains coupled heat and flow under idealized boundaries; it does not replace a real three-dimensional experiment.

cues.title: 先过能量门槛
cues.caption: 越过带隙才可能激发电荷对；多出来的光子能量先变成热。
cues.captionEn: A photon must cross the bandgap to excite a pair; excess photon energy becomes heat.
cues.zh: 先别急着数电流，先看每个光子的能量。这颗低能光子跨不过硅的带隙，继续穿过去。能量足够的光子，吸收后可以激发一对电子和空穴。注意能量更高的那一颗：多出来的能量变成热，并没有在这里变出第二对电荷。
cues.en: Start with one photon, before counting any current. The low-energy photon cannot cross silicon's bandgap, so it passes through. An energetic enough photon can be absorbed and excite an electron and a hole. Watch the higher-energy photon: its extra energy becomes heat. Our model does not turn it into a second pair.

cues.title: 一对电荷分开走
cues.caption: 一对等量异号电荷同时出现；结区电场让电子与空穴向相反方向移动。
cues.captionEn: Equal opposite charges appear together. The junction field separates electrons and holes.
cues.zh: 现在切开电池，跟住一个确定被吸收的光子。电子和空穴在同一处出现，电荷没有凭空增加。电子先扩散到结区，再被那里的电场推向上方；空穴向下方的接点移动。注意，电场只标在薄薄的结区里，不是整块硅都在被同样地推动。
cues.en: Now open the cell and follow one photon that is absorbed. An electron and a hole appear together, with no net charge created. The electron diffuses toward the junction, then the field drives it upward. The hole moves toward the rear contact. That field is drawn only inside the thin junction region.

cues.title: 外面的路也要闭合
cues.caption: 电子沿接点、导线与负载返回；空穴留在电池内，闭合路径才持续输出。
cues.captionEn: Electrons return through contacts, wire and load. Holes stay in the cell; sustained output needs a closed path.
cues.zh: 电子到了前接点，路还没有结束。沿导线往右，它经过负载，最后回到背面的接点。空穴没有钻进金属导线，而是在电池这一侧等待复合。这里慢放的是一对电荷的完整路径；持续照明时，许多这样的过程共同维持电流，标记的数量并不代表安培数。
cues.en: Reaching the front contact is only part of the journey. Follow the electron along the wire, through the load and back to the rear contact. The hole stays on the cell side, where recombination completes the path. We slow down one pair; continuous illumination sustains many such processes, not just these two markers.

cues.title: 负载选择工作点
cues.caption: 负载直线与 I–V 曲线的交点，决定真实电流、电压与输出功率。
cues.captionEn: The load line meets the I–V curve at the actual current, voltage and power.
cues.zh: 把负载电阻慢慢增大，看棕色直线转动。它和蓝色电池曲线的交点，才是电路实际采用的电压和电流。浅色矩形的面积表示两者相乘，也就是输出功率。交点经过空心标记附近时，面积最大；继续增大电阻，电压还在升，功率却已经下降。
cues.en: Increase the load resistance and watch the brown line rotate. Where it meets the blue cell curve gives the actual voltage and current. The shaded rectangle multiplies them: that is output power. Near the hollow marker, its area is largest. Keep increasing resistance and voltage still rises, but useful power falls again.

cues.title: 两种零输出
cues.titleEn: Two ways to get zero power
cues.caption: 开路有电压却没有外电流；短路有电流却没有负载电压。两者输出都为零。
cues.captionEn: An open circuit has no external current; a short has no load voltage. Both deliver zero power.
cues.zh: 先断开外面的路。电池两端有电压，但没有外电流，所以不能向负载持续送出功率。现在换成理想短路，交点移到另一端：电流很大，负载上的电压却为零。两种状态看起来相反，电压乘电流都等于零；发电需要在这两个端点之间工作。
cues.en: First, disconnect the outside path. Voltage remains across the cell, but no external current flows, so the load receives no steady power. Now replace it with an ideal short. Current is large, yet load voltage is zero. These opposite endpoints both give zero power. Useful operation lies between them, with both factors nonzero.

cues.title: 光照把曲线抬起来
cues.caption: 增加照度提高光生电流；暗态的被动负载没有可用输出。
cues.captionEn: More irradiance raises photocurrent. In darkness, a passive load receives no power.
cues.zh: 把温度和负载固定，先从完全黑暗开始。没有光生电流，这个被动电路也没有输出。随着光照恢复，蓝色曲线逐渐抬高，负载交点跟着移动。灰色虚线保留满光照时的曲线，方便比较。这里增加的是入射光通量，并没有偷偷改变电阻或电池面积。
cues.en: Hold temperature and load fixed, and begin in complete darkness. With no photocurrent, this passive circuit supplies no power. As illumination returns, the blue curve rises and the operating point moves along the load line. The dashed curve keeps the full-light reference visible. Only irradiance changes; resistance and the equivalent cell area stay fixed.

cues.title: 更热不等于更强
cues.caption: 这组硅电池参数中，升温略增短路电流，却降低开路电压与最大功率。
cues.captionEn: For this silicon model, warming slightly raises short-circuit current but lowers open-circuit voltage and maximum power.
cues.zh: 阳光不变，只把电池从二十五度加热到六十五度。短路电流会略微增加，曲线的右边却明显往回缩。与灰色的低温参考相比，最大功率也降低了。原因不能只看光生电流：温度还改变二极管的饱和电流和结电压。这组硅电池参数并不支持越热发电越多的说法。
cues.en: Keep the sunlight fixed and warm the cell from twenty-five to sixty-five degrees Celsius. Short-circuit current rises slightly, but the curve retreats to the left. Maximum power falls below the cool reference. Temperature also changes the diode's saturation current and junction voltage. For these silicon parameters, a hotter cell does not mean more electricity.

cues.title: 每一份能量有去处
cues.caption: 先减少被收集的电荷，再增大串联电阻：复合与发热是不同损失。
cues.captionEn: First reduce collection, then increase series resistance: recombination and heating are different losses.
cues.zh: 最后给同一份阳光记一本账。先降低收集倍率，更多电荷复合，输出减少。再增大串联电阻，导电路径消耗更多能量，发热条跟着变化。反射、透过、光子热化也各有去处。结电压能量差是模型里的剩余能量项，不是实测热图；所有条目相加，始终回到入射光功率。
cues.en: Finish by accounting for the same incoming sunlight. First reduce collection: more charge recombines and output falls. Then raise series resistance, increasing dissipation along the conducting path. Reflection, transmission and photon thermalization have separate entries. The junction energy gap is a model residual, not a measured heat map. Every entry sums back to incident power.

cues.title: 把一把钥匙放到公开处
cues.titleEn: Put one key in public view
cues.caption: 公开 n 和 e；发件人可算出密文，d 由收件人保管。
cues.captionEn: Publish n and e so anyone can compute ciphertext. The recipient keeps d private.
cues.zh: 先看上面那张公开告示。收件人把两个数交给所有人，发件人就能把消息变成密文，却不用先交换私人钥匙。跟住信封里的四十二，它会变成十五。这里故意使用极小的数，让每一步都看得清；这些参数没有真实的保密能力。
cues.en: Look at the notice above the envelope. The recipient publishes two numbers, so a sender can compute ciphertext without first receiving a secret key. Follow forty-two as it becomes fifteen. We have deliberately chosen tiny numbers so every operation stays visible. This example teaches the mechanism; these particular keys cannot keep a real secret.

cues.title: 两种指数，从哪里来
cues.titleEn: Where the two exponents come from
cues.caption: 由不同素数构造 n，再求 e 在模 λ 下的逆元 d。
cues.captionEn: Build n from distinct primes, then find d as the inverse of e modulo λ.
cues.zh: 把纸翻过来，看看钥匙的来历。十一乘十七得到一百八十七。再取十与十六的最小公倍数，得到八十。公开指数选七，欧几里得算法找到二十三：七乘二十三，除以八十余一。这种倒过来的关系，是模逆元，不是普通分数。
cues.en: Turn the notice over and inspect its construction. Eleven times seventeen gives the public modulus. The least common multiple of ten and sixteen is eighty. Choose seven as the public exponent. Euclid’s algorithm gives twenty-three for the return trip: their product leaves remainder one modulo eighty. That is a modular inverse, not an ordinary fraction.

cues.title: 只留下整除后的余数
cues.caption: 消息只能取 0 到 n−1；mod 表示余数，不是普通除法。
cues.captionEn: Messages range from 0 to n−1. The mod operation returns a remainder.
cues.zh: 消息先限定为一个整数，最小是零，最大是一百八十六。现在只做一次平方：四十二乘自己，得到一千七百六十四。去掉九份一百八十七，剩下八十一。这个剩余就是模运算的结果；以后每次相乘，都可以这样留下小的余数。
cues.en: Our message is an integer between zero and one hundred eighty-six. Try just one square. Forty-two squared is one thousand seven hundred and sixty-four. Remove nine whole copies of the modulus, and eighty-one remains. That remainder is what mod means. We can reduce after every multiplication, keeping the arithmetic small without changing its eventual answer.

cues.title: 把幂拆开，算出密文
cues.titleEn: Split the power to compute the ciphertext
cues.caption: 指数 7 = 1 + 2 + 4；平方得余数，选中后逐项乘入。
cues.captionEn: The exponent 7 is 1 + 2 + 4. Square, reduce, and multiply the selected terms.
cues.zh: 七次幂，不必真的连乘出一个巨数。看上排，一次幂、二次幂、四次幂，靠平方逐个得到。七正好拆成一加二加四，所以三项都取用。下面的累积值从一出发，每乘一项就取余，经过四十二、三十六，最后停在十五。
cues.en: We do not need to build the enormous seventh power first. Along the top, successive squares give powers one, two and four. Those exponents add to seven, so all three terms are selected. Watch the accumulator below: start at one, multiply, then reduce. It passes through forty-two and thirty-six before reaching ciphertext fifteen.

cues.title: 私人指数把消息带回来
cues.titleEn: The private exponent brings the message back
cues.caption: 同一密文改用指数 23；跳过 8，最后恢复消息 42。
cues.captionEn: Apply exponent 23 to the ciphertext. Skip power 8 and recover message 42.
cues.zh: 收件人拿到十五，底数变了，运算方法没变。现在使用私人指数二十三，它拆成一、二、四和十六。注意八次幂这一格：算出来了，却不需要乘进去，累积值仍是九十三。最后取用十六次幂，四十二就回来了。
cues.en: The recipient starts with fifteen and uses the private exponent, twenty-three. The same arithmetic now selects powers one, two, four and sixteen. Watch the eighth-power column carefully. Its remainder is computed but never multiplied into the accumulator, which stays at ninety-three. The final selected term brings back forty-two, the original message.

cues.title: 零和不互素的数，也要回来
cues.titleEn: Zero and shared factors must work too
cues.caption: 逐个检查边界与不互素消息；两边素数的余数都必须恢复。
cues.captionEn: Check boundaries and shared factors. Both prime remainders must return correctly.
cues.zh: 不能只挑好看的消息。让零、十一、十七和最大值轮流走一遍。十一与模数有公因子，其中一边的余数为零，但零的正整数次幂仍是零。两边素数的余数都恢复，范围内就只有原来那个数。这里还完整核对了全部一百八十七个输入。
cues.en: Now test the awkward inputs: zero, eleven, seventeen and the largest allowed value. Eleven shares a factor with the modulus, so one prime remainder is zero. A positive power keeps that zero intact. Both prime remainders return correctly, identifying the original integer. We also check all one hundred eighty-seven possible inputs for this key.

cues.title: 算得回来，不代表守得住
cues.titleEn: A round-trip is not a security guarantee
cues.caption: 不填充的 RSA 是确定性的；小消息可以逐个公开猜测。
cues.captionEn: Unpadded RSA is deterministic. Small messages can be guessed using the public key.
cues.zh: 不过，能解回来，不等于别人猜不到。连续发送两个四十二，两次密文都是十五。旁观者也有公钥，可以从零开始，把猜测逐个加密。看到四十二这一行了吗？密文吻合了。小范围加上没有随机填充，让这封信根本守不住秘密。
cues.en: A successful return trip does not guarantee secrecy. Send forty-two twice and both ciphertexts are fifteen. An observer has the public key too, and can encrypt candidate messages starting at zero. There: the forty-two row matches. This small message space, with no randomized padding, lets a public calculation reveal what the envelope contained.

cues.title: 真实系统，多做了什么
cues.caption: 现代 RSA 加密需要安全填充；混合方案用随机密钥保护内容。
cues.captionEn: Modern RSA encryption needs secure padding. Hybrid schemes protect content with a random key.
cues.zh: 最后把教具与真实用法分开。现代 RSA 加密采用随机填充的规范方案，例如 OAEP。混合加密中，公钥保护随机对称密钥，再用它保护内容。图上只画分工，没有执行这些算法。还要确认公钥属于谁；会加密，并不证明发件人身份。
cues.en: Here is the extra structure real encryption needs. Modern RSA uses randomized padding in a scheme such as OAEP. In a hybrid design it protects a random symmetric key, while authenticated symmetric encryption protects the content. This is only an architecture diagram. Verify whose public key you have; encryption alone does not establish the sender’s identity.

cues.title: 低输入接通上拉路径
cues.titleEn: A low input opens the pull-up path
cues.caption: A 为 0，上拉给电容充电；输出电压逐渐升高。
cues.captionEn: With A at 0, the pull-up charges the capacitor and the output rises.
cues.zh: 先看这只反相器。输入为零，上方的开关接通，下方断开。沿着棕色通路，电源给输出电容充电。注意输出电压：它没有立刻跳到一，而是逐渐升高。栅极负责控制开关，并没有把电流直接送进沟道。
cues.en: Follow the brown path above the output. With the input low, the upper switch connects the supply to the capacitor. The lower path is open. Watch the voltage rise along a curve, rather than jump to one. The insulated gate controls the channel; it does not feed current straight through it.

cues.title: 高输入接通下拉路径
cues.titleEn: A high input opens the pull-down path
cues.caption: A 为 1，上拉断开，下拉让电容连续放电。
cues.captionEn: With A at 1, the pull-up opens and the capacitor discharges through the pull-down.
cues.zh: 现在把输入变成一。上方通路断开，蓝色的下拉通路接通。电容里原有的电荷经过沟道流向地，输出电压连续下降。输入已经变了，输出却还需要一点时间。这就是同一只反相器完成的另一个方向。
cues.en: Now raise the input. The upper path disconnects and the blue pull-down turns on. Charge leaves the output capacitor through that channel toward ground. The input has already changed, but the output is still moving. This is the other half of inversion: a high input eventually produces a low output.

cues.title: 与非门：下拉必须串通
cues.caption: 两个下拉串联；任一个没有接通，输出就不能沿它们放电。
cues.captionEn: The pull-down devices are in series; either open switch breaks the discharge path.
cues.zh: 把下方换成两只串联开关。只有一个输入变高时，蓝色通路仍然断着，输出保持高电平。等两个输入都高，放电路径才完整。再把其中一个输入变低，上方的并联支路就能充电。这种接法，实现的就是与非。
cues.en: Look at the two lower switches in series. Changing just one input leaves a gap, so the output stays high. When both inputs become high, the discharge path is complete. Lower either input again and a parallel upper branch can recharge the capacitor. Those connections are what make this a NAND gate.

cues.title: 或非门：一条下拉就够
cues.titleEn: NOR needs only one pull-down path
cues.caption: 下拉改成并联，任一高输入都能拉低输出。
cues.captionEn: Parallel pull-down paths let either high input pull the output low.
cues.zh: 再交换串联和并联的位置。下方现在有两条独立通路，任何一个输入变高，就能让电容放电。上方却需要两个开关都接通，输出才能重新升高。留意最后的上升：电流要经过两只电阻，充电也因此更慢。
cues.en: Exchange the series and parallel arrangements. Now either lower branch can discharge the output when its input goes high. Recharging requires both upper switches to be on. Notice the slower final rise: charging current must pass through two resistances in series. The circuit topology changes both the logic and the timing.

cues.title: 电压要穿过中间区域
cues.caption: X 表示不能保证的逻辑读数；电容电压仍有确定数值。
cues.captionEn: X marks an unguaranteed logic reading; the capacitor voltage remains definite.
cues.zh: 把刚才的下降过程放慢。蓝线进入浅色带，读数变成了叉号。电容并没有失去电压，只是此时不能保证把它读成零或一。圆点标出半电源电压，用来比较延迟。本片的这些界线是教学约定，不是所有芯片的规格。
cues.en: Watch the falling voltage enter the shaded band. Its logic label becomes X, although the capacitor still has a definite voltage. In this band we do not promise a reliable zero or one. The dot marks half supply for comparing delay. These boundaries are teaching choices, not universal chip specifications.

cues.title: 更大的负载需要更久
cues.caption: 10 fF 换成 40 fF，电阻不变，半电压时间增加到四倍。
cues.captionEn: Changing 10 fF to 40 fF quadruples half-voltage time at the same resistance.
cues.zh: 先看较小的输出电容，电压很快就升起来了。接着只把电容放大四倍，电源和开关电阻都不变。两次曲线用同一个时间范围，这次明显变缓。更大的电容需要搬运更多电荷，才能改变同样多的电压。
cues.en: First watch the smaller output capacitor charge. Now replace it with four times the capacitance, keeping the supply and channel resistance unchanged. The plot uses the same time scale. Reaching half supply takes four times as long because changing the voltage requires moving four times as much charge through the same resistance.

cues.title: 变化沿两级电路传播
cues.titleEn: A transition travels through two stages
cues.caption: Y₁ 穿过模型界线后，第二级才开始改变 Y₂。
cues.captionEn: Only after Y₁ crosses the model boundary does the second stage begin changing Y₂.
cues.zh: 顺着这条连线，第一级输出接到第二级的两个栅极。先看第一条电压曲线下降。只有穿过模型的切换界线，第二级才换通路，另一只电容开始充电。两条曲线之间的错开，来自两段真实计算的充放电过程。
cues.en: Follow the wire from the first output to both gates of the second inverter. The first voltage falls before the second stage changes paths. It switches only when that voltage crosses our model boundary. Then its own capacitor starts charging. The separation between the curves comes from two calculated charging and discharging processes.

cues.title: 一次翻转，能量去了哪里
cues.caption: 充电把能量分给电容与热，随后放电把储能也变成热。
cues.captionEn: Charging divides energy between storage and heat; discharging turns the stored part into heat.
cues.zh: 最后追踪一轮充放电。充电时，电源给出的能量一部分存进电容，另一部分已经变成热。放电时，存下来的能量也经过下拉电阻变成热。稳定电平在这个理想模型里不持续耗电，但翻转有代价；真实芯片还会有漏电等损耗。
cues.en: Now follow the energy through a complete charge and discharge. During charging, some supply energy is stored and some is already lost as heat. Discharging turns the stored part into heat too. A settled level draws no permanent current in this ideal model, but switching costs energy. Real chips also have leakage and other losses.

cues.title: 两种宿主，一层隔膜
cues.caption: 锂储存在宿主里，隔膜保持两极分开。
cues.captionEn: Lithium sits in hosts; the separator keeps the electrodes apart.
cues.zh: 先把电芯的截面打开。左边的石墨和右边的磷酸铁锂，都是容纳锂的宿主，并不是两块金属锂。铜与铝薄片负责集流。中间这层湿润的隔膜，让离子能够穿行，同时避免两极直接接触。接下来，跟住金色标记和蓝色标记。
cues.en: Look inside this graphite and lithium iron phosphate cell. The materials on either side host lithium; neither is a slab of lithium metal. Copper and aluminum collect electronic current. Between them, a wet separator keeps the electrodes apart. Now follow the gold and blue markers.

cues.title: 两条路，同一次放电
cues.caption: 锂离子向内穿行，电子经过外部负载。
cues.captionEn: Ions travel internally; electrons pass through the external load.
cues.zh: 接上负载，放电开始。金色标记从石墨一侧离开，经电解液向另一极移动。蓝色电子标记先经过集流体，再绕到外部负载。它们的路径不同，却属于同一次电荷转移。标记是选出的示踪对象，不代表真实粒子的数量，也没有模拟它们的实际速度。
cues.en: Connect the load and watch discharge begin. Gold moves out of the graphite through electrolyte. Blue first reaches a collector, then takes the wire through the external load. These separate routes belong to the same charge transfer. The markers are selected tracers, not particle counts or actual transit speeds.

cues.title: 让离子过，不让电子过
cues.caption: 同一组身份保持不变，路径不会跨错材料。
cues.captionEn: Tracer identities stay fixed, and their paths respect the materials.
cues.zh: 看隔膜中，金色标记经过的孔道。孔里含有电解液，所以离子能通过。电子必须经由外部导线，不能把隔膜当成捷径。正极接收锂的同时，也接收来自外部的电子；两边的反应配合起来，才构成完整的电流回路。
cues.en: Look at the separator. Its pores contain electrolyte, so lithium ions can pass. The electron takes the external conductor; the separator is not an electronic shortcut. At the positive electrode, lithium insertion accompanies electron transfer. The reactions connect the internal and external parts of the circuit.

cues.title: 电量对应锂的搬移
cues.caption: 两极含锂比例一减一增，总量保持不变。
cues.captionEn: One host loses lithium as the other gains it; total inventory stays fixed.
cues.zh: 继续放电，留意这两条库存条。石墨里的平均含锂比例降低，磷酸铁锂一侧升高，总锂量没有减少。外部每通过相应的电荷，就对应一份锂的转移。SOC 记录可用电荷还剩多少；它不是电压的另一个名字，更不能直接当成瓦时。
cues.en: Keep discharging and compare the two inventory bars. Average lithium content falls in graphite and rises in the positive host, while the total stays fixed. External charge counts the matching lithium transfer. State of charge tracks the usable charge remaining. It is neither another name for voltage nor a measurement in watt-hours.

cues.title: 电流变大，压降出现
cues.caption: 内阻立刻降压，极化随后变化，内部持续发热。
cues.captionEn: Resistance acts immediately; polarization follows, with internal heat loss.
cues.zh: 把放电电流提高，端电压立刻降低一截。这一步来自内阻，之后缓慢增加的压降来自等效极化。负载拿到的功率，已经扣除了内部损耗。注意热功率读数：更快取出电荷，并不意味着所有化学能都变成了有用的外部功。
cues.en: Increase the discharge current. Terminal voltage immediately steps down through the series resistance, then polarization adds a slower change. The load receives power after internal losses. Watch the heat reading rise. Extracting charge faster does not mean that all the released chemical energy becomes useful work in the external circuit.

cues.title: 电压回升，不是电量回生
cues.caption: 断流后 SOC 不变，极化储能释放为热。
cues.captionEn: At zero current, SOC stays fixed while polarization energy becomes heat.
cues.zh: 现在把外部电流降到零。电阻压降立刻消失，端电压随后慢慢靠近虚线。看清下面的 SOC：前后完全一样。这段回升来自极化状态的松弛；等效暂存的能量正释放为热。电池并没有趁着休息，凭空把已经输出的电量补回来。
cues.en: Now remove the external current. The resistive drop vanishes immediately, and voltage gradually approaches the dashed line. Read the state of charge below: it has not changed. The recovery comes from polarization relaxing, with its equivalent stored energy becoming heat. Rest has not replaced charge already delivered to the load.

cues.title: 提供能量，沿原路返回
cues.titleEn: Supply energy and reverse the paths
cues.caption: 充电源做功，锂回到石墨，电子方向也反转。
cues.captionEn: The charger does work as lithium returns to graphite and electrons reverse.
cues.zh: 让外部装置改为提供能量，方向就反过来了。还是这些示踪点，没有换一批，也没有跳到另一端。锂向石墨返回，电子也沿外部回路反向传输。充电源必须提供足够的端电压：一部分输入增加可逆储能，另一部分仍消耗在内部。
cues.en: The external device now supplies energy, and the directions reverse. These are the same tracers, retracing their paths without jumping to a new starting point. Lithium returns to graphite, and external electrons reverse too. The source increases reversible storage while also paying for internal losses; charging does not eliminate resistance.

cues.title: 到边界，停止继续充入
cues.caption: 容量端点触发断流，能量账目始终闭合。
cues.captionEn: The usable capacity limit stops current, while energy accounting stays balanced.
cues.zh: 最后观察电量接近可用上限。到达端点，模型控制器断开电流，不允许 SOC 继续超过百分之百。下面这笔账始终相等：初始储能加上充入能量，等于仍然储存的、已经输出的和内部放出的热。真实电池需要自己的控制策略，这里只是明确边界的教学电芯。
cues.en: Watch the cell approach its usable upper limit. The model controller stops current instead of allowing state of charge to exceed one hundred percent. The ledger still balances: initial energy plus charging input equals energy retained, energy delivered and internal heat. This bounded teaching cell does not prescribe a real charging protocol.

cues.title: 轮子想转，摆在把关
cues.titleEn: The wheel wants to turn; the pendulum gates it
cues.caption: 重锤拉动卷筒；擒纵轮被两块擒纵瓦交替拦住。
cues.captionEn: The weight pulls the drum; two pallets alternately hold the escape wheel.
cues.zh: 先看下方的重锤，再看轮缘。重锤始终往下拉，可这只轮子没有一路转过去。它被上方的两块擒纵瓦轮流拦住。钟摆与锚架连在同一根轴上，每次摆过来，只打开一小段通路。我们把外壳剖开，沿着那枚绿色标记的齿，看看持续的拉力怎样变成一步一步的运动。
cues.en: Start with the hanging weight, then look at the rim. The weight keeps pulling, yet the wheel cannot simply run away. Two pallets take turns holding it. The pendulum shares an arbor with the anchor and opens a short passage on each swing. Follow the green-marked tooth as that steady drive becomes a sequence of steps.

cues.title: 锁住轮子，摆仍在走
cues.titleEn: The wheel rests while the pendulum moves
cues.caption: 锁面是以锚轴为圆心的圆弧：摆动时，齿尖停在原处。
cues.captionEn: The locking arc is centred on the anchor arbor, so the tooth stays put as the anchor swings.
cues.zh: 现在靠近入口瓦，只盯住接触点。摆还在动，齿尖却停在同一个位置。绿色锁面不是随手画的斜坡，它是一段以锚轴为圆心的圆弧。锚架转动时，这段圆弧沿着自己原来的圆移动，所以轮子不用倒退让路。这就是静止式擒纵里，锁定阶段的关键几何。
cues.en: Move in to the entry pallet and watch the contact point. The anchor moves, but the tooth remains in one place. That green surface is an arc centred on the anchor arbor. Turning the anchor slides the arc along its own circle. The wheel does not need to recoil. This geometry explains the dead, or resting, part of deadbeat.

cues.title: 齿尖滑过冲量面
cues.titleEn: The tooth crosses the impulse face
cues.caption: 齿尖越过锁角，沿平面冲量面推进；随后进入短暂跌落。
cues.captionEn: The tooth passes the locking corner, drives along the impulse plane, then briefly drops free.
cues.zh: 等到摆返回，齿尖终于来到圆弧尽头。这里接上一块平面，接触的作用变了：轮子开始前进，同时通过冲量面推动锚架。看那一点从锁角走到出口，它不是跳到下一块瓦上。离开端点后，还有很短的自由转动，直到另一枚齿被对侧接住。这个间隙叫作跌落。
cues.en: As the pendulum returns, the tooth reaches the end of the circular face. A flat impulse face begins there. Now the wheel advances and pushes the anchor through contact. Watch the point travel from the corner to the discharge edge. It then leaves the pallet and moves briefly without contact. This small free movement is called drop.

cues.title: 出口瓦接住下一步
cues.titleEn: The exit pallet catches the next step
cues.caption: 出口瓦先锁住轮子，待摆返回，再从另一方向传递冲量。
cues.captionEn: The exit pallet locks first, then delivers an impulse on the returning swing.
cues.zh: 把视线移到出口瓦。另一枚齿已经落在它的锁面上，轮子再次停下。摆还会继续走到另一端，再折回来。直到这边的锁角让开，第二次冲量才开始。两边的表面朝向不同，但职责相同：先可靠地拦住，再在合适的摆动方向上放行，顺带把能量交给钟摆。
cues.en: Look across to the exit pallet. Another tooth has landed on its locking face, stopping the wheel again. The pendulum continues to the far side and returns. Only then does this locking corner clear and the next impulse begin. The two pallets face different ways, but share the same job: hold, release, and pass energy in the returning direction.

cues.title: 一次往返，恰好一个齿距
cues.titleEn: One full swing, one tooth pitch
cues.caption: 每半次往返放行一次；完整往返后，30 齿轮前进 12°。
cues.captionEn: There is one release per half-swing; a full swing advances this 30-tooth wheel by 12°.
cues.zh: 现在退远一点，把两次声音想成一对滴答。一次完整往返包含两次放行，轮子合起来前进一个齿距。这只轮有三十枚齿，所以一齿对应十二度。注意摆的连续运动和轮子的停走并不一样。摆提供周期，轮子把这些周期变成可以累计的步数，再交给钟里的后续计数机构。
cues.en: Pull back and group two releases into one complete swing. Together they advance the wheel by one tooth pitch. There are thirty teeth here, so that pitch is twelve degrees. Compare the smooth pendulum motion with the wheel’s stops and starts. The pendulum provides a repeating period; the wheel turns those periods into steps a clock can count.

cues.title: 补回损失，摆幅才留得住
cues.caption: 同一起点与阻尼：自由摆衰减；理想中点补能维持能量范围。
cues.captionEn: Same start and damping: the free swing decays; ideal centre impulses sustain its energy range.
cues.zh: 如果只会放行，钟摆迟早还是会停。看这组能量对照：两只摆从相同状态出发，也有相同阻尼。左边没有补能，能量逐渐减少；右边每次过中点都得到一小份能量。这是单独的理想小角摆模型，把冲量压成瞬间，方便看清损失与补偿，并不是在测量这副擒纵的真实效率。
cues.en: Releasing the wheel is only half the story. These two pendulums start alike and have identical damping. Without added work, the left one loses energy. The right receives a small, fixed amount at each centre crossing. This separate small-angle model compresses an impulse into an instant. It isolates loss and replacement; it does not measure the escapement’s actual efficiency.

cues.title: 摆变长，放行的节拍变慢
cues.titleEn: A longer pendulum releases more slowly
cues.caption: 相同计时窗口里，较长的摆周期更长，累计放行更少。
cues.captionEn: Over the same time window, a longer pendulum has a longer period and fewer releases.
cues.zh: 供能足够以后，怎样改变节拍？先保持左边的短摆不动，再加长右边的有效摆长。两边经过的时间完全相同，可右边一次往返需要更久，累计放行也更少。这里使用小角摆的周期关系。改变的是重心到转轴的有效长度，不是把齿轮随便调慢，也不是改齿数来假装调准钟摆。
cues.en: Once losses are replaced, what sets the pace? Keep the short pendulum on the left and lengthen the one on the right. Both comparisons use exactly the same elapsed time. The longer pendulum takes more time per swing and produces fewer releases. We use the small-angle period relation: the effective pivot-to-bob length changes the beat, not a wheel-speed animation setting.

cues.title: 重锤供能，钟摆定拍
cues.titleEn: The weight supplies energy; the pendulum sets the beat
cues.caption: 锁定限制轮的推进；冲量补偿损失；摆长决定近似周期。
cues.captionEn: Lock limits the wheel, impulse replaces losses, and length sets the approximate period.
cues.zh: 回到完整机构，把三件事分开看。重锤下降，提供能量；齿尖和擒纵瓦接触，把能量分批送出，也拦住轮子；钟摆的往返决定下一次什么时候放行。这里省略了真实钟里的多级轮系，让重锤直接驱动示范卷筒。记住这条关系，就能看懂一只机械钟怎样既走得动，又走得有节拍。
cues.en: Return to the whole movement and separate its three jobs. The descending weight supplies energy. Teeth and pallets gate that energy and prevent the wheel from running freely. The pendulum determines when the next release can happen. Our drum is driven directly to expose those connections; a real clock adds a gear train. Energy keeps it moving, and the regulator gives it a beat.

cues.title: 先逐页翻完这张表
cues.titleEn: Read the table page by page
cues.caption: 查找键 63：完整扫描要检查全部 24 行。
cues.captionEn: Finding key 63 requires scanning all 24 rows.
cues.zh: 先别看索引。这里有二十四条记录，每四行放在一张堆页里。我们要找键值六十三。看，记录按照插入顺序存放，键值没有排好队。即使中途找到目标，也不能就此停下，因为后面可能还有同键的行。把六张页翻完，才知道结果没有遗漏。
cues.en: Leave the index aside for a moment. These twenty-four records occupy six heap pages, in insertion order. We want key sixty-three. Watch the keys jump around as the scan advances. Finding a match does not finish the job: another row could have the same key. Reading every page makes the result complete.

cues.title: 分隔键，是通往下一页的路标
cues.titleEn: Separators point to the next page
cues.caption: 分隔键决定下一页；键相同，再比较行号。
cues.captionEn: Separators choose the next page; row IDs break ties.
cues.zh: 现在打开索引的根页。它不装完整记录，只放分隔键和下一页的地址。每个分隔键，是右边子树的最小一项。这里先比较键值，相同再比较行号。查询从六十三、行号零开始；零比所有真实行号小，这样就不会越过同键的第一条记录。
cues.en: Open the root page now. It holds separators and child addresses, not full records. Each separator is the smallest entry in the subtree to its right. Compare the key first, then the row ID. Our search starts with sixty-three and row zero, which comes before every real row with that key.

cues.title: 沿着页号，找到同一条记录
cues.titleEn: Follow page IDs to the same record
cues.caption: 沿子页指针下降，再用行号取回完整记录。
cues.captionEn: Follow child pointers, then fetch the record by row ID.
cues.zh: 让这个查询继续往下走。每一次比较，都决定下一张要翻开的页。到叶页以后，按照顺序检查索引项；需要时，沿链接走到下一张叶页。六十三找到了，旁边的行号是十四。用它回到第四张堆页，取出完整内容。索引没有把原记录搬走，只是给了它一条可查找的路。
cues.en: Let the search continue downward. Each comparison chooses the next page to open. At a leaf, inspect the entries in order, following its neighbor link when necessary. There is sixty-three, paired with row fourteen. That pointer leads back to heap page four for the payload. The original record has stayed in place.

cues.title: 少翻了几页，账要算完整
cues.titleEn: Count every page on both routes
cues.caption: 同一结果：全扫 6 页，索引 4 页加堆页 1 页。
cues.captionEn: Same result: scan 6 pages, or read 4 index pages plus 1 heap page.
cues.zh: 两条路都返回第十四行，现在把账放在一起。全扫用了六张堆页，索引用了四张索引页，再加一张堆页，总共五张。比较次数也来自刚才的实际步骤。我们只数一次查询触及的不同页，读过的页保留在缓存里。这不是秒表，更不能把这个差额当成数据库的加速倍数。
cues.en: Both routes return row fourteen. Now count all their pages: six heap pages for the scan; four index pages plus one heap page for the lookup. Comparisons come from the recorded steps too. A query retains pages already read. These are distinct-page counts, not a stopwatch or a prediction of production speed.

cues.title: 范围查询，顺着叶页接着走
cues.titleEn: Continue a range along the leaves
cues.caption: 沿叶页查找 38–47；三个 42 各有独立行号。
cues.captionEn: Follow leaves for 38–47; all three 42s retain their row IDs.
cues.zh: 把条件展开成三十八到四十七。只需要先定位起点，接下来顺着叶页的链接读下去，不必每找一行就重新回根。留意三个四十二：它们是不同记录，行号六、七、八都要保留。碰到超过上界的键，才停止这段扫描。排序让一个区间变成一条连续可走的路线。
cues.en: Widen the predicate to thirty-eight through forty-seven. Locate the start, then continue along the linked leaves without returning to the root for each row. Notice the three forty-twos: rows six, seven, and eight are separate records. Keep them all. Stop only when a key passes the upper bound of the range.

cues.title: 叶页满了，把新邻居接进来
cues.titleEn: A full leaf gains a new neighbor
cues.caption: 第 4 项撑满叶页：分裂，并把右页最小项复制到父页。
cues.captionEn: A fourth entry splits the leaf; copy the right minimum to its parent.
cues.zh: 查找之外，还要照顾新记录。先加入几条数据，再看七十九落进已满的叶页。四项放不下，就分成两张各有两项的页，并把邻居链接接好。右页最小的一项复制到父页，配上新页地址。注意是复制：叶子里仍然保留那条记录的索引项。
cues.en: An index must handle new records too. After a few inserts, seventy-nine reaches a full leaf. Four entries exceed our three-entry capacity, so split them into two pages and repair the neighbor link. Copy the right page’s smallest entry into the parent beside its address. The actual entry remains in the leaf.

cues.title: 分裂向上传，直到长出新根
cues.titleEn: Splits climb until a new root grows
cues.caption: 分裂传到根时，所有叶子统一加深一层。
cues.captionEn: A root split adds one level to every leaf.
cues.zh: 继续插入，直到九十六进来。这一次，新子页把父页也挤满了。内部页同样分开，不过中间的分隔键是向上推，两侧不再保留它。分裂继续传到旧根，于是建立一个新根，把两边接起来。树从三层长到四层，所有叶子仍然处在同一深度，没有哪一条记录被丢下。
cues.en: Continue until ninety-six arrives. This time the new child pointer overflows its parent. Split that internal page, promoting the middle separator instead of keeping it on either side. The change reaches the old root, so create a new root above both halves. Every leaf moves from depth three to depth four together.

cues.title: 读得越多，索引越不占便宜
cues.titleEn: Reading more can erase the advantage
cues.caption: 读全部 37 行：索引触及 27 页，全扫只需 10 页。
cues.captionEn: Read all 37 rows: the index touches 27 pages; a scan needs 10.
cues.zh: 最后，别再只挑一条记录了：把现在的三十七行全部取回来。全扫只要十张堆页，索引还要读自己的十七张页，总共二十七张。答案仍然相同，代价却倒过来了。索引占空间，写入时还要维护；它是否值得用，取决于要读多少、数据怎样存放，以及真实系统的缓存和查询计划。
cues.en: Finally, ask for all thirty-seven records. The table scan touches ten heap pages. The index route touches those ten plus seventeen index pages: twenty-seven altogether. The answer is identical, but the page advantage has reversed. Indexes occupy space and need maintenance. Their value depends on the query, storage layout, caching, and the chosen plan.

cues.title: 只盯住这一颗
cues.caption: 没有整体水流，微球仍留下不规则轨迹。
cues.captionEn: Even without mean flow, the sphere wanders.
cues.zh: 先只盯住这颗金色微球。它没有朝某个方向匀速前进，也不是活物在游动。流体的平均速度是零，周围分子的热运动却没有停止。细线记下它经过的观测位置：下一段往哪儿拐，不能靠上一段直线外推。
cues.en: Keep your eye on the gold sphere. It is neither swimming nor riding a steady current. The fluid has no mean flow, but its molecules are still moving thermally. The thin line records observed positions. Extending the last little segment does not tell us where the next one will go.

cues.title: 把时间放到纳秒
cues.caption: 热浴与阻力的冲量，共同改变微球动量。
cues.captionEn: Bath and drag impulses change the sphere’s momentum.
cues.zh: 现在切到一次纳秒尺度的观测，只放大质心的位置。金色条是这段时间里热浴给出的冲量，蓝色条是阻力的冲量。把两条带符号的量相加，就得到动量的变化。这不是逐个分子碰撞的录像，而是很多碰撞合成后的随机模型。
cues.en: Now switch to a nanosecond observation, magnifying only the centroid. Gold shows the bath’s impulse over one window; blue shows the drag impulse. Add them with their signs to get the momentum change. These are collective random effects, not a movie of individually resolved molecular collisions.

cues.title: 惯性会被忘记
cues.caption: 关闭热噪声，已有速度按时间常数 τ 衰减。
cues.captionEn: With thermal noise off, velocity decays on the timescale τ.
cues.zh: 做一个只属于模型的对照：关掉热噪声，保留刚才的初速度。粒子不会立刻停住，阻力让它慢慢失去速度，曲线按指数落下。这里的时间常数只有大约五十八纳秒。零开尔文只是经典极限，不是在说真实液体可以这样冷却。
cues.en: Try a mathematical control: switch off thermal noise but retain the initial velocity. The particle does not stop instantly. Drag gradually erases its motion along this exponential curve. The relaxation time here is about fifty-eight nanoseconds. Zero kelvin is a classical limit, not a claim about cooling a real liquid.

cues.title: 拉回秒尺度
cues.caption: 远大于 τ 时，同一热浴的两种轨迹几乎重合。
cues.captionEn: Far beyond τ, both descriptions nearly coincide for the same bath.
cues.zh: 再回到秒尺度。金线保留惯性，蓝色虚线省去了惯性，却由同一个热浴驱动。现在它们几乎贴在一起；下方仍算出了纳米级的端点差。过阻尼近似适合这种长时间观测，不表示粒子在任意短的时间里都没有惯性。
cues.en: Return to seconds. Gold retains inertia; the blue dashed path uses an overdamped description driven by the same bath. They nearly overlap, although the readout still resolves their nanometer separation. This approximation works at long observation times. It does not mean inertia disappears at every possible time scale.

cues.title: 只改变热浴温度
cues.caption: 固定黏度与半径：升温使扩散系数 D 增大。
cues.captionEn: At fixed viscosity and radius, higher temperature increases D.
cues.zh: 把黏度和粒子半径固定，比较三百与四百五十开尔文。两次计算使用匹配的随机输入，较热的一条展开得更远。看扩散系数，温度增到一点五倍，D 也增到一点五倍；典型位移按平方根改变，不会直接变成一点五倍。
cues.en: Hold viscosity and radius fixed, and compare three hundred with four hundred fifty kelvin. Matched random inputs make the scale change visible. The warmer path spreads farther. A fifty-percent temperature increase gives a fifty-percent increase in D. Typical displacement follows a square root, so it does not increase by the same factor.

cues.title: 阻力改变游走尺度
cues.caption: 黏度乘三，D 除三；半径乘二，D 减半。
cues.captionEn: Triple viscosity: D divides by three. Double radius: D halves.
cues.zh: 这次温度不变。蓝色样本的黏度变成三倍，紫色样本的球半径变成两倍。它们受到的黏滞阻力都更大，扩散系数都下降。注意，大球还更重，惯性时间也变了。表里的 D 管长时间的展开，并不能独自说明每一次短时转弯。
cues.en: Keep temperature fixed. The blue trial has three times the viscosity; the purple sphere has twice the radius. Both changes increase viscous drag and reduce D. The larger sphere is also heavier, so its inertial timescale changes. D describes long-time spreading, not every turn in one short stretch of a path.

cues.title: 把重复实验叠起来
cues.caption: 单次位移平方会起落；多次平均接近理论均方位移。
cues.captionEn: One squared displacement fluctuates; trial averages approach the MSD.
cues.zh: 现在把六十四次独立实验放回同一个起点。金色仍是最初那条，其他样本各走各的。下面先看金线，它到原点的距离可以变大，也可以变小。再看平均后的蓝线，有限样本仍会波动，却开始显出理论的增长尺度：这里看两个坐标，长时间是四 D t。
cues.en: Repeat the experiment sixty-four times from the same origin. Gold still identifies our original path; the others wander independently. Its squared distance can rise or fall. The blue average still fluctuates with a finite sample, but reveals the theoretical growth scale. For two observed coordinates, the long-time result is four D t.

cues.title: 平均位置不是一条命运
cues.titleEn: The mean is not a particle
cues.caption: 平均位置接近起点，典型离开距离却持续增大。
cues.captionEn: The mean stays near the start while typical displacement grows.
cues.zh: 最后看深色菱形，它是这些位置的平均，不是一颗新粒子。大家向不同方向走，平均位置仍可能靠近起点；均方根位移却明显更大。这就是随机运动里可靠的部分：我们能预测许多次实验的尺度，不能把平均位置当作这一颗粒子的下一站。
cues.en: Watch the dark diamond. It is the average position, not another particle. Wandering in different directions can leave that average near the origin while the root-mean-square displacement grows much larger. This is what the statistical prediction gives us: a scale across repeated trials, not the next destination of this particular sphere.

cues.title: 从浓到淡
cues.titleEn: From a peak to a spread
cues.caption: 峰变矮、两侧变宽；封闭带中的总量不变。
cues.captionEn: The peak spreads; the sealed strip’s total stays constant.
cues.zh: 先看中间这段深色。它表示标记物比较集中，不是一团正在流动的水。随着时间推进，浓度曲线变矮、变宽，两端仍然封闭。再看总量，数字没有减少。扩散改变的是物质分布，峰值降低并不等于物质消失。
cues.en: Look at the dark patch in the middle. It marks a high concentration, not a moving lump of water. As time advances, the curve becomes lower and wider, while both ends remain sealed. Now check the total: it has not fallen. Diffusion changes the distribution, without removing the material.

cues.title: 坡度决定净通量
cues.caption: 同一截面：浓度坡度越缓，净通量越小。
cues.captionEn: At a fixed section, a gentler slope means less net flux.
cues.zh: 把这条亮线固定在峰的右边。沿着向右的方向，浓度在下降，所以净通量指向右。下面的短线标出局部坡度，它逐渐变平，通量读数也降低。箭头不是水流速度，更不是每个分子的路线；它表示这个截面上统计意义的净输运。
cues.en: Keep the bright section to the right of the peak. Concentration decreases toward the right, so net flux points right. The short tangent underneath shows the local slope. As it flattens, the flux reading falls too. This arrow is neither fluid velocity nor a molecule’s route; it represents net transport across the section.

cues.title: 一小段的收支
cues.caption: 局部先积累、再流出；封闭带的总量始终守恒。
cues.captionEn: A region gains, then loses material; the sealed total is conserved.
cues.zh: 现在只圈住右边这一小段。左边进入的通量减去右边离开的通量，就是它的净增加率。留意符号：开始是正，后来转成负，这一段可以先变多、再变少。守恒不要求每个小格都不变化，而是要求所有进出能够对上账。
cues.en: Focus on the highlighted region on the right. Subtract the flux leaving its right edge from the flux entering its left edge. That gives its accumulation rate. Watch the sign change from positive to negative. A region can gain and then lose material; conservation requires the full transport budget to balance.

cues.title: 边界让宽度停下
cues.caption: 方差起初近似线性增长，随后受封闭边界限制。
cues.captionEn: Variance first grows almost linearly, then meets the boundary limit.
cues.zh: 换一把尺子，观察分布的方差。最初，它增加得接近两倍扩散系数乘时间；但这条带不是无限长。随着两端的浓度上升，增长逐渐变慢，最后接近均匀分布的极限。曲线变平，不表示分子停下，只表示宏观浓度不再明显起伏。
cues.en: Use a different measure now: the variance of the distribution. Its early increase is close to twice diffusivity times time. But this strip is finite. As concentration builds near the ends, growth slows toward the uniform-distribution limit. A flat profile does not mean molecules stop; it means the macroscopic concentration has become even.

cues.title: 改变扩散系数
cues.caption: 相同初态：D 加倍，等效于基准组的两倍模型时间。
cues.captionEn: Same initial state: double D equals twice the baseline model time.
cues.zh: 让两条同样的浓度带一起开始，质量、长度和初态完全相同，只把第二条的扩散系数加倍。对照两条曲线，较大的扩散系数让分布更快变平。下面的无量纲时间也正好加倍。这是方程里的时间尺度改变，不是把动画随意调快。
cues.en: Start two identical concentration strips together. Keep their amount, length and initial profile the same, and double only the second diffusivity. Its curve becomes flatter sooner. The dimensionless time beneath it is also doubled. This is the equation’s time scaling, rather than an arbitrary playback-speed adjustment.

cues.title: 长度的平方
cues.caption: 初态同比放大：长度加倍，同等相对平滑需四倍时间。
cues.captionEn: Scale the initial shape: double length takes four times as long to smooth.
cues.zh: 这次保留相同的扩散系数，把第二条带拉长到两倍。每条的总量仍为一，所以较长带一开始就更浅，不能只比峰高。初态按长度同比放大以后，达到同样的相对平滑程度，需要四倍时间。扩散的特征时间跟长度的平方一起增长。
cues.en: Keep diffusivity fixed and make the second strip twice as long. Each still contains amount one, so the longer strip starts at lower concentration: peak height alone is not a fair comparison. With geometrically scaled initial shapes, equal relative smoothing takes four times as long. The diffusion time scale grows with length squared.

cues.title: 混合而不消失
cues.caption: A、B 逐渐重叠；各自总量与总浓度都不变。
cues.captionEn: A and B overlap; each amount and their total concentration stay fixed.
cues.zh: 换成两种不反应的标记，蓝色偏左，暖色偏右。它们有相同的扩散系数，分别沿自己的浓度梯度扩散。两条曲线靠近，颜色渐渐混合，但下面的两个总量都保持为一。这里没有化学反应，也没有谁被擦除；变化的是每个位置上两种标记的比例。
cues.en: Now use two nonreacting labels, with blue concentrated toward the left and amber toward the right. They share a diffusivity, and each diffuses along its own concentration gradient. Their curves approach and the colors blend, but both amounts remain one. Neither label disappears; their proportions at each position change.

cues.title: 有通量的稳态
cues.caption: 储库维持浓度差：曲线逐渐稳定，净通量仍存在。
cues.captionEn: Reservoirs maintain the gradient: the profile approaches steady state while flux continues.
cues.zh: 最后换一个边界实验。左端浓度固定为一，右端固定为零，初态也重新指定。两端储库可以交换物质，带内总量的变化必须记入边界账本。看最后逐渐接近直线的浓度曲线：分布趋于稳定，净输运仍然存在。稳态不是零通量，静止介质也不等于没有扩散。
cues.en: Finish with a different boundary experiment and a new initial profile. Hold the left concentration at one and the right at zero. Reservoirs can exchange material, so changes inside belong in the boundary budget. The profile approaches a steady straight line, yet flux continues through both ends. Steady state does not require zero transport.

cues.title: 分组只选择下一跳
cues.titleEn: Each router chooses a next hop
cues.caption: 目的地始终是 R；每台路由器只选择下一跳。
cues.captionEn: Destination R stays fixed; each router chooses only the next hop.
cues.zh: 跟住这个一号分组。它的目的地一直是接收端 R，但不会一次决定整段旅程。到达路由器后，先收齐，再查本地路由表，选出下一跳。下方的时间条把处理、发送和传播分开，每一段等待都有来处。
cues.en: Follow packet one. Its destination stays R throughout the journey, but each router makes its own next-hop decision. The router receives the complete packet, checks its local table, then sends it onward. The strip below separates processing, transmission and propagation, so the journey time comes from specific operations rather than an animation speed.

cues.title: 最短的是路由代价
cues.caption: 仅改变 B–R 代价，收敛后的最短路径随之改变。
cues.captionEn: Change only B–R cost: the converged least-cost path changes.
cues.zh: 这次看连线旁的数字。最短路径加的是路由代价，不是屏幕上的线段长度。先经 B，再比较另一套已经收敛的网络：只把 B 到 R 的代价调高，路由就改经 C。代价是配置条件，不会自动跟着眼前的队列变化。
cues.en: Look at the numbers beside the links. Shortest path means the lowest sum of routing costs, not the shortest line on the screen. Compare two already-converged networks. Raising only the B-to-R cost sends the packet through C instead. These configured costs do not automatically change whenever a packet joins a queue.

cues.title: 先排队，再逐位发送
cues.caption: 一个出口依次发送分组，后来者先排队。
cues.captionEn: An output sends one packet at a time; later arrivals queue.
cues.zh: 一批分组很快来到同一个出口。出口还在发送前一个，三号只能排队。注意，队列等待和把字节送上链路，是两段不同的时间。这里每个分组一千二百字节，出口每秒四十万比特，光是发送就需要二十四毫秒。
cues.en: A burst reaches the same output faster than it can transmit. Packet three has to wait while earlier packets are sent. Queueing and serialization are different delays. Each packet here contains twelve hundred bytes, and this output carries four hundred thousand bits per second. Serialization alone takes twenty-four milliseconds, before propagation is added.

cues.title: TTL 限制转发次数
cues.caption: 转发前 TTL 减一；减到零，分组就被丢弃。
cues.captionEn: TTL drops before forwarding; at zero, the packet is discarded.
cues.zh: 把初始生存时间设得很小，再跟一次这个分组。它在源端带着二，到第一个路由器变成一，第二个再减就到了零。即使目的地只剩一跳，也不能继续转发。这个逐跳限制能阻止分组在错误的路由环里一直兜圈。
cues.en: Give this packet a deliberately small TTL. It leaves the source with two. The first router reduces it to one; the second reduces it to zero and discards it, even though the destination is only one link away. This hop-by-hop bound prevents a packet from circulating indefinitely in a routing loop.

cues.title: 故障先被邻居发现
cues.titleEn: A neighbor notices the failure first
cues.caption: B–R 中断，P1 丢失；远处路由器还不知道。
cues.captionEn: B–R fails and P1 is lost; remote routers do not know yet.
cues.zh: 看 B 通向接收端的链路。一号还在路上传播，链路突然中断，它就在这里丢失了。B 先知道故障，随后发出紫色的拓扑更新。其他节点必须等消息到达并处理完，不能在故障瞬间就拥有同一张新地图。
cues.en: Watch the link from B to the receiver. Packet one is still propagating when that link fails, so it is lost there. B notices first and sends the violet topology update. The other routers must receive and process that message. They cannot all acquire the new network map at the instant of failure.

cues.title: 更新传播后，路由才收敛
cues.caption: B 已改道，C 仍用旧表；更新传完前可能绕圈。
cues.captionEn: B updates before C; a temporary loop lasts until convergence.
cues.zh: 现在跟二号，并对照三张路由表。B 已经改道，C 却还按旧消息送回去，于是出现短暂绕圈。等更新安装完成，C 终于直接发往接收端。表格里的版本号和下一跳并非一起跳变，收敛就是这个逐处完成的过程。
cues.en: Follow packet two and compare the three local tables. B has changed its route, but C still sends the packet back using old information. That creates a temporary loop. Once C installs the update, it can forward directly to R. The different version numbers expose how convergence happens at different routers at different times.

cues.title: 队列满了，分组会被丢弃
cues.titleEn: A full queue drops arriving packets
cues.caption: 同样十个分组：加等待位可减少丢弃，出口速率不变。
cues.captionEn: Same ten packets: more queue slots reduce drops but do not speed up output.
cues.zh: 再发送完全相同的十个分组。先给出口两个等待位，位置满了，后来的分组就被丢弃，编号仍留在记录里。接着只增加等待位。五号这次能留下，却要等前面的分组发送完。缓存可以容纳更多等待，不能凭空增加链路速率。
cues.en: Send exactly the same ten packets at exactly the same times. With two waiting slots, a full queue discards later arrivals and keeps their IDs in the loss record. Now increase only the buffer. Packet five survives, but waits behind earlier packets. More storage accommodates waiting; it does not create extra link capacity.

cues.title: 先到达，不一定先交付
cues.titleEn: Arrival order is not delivery order
cues.caption: 后发的 P4 先到；顺序交付仍要等待缺失分组。
cues.captionEn: P4 arrives ahead of earlier packets; ordered delivery waits for the gap.
cues.zh: 最后看恢复链路的情况。前几个分组已经走上较慢的路径，后来的四号却用新路抢先到达。上排记录实际到达顺序，下排是一个按序交付的应用示例。它先暂存四号，等前面的缺口补齐。本片没有替你假装完成重传或整套 TCP。
cues.en: Earlier packets are already on the slow route when the faster link returns. Packet four takes that new route and arrives first. The upper row records arrival order. Below it, an example application holds later sequence numbers until gaps are filled. This illustrates ordered delivery; it does not simulate retransmission or a complete TCP connection.

cues.title: 拉头经过，齿留在身后
cues.titleEn: A moving slider, a lasting join
cues.caption: 拉头改变相遇路径，齿留在连续织带上。
cues.captionEn: The slider changes the meeting path; the teeth stay attached to their tapes.
cues.zh: 看拉头往上走。上面还是两排分开的齿，下面已经连成一条链。它没有留下胶水，也没有把齿挪到另一条带上。我们选的是注塑蘑菇头齿，两边错开半个齿距。接下来盯住绿色的左侧第七齿，看看拉头怎样改变它与邻齿相遇的方向。
cues.en: Watch the slider move upward. Two separate rows enter above it; a joined chain remains below. No glue is left behind, and no tooth changes tapes. This is a moulded mushroom-head design, with the two rows offset by half a pitch. Follow the green tooth, L seven: its route will explain how the join is made.

cues.title: 宽齿头里藏着一道齿窝
cues.titleEn: A recess inside the broad head
cues.caption: 剖去 L7 的上唇，看对侧薄翼进入齿窝。
cues.captionEn: Cut away L7’s upper lip to see the opposite wing inside its recess.
cues.zh: 先停在这颗绿色齿旁边。宽宽的头后面是一段细颈，齿根包着织带边缘的珠边。现在剖开齿头的上唇：中间不是实心，里面留着齿窝，对侧齿颈的薄翼伸了进来。上、下两层齿唇围住薄翼，同时保留间隙；这不是两块平面图案简单叠在一起。
cues.en: Pause beside the green tooth. Behind its broad head is a narrow neck, and its root wraps around the tape bead. Cut away the upper lip: the head has a recess through its middle. A thin wing from the opposite neck enters that space. Upper and lower lips surround it with clearance, making this a three-dimensional connection.

cues.title: Y 形通道让两条带转弯
cues.titleEn: The Y guide turns the tapes
cues.caption: 外导边与中心楔限定两条连续的弯曲路径。
cues.captionEn: Outer flanges and a central diamond bound two continuous curved paths.
cues.zh: 把目光移到开窗的拉头。两侧导边与中间的楔体，围出一个字母 Y。两条带进入宽口，沿着各自的弯道靠近。注意齿根和珠边一起转，齿头不是横着硬挤过去。上、下翼板限制厚度方向，侧边留下织带出口，拉片则通过横销连接在拉头上。
cues.en: Look through the window in the slider. The outer flanges and central diamond form a Y-shaped passage. Each tape follows its own bend from the wide mouth toward the joined channel. Tooth roots turn with their beads; the heads are not forced straight through each other. Upper and lower plates bound the thickness, while side slots let the tapes pass.

cues.title: 跟着 L7 走进咬合
cues.caption: 半齿距错位与转弯配合，让宽头进入邻齿之间。
cues.captionEn: Half-pitch staggering and rotation let the broad head enter between its neighbours.
cues.zh: 现在只跟着左侧第七齿走。它从分开的支路进入，逐渐转正，宽齿头来到对侧两颗齿之间。两排预先错开的半个齿距，在这里给出了位置。继续往下看，细颈旁的薄翼进入齿窝，齿肩来到相互挡住的位置。整段过程中，这始终是同一颗齿，根也始终连着原来的带。
cues.en: Stay with L seven. It enters along the separated branch, turns toward the centre, and places its broad head between two opposite teeth. The half-pitch offset provides the required spacing. As the route straightens, thin wings enter the head recesses and the shoulders reach their retaining positions. Nothing is replaced: this tooth remains attached to the same bead throughout.

cues.title: 横着拉，为什么分不开
cues.titleEn: Why a sideways pull is resisted
cues.caption: 在对称刚体假设下，两处肩面各承担 F/2。
cues.captionEn: Under the symmetric rigid-body assumption, each shoulder carries F/2.
cues.zh: 把拉头先放在一边，只看已经咬合的三颗齿。向左拉绿色齿，它的宽肩会抵住对侧两颗齿肩。图中假设左右方向受力、上下两处接触完全对称，所以每处反力是总载荷的一半。箭头变长，齿却不假装伸长；这是解释阻挡方向的刚体模型，不是拉链承重的数值预报。
cues.en: Set the slider aside and inspect three engaged teeth. A sideways pull on the green tooth presses its broad shoulders against two opposite shoulders. In this deliberately symmetric, rigid-body example, each contact carries half the applied load. The arrows grow, but the teeth do not stretch. This explains a blocked direction; it does not predict a real zipper’s strength.

cues.title: 倒着走，同一颗齿退出
cues.titleEn: The same tooth follows the reverse route
cues.caption: 拉头改变退出方向，让相互阻挡的肩面逐步分离。
cues.captionEn: The slider changes the exit direction so the retaining shoulders can separate.
cues.zh: 再把拉头沿反方向拉回。绿色齿没有突然松掉，而是沿刚才那条路倒着走。导道让珠边转弯，齿肩的相对方向随之改变；薄翼退出齿窝，两排齿逐渐分开。横着直接拉，被肩面挡住；沿拉头安排的转弯路径走，却有退路。区别就在这里。
cues.en: Now move the slider back. The green tooth does not suddenly release; it follows the same route in reverse. The guide turns the bead, changing the relative orientation of the shoulders. Wings leave their recesses and the rows separate. A direct sideways pull meets a shoulder, whereas the turning route arranged by the slider provides a way out.

cues.title: 上下止限定这段旅程
cues.caption: 上止挡住拉头；下止连接两条带并限制下行。
cues.captionEn: Top stops block the slider; the bottom stop joins the tapes and limits downward travel.
cues.zh: 拉到最上面，先碰到的是两侧上止，拉头不能继续越过它们。再向下走，闭尾拉链的下止连接着两条带，也接住拉头。这些不是装饰：演示的行程就由实际接触位置限定。留意顶部仍有齿在导道里。另外，我们选的是非锁定拉头，齿的咬合不能代替拉头自锁。
cues.en: At the upper end, two top stops prevent the slider from leaving the tapes. At the lower end, a bridge joins both tapes and catches the slider. These parts set the model’s actual travel limits. Some upper teeth remain inside the guide. One distinction matters: this is a non-locking slider; engaged teeth do not themselves lock the slider’s position.

cues.title: 去掉宽肩，结果就变了
cues.titleEn: Remove the shoulder, change the result
cues.caption: 相同横移尝试下，宽肩保留阻挡；削肩假想齿可退出。
cues.captionEn: With the same attempted shift, broad shoulders retain; hypothetical narrow heads can withdraw.
cues.zh: 最后做一个只改齿形的对照。第一组保留宽肩，第二组把宽肩削窄，两个画面尝试相同的横向位移。有肩的齿留在原位，没有肩的假想齿能够退出。这个对照不是新产品设计，也不比较强度。它把拉链的两个工作分开了：齿形负责留住，拉头安排进入和退出的路径。
cues.en: For the last comparison, change only the broad shoulders. Keep them in the first specimen and narrow them in the hypothetical second one. Apply the same attempted sideways shift. The shouldered teeth stay put; the narrow heads can withdraw. This is a geometry experiment, not a strength test. Tooth shape retains the join; the slider arranges entry and exit.

cues.title: 都在落向月球
cues.caption: 近侧、地心、远侧都向月球加速，但加速度不一样。
cues.captionEn: Near side, center and far side all accelerate toward the Moon, by different amounts.
cues.zh: 先看三个位置受到的月球引力。近侧比地心强一点，远侧比地心弱一点，但方向都大致朝向月球。金色观测点从近侧走向远侧，当地的加速度也跟着改变。地心不是钉在原地的支点；理解潮汐，要比较这些加速度之间的差，而不是只看一个向月球的箭头。
cues.en: Look at the accelerations across Earth. The near side is pulled a little more strongly than the center; the far side a little less. All still accelerate toward the Moon. As the gold point crosses the globe, its acceleration changes. Earth’s center is not fixed in place. That small difference is what matters.

cues.title: 跟地心一起下落
cues.caption: 减去地心加速度后，近侧相对向月，远侧相对背月；两边都远离地心。
cues.captionEn: Subtract the center acceleration: the near and far sides both stretch away from the center.
cues.zh: 现在跟地心一起自由下落。在每一个位置，都减去同一份地心加速度。远侧受月球牵引较弱，剩下的相对加速度背向月球；近侧受牵引较强，剩下的相对加速度朝向月球。注意两端都在相对远离地心，不需要再给远侧加上一只神秘的推手。
cues.en: Now fall with Earth’s center. Subtract the same center acceleration at every location. The far-side remainder points away from the Moon because the lunar pull there is weaker. On the near side, the remainder points toward the Moon. Both ends stretch away from the center. No separate far-side push is needed.

cues.title: 海面跟随同一个势
cues.caption: 形变逐渐放大：同一潮汐势让理想海面在近、远两端隆起。
cues.captionEn: Magnify the deformation: one tidal potential raises the ideal surface on both sides.
cues.zh: 想象一颗刚性的球形地球，表面全是能够立即达到平衡的海洋。同一个潮汐势，决定这张理想海面的高度。现在慢慢放大微小的形变，近侧和远侧都隆起，横向的海面降低。这是形变比例尺在变化，不是海水流动的录像；高度曲线的米数仍是模型算出的高度。
cues.en: Imagine a rigid spherical Earth covered by an ocean that settles instantly. The same tidal potential sets its equilibrium surface. We gradually magnify the tiny height differences, not water motion. Both ends rise while the crosswise surface falls. The metre values remain the physical model results, even while the picture makes the deformation enormous.

cues.title: 距离的三次方
cues.caption: 潮汐的主导项随距离的三次方衰减，比整体引力更敏感。
cues.captionEn: The leading tidal term falls with distance cubed, more steeply than bulk attraction.
cues.zh: 在受控比较中，让月球靠近一些。整体引力随距离的平方变化，主导潮汐项却随距离的三次方变化，所以实线比虚线上升更快。地球的大小没有改变，改变的是引力跨越这个大小时的差异。这里的距离滑块是思想实验，不是月球真实运行日期的进度条。
cues.en: Bring the Moon closer in this controlled comparison. Bulk attraction grows with inverse distance squared, but the leading tidal term grows with inverse distance cubed. The solid curve rises faster than the dashed one. Earth’s size stays fixed; gravity varies more across it. This is a thought experiment, not an orbital calendar.

cues.title: 把太阳项加进来
cues.caption: 太阳也贡献潮汐项；日月同向时，两者的形变增强。
cues.captionEn: The Sun also contributes. Aligned lunar and solar tides reinforce the deformation.
cues.zh: 先保留月球，再逐渐把太阳的潮汐项加进来。太阳对地球的整体引力很强，却因为距离遥远，跨越地球的引力差没有那么大。在这组参考距离下，太阳的主导潮汐强度约为月球的零点四六倍。两者同向时，平衡海面的形变叠加，潮差也随之增大。
cues.en: Keep the Moon’s contribution, then gradually add the Sun’s. The Sun exerts strong bulk attraction, but its enormous distance limits the variation across Earth. At these reference distances, its leading tidal strength is about forty-six percent of the Moon’s. When their directions align, the equilibrium deformations reinforce each other and the range grows.

cues.title: 大潮与小潮
cues.caption: 日月成直线时，赤道平衡潮差较大；成直角时较小。
cues.captionEn: Alignment gives a larger equatorial equilibrium range; a right angle gives a smaller one.
cues.zh: 接下来转动太阳方向，保持两项的强度不变。日月形成直角时，赤道上的平衡潮差缩小，对应小潮的理想情形。继续转到另一端，三者重新排成直线，潮差又增大。月球与太阳在同一侧或相对两侧，都能增强大潮；不能只用两根整体引力箭头相加来判断。
cues.en: Turn the Sun’s direction while keeping both strengths fixed. At a right angle, the equatorial equilibrium range shrinks: the ideal neap-tide case. Continue to the opposite alignment and the range grows again. Both same-side and opposite-side alignments reinforce spring tides. Adding two bulk-gravity arrows alone would miss what the tidal field is doing.

cues.title: 让观测点转过一圈
cues.caption: 在固定月球方向的平衡模型里，赤道观测点转过一圈，经过两个高度峰值。
cues.captionEn: With the Moon fixed, an equatorial site crosses two ideal height peaks per relative turn.
cues.zh: 把月球方向固定，让赤道上的一个观测位置转过一圈。金色标记会依次经过这张理想海面的两个高处，曲线记录的也是同一个位置的计算高度。这里追踪的是地球上的位置，不是一团绕圈跑的海水。横轴用相对转角表示，不能把它直接读成某个港口的潮汐时刻。
cues.en: Hold the Moon’s direction fixed and turn a marked site around the equator. It crosses two high parts of this equilibrium surface. The plotted height comes from that same site calculation. The marker follows a location on Earth, not a parcel of water. Our horizontal axis is an angle, not a local tide timetable.

cues.title: 峰值没有统一答案
cues.caption: 纬度可以让理想峰值不等高，甚至只剩一个；真实海岸还取决于海盆动力学。
cues.captionEn: Latitude can make the ideal peaks unequal or remove one. Real coasts also depend on basin dynamics.
cues.zh: 换到四十五度纬圈，再让月球偏离赤道，两次理想高值开始不一样。随后把观测点移向更高纬度，这个例子最后只剩一个峰值。真实海洋还受到海盆形状、自转、摩擦与共振影响。所以，一天两次高潮并不是所有海岸的统一规则，这张平衡图也不能给出当地的潮高预报。
cues.en: Start at forty-five degrees latitude and move the Moon north of the equator. The two ideal peaks become unequal. Now move the observer farther north: this example ends with one peak. Real oceans also involve basin shape, rotation, friction and resonance. Neither these heights nor two daily high tides are universal coastal rules.

cues.title: 一斗土，三支油缸
cues.caption: 钢臂没有变长，变长的是油缸。
cues.captionEn: The steel arms never change length; the cylinders do.
cues.zh: 看这台挖掘机挖起一斗土：铲斗先收拢，斗杆往回收，动臂再把整条臂抬起来。注意，每一段黄色的钢臂长度都没有变，真正在伸长和缩短的，是连在关节之间的三支油缸。一支油缸伸出去，一个关节就转过去。力，就是从这几根缸里进来的。
cues.en: Watch the excavator take a bucket of earth: the bucket curls, the stick draws in, and the boom lifts the whole arm. Notice that none of the yellow steel members changes length. What extends and retracts are the three cylinders bridging the joints. One cylinder pushes out, one joint turns. This is where the force comes in.

cues.title: 切开动臂缸
cues.caption: 油进入无杆腔，推动活塞，活塞杆顶起动臂。
cues.captionEn: Oil fills the cap end, pushes the piston, and the rod lifts the boom.
cues.zh: 我们把一支动臂缸沿轴线剖开。里面是一根活塞杆，杆的末端是活塞，活塞把缸筒隔成两个腔：靠底部的无杆腔，和套着杆的有杆腔。泵把油送进无杆腔，油越积越多，活塞只能往外走，活塞杆就把动臂顶了起来。另一腔里的油同时被挤出去，沿回油管流回油箱。
cues.en: Let's cut one boom cylinder open along its axis. Inside is a rod, and at the end of the rod a piston that divides the barrel into two chambers: the cap end at the base, and the rod end around the rod. The pump sends oil into the cap end. As oil accumulates, the piston has nowhere to go but outward, and the rod lifts the boom. Oil in the other chamber is squeezed out and returns to the tank.

cues.title: 一条闭合的油路
cues.caption: 发动机带动泵送出流量，阀芯决定油去哪个腔。
cues.captionEn: The engine drives the pump; the spool decides where the oil goes.
cues.zh: 油从哪里来？发动机带动泵，把油箱里的油源源不断送出来；泵只负责流量。油经过主控制阀，阀芯决定它去哪一支缸的哪个腔。进无杆腔的油顶出活塞，有杆腔挤出的油再经阀回到油箱。油没有被消耗，只是在这条闭合油路里循环。
cues.en: Where does the oil come from? The engine drives a pump that draws oil from the tank and keeps sending it out; the pump only provides flow. The oil passes through the main control valve, where a spool decides which cylinder and which chamber it goes to. Oil entering the cap end pushes the piston out, and oil squeezed from the rod end returns through the valve to the tank. Nothing is used up; the oil circulates in one closed loop.

cues.title: 压力由载荷决定
cues.caption: 连通的油液压力处处相等；面积大三十六倍，推力大三十六倍。
cues.captionEn: One pressure everywhere; 36 times the area, 36 times the force.
cues.zh: 轻轻拉杆，油缸和泵连通了。看压力表：斗里三百公斤时六点五兆帕，加到一千八百公斤，升到九点五。压力不是泵定的，是载荷定的。帕斯卡原理说，连通的油液里压力处处相等：泵里直径两厘米的小活塞和动臂缸直径十二厘米的大活塞，顶着同样的压力，面积大三十六倍，推力也大三十六倍。这就是液压以小博大的道理。
cues.en: Pull the lever a little and the cylinder is connected to the pump. Watch the gauge: three hundred kilograms in the bucket reads six and a half megapascals; add earth up to eighteen hundred and it climbs to nine and a half. The pump doesn't set the pressure; the load does. Pascal's principle says the connected oil carries one pressure everywhere. A pump piston two centimetres across and the boom piston twelve centimetres across feel the same pressure, and thirty-six times the area means thirty-six times the force. That is how hydraulics turns a small push into a large one.

cues.title: 推杆多少，走多快
cues.caption: 手柄推阀芯，阀口开多少，进多少油。
cues.captionEn: The lever moves the spool; the opening meters the flow.
cues.zh: 手柄并不直接连着油缸，它推的是阀芯。杆拉得少，阀口开得小，进油少：每分钟四十升，活塞每秒走三厘米，动臂慢慢抬。杆拉到底，阀口全开，一百升，七厘米多，动臂明显快了。面积和压力都几乎没变，变的只是每秒进来多少油。右手杆管动臂和铲斗，左手杆管斗杆和回转。
cues.en: The lever isn't linked to the cylinder; it moves the spool. Pull a little and the port opens a little, so little oil gets through: forty litres a minute, the piston creeps at three centimetres a second, the boom rises slowly. Pull all the way and the port is wide open: a hundred litres, over seven centimetres a second, and the boom is clearly quicker. Area and pressure barely change; what changes is how much oil arrives each second. The right lever runs the boom and bucket, the left lever the stick and swing.

cues.title: 同一斗土，不同的姿态
cues.caption: 同样的载荷，力矩和力臂都随姿态改变。
cues.captionEn: The same load, but moment and lever arm change with pose.
cues.zh: 换到侧面看。油缸的推力沿着它自己的轴线，而动臂绕着支点转。从支点到这条作用线的垂直距离，就是力臂 d。动臂抬升时，斗里的土离支点的水平距离变短，重力矩变小；同时这条橙色的力臂也在变短。两者一起决定所需压力：动臂低时八点六兆帕，抬到最高七点八。设计师要做的，就是在整个动作范围里，把力臂安排得够用。
cues.en: Switch to the side. A cylinder pushes along its own axis, while the boom turns about its foot pin. The perpendicular distance from that pin to the line of action is the lever arm, d. As the boom rises, the earth moves closer to the pivot, so the gravity moment shrinks, and the orange lever arm shortens too. Together they set the required pressure: eight point six megapascals with the boom low, seven point eight at the top. A designer's job is to keep that lever arm generous through the whole range.

cues.title: 铲斗的四连杆
cues.caption: 直线推力经摇臂和连杆，变成铲斗的收拢。
cues.captionEn: A straight push becomes bucket curl through the rocker and link.
cues.zh: 最后一段传动最巧。铲斗缸装在斗杆背上，它的活塞杆并不直接推铲斗，而是推在一个接点上：接点一头连着摇臂，摇臂铰在斗杆上；另一头连着连杆，连杆铰在铲斗的耳板上。四个铰点组成一个四连杆。看，活塞杆伸出，接点被推向斗尖，连杆把铲斗耳板往前顶，铲斗就绕着铲斗销卷了进来。杆走直线，斗齿走的是一段圆弧。
cues.en: The last link in the chain is the cleverest. The bucket cylinder sits on the back of the stick, and its rod doesn't push the bucket directly. It pushes a joint: on one side the rocker, pinned to the stick; on the other the link, pinned to the bucket's ears. Four pins make a four-bar linkage. Watch: as the rod extends, the joint is pushed toward the tip, the link drives the bucket ear forward, and the bucket curls in about its pin. The rod moves in a straight line; the teeth sweep an arc.

cues.title: 撬不动的石头
cues.caption: 压力到达限压，油从溢流阀回油箱，动臂不再上升。
cues.captionEn: At the relief setting, oil returns to tank and the boom stops rising.
cues.zh: 如果斗齿卡在一块搬不动的石头下面呢？操作手继续推举升，泵继续送油，可是活塞走不动，压力一路上升。到三十七点三兆帕，主溢流阀打开，多余的油从溢流阀直接回油箱：泵还在转，动臂却不会再往上。这是液压系统保护自己的方式。松开手柄，阀口关闭，油被封在缸里，压力回落到只承担自重，动臂就停在原地。
cues.en: What if the teeth are caught under a boulder that won't move? The operator keeps calling for lift, the pump keeps delivering, but the piston can't advance, so pressure climbs. At thirty-seven point three megapascals the main relief valve opens and the surplus oil goes straight back to the tank. The pump is still turning, but the boom will not rise. That is how a hydraulic system protects itself. Release the lever, the valve closes, the oil is trapped, pressure falls back to the weight alone, and the boom simply stays where it is.

cues.title: 多一道缝，反而更暗
cues.caption: 多开一道缝，有些地方却更暗。
cues.captionEn: Two open slits can make a dark fringe.
cues.zh: 先只开一道缝，屏幕上是一片宽亮带。现在打开第二道缝，中央更亮了，有些位置却变暗，甚至完全没有光。多开的通道为什么会让这里更暗？关键是，来自两道缝的电场要先相加，才能算出屏幕有多亮。
cues.en: With one slit open, a broad band lights the screen. Open the second and the centre brightens, yet some places become dark. How can another opening deliver less light to those spots? The two electric fields must add first. Only then can we work out the brightness.

cues.title: 跟住屏幕上的一点
cues.caption: 光程差增加一个波长，相位再次重合。
cues.captionEn: One wavelength of path difference restores phase.
cues.zh: 跟住屏幕上的这个点。正对中央时，两路一样长，电场同相。把它移开，两路开始出现光程差。差半个波长时，一路为正，另一路恰好为负，合起来变成零。再移到相差一个波长，两路重新同相，这里又亮了。
cues.en: Follow this point on the screen. At the centre, the paths are equal and the fields agree in phase. Move away: half a wavelength of extra path makes them opposites, cancelling to zero. At one full wavelength of difference they agree again, and this point becomes bright once more.

cues.title: 先加电场，再算亮度
cues.caption: 先叠加电场，再计算光强。
cues.captionEn: Add the fields before finding intensity.
cues.zh: 用两支箭头记下这两路电场的振幅和相位，再把它们首尾相接。同向时，合成箭头变长；反向时，合成箭头消失。屏幕亮度看的是合成电场平方的时间平均，不是两份亮度直接相加。这里的光振荡已经大幅放慢。
cues.en: These arrows represent the amplitude and phase of the two fields. Place them end to end: aligned arrows make a longer result, while opposite arrows cancel. Intensity comes from the time average of the total field squared. We have slowed the optical oscillation enormously so you can follow it.

cues.title: 两缝拉开，条纹变密
cues.caption: 两缝拉开，条纹变密。
cues.captionEn: Farther slits make closer fringes.
cues.zh: 只把两道缝的中心拉开，保留每道缝的宽度和光的波长。现在屏幕上移动同样的距离，两路光程差变得更多，更快地经历同相和反相，所以亮暗条纹挤得更密。控制这一层细条纹的，是两道缝之间的距离。
cues.en: Move the slit centres farther apart, keeping their widths and the wavelength fixed. Now the same movement across the screen produces a greater change in path difference. The fields cycle between agreement and opposition more quickly, so the fringes crowd together. Slit separation controls this fine spacing.

cues.title: 波长变长，条纹变疏
cues.caption: 波长变长，条纹变疏。
cues.captionEn: Longer wavelengths spread the fringes.
cues.zh: 再固定两道缝，让光从短波长变成长波长。想让两路重新同相，现在需要多走更长的一段路。因此要沿屏幕移得更远，才遇到下一轮同相，条纹也就疏开了。比较颜色之前，先看毫米刻度上的条纹间距怎样变化。
cues.en: Keep the slits fixed and increase the wavelength. To bring the fields back into phase, the extra path must now be longer. You have to move farther across the screen to reach the next agreement, so the fringes spread apart. Follow the millimetre scale as the colour changes.

cues.title: 缝变宽，包络变窄
cues.caption: 缝变宽，外层包络变窄。
cues.captionEn: Wider slits narrow the outer envelope.
cues.zh: 两道缝的中心不动，只把每道缝加宽。细条纹的间隔基本不变，罩在外面的衍射包络却收窄了，因为每一道缝内部的电场也会相消。此处按当前单缝中央光强归一化，只比较图样形状，不比较加宽后总共透过多少光。
cues.en: Keep the slit centres fixed and widen each opening. The fine spacing stays almost unchanged, but the diffraction envelope narrows: contributions within each slit also cancel. Here the reference is the current single-slit central intensity. We are comparing pattern shapes, rather than measuring how much total light passes through.

cues.title: 一个点，一个点地积累
cues.caption: 一次次探测，积累出条纹。
cues.captionEn: Individual detections build up the fringes.
cues.zh: 最后只记录一次次到达。最初几个点很零散，积累多了，亮暗条纹慢慢显出来。在两种过缝可能性保持相干的理想单光子实验里，这个强度图样对应探测概率。这里的点按概率抽样，只记录到达位置，没有替光子指定途中走哪条路。
cues.en: Now record individual arrivals. A few dots look scattered; many gradually reveal the fringes. For an ideal single-photon experiment with coherent alternatives through the slits, this intensity pattern gives the detection probability after normalization. These dots sample that probability. They record arrival positions without assigning a photon a definite route.

cues.title: 没有电池，也能回应
cues.caption: 先从场里取得能量，再借同一个场回答。
cues.captionEn: The reader's field carries both power and a reply.
