cues.zh: 这张标签没有电池。读卡器靠近，芯片却醒了过来。它先从读卡器的场里取得能量，再借同一个场回答。我们跟着标签上的这一圈导线，拆开这次看似瞬间完成的对话。
cues.en: This tag has no battery. Yet bring a reader close, and its chip wakes up. First it takes energy from the reader's field. Then it uses that same field to answer. Follow the tag's coil as we open up this brief exchange.

cues.title: 变化的磁通，感应出电压
cues.caption: 穿过标签线圈的磁通在变，交流电压随之产生。
cues.captionEn: Changing flux through the tag coil induces an alternating voltage.
cues.zh: 读卡线圈里的电流不断换向，周围的磁场也跟着变化。真实电流每秒完成一千三百五十六万次完整振荡，画面已大幅放慢。变化的磁通穿过标签线圈，在线圈两端感应出交流电压。
cues.en: The reader's coil carries an alternating current, creating a changing magnetic field. In reality, it completes thirteen point five six million cycles each second. We have slowed it down. Changing magnetic flux through the tag's coil induces an alternating voltage.

cues.title: 把交流变成芯片的电源
cues.titleEn: Turn the induced voltage into a supply
cues.caption: 整流统一极性，储能电容缓冲供电波动。
cues.captionEn: Rectification and stored energy provide the chip's supply.
cues.zh: 芯片需要更稳定的电源。看这幅整流示意：它把两种方向的输入变成同一极性的输出，再由储能电容缓冲波动。只有供电足够，标签才能处理指令。这里展示功能，真实芯片的电路会更复杂。
cues.en: The chip needs a steadier supply. In this rectifier illustration, both input polarities become one output polarity. A storage capacitor smooths the supply. With enough power, the tag can process a command. This shows the function; the circuit inside a real chip is more complex.

cues.title: 读卡器把问题放进包络
cues.titleEn: The reader asks through the envelope
cues.caption: 读卡器短暂改变载波幅度，标签识别编码。
cues.captionEn: Brief carrier-amplitude changes encode the reader's question.
cues.zh: 读卡器开始发问了。快速振荡的载波里，出现一串短暂停顿。暂停的位置按照编码规则安排，标签从包络中识别这些变化。这里放大一小段信号，看信息怎样搭上供能的通道，并没有重演完整的通信协议。
cues.en: Now the reader asks a question. The rapidly oscillating carrier contains a pattern of brief pauses. Their positions follow an encoding rule. The tag detects those changes in the envelope. We have enlarged a short signal segment to show information riding on the power link, rather than a complete protocol exchange.

cues.title: 切换负载，就是回答
cues.caption: 标签改变负载，读卡线圈也能察觉变化。
cues.captionEn: A load change at the tag also changes the reader's current.
cues.zh: 轮到标签回答。看这个开关：它接入、断开一份负载，改变标签线圈的电流。互感也把这点变化带回读卡线圈。读卡器检测它，就能接收回答。这叫负载调制，标签不用另造一个强载波。
cues.en: To answer, the tag switches an extra load in and out. That changes the current in its coil. Through mutual coupling, the change also appears at the reader's coil. The reader detects it as a reply. This is load modulation; the tag needs no separate strong carrier.

cues.title: 跟住同一串比特
cues.caption: 开关节奏变成电流变化，再还原成同一串比特。
cues.captionEn: Switching becomes current changes, then the same bits again.
cues.zh: 跟住这串比特。每一位决定哪半段出现快速的负载切换，读卡器的电流也留下对应的细纹。接收端识别这些节奏，再还原出原来的序列。读卡器一直提供载波，而回答的信息来自标签对负载的控制。
cues.en: Follow this sequence of bits. Each bit selects which half contains a burst of rapid load switching. Matching ripples appear in the reader's current. The receiver recognizes the pattern and recovers the original sequence. The reader still supplies the carrier; the tag supplies the information by controlling its load.

cues.title: 为什么要靠近、对准
cues.caption: 供电和回传都依赖耦合；靠近后，还要对准。
cues.captionEn: Both power and the reply depend on useful coil coupling.
cues.zh: 先把间隙拉大。耦合减弱，拉得足够远，供电和回应都不足以维持通信。移回来，再把标签转一转：朝向也会影响耦合。重新靠近、对准，对话恢复。读取成功本身不代表身份已验证，也不代表支付完成。
cues.en: First increase the gap. Coupling weakens, and far enough away, power and the reply become insufficient. Bring the tag back, then turn it: orientation matters too. Closeness and alignment restore the exchange. A successful read alone does not prove identity or complete a payment.

cues.title: 一个中子，一滴核
cues.caption: 吸收一个中子后，核像液滴一样裂开。
cues.captionEn: After absorbing a neutron, the nucleus splits like a drop.
cues.zh: 看这颗铀-235 的核。一个慢中子靠近，被它吸收，核变成受激的铀-236，开始像一滴液体那样晃动。拉长，出现细颈，然后断开：两块碎片朝相反方向飞走，同时甩出三个新的中子。一次裂变，就放出大约一百七十三兆电子伏的能量。
cues.en: Watch this uranium-235 nucleus. A slow neutron drifts in and is absorbed. The nucleus becomes excited uranium-236 and begins to wobble like a drop of liquid. It stretches, a narrow neck forms, and it snaps. Two fragments fly apart, and three fresh neutrons are thrown out. One fission releases about 173 million electron-volts.

cues.title: 能量从结合能来
cues.caption: 碎片结合得更紧，多出的结合能变成动能。
cues.captionEn: Fragments are bound more tightly; the surplus becomes motion.
cues.zh: 能量从哪里来？这条曲线是每个核子的结合能。铁附近最高，铀在右端偏低。裂开后，钡和氪这两块碎片都落到曲线更高的位置：碎片里每个核子多绑紧了大约零点八兆电子伏。两百多个核子加起来，再扣掉放出两个多余中子的花费，就是那一百七十三兆电子伏。作为对比，一次化学反应每个原子只有几个电子伏，在这张图上连一个像素都画不出来。
cues.en: Where does the energy come from? This curve is the binding energy per nucleon. Iron sits near the top; uranium lies lower at the far right. After the split, barium and krypton both land higher on the curve: each nucleon in the fragments is bound about 0.8 million electron-volts more tightly. Add that up over more than two hundred nucleons, subtract the cost of freeing two extra neutrons, and you get those 173 million electron-volts. A chemical reaction gives a few electron-volts per atom. On this chart it would not fill a single pixel.

cues.title: 一代接一代
cues.caption: 每一代都比上一代多，几十代后就是天文数字。
cues.captionEn: Each generation outnumbers the last; eighty generations later, astronomical.
cues.zh: 每次裂变放出两到三个中子。如果它们都留在材料里，每个又能引发新的裂变，就长出这样一棵家族树：一，二，二，五，十二，二十五。少数中子被俘获，掉了队，但整体每一代大约是上一代的两倍多。一代只需要大约十纳秒。看右边的对数刻度：八十代之后，中子数已经超过十的二十四次方，而这总共不到一微秒。
cues.en: Every fission releases two or three neutrons. If they all stay inside the material and each one causes another fission, a family tree grows: one, two, two, five, twelve, twenty-five. A few neutrons are captured and drop out, but on average each generation is still more than twice the last. One generation takes only about ten nanoseconds. Look at the logarithmic scale on the right: after eighty generations the count passes ten to the twenty-fourth, and less than a microsecond has gone by.

cues.title: 小球：中子漏掉了
cues.caption: 球太小，中子还没碰上核就飞出去了。
cues.captionEn: Too small a sphere: neutrons escape before they collide.
cues.zh: 现在把同样的材料做成一个小球，半径只有一点六个平均自由程。从中心放出一个中子，跟着它走：每一段直线是一次飞行，拐点是一次碰撞。看蓝点，那是中子离开球面的位置。球太小，大多数中子还没碰到几个核就漏出去了。增殖因子 k 只有零点六七，每一代都比上一代少，链式反应几步就熄灭。
cues.en: Now shape the same material into a small sphere, with a radius of only 1.6 mean free paths. Release one neutron at the centre and follow it: each straight run is a flight, each bend a collision. The blue dots mark where neutrons leave the surface. The sphere is too small, so most neutrons escape after only a few collisions. The multiplication factor k is just 0.67. Every generation is smaller than the last, and the chain dies out within a few steps.

cues.title: 大球：过了临界
cues.caption: 体积长得比表面快；过了临界半径，链自己延续。
cues.captionEn: Volume outgrows surface; past the critical radius the chain sustains itself.
cues.zh: 把球慢慢做大。产生中子的核数随体积增长，漏出的机会随表面增长，体积长得更快，所以 k 一路上升。标记越过虚线的那一刻，k 等于一，这就是临界半径。继续到四点五个自由程，k 约为一点五。再从中心放出一个中子：这一次，漏出的仍然不少，但每一代留下的中子比上一代更多，链式反应自己延续下去。
cues.en: Let the sphere grow. The number of nuclei that produce neutrons rises with volume, while the chance of leaking rises with surface area. Volume wins, so k climbs. The moment the marker crosses the dashed line, k equals one: that is the critical radius. Keep going to 4.5 mean free paths and k is about 1.5. Release one neutron at the centre again. Plenty still leak out, but every generation now leaves more neutrons than the last, and the chain sustains itself.

cues.title: 反应堆与炸弹
cues.caption: 同样的 k，反应堆靠缓发中子留出调节的时间。
cues.captionEn: Same k, but delayed neutrons give a reactor time to respond.
cues.zh: 反应堆和炸弹用的是同一套物理，差别在 k 和代时间。反应堆把 k 控制在一附近。只靠瞬发中子，哪怕 k 只有一点零零一，灰线也会在一秒内失控。但有一小部分中子要等碎片衰变后才放出，平均晚十几秒，把代时间拉长到近零点一秒。蓝线一分钟才翻一倍，控制棒来得及调节。橙线是 k 等于一点五、每代十纳秒的链，约一微秒就冲到顶。
cues.en: A reactor and a bomb share the same physics; the difference is k and the generation time. A reactor holds k near one. With prompt neutrons alone, even k = 1.001 runs away within a second, as the grey line shows. But a small fraction of neutrons appear only after the fragments decay, more than ten seconds late, stretching the generation time to nearly a tenth of a second. The blue line takes a minute to double, and control rods can keep up. The orange line is k = 1.5 with ten nanoseconds per generation: it reaches the top in about a microsecond.

cues.title: 它为什么会停
cues.caption: 一膨胀，密度下降，k 跌回一以下，反应自己停下。
cues.captionEn: Expansion lowers density, k drops below one, and the reaction stops itself.
cues.zh: 增长如此之快，它是怎么停下来的？能量让材料急剧升温、膨胀。质量没有变，但密度下降，中子在两次碰撞之间要飞得更远，同样的球按平均自由程来量反而变小了。看标记沿曲线往回滑：膨胀到一点三四倍时 k 回到一，再大一点就跌回次临界。新放出的中子又开始漏掉，链式反应自己熄灭。这一切发生在不到一微秒里，只有一小部分原子核来得及裂变。
cues.en: If it grows this fast, how does it ever stop? The energy heats the material violently and it expands. The mass is unchanged, but the density falls, so a neutron travels farther between collisions. Measured in mean free paths, the same sphere is now smaller. Watch the marker slide back along the curve: at 1.34 times the original size k returns to one, and a little further it drops below. Newly released neutrons leak away again and the chain dies out. All of this happens in under a microsecond, and only a small fraction of the nuclei ever fission.

cues.title: 靠近，然后被推开
cues.caption: 两个核带正电，靠近就互相推开。
cues.captionEn: Both nuclei are positive; closeness pushes them apart.
cues.zh: 跟住这颗粉色的氚核。它朝着氘核冲过去，可两个核都带正电，越近，推力越大。火焰的温度只让它走到几百万飞米就折返；太阳核心能让它爬到七百多飞米；一亿多度，也只到一百飞米左右，离三飞米的接触点还差得远。让它们真正相遇的，是最后那一点隧穿的概率。
cues.en: Follow the pink tritium nucleus. It rushes toward the deuterium, but both are positive, and the closer they get, the harder they push apart. A flame turns it back millions of femtometres out. The Sun's core lets it climb to about seven hundred. Even above a hundred million kelvin it stops near one hundred, far from the three-femtometre contact point. What finally lets them meet is a tiny chance of tunnelling through.

cues.title: 合上以后，能量从哪里来
cues.caption: 氦-4 绑得更紧，多出的能量被释放。
cues.captionEn: Helium-4 is bound tighter; the surplus is released.
cues.zh: 看这条结合能曲线的左端。氘和氚每个核子只绑住一到三兆电子伏，而氦四高得多，每个核子超过七兆电子伏。把氘和氚合成氦四，再放出一个中子，多出来的十七点六兆电子伏就变成了动能，大部分由中子带走。按每个核子算，这比铀裂变还多四倍以上。
cues.en: Look at the left end of the binding-energy curve. Deuterium and tritium hold each nucleon with only one to three MeV, while helium-4 sits far higher, above seven MeV per nucleon. Fuse deuterium and tritium into helium-4, release a neutron, and the surplus 17.6 MeV becomes motion, most of it carried by the neutron. Per nucleon, that is more than four times what uranium fission gives.

cues.title: 温度决定分布的尾巴
cues.caption: 只有分布尾巴上的少数核对能穿过势垒。
cues.captionEn: Only the few pairs in the tail can tunnel through.
cues.zh: 现在把温度升上去。三千开时，所有核对的能量都挤在最左边那根针里。到了太阳核心的温度，分布才开始摊开；一亿多度时，尾巴伸到了几十千电子伏。紫色虚线是隧穿概率，随能量陡升。把分布和它相乘，中间出现这个亮色的峰，叫伽莫夫峰，聚变几乎全在这里发生。
cues.en: Now raise the temperature. At three thousand kelvin, every pair's energy is squeezed into that needle at the far left. At the Sun's core temperature the distribution begins to spread; above a hundred million kelvin its tail reaches tens of keV. The violet dashed line is the tunnelling probability, climbing steeply with energy. Multiply the two and the bright peak in the middle appears: the Gamow peak, where almost all fusion happens.

cues.title: 反应率随温度陡升
cues.caption: 温度提高几倍，反应率提高几千倍。
cues.captionEn: A few times hotter, thousands of times faster.
cues.zh: 把每一对核的平均反应率画在对数图上。亮点从一千电子伏走到三万电子伏，曲线几乎直着往上冲。从太阳核心到一亿度，温度只高了八倍，反应率却高了近四千倍。下面那条淡紫色曲线是氘氘反应，同样温度下慢一百倍。三千开的火焰远在图的左边之外，那里的反应率实际上是零。
cues.en: Here is the average reaction rate per pair on a logarithmic chart. As the bright dot moves from one to thirty keV, the curve shoots almost straight up. From the Sun's core to a hundred million kelvin the temperature rises eight times, yet the rate rises nearly four thousand times. The paler violet curve below is deuterium with deuterium, a hundred times slower. A flame lies far off the left edge, where the rate is effectively zero.

cues.title: 只有裂变能点燃它
cues.caption: 裂变火球的辐射把聚变燃料压紧、加热。
cues.captionEn: A fission fireball's radiation squeezes and heats the fuel.
cues.zh: 看这架温度阶梯。化学火焰停在三千开，亮点纹丝不动，燃料毫无反应。只有一次裂变爆炸能在瞬间到达一亿度，它放出的辐射加热并压缩分开放置的聚变燃料。这团燃料被压得越小，密度越高，单位体积的反应率按密度的平方增长。压缩一千倍后，燃料飞散前烧掉的份额从不到千分之一升到大约百分之八。
cues.en: Watch the temperature ladder. A chemical flame stops at three thousand kelvin; the marker does not move and the fuel does nothing. Only a fission explosion reaches a hundred million kelvin in an instant, and its radiation heats and compresses the separately placed fusion fuel. As the fuel sphere shrinks, density rises and the rate per volume grows with density squared. Compressed a thousand times, the share burned before the fuel flies apart rises from under a tenth of a percent to about eight percent.

cues.title: 燃料自带下一份氚
cues.titleEn: Fuel that makes its own tritium
cues.caption: 中子把锂变成氚，燃料在燃烧中补给自己。
cues.captionEn: Neutrons turn lithium into tritium; the fuel restocks itself.
cues.zh: 氚有放射性，存不住，所以燃料用固体氘化锂。跟住这颗刚生成的中子：它带着十四兆电子伏飞出去，撞上一个锂六核，锂六裂成一个氚核和一个氦核，还多放出四点八兆电子伏。新的氚回到起点，继续和氘反应。飞出去的快中子也能让周围的铀核裂变，再放出一份能量。
cues.en: Tritium is radioactive and cannot be stored, so the fuel is solid lithium deuteride. Follow the newly made neutron: it flies off with fourteen MeV, strikes a lithium-6 nucleus, and lithium-6 splits into tritium and helium, releasing another 4.8 MeV. The new tritium returns to the start and reacts with deuterium again. Fast neutrons escaping the fuel can also fission surrounding uranium, releasing more energy.

cues.title: 三种留住高温的办法
cues.titleEn: Three ways to hold the heat
cues.caption: 同一反应，三种约束。
cues.captionEn: One reaction, three kinds of confinement.
cues.zh: 同样的氘氚反应，要自持燃烧，密度、温度和约束时间的乘积得超过这条虚线。托卡马克用磁场，把稀薄的等离子体留住大约一秒。惯性约束走另一头：密度高出十一个多数量级，只留住一百亿分之一秒，二零二二年国家点火装置就这样首次实现点火。太阳则靠引力永久约束，烧的是慢得多的质子链，它有的是体积和时间。
cues.en: For the same D–T reaction to sustain itself, density times temperature times confinement time must cross this dashed line. A tokamak uses magnetic fields to hold a thin plasma for about a second. Inertial confinement takes the other end: density eleven orders of magnitude higher, held for a ten-billionth of a second. That is how the National Ignition Facility first reached ignition in 2022. The Sun confines by gravity and burns the far slower proton chain; it has volume and time to spare.

cues.title: 旋转的机翼
cues.caption: 机身原地不动，桨叶仍迎着空气。
cues.captionEn: The cabin stays still; the blades meet the air.
cues.zh: 直升机没有沿跑道加速，为什么还能飞起来？先盯住铜色的这片桨叶。它绕着主轴转动，本身就在相对空气运动。旋翼其实是一组旋转的机翼。悬停时，整副旋翼向上的推力，恰好抵住直升机的重量。画面放慢了旋转，让我们看清每一步。
cues.en: The cabin is staying in one place, yet the helicopter can stay aloft. Follow the copper blade. Rotation keeps that wing moving through the air. In a steady hover, the rotor’s upward thrust balances the aircraft’s weight. The rotation is slowed here so we can follow it.

cues.title: 桨距与空气
cues.caption: 桨距改变迎角，也改变剖面升力。
cues.captionEn: Pitch changes the angle of attack and section lift.
cues.zh: 把铜色桨叶切出一个剖面。看它的前缘抬起来：这就是桨距增加。空气除了掠过桨叶，还带着向下的入流，所以桨距和迎角并不相同。在这里的正常工作范围内，迎角增大，升力也会增大。旋翼把空气推向下，空气给旋翼向上的力。
cues.en: Look at a section of the copper blade. Its leading edge rises as blade pitch increases. The incoming air also has a downward component, so pitch and angle of attack are different angles. Within this model’s range, increasing the angle of attack increases lift. The rotor sends air downward.

cues.title: 一起改变桨距
cues.caption: 总距一起增加，两片桨叶一起增升力。
cues.captionEn: Collective raises both blades’ pitch together.
cues.zh: 现在把两片桨叶放在一起看。总距控制让它们的桨距同时增加相同的量，而旋翼转速保持不变。看主旋翼推力的读数：超过重量时，直升机就有向上的加速度。总距回到悬停值，受力重新平衡。真实飞行还要协调发动机功率，并考虑已经产生的运动。
cues.en: Now watch both blades. Collective pitch adds the same amount to each blade while rotor speed stays constant. Thrust rises above weight, giving an upward acceleration. Restoring the hover setting restores the force balance. This comparison shows instantaneous forces; an actual aircraft also has motion and engine power to manage.

cues.title: 一圈内的变化
cues.caption: 同一片桨叶，每转一圈改变一次桨距。
cues.captionEn: Each blade’s pitch varies around the circle.
cues.zh: 跟着铜色桨叶走一圈。周期变距让这片桨叶在某些方位增大桨距，在另一些方位减小桨距。对侧桨叶正好处在半圈之外，所以它们此刻的桨距不同。曲线记录的是同一片桨叶，而不是两片不同的桨叶。真实旋翼还会挥舞；这里只展示桨距变化本身。
cues.en: Follow the copper blade around one complete turn. Cyclic pitch makes its pitch larger at some positions and smaller at others. The opposite blade is half a turn away, so its pitch differs. The curve belongs to one tracked blade. Real rotor flapping adds dynamics that this pitch illustration omits.

cues.title: 把推力倾斜
cues.caption: 推力倾斜后，一部分指向水平方向。
cues.captionEn: Tilt gives the thrust a horizontal component.
cues.zh: 再看这架直升机，让旋翼盘缓缓倾斜。盯住主轴上的青色箭头，它始终指向旋翼盘的法线方向。真实旋翼通过周期变距和挥舞改变盘面方向，这里给定一个倾盘姿态。总推力现在既有垂直分量，也有水平分量：一部分托住重量，一部分让机体开始向前加速。
cues.en: Watch the same helicopter as its rotor disk tilts. The teal arrow at the mast stays perpendicular to the disk. Real cyclic control and flapping change that orientation; here we prescribe the pose. Thrust now has two components: a vertical part supporting weight, and a horizontal part providing forward acceleration.

cues.title: 尾桨抵住什么
cues.caption: 尾桨侧推产生力矩，抵住机身反扭矩。
cues.captionEn: Tail thrust counters the airframe’s reaction torque.
cues.zh: 主旋翼转动，需要发动机给它扭矩。机身同时受到反方向的扭矩。看尾桨处的青色侧推箭头：侧推力隔着一根长尾梁，产生反向力矩。让尾桨补偿变小，两条力矩条就不再相等；恢复补偿，它们重新平衡。真实飞行还需要处理尾桨带来的侧向力。
cues.en: Turning the main rotor requires torque. The airframe receives an opposite reaction. Look at the teal arrow at the tail rotor: its sideways force acts through a long lever arm. Reduce that compensation and the two moments no longer balance. Restore it and they match. Real flight must also balance the sideways force.

cues.title: 倾斜后重新平衡
cues.caption: 补足垂直分量，水平分量仍然保留。
cues.captionEn: Restore vertical balance while keeping horizontal thrust.
cues.zh: 最后保留旋翼盘的倾角。总推力虽然没有变小，垂直分量却比重量少了一点。缓缓增加总距，直到垂直推力再次等于重量。注意，水平分量并没有消失。这就是控制需要配合的原因：总距改变推力大小，周期变距改变旋翼盘方向，尾桨管理偏航力矩。
cues.en: Keep the disk tilted for the final comparison. Its vertical thrust is slightly below the weight. Increase collective until those two forces match again. A horizontal component remains. The controls work together: collective changes thrust magnitude, cyclic changes disk orientation, and the tail rotor manages yaw torque. This is a near-hover teaching model.

cues.title: 一条能量线
cues.caption: 跟住导气活塞与枪机框。
cues.captionEn: Follow the piston and carrier.
cues.zh: 看这件二十世纪的机械器物。今天跟住一条能量线。外壳变浅后，银色的活塞杆连着枪机框。接下来，靠近观察这组相连的部件，看看一股短暂的燃气能量，怎样让同一组部件走完一次往返。
cues.en: Look at this object from twentieth-century mechanical history. We will follow an energy path through it. As the exterior fades, a steel piston rod connects to the carrier. A closer view keeps their physical connection visible. How does one brief input move the linked assembly away, and then bring it back?

cues.title: 燃气做功
cues.caption: 短暂输入，让联动组开始移动。
cues.captionEn: A brief input starts the assembly moving.
cues.zh: 能量的起点不是弹簧。推进剂释放化学能，燃气膨胀，其中一部分经过导气支路，对活塞做功。跟住亮起的铜色能量线，运动能量开始增加。气体给予的是一段短暂的推动，而运动与储能还会在后面的过程里继续发生。
cues.en: The spring is not the original energy source. Propellant releases chemical energy, and part of the expanding gas does work on the piston through a gas branch. Follow the copper energy path as motion begins. The input is brief, while movement and energy storage continue beyond it. Stored energy keeps moving between forms.

cues.title: 始终相连
cues.caption: 活塞与枪机框保持连接。
cues.captionEn: Piston and carrier stay connected.
cues.zh: 现在只看银色的活塞杆与枪机框。它们一同后移，中间没有分开，两个标志之间的距离也没有变化。长行程导气强调的正是这种联动关系：活塞和枪机框一起经历这段运动。留意活塞杆的末端，再留意枪机框：它们的运动来自同一个相连的整体。
cues.en: Watch the steel piston rod and the carrier. They move rearward together, without separating. The distance between them remains fixed. This linked movement is the central idea of long-stroke gas operation: the piston stays connected to the carrier. Follow the end of the piston rod, then the carrier. They belong to the same moving assembly.

cues.title: 把运动存起来
cues.caption: 运动减慢，弹性储能增加。
cues.captionEn: Motion slows; spring energy grows.
cues.zh: 输入已经结束，运动却还在继续。联动组靠惯性后移，把回位簧压得更紧。留意能量条，运动能量减少，弹性储能增加。到了即将改变方向的位置，部件几乎停住，但能量并没有消失。它主要存进了弹簧，还有一部分在过程中耗散。
cues.en: The input has ended, but the assembly continues rearward through inertia and compresses the return spring. Watch the energy strip: motion energy decreases while elastic energy increases. Near the turning point, the assembly almost stops. Its energy has not vanished. Much is stored in the spring, and some has been dissipated.

cues.title: 把能量交回来
cues.caption: 输入已停，弹簧驱动回程。
cues.captionEn: The input ends; the spring drives the return.
cues.zh: 现在，弹簧把先前存下的能量交回来。它逐渐展开，推动同一组部件向前返回；绿色的储能减少，铜色的运动能量重新增加。注意，这时并没有新的输入。弹簧能让机构回程，靠的是刚才的储存，而不是自己产生了能量。
cues.en: Now the spring gives back energy stored earlier. As it expands, it moves the same linked assembly forward. The green share of stored energy falls, while copper motion energy rises again. Notice that there is no new input during this return. The spring transfers energy; it does not create its own supply.

cues.title: 同位不同向
cues.caption: 位置相同，方向相反。
cues.captionEn: Same position, opposite directions.
cues.zh: 把去程和回程放在一起，选同一个位置。两根弹簧压得一样紧，所以弹性储能相同；运动箭头却指向相反方向。同一个位置，可以对应两种不同的运动状态。再看灰色的耗散，它一直累积，因此有损耗时，返回时的运动能量也不必和去程相等。
cues.en: Compare the outward and returning states at one position. The springs have the same compression and the same elastic energy, but the arrows point in opposite directions. Position alone cannot describe the motion. The gray dissipation has accumulated along the journey, so the two motion energies need not be equal either.

cues.title: 一轮能量路径
cues.caption: 位置回来了，能量已转移。
cues.captionEn: Position returns; energy has been transferred.
cues.zh: 最后把这一条路径连起来：短暂输入，联动后移，弹簧储能，再驱动返回。回到边界后，教学模型把剩余运动能量计入耗散，整轮停止。位置回到起点，不代表能量也恢复了。本篇解释的是这个宏观关系，真实枪械还包含许多这里没有模拟的机构和控制条件。
cues.en: Join the path into one excursion: a brief input, linked rearward movement, elastic storage, and a spring-driven return. At the boundary, our teaching model dissipates the remaining motion energy and stops. Returning to the starting position does not restore the energy. Real firearms include additional mechanisms and control conditions beyond this conceptual model.

cues.title: 地表之下
cues.caption: 切面打开，地雷位置没有改变。
cues.captionEn: The section opens; the mine stays fixed.
cues.zh: 先看这片普通地面，草和落叶遮住了下面。教学镜头打开一个地层切面，地雷外壳才露出来。它一直留在同一位置，下方仍与土层接触。这不是挖掘过程，只是把被遮挡的空间显出来。看不见，不代表那里没有危险。
cues.en: Begin with ordinary ground, covered by grass and leaves. A teaching section opens to reveal a landmine casing. The object has stayed in the same place, in contact with the soil beneath it. This is an observation cut, not an excavation. Something hidden has not necessarily ceased to be dangerous.

cues.title: 完整外壳近看
cues.caption: 外壳保持封闭，镜头观察外部轮廓。
cues.captionEn: The camera explores the sealed exterior.
cues.zh: 镜头靠近，先看圆盘外壳，再看上方覆盖件、卷边和侧面的把手。这份外观参考一件博物馆收藏的反坦克地雷，内部始终没有打开。不同地雷的形式和触发方式并不相同。外形能帮助我们理解对象，却不能据此试探或判断实际状态。
cues.en: Move closer to the circular casing, its top cover, rolled edges and side handle. The exterior draws on a museum collection of an anti-tank mine; its interior stays closed. Landmines differ in form and activation. An exterior helps us understand the object, but it is no invitation to test its condition.

cues.title: 静止的外表，储存的能量
cues.caption: 外壳静止，不代表没有储能。
cues.captionEn: A still exterior does not mean no stored energy.
cues.zh: 从外面看，壳体可以一直安静不动。但地雷把某些外部事件和储存能量的快速释放联系起来。触发是一个事件，不是全部爆炸能量的来源；能量来自事先储存的化学能。这里继续保留完整外壳，只解释这个关系，不演示按压，也不模拟爆炸。
cues.en: The casing can look completely still. Yet a landmine connects certain external events to the rapid release of stored energy. Triggering is an event, not the source of all the explosive energy: that energy was stored chemically beforehand. The exterior remains closed while we explain the distinction, without pressing the object or simulating a blast.

cues.title: 地表在变，物体仍在
cues.caption: 草与落叶变化，同一外壳留在原位。
cues.captionEn: Cover changes around the same casing.
cues.zh: 回到土层，继续追踪同一枚地雷。草的高度和落叶覆盖发生变化，外壳与土壤的接触位置没有变化。地面可以变得很不一样，却没有提供安全结论。教学切面只保留观察机会；它不是探测设备的视野，也不是清理地面的指导。
cues.en: Return to the soil and follow the same mine. Grass height and leaf cover change; the casing keeps the same contact with the ground. A different-looking surface does not establish safety. Our teaching section preserves the view, but it is neither a detector image nor guidance for clearing the ground.

cues.title: 时间不是安全证据
cues.caption: 时间前进，状态仍是未知。
cues.captionEn: Time advances; the state stays unknown.
cues.zh: 再把时间拉长：当时，后来，多年以后。地雷的位置没有自动消失，安全状态也没有自动改变。地雷和其他遗留爆炸物可能持续危险许多年。战斗结束、植被恢复，或者很久没有发生事故，都不能代替专业核查。
cues.en: Now extend the passage of time: then, later, and years afterward. The mine does not automatically disappear, and the display supplies no safe verdict. Landmines and other explosive remnants can stay dangerous for many years. An ended conflict, returning vegetation or a long quiet interval cannot substitute for professional assessment.

cues.title: 磨损也不是答案
cues.caption: 涂层和磨损可见，安全状态仍未知。
cues.captionEn: Visible wear; unknown safety.
cues.zh: 近看外壳的涂层、磨损和泥土。它们让这个物体显得真实，却不能告诉我们内部是否安全。旧，不等于失效；外形完整，也不等于可以触碰。这个画面里的磨损是固定的外观细节，不是一把测量危险程度的尺子。
cues.en: Look closely at the coating, wear and traces of soil. These details make the object tangible, but they do not reveal whether its interior is safe. Old does not mean inert; intact does not mean touchable. The wear here is fixed visual detail, not a scale that measures how dangerous the object is.

cues.title: 让观察停在接触之前
cues.caption: 不靠近、不触碰，联系当地专业机构。
cues.captionEn: Do not approach or touch. Contact professionals.
cues.zh: 最后，镜头回到同一片土层。理解原理，是为了不把好奇变成接触。发现可疑物，不靠近、不触碰，并联系当地主管部门或专业排雷机构。遵循当地官方风险提示。我们能够回放的是教学画面，真实物体的判断和处理需要专业人员。
cues.en: The camera returns to the same soil. Understanding the idea should keep curiosity from becoming contact. If you encounter a suspicious object, do not approach or touch it. Contact local authorities or a professional mine-action organization, and follow local official guidance. Replaying a lesson is safe; assessing a real object requires professionals.

cues.title: 按下一颗键
cues.caption: 轴心下移，弹簧压缩，触点接通。
cues.captionEn: The stem moves; the spring compresses; contacts meet.
cues.zh: 按下一颗键，键帽带着轴心往下走。看剖面里的弹簧，它在压缩；再看金属触点，它们从分开变成接通。松开后，弹簧让轴心回升。接下来，我们保留这些部件的位置，只改变真正造成差异的结构。
cues.en: Press one key and follow the stem beneath its keycap. The spring compresses, while a pair of metal contacts changes from separated to connected. Release the key and the spring lifts the stem again. Keep these parts in view as we change the structures that make switches behave differently.

cues.title: 红与黑：同为线性
cues.caption: 没有段落，不代表按起来一样重。
cues.captionEn: A smooth stroke can still require different forces.
cues.zh: 先比较这里的红轴和黑轴。它们都没有明显的段落，轴心平顺下移；黑轴的弹簧阻力更大。同样压到触发位置，红轴标称四十五厘牛，黑轴六十厘牛。线性说的是力的变化形状，不是完全恒定，也不等于静音。
cues.en: Compare these Red and Black examples at the same depth. Both move smoothly without a tactile bump, but Black resists more strongly. Their nominal actuation forces are forty-five and sixty centinewtons. Linear describes the shape of the force response. It does not mean constant force, and it does not promise silence.

cues.title: 茶轴的段落从哪来？
cues.titleEn: Where the tactile bump comes from
cues.caption: 轮廓越过弹片，阻力先升后降。
cues.captionEn: The profile bends the leaf. Resistance rises, then falls.
cues.zh: 把轴心换成茶轴，近看它碰到弹片的那段轮廓。凸起挤过弹片时，阻力先增加，再下降，手指便感觉到一个段落。弹簧仍在压缩，变化来自轮廓与弹片的配合。这种触觉提示，不需要额外的发声套件。
cues.en: Now watch the shaped surface on the Brown stem meet the metal leaf. As the raised profile passes it, resistance builds and then drops. That change is the bump your finger feels. The return spring is still compressing; the profile and leaf add tactile feedback without a separate click-making jacket.

cues.title: 青轴多了一件会动的零件
cues.caption: 白色套件快速跳移，形成发声事件。
cues.captionEn: The white jacket jumps, creating a click event.
cues.zh: 青轴的轴心分成两件。盯住蓝色轴心和白色套件：越过段落附近，白色套件会相对轴心快速跳移，产生点击声。触觉变化、发声和电信号是有关联的事件，却不是同一件事。松开时再看一次，白色套件跟随轴心复位，为下一次按压做好准备。
cues.en: Blue uses a two-piece stem. Follow the blue stem and its white jacket: near the tactile transition, the jacket moves abruptly relative to the stem and produces a click. The force change, sound and electrical signal are related but different events. Watch the release: the jacket returns with the stem, ready for another press.

cues.title: 触发，不必按到底
cues.caption: 触发、触底和复位，是三个观察点。
cues.captionEn: Actuation, bottom-out and reset are separate events.
cues.zh: 继续按下，电信号已经出现，轴心却还能再走一段。这里的红轴在两毫米附近触发，总行程约四毫米。触发点不是触底位置。再慢慢松开，观察信号何时消失：回程的复位点也要单独看，不能拿段落峰值或触底力代替它。
cues.en: The signal is already on, yet the stem can travel farther. This Red example actuates at about two millimeters and reaches the bottom at about four. Those are different positions. Now release it slowly and watch the signal turn off. Reset belongs to the return stroke; neither a force peak nor bottom-out tells you where it occurs.

cues.title: 短行程与缓冲，是两种改变
cues.caption: 银轴改变行程；静音轴缓和撞击。
cues.captionEn: Silver shortens travel; damping softens impacts.
cues.zh: 先跟红轴对照银轴。银轴仍然是线性轴，但更早触发，行程也更短；这不等于更小的触发力。再看静音红轴的缓冲部位：按到底和弹回顶端时，缓冲材料减轻硬碰撞。它减少的是一部分机械噪声，不会让整把键盘完全无声。
cues.en: First compare Speed Silver with Red. Silver stays linear but reaches actuation sooner and has less total travel. That does not imply a smaller actuation force. Next, watch the damping pieces on Silent Red at the bottom and top of its stroke. They soften impacts. They reduce mechanical noise rather than make the complete keyboard soundless.

cues.title: 磁轴把位置交给固件
cues.caption: 持续测量位置，再按运动距离更新信号。
cues.captionEn: Position sensing lets firmware follow small reversals.
cues.zh: 换成磁轴，轴心里有磁体，电路板上的霍尔传感器读取位置变化。看同一段往返：固定触发点要等轴心经过指定位置；快速触发则在首次触发后，按回抬和再次下压的距离更新信号。这是位置测量加固件规则，不是弹簧突然变轻，也不是磁轴独有的手感。
cues.en: A magnet now moves with the stem, while a Hall sensor on the board tracks its position. Compare the same motion under two rules. A fixed threshold waits for a specified position; after initial activation, Rapid Trigger uses release and renewed press distances. Position sensing and firmware create that behavior. The spring has not become lighter.

cues.title: 光轴仍有机械运动
cues.caption: 轴心让光路接通，检测无需电触点。
cues.captionEn: Stem movement opens a light path to the receiver.
cues.zh: 这个通光型光轴保留轴心和弹簧。按下时，轴心的开口对准光路，接收器得到光，检测状态随之改变。手指仍在推动机械部件，改变的是检测方式。光轴可以做成线性，也可以有段落或点击结构，不能只凭光学两个字判断手感。
cues.en: This optical example still has a moving stem and a spring. Pressing aligns an opening with the light path, allowing light to reach the receiver and change the detected state. The motion remains mechanical; the sensing method changes. Optical switches can have different force profiles and click mechanisms, so optical alone does not describe their feel.

cues.title: 把三件事分开看
cues.caption: 手感、声音、检测方式，分别比较。
cues.captionEn: Compare feel, sound and sensing separately.
cues.zh: 再看这些轴体：手感来自受力和结构，声音来自振动与撞击，输入来自检测和固件。颜色只是这些代表型号的名字，不是跨品牌标准。没有电接点抖动，也不等于整机零延迟。理解每条因果链，比用一种颜色概括全部差异更准确。
cues.en: Now compare what each switch changes. Structure shapes the force you feel; impacts and vibration shape sound; sensing and firmware determine input. Colors name these particular examples, not a universal standard. Avoiding electrical contact bounce also does not remove every source of keyboard latency. Compare those dimensions separately.
